jobs.title: Data Solution Architect
jobs.description: Millions of records can still leave basic questions unanswered. Which records match? What's missing? Who can see the data? Before an AI Module can use a client's data, someone has to make that data reliable, usable, and secure. That's the work we're hiring for. IntoFocus AI builds governed AI Modules that turn deep subject\-matter expertise into repeatable solutions for defined, valuable business problems across many clients. We're looking for a hands\-on engineer to design, build, and secure the data foundation behind those Modules. Location: Jacksonville, FL. Hybrid, mostly in office, with some at\-home sprint days. Type: Contract\-to\-hire. Target start: November 2026\. The data comes from CRMs, ERPs, accounting systems, databases, APIs, and flat files. It can run to millions of records or more. Some of it is messy. Some of it is sensitive. You'll do the practical engineering work needed to bring it in, transform it, govern it, and serve it reliably and safely. What you'll work on: * Build and maintain ETL and ELT pipelines for large client data sets. * Map, clean, deduplicate, and reconcile records, then verify that the data is complete. * Design reusable schemas and storage that work across many clients. * Protect financial and personal data with least\-privilege access, encryption, secrets management, client data separation, and logging. * Put lineage, retention, validation, monitoring, and quality checks in place. * Prepare and manage data for AI use, including retrieval sources, embeddings, and approved knowledge bases. * Tune data systems for speed, infrastructure cost, and token cost. * Document data flows, definitions, runbooks, and security controls. * Work with our implementation lead and explain data risks in plain language. Client contact is occasional and usually alongside the implementation lead. We're looking for someone who has built data pipelines at volume and is comfortable working in SQL and Python. You should know how to handle complex migrations and reconcile messy data, model it for use beyond a single project, and apply practical security and privacy controls. Clear documentation and the ability to explain a problem without jargon matter here. Experience preparing data for AI or LLM systems is preferred. The core of the role, though, is data engineering: making the foundation sound enough for the work built on top of it. Apply through Indeed. Experience: * SQL, Python, and ETL: 3 years (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Jacksonville, FL 32256

You'll report to the SVP, Design, Product and Technology and work alongside them daily. A lot of the job is the two of you thinking out loud: what's worth building, what it would take, what it would cost. You'll help shape the technical strategy together (architecture direction, build\-versus\-buy, where the platform goes next), with the SVP owning the final call and the direction for product and design. The technical thinking is yours, and we'd much rather hear "here's how we could do that" than "here's why we can't". You'll be the technology counterpart to editorial and commercial leadership. The remit is wider than engineering. Delivery, technical program management, the operational layer, the business systems the company runs on, and the vendors who extend the team all sit with you, and the team beneath you will grow to reflect that. This role is based in the United States and is fully remote.#### **What You'll Do** * Lead and grow the technology team across engineering, delivery and operations. Own the people side fully — hiring, performance, development and the hard conversations — and manage through a manager as the function scales. * Shape the technical strategy with the SVP — architecture direction, build, buy and integrate calls, and where the platform needs to go next. The SVP owns the final decision; you own the thinking that informs it and the delivery that follows. * Turn product direction into shipped work. Own everything between the outcome, standard and date and working software in production — scoping, technical requirements, sequencing, and the commitments we make back to editorial and business stakeholders. * Run delivery across the technology function. Own the cadence, the dependencies and the visibility that lets the rest of the company know what's coming and when. * Answer for what the team ships. Set the standard, review architecture and overrule it on technical grounds where required, and put mechanisms in place that catch problems before production. * Ship code every week. The team is small and everyone here builds, including the people who lead. You'll carry real work of your own — the hard problems, the spikes that set direction, the things that have to land — alongside the team rather than above it. * Stand up new products and evolve the existing ones across news, subscriptions and identity, data and events, including the wind\-down of what the new platform replaces. * Lead security across everything we run: what's exposed, who has access, what's still running that shouldn't be, third\-party risk, and the response when something happens. * Own the content and data spine. You and your team build the spine, not the surface: the interface is design's \- our designers author the design system and ship it to production themselves. Shape the content model, keep the CMS moving, build the APIs and MCP services every surface and every team draws on, and finish that shift across the rest of the estate. * Own the operational layer — environments, CI, previews, observability, and the road to production that lets a designer ship with confidence. * Own the internal systems and tooling the business runs on — the integrations across CRM, events, email and subscriptions, and the services that let business teams work directly with our own data. * Direct the contractors and vendors who extend the team, and hold their output to the same standard as our own. * Get sound AI\-assisted work from non\-engineers live quickly, and know when it isn't sound. * Partner with editorial and business leadership to turn ideas into shipped features at the pace a newsroom requires. #### **Technical Requirement** Our actual stack, not a generic list. We care more about depth than about covering every line. ##### **Hands\-on, every week** * TypeScript, Node.js, modern tooling * Payload CMS on PostgreSQL, or equivalent depth in a headless, code\-first CMS * Content modeling and API design — GraphQL and REST * Next.js, and Astro wi 've owned delivery, operations, vendor relationships and stakeholder commitments — not just the codebase — and you've been the person the business holds to account for technology outcomes. * And a builder every week. Everyone at Endpoints contributes as an IC at some level, and at this team size that includes you. You'll be writing and shipping production code regularly, not symbolically. * You take a short ask and build the right thing. A sentence of business intent is enough for you to come back with what it means technically, what it costs and what it breaks. * Real backend and infrastructure depth, even where you no longer use it daily. You'll be accountable for work you don't write. * You've worked where designers ship their own code. * You've directed contractors and vendors and held their output to your own standard. * A thinking partner. The SVP will bring you ideas and expect a real conversation: what it would take, what it would break, and what a better version might be. You make your case, and you commit once the call is made. * Comfortable being the technical voice in a room of editorial and commercial leaders, and translating in both directions. * A background in media or publishing is a strong plus, not a requirement. #### **Compensation** Total compensation opportunity: \~$215,000, inclusive of \~$175k base and \~$40k annual bonus. *It's important to note that salary information provided in job descriptions is subject to change and may be dependent on a variety of factors such as location, experience, and qualifications. The salary range provided is meant to give potential applicants an idea of the compensation they can expect, but it is not a guarantee of a specific salary. Actual salary may vary based on individual factors and negotiations. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on salary history or other personal factors.*#### **Why Join Us?** **Work From Anywhere!****Positive, Supportive, and Collaborative Work Culture.** **Paid Time Off**: Generous PTO is offered annually, plus 12 company holidays and 2 floating holidays! **Medical Insurance**: Endpoints pays 70% of premiums for employee, spouse, and/or dependents. **Fully\-Paid Benefits for Employees:** Dental and Vision insurance, Short\-Term and Long Term Disability, $50,000 Basic Life and AD\&D Insurance, and our Employee Assistance Program. **Additional Life, Hospital, Critical Illness, and Accident Insurance:** Offered through Guardian. **MDLIVE:** See a doctor, mental health professional, nutritionist, or dermatologist on your time and online! **Family Leave**: All employees are eligible for fully\-paid Primary or Secondary Caregiver Leave for the birth or adoption of a child. **Paid Volunteer Days:** Provides employees with the opportunity to engage in community service \& volunteer activities. **401K:** Endpoints will match 100% of the first 3% of an employee's contribution; followed by 50% match of the next 2%. **Equipment Provided:** Laptop, monitor, and additional equipment needs.**WFH Stipend:** $75 per month to cover the costs of working from home.**Home Office Stipend:** $500 annually to help you create your dream office. **Benefits Marketplace:** We’ve partnered with Bennie to provide discounted products for employees such as other insurances, family planning \& support, behavioral health, wellness, pet insurance, and financial wellness. **MetLife Legal:** We’ve partnered with MetLife Legal Services to provide a discounted legal plan for our employees. *Endpoints News is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diverse backgrounds and thoughts and welcome everyone to apply for employment with us. We are committed to fostering an environment that is inclusive, transparent, and collaborative. Mutual respect is central to how Endpoints News operates, and we believe the best solutions come from diverse perspectives, experiences, and skills. We embrace our differences and know that we are stronger working together.*

jobs.title: Founding Engineer
jobs.description: Tidal Neuro’s mission is to make EEG as routine as ECG. We’re seeking a hands\-on founding engineer with medical\-device experience to build our first EEG and physiological\-data acquisition platform, working directly with the founders and leading clinical and research collaborators. You’ll initially own hardware prototyping, embedded firmware, monitor integration, signal synchronization, and verification. The role includes potential direct collaboration with National Medal of Science recipient Dr. Emery Brown, Executive Director of Innovation Dr. Kai Kuck, and other world renowned collaborators. jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description: **About Bruno** =============== Bruno is the local\-first, Git\-native API client trusted by more than 4 million developers worldwide. From startups to Fortune 500 companies, engineering teams use Bruno to build, test, and collaborate on APIs without the complexity, cost, or security concerns of cloud\-first tools. We're building beyond the API client, expanding into API collaboration, documentation, registries, and enterprise developer workflows. We have a product developers already love, a passionate open\-source community, and an ambitious roadmap. We're looking for someone to help define what comes next. **About the Role** ================== We're looking for a product leader who is still a builder at heart. Someone who has strong opinions about what makes a great developer product, understands the technical details behind it, and enjoys working closely with engineers to bring ideas to life. You'll lead Bruno's product direction, work closely with the founders and engineering leadership, and develop a growing team of Product Managers. This isn't a role for someone who wants to manage roadmaps from a distance. We want someone comfortable opening the product, reproducing bugs, talking to developers, challenging assumptions, writing specifications, and getting into the weeds with engineering. You'll need to balance the needs of our open\-source community, individual developers, and enterprise customers while keeping Bruno simple, focused, and enjoyable to use. We value strong opinions, but we expect them to be challenged. You'll need the judgment to make difficult trade\-offs, the curiosity to understand problems firsthand, and the ability to turn ambitious ideas into products that actually ship. **What You'll Do** ================== * Own product strategy and roadmap: define where Bruno should go, what we should build, and equally importantly, what we should not build. * Set a high bar for product quality, developer experience, usability, simplicity, and craftsmanship. * Lead and develop the PM team: coach Product Managers, improve product thinking, and build a team capable of independently owning meaningful product areas. * Stay close to developers: regularly engage with users, understand their workflows, and identify problems worth solving. * Partner deeply with Engineering to work through technical trade\-offs, architecture, feasibility, and scope. * Turn ambiguity into clear product decisions, specifications, priorities, and measurable outcomes. * Balance long\-term product bets with consistent execution and delivery. * Use product analytics, customer feedback, market understanding, and judgment to make informed decisions. * Partner with Sales and Marketing to understand customer needs, support product\-led growth, and inform pricing and packaging decisions. * Work directly with the founders to challenge assumptions, align on priorities, and build a strong product culture. **What We're Looking For** ========================== * 7\+ years of Product Management experience, preferably in developer tools, infrastructure, or technical platforms. * Strong technical depth across APIs, Git, networking, developer workflows, and system architecture. * Exceptional product judgment and a strong instinct for simplicity and developer experience. * A builder's mindset: you enjoy prototyping, experimenting, and getting hands\-on with products. * A proven track record of taking meaningful products from idea to launch, with measurable results. * Deep developer empathy and a genuine understanding of how developers work. * Strong prioritization skills and the conviction to say no to ideas that don't move the product forward. * Excellent written communication and the ability to bring clarity to ambiguous problems. * Opinionated but low\-ego, comfortable challenging ideas and changing your mind when the evidence warrants it. * Experience leading and mentoring Product Managers while raising the quality of product thinking. * Comfortable working closely with founders in a fast\-paced startup environment. **Bonus Points** ================ * Experience building products at companies such as GitHub, GitLab, Docker, HashiCorp, or similar developer\-focused companies. * Contributions to open\-source projects or experience working with open\-source communities. * Experience with product\-led growth, developer adoption, or monetization of developer tools. * Experience balancing the needs of individual developers and enterprise customers. * Previous experience as a software engineer. **Why Join Bruno?** =================== * Shape the future of a product already used by more than 4 million developers worldwide. * Real ownership over product direction, strategy, and execution. * Work directly with founders and a strong engineering team that values craftsmanship and technical excellence. * Build in the open alongside a passionate and growing open\-source community. * Lead and develop a growing product team while staying close to the craft of building great products. * Join a fast\-growing, well\-funded company with significant opportunities ahead. * Competitive salary, equity, and benefits.

jobs.title: IT Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Location: West Columbia, SC Employment Type: Full\-Time \| On\-Site Build Systems That Work. Keep Them That Way. Reliable IT infrastructure doesn't happen by accident. Behind every secure network, stable server, and well\-performing cloud environment is careful engineering, proactive maintenance, and someone who understands how the pieces fit together. At Coreharbor Technologies, we're looking for an IT Systems Engineer who can take ownership of complex technical environments, strengthen infrastructure performance, and solve problems before they become business disruptions. This role is for someone who enjoys working beyond the help desk, digging into system architecture, troubleshooting infrastructure issues, and finding practical ways to make technology more secure, efficient, and dependable. Responsibilities You'll help design, maintain, and improve the infrastructure that supports day\-to\-day business operations. * Systems Engineering: Configure, administer, and maintain Windows Server environments, virtualization platforms, and enterprise IT infrastructure. * Cloud Infrastructure: Support Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, and hybrid cloud environments. * Network Operations: Troubleshoot and optimize firewalls, VPNs, DNS, DHCP, and network connectivity. * Infrastructure Security: Implement access controls, system hardening, patch management, and security best practices. * Monitoring \& Reliability: Identify performance issues, respond to system alerts, and prevent recurring infrastructure problems. * Backup \& Recovery: Maintain backup systems, test recovery procedures, and support business continuity planning. * Automation: Develop scripts and automate routine administrative tasks using PowerShell or similar tools. * Technical Projects: Assist with infrastructure upgrades, system migrations, deployments, and technology improvements. * Documentation: Maintain accurate system configurations, technical procedures, and infrastructure documentation. What You'll Need to Succeed We're looking for an engineer who combines strong technical knowledge with independent judgment and a methodical approach to troubleshooting. * 3–5 years of experience in systems engineering, systems administration, infrastructure support, or a related IT role. * Hands\-on experience with Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, and Microsoft 365\. * Working knowledge of Azure or other cloud infrastructure platforms. * Experience with virtualization technologies such as VMware or Hyper\-V. * Solid understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, and network security. * Experience with backup solutions, disaster recovery, and system monitoring. * Familiarity with PowerShell scripting and infrastructure automation. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills. * Ability to manage technical priorities and work collaboratively across teams. jobs.title: ML/AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Bridge Neurotech** -------------------------- Bridge Neurotech is building a non\-invasive functional ultrasound imaging (fUSI) platform with AI\-based neural decoding for brain\-computer interface applications. We are a seed\-stage neurotechnology company developing technology that has the potential to transform how we interact with the human brain. **About the role** ------------------ We are looking for an ML/AI Engineer to own and scale key parts of the models and infrastructure behind our neural decoding pipeline, from raw functional ultrasound acquisition through image reconstruction, preprocessing, and decoding. This role sits at the frontier of two rapidly converging fields: neural decoding and foundation models. Recent work has shown that brain activity can be mapped into the latent spaces of pretrained deep learning models to reconstruct visual perception and continuous language with remarkable fidelity. This has been demonstrated with fMRI, in research settings. Your job is to bring these techniques to functional ultrasound: a modality with superior spatial and temporal resolution, portability, and a path to consumer deployment. This is a hands\-on role with an unusual amount of surface area. You will scope and lead projects from open question to result with a high degree of independence, and help set the technical direction of our decoding work. You will report to our ML/AI Engineering Lead. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Design, implement, train, and evaluate models across the pipeline: fUSI reconstruction, signal preprocessing, and downstream decoding, and own the results for the components you lead. * Drive the experimental agenda for your area: form and test hypotheses about why a model is not learning, design ablations, and tune architectures, losses, and training schedules, then turn what you find into decisions the team can act on. * Extend models to new data regimes, for example new dimensionalities (2D to 3D volumetric), new probes, and new subjects, and build the preprocessing pipelines needed to normalize that data for training. * Own the training infrastructure: experiment tracking, config management, checkpointing, mixed\-precision and multi\-GPU training, and profiling, built well enough for the rest of the team to rely on. * Define the evaluation strategy: metrics, pre\-launch tests, and regression checks that tell us when a model is actually better. * Debug numerical and performance problems, for example NaNs under mixed precision, silent shape bugs, page\-cache thrashing, dead gradients, and GPU memory ceilings. * Build inference paths for full\-volume reconstruction and low\-latency real\-time decoding. * Work directly with our imaging scientists and neuroscientists to understand where the data comes from and what its artifacts mean, and help shape how future data is collected. * Track the relevant literature in neural operators, neuroimaging, and neural decoding, reproduce the results that matter to our roadmap, and propose where we should go next. * Review code and designs, and help onboard new engineers and interns as the team grows. **Who you are** --------------- **Required** * A PhD in machine learning, computer science, electrical engineering, computational neuroscience, physics, or a related field; or a bachelor’s or master’s degree in one of those fields plus 2 to 3 years of experience building and shipping machine learning systems in a research or product setting. * Strong Python and hands\-on PyTorch development (or an equivalent framework such as JAX or TensorFlow). * A track record of independently taking a model from a paper or a prototype to something that trains reliably on real data. * Evidence of owning an open\-ended technical problem end to end, such as a thesis, publications, open\-source work, or a shipped system. * Comfort with large numerical datasets, for example hundreds of gigabytes to multiple terabytes, and memory\-mapped arrays. * Solid grounding in first principles, for example linear algebra and signal processing. * GPU proficiency: mixed precision, memory profiling, gradient checkpointing, and the ability to diagnose bottlenecks. * Strong software engineering practices: version control, testing, code review, and coding conventions. * Self\-directed and self\-motivated, with the ability to execute on a goal rather than a step\-by\-step guide. **Nice to have** * Experience with neural operators (FNO), implicit neural representations, or physics\-informed machine learning architectures. * Exposure to neural decoding, brain\-computer interfaces, or neuroimaging data. * Familiarity with complex\-valued neural networks or spectral methods. * Experience developing real\-time or low\-latency inference systems. * Distributed or multi\-GPU training at scale. * Publications at machine learning or neuroscience venues, or contributions to open\-source machine learning tooling. * Prior work in a startup or small team, or other evidence of thriving without much scaffolding. **What we offer** ----------------- * Real ownership of core technical infrastructure at a seed\-stage company, with a direct path to growing into a senior or lead role as the team scales. * Mentorship from our ML/AI Engineering Lead, and direct collaboration with leading clinicians and neuroscientists at top\-tier academic institutions. * Work on a modality early enough that the tooling does not exist yet. Much of what you build will be the first of its kind. * Excellent medical benefits and a 6% match 401(k). Bridge Neurotech is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** We have an exciting opportunity for a **Robotics Software Engineer** at UL Research Institutes , based in our Skokie, IL office. The **Robotics Software Engineer** will design and maintain the software infrastructure that connects laboratory automation, robotics, scientific instruments, data systems, and decision tools into integrated autonomous workflows. The role will work closely with scientists, automation engineers, robotics engineers, and data scientists to build scalable, reliable software for experimental orchestration and closed\-loop research. **UL Research Institutes:** At UL Research Institutes (ULRI) , we expand the boundaries of safety science to create a more secure and sustainable world. For more than a century, we have studied the unintended consequences of innovation, designed solutions to mitigate risk and shared our findings with academia, scientists, manufacturers, and policymakers across industries. We identify critical safety and sustainability issues, asking the tough questions because we believe a safer world begins with knowledge. Build a safer, more secure, and sustainable future with us. Join us and work with our Materials Discovery Research Institute teams who conduct the research required to produce that knowledge and put into practice. **Materials Discovery Research Institute:** The Materials Discovery Research Institute (MDRI) works to develop and deploy new materials with the potential to address current global safety challenges. Pursuing materials that will help produce transformational safety breakthroughs, MDRI harnesses the power of advanced computing and high\-throughput experimental methods to create innovative materials that will produce resilience for a sustainable future and protect individual and societal health. We focus on today’s critical challenges, working to create new and better materials that will support renewable energy and environmental sustainability. Among our top priorities is research into materials capable of carbon capture and energy storage, with an eye toward reducing the adverse impacts of humanity’s reliance upon fossil fuel resources and enabling a transition to renewable energy sources. Above all, our research builds on our commitment to a safer, more sustainable future. **What you’ll learn and achieve:** **As the Robotics Software Engineer, you will play a key role in the rapid growth of UL** **as you:** * Develop and maintain software integrations for laboratory instruments, robotics, and automation platforms. * Design and implement scalable APIs and reusable interfaces for communication across heterogeneous systems. * Build workflow orchestration for multi\-step experimental processes across synthesis, sample handling, characterization, and analysis. * Develop and maintain sample tracking, metadata, and lineage capabilities to support experimental traceability. * Implement scheduling, system\-state management, error handling, and recovery capabilities to support reliable unattended operation. * Integrate systems using APIs, OPC\-UA, Ethernet/IP, Modbus TCP, serial communication, and related protocols. * Collaborate with Data Science team to support integration with scientific databases, data platforms, ML models, and decision tools. * Develop monitoring, logging, dashboards, and diagnostic tools in conjunction with Data Science team. * Apply modern software engineering practices including Git, testing, CI/CD, documentation, and containerization. * Troubleshoot and resolve software issues, implementing proactive solutions to enhance system stability. * Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to translate laboratory needs into scalable software solutions. Perform other duties as assigned. * **What you’ll experience working at UL Research Institutes:** We have pursued our mission of working for a safer, more secure, and sustainable world for nearly 130 years, embedding conscientious stewardship into everything we do. * **People** : Our people make us special. You’ll work with a diverse team of experts respected for their independence and transparency and build a network, because our approach is collaborative. We collaborate across disciplines, organizations, and geographies to build the global scientific response that today’s global challenges require. * **Interesting work** : Every day is different for us here. We see what’s on the horizon and use our expertise to build the foundations of a safer future. You’ll have the opportunity to push the boundaries of human understanding as part of a team working to advance the public good. * **Grow and achieve** : We learn, work, and grow together through targeted development, reward, and recognition programs. * **Values** . Four core values guide our work: collaboration, respect, integrity, and beneficence. By living our values, we inspire the trust essential to fulfilling our mission and foster the partnerships that enable us to pursue a beneficent future in which we all can thrive. * **Total Rewards** : All employees at UL Research Institutes are eligible for bonus compensation. We offer comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans and a generous 401k matching structure of up to 5% of eligible pay. Moreover, we invest an additional 4% into your retirement saving fund after your first year of continuous employment. Depending on your role, you may be able to discuss flexible working arrangements with your manager. We also provide employees with paid time off, including vacation, holiday, sick, and volunteer days. **What makes you a great fit:** **While no one candidate will embody every quality, the successful candidate will bring many of the following professional competencies and personal attributes:** * Demonstrated proficiency in Python and experience developing production\-quality software. * Experience with an additional programming language or development framework such as C\#, .NET, Java, Go, or TypeScript is preferred. * Experience designing APIs, distributed systems, microservices, or event\-driven architectures. * Experience integrating software with hardware, robotics, instrumentation, or automation systems. * Working knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases and data integration. * Knowledge of workflow orchestration, scheduling, state machines, and asynchronous systems. * Experience with Git, automated testing, Docker, CI/CD, and software documentation. * Strong troubleshooting, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills. Experience with scientific laboratories, robotics, controls, or autonomous systems is highly desirable. * **Professional education and experience requirements for the role include:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, computer engineering, robotics, controls, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. * Minimum 4 years of professional software development experience. * Experience building scalable software systems beyond standalone scripts. * Experience integrating laboratory instruments, robotics, automation, or other cyber\-physical systems is strongly preferred. Experience working in a scientific research, laboratory, manufacturing, or research and development environment is preferred. * **About UL Research Institutes and UL Standards \& Engagement** UL Research Institutes and UL Standards \& Engagement are nonprofit organizations dedicated to advancing safety science research through the discovery and application of scientific knowledge. We conduct rigorous independent research and analyze safety data, convene experts worldwide to address risks, share knowledge through safety education and public outreach initiatives, and develop standards to guide safe commercialization of evolving technologies. We foster communities of safety, from grassroots initiatives for neighborhoods to summits of world leaders. Our organization employs collaborative and scientific approaches with partners and stakeholders to drive innovation and progress toward improving safety, security, and sustainability, ultimately enhancing societal well\-being. To learn more, visit our websites UL.org and ULSE.org . **Salary Range:** $89,602\.01\-$123,202\.76 **Pay Type:** Salary

jobs.title: STAFF PRODUCT ENGINEER, AI-Native Developer Tools
jobs.description: **STAFF PRODUCT ENGINEER AI\-Native Developer Tools** Posted by AMBSIMS \& Associates Corp on behalf of a confidential client **Item** **Detail** **Role** Staff Product Engineer **Location** New York City, Flatiron office **Work arrangement** On\-site five days per week. No remote or hybrid option. **Employment type** Full\-time **Base salary** $280,000 to $380,000 **Equity** Significant early\-stage equity **Experience** 7 to 20 years **Core stack** TypeScript and React **Work authorization** Must be authorized to work in the U.S. Existing visa transfers (including OPT and H\-1B transfers) may be considered. New visa sponsorship is not available. **ABOUT THE COMPANY** Our client is a high\-growth, AI\-native technology company based in New York City. The team builds and ships with AI at the center of how it works: its strongest engineers run multiple coding agents in autonomous workflows. The company is looking for a Staff\-level builder to set the technical direction of high\-value products from their earliest stages. **ABOUT THE ROLE** This is a Staff engineering role for someone who is deeply hands\-on. You will personally design, build, and launch products from zero to one, make the major architectural calls, and lead through influence rather than management authority. The role is not simply systems\-building: you will care about product quality, user experience, customer needs, and the technical trade\-offs that connect them. **WHAT YOU WILL DO** * Take high\-value products from 0 to 1: define the problem, design the architecture, build, launch, and own them in production. * Set or materially shape technical direction and make significant architectural decisions as a senior individual contributor. * Build full\-stack product features and systems, with TypeScript and React as the core of your work. * Work in an AI\-native way: use coding agents in autonomous workflows and ship applied AI where it improves the product. * Keep the customer in view: weigh UX, product quality, and customer needs against technical trade\-offs. * Explain technical decisions and trade\-offs clearly to engineers, leadership, and non\-technical stakeholders. * Operate with ambiguity and radical ownership and help raise the bar for the engineers around you. **WHAT YOU BRING** * **Experience:** 7 to 20 years as a full\-stack or product engineer, with meaningful end\-to\-end product ownership at a Staff level. * **Proven 0\-to\-1 ownership:** You personally designed, built, and deployed exceptional products from the early stages in a high\-growth startup or scale\-up with a strong engineering organization. You can explain what you owned, what you built, the technical decisions you made, and what happened to the product afterward. * **Strong full\-stack fundamentals:** Hands\-on TypeScript and React expertise, plus depth across the rest of the stack. * **Technical leadership as an IC:** A track record of setting or shaping technical direction, making significant architectural decisions, and leading through influence while staying hands\-on. * **Applied AI or** **coding\-agent** **experience:** Specific examples of applied AI work, or substantive use of coding agents that changed how you build. Occasional use of an AI assistant is not enough. * **Product and customer orientation:** Experience leading the technical direction of recognizable, high\-value products, with real attention to customer experience. * **Clear communication:** You can explain complex decisions and trade\-offs pragmatically to any audience. * **Location:** Based in NYC, or genuinely willing to relocate and work in person five days a week. **NICE TO HAVE** * Experience at a developer tools or infrastructure startup, building products for engineers. **THIS ROLE IS NOT A FIT IF** * Your background is primarily infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, platform, or backend\-only work without strong TypeScript and React product engineering. * Your experience is mainly maintaining or optimizing established products rather than owning 0\-to\-1 builds. * You are looking for a remote or hybrid role. **COMPENSATION AND LOCATION** Base salary of $280,000 to $380,000, plus significant early\-stage equity. The role is based in the company's Flatiron office in New York City and requires being on\-site five days per week. \#hc268747

jobs.description: Senior Cloud Engineer * US\-Remote * IT * Full Time * 612380 $ 150,000 \- $ 180,000 Per Year Naviga Inc. delivers the broadest range of technology solutions for the global news media industry, including content management, digital advertising, circulation, and audience relationship management. The company's innovative solutions and professional services help media organizations engage audiences through web, print, mobile, and social media channels. **Position Summary** Naviga is seeking an experienced Senior Cloud Engineer to design, implement, maintain, and optimize highly available, secure, and scalable cloud infrastructure supporting our global business operations and customer\-facing platforms. This position requires advanced hands\-on expertise with Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft SQL Server, Microsoft server technologies, and enterprise networking. The Senior Cloud Engineer will work closely with Cloud Operations, Information Technology, Security, Development, and Database teams to ensure Naviga's infrastructure meets operational, security, performance, availability, and business continuity requirements. The successful candidate will be a highly technical engineer capable of troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues across cloud, networking, operating system, database, and application layers. **Key Responsibilities** AWS Cloud Infrastructure * Design, deploy, administer, and support enterprise environments within Amazon Web Services (AWS). * Manage AWS services including EC2, VPC, S3, RDS, EBS, ELB/ALB, Route 53, IAM, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, Systems Manager, AWS Backup, and Auto Scaling. * Design highly available and fault\-tolerant AWS architectures across multiple Availability Zones. * Configure and maintain AWS VPCs, subnets, route tables, security groups, Network ACLs, NAT gateways, VPN connections, and related networking components. * Implement cloud infrastructure following security, availability, scalability, and disaster\-recovery best practices. * Monitor AWS resource utilization, availability, performance, and cost. * Participate in cloud migrations, infrastructure modernization, and application migration projects. * Troubleshoot complex AWS infrastructure, connectivity, performance, and availability issues. * Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code and automation where appropriate. Microsoft SQL Server * Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Microsoft SQL Server environments. * Support SQL Server running on AWS EC2 and other supported cloud architectures. * Assist with SQL Server performance troubleshooting, capacity planning, and infrastructure optimization. * Manage SQL Server connectivity, authentication, firewall, DNS, storage, and infrastructure dependencies. * Support SQL Server high\-availability and disaster\-recovery technologies, including Always On Availability Groups, clustering, replication, backup, and recovery solutions. * Troubleshoot database infrastructure issues in collaboration with application developers and database administrators. * Assist with SQL Server upgrades, migrations, patching, and lifecycle management. * Understand SQL Server storage, memory, CPU, I/O, and networking requirements in high\-volume production environments. Networking * Design, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise and cloud networking environments. * Demonstrate advanced understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching, subnetting, NAT, firewalls, VPNs, load balancing, network security, SSL/TLS, HTTP/HTTPS, and network troubleshooting. * Troubleshoot connectivity between AWS environments, corporate networks, data centers, third\-party providers, and customer environments. * Support Site\-to\-Site VPN, AWS Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, and hybrid\-cloud connectivity. * Analyze network traffic and resolve latency, packet loss, routing, firewall, and application connectivity issues. * Work with security teams to ensure network architecture follows corporate security standards. Microsoft Infrastructure * Administer and troubleshoot Microsoft Windows Server environments. * Support Microsoft technologies including Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, Microsoft IIS, PowerShell, Certificate Services, and Microsoft 365 integration. * Troubleshoot Windows Server performance, authentication, networking, storage, and application\-hosting issues. * Support IIS\-hosted applications and troubleshoot HTTP/HTTPS, certificates, authentication, application pools, and web\-server configuration. Automation and Infrastructure as Code * Develop automation using PowerShell, Python, AWS CLI, or similar technologies. * Experience with Infrastructure as Code platforms such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or equivalent technologies. * Automate provisioning, configuration, monitoring, maintenance, and operational processes. * Identify opportunities to reduce manual administration through automation and standardized deployment practices. Monitoring and Op al change\-management and incident\-management processes. * Strong technical documentation skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * AWS certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect \- Associate or Professional, AWS Certified SysOps Administrator, or AWS Certified Advanced Networking. * Microsoft certifications related to Azure, Windows Server, SQL Server, or infrastructure technologies. * Experience with Terraform or AWS CloudFormation. * Experience with AWS multi\-account architectures and AWS Organizations. * Experience with hybrid cloud and multi\-cloud environments. * Experience supporting SaaS or enterprise software platforms. * Experience supporting production systems operating across multiple geographic regions. * Experience with enterprise monitoring and observability platforms. * Knowledge of DevOps and CI/CD methodologies. * Familiarity with security frameworks and compliance requirements. **Technical Skills** Cloud: AWS, EC2, VPC, S3, RDS, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, ELB/ALB, EBS, Systems Manager, AWS Backup, Transit Gateway Database: Microsoft SQL Server, SQL Server Always On, clustering, backup/recovery, performance troubleshooting Networking: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, subnetting, VPN, NAT, firewalls, load balancers, SSL/TLS, AWS networking Microsoft: Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, IIS, PowerShell, Microsoft 365 Automation: PowerShell, Python, AWS CLI, Terraform, CloudFormation Operations: Monitoring, incident response, root\-cause analysis, change management, disaster recovery, capacity planning Core Competencies * Advanced troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills * Strong ownership and accountability * Ability to troubleshoot complex production environments under pressure * Ability to work independently and lead technical initiatives * Strong written and verbal communication skills * Ability to collaborate across Infrastructure, Development, Security, Database, and Support teams * Strong focus on operational excellence, reliability, security, and automation * Ability to prioritize multiple critical initiatives in a fast\-paced global environment jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Credit
jobs.description: Alt is unlocking the value of alternative assets, starting with the $5 B trading\-card market. We let collectors buy, sell, vault, and finance their cards in one place and we are backed by leaders at Stripe, Coinbase, Seven Seven Six, and pro athletes like Tom Brady and Giannis Antetokounmpo. Our next frontier is real\-time pricing at scale—the Alt Value that powers every trade, loan, and product on the platform. ### **THE ROLE** A collector borrows against a card sitting in our vault. We size the advance off its Alt Value, underwrite it, disburse the money, and manage the loan until the last dollar comes back or the collateral is released. Today too much of that path runs on people: manual approvals, hand\-checked disbursements, a triage queue that grows when a transfer goes sideways, and screens that don't always tell the borrower where their money is. Your job is to turn that into a product. You'll implement our new underwriting design hand in hand with our data scientists, automate the loan workflow end to end, own disbursement failures until they stop happening, and ship the borrower and operator experiences on top, built from our designs. This is a full\-stack seat: the same engineer who fixes the idempotency bug builds the screen that tells the borrower their funds are on the way. The north star: T7 (trailing 7\-day) Disbursement within SLA rate, with a target of 99%. Every underwriting change, automation, triage fix, and screen you ship either moves that number or protects it. Supporting KPIs: time from application to underwriting decision, share of loans that go from application to funded with no manual touch, disbursement exceptions per week, and support tickets asking "where is my money," driven toward zero. In lending, a disbursement that "probably went out" is a failure. The people who are great at this have owned a lending or payments product where it mattered, from the state machine to the pixels. They think in idempotency and reconciliation because they've been on the wrong side of both, and they care that the UI tells the truth about what the system is doing. ### **WHAT YOU'LL OWN** * **The underwriting revamp.** We're redesigning how we underwrite cash advances and term loans, and you'll implement the new design end to end, working hand in hand with our data scientists. That means turning their models and credit policy into a production decisioning service: inputs computed reliably, every decision versioned and explainable, and every rule or model change shipped through shadow mode and backtests before it goes live. Done looks like the new logic deciding every application, with Data Science able to iterate on it without an engineering rewrite. * **The automated loan workflow.** Application, underwriting decision, offer, acceptance, disbursement, servicing, repayment, delinquency, and collateral release, modeled as an explicit state machine with every transition logged. Manual steps become rules, and rules become auditable. Done looks like a standard advance funding with no human in the loop, and a non\-standard one landing in front of the right person with the context already attached. * **Disbursement triage, fixed at the root.** Failed, duplicated, delayed, and stuck disbursements. You'll find out why each class of break happens (a retry without an idempotency key, a webhook that arrived out of order, a rail that returned after we marked it settled) and close it for good. Done looks like the triage queue shrinking week over week, with the T7 SLA rate to prove it. * **The borrower experience, built to design.** The cash advance offer, acceptance, disbursement status, repayment, payoff, and loan history screens across web and mobile, implemented faithfully from our designs and improved through what you learn in production. You own design fidelity, accessibility, and performance, and you make sure the status a borrower sees is the status the loan is actually in. * **Operator and triage tooling.** The internal console where Credit, Operations, and Support see every loan and disbursement, spot the stuck ones, and resolve them with the context already on screen. Watch what they do in spreadsheets today, then delete the spreadsheet. * **Loan servicing and money movement.** Scheduled auto\-pay, partial payments, payoff quotes, reversals, and the edge cases between them, over ACH, RTP, and wires. Every movement integrates cleanly with the ledger so it posts, reconciles, and has an owner. You'll work closely with the Ledger team and own the product consequences of settlement timing, not just the API call. * **Risk controls in the workflow.** Limits, holds, loan\-to\-value checks, and step\-up review triggered by risk signals rather than blanket friction. You'll know what each control costs in conversion. * **The bar.** Rigorous code reviews, clear technical docs, and mentorship for the rest of the Credit team. You'll be the team's closest partner to Design and Data Science. ### **WHAT GREAT LOOKS  . We ask. If you've built agents, wired up connectors, written skills or MCP servers, or shipped internal tooling your team actually depends on, lead with that. Name the artifact, not the tool. ### **WHAT YOU BRING** * 5\+ years building and scaling production applications across the stack: backend (Python, Postgres, AWS or comparable cloud infrastructure) and frontend (React, React Native, TypeScript). Both halves are load\-bearing here. * You've built or owned a lending, credit, or payments workflow in production. Loan origination, servicing, or disbursement, and you can explain a design decision you'd make differently now. * You've moved real money on real rails. ACH origination and returns, RTP or FedNow, wires, or equivalent. You know what an R01 is and why return windows matter to a disbursement. * Workflow and state\-machine design. You model long\-running processes explicitly, with retries, timeouts, compensation, and a clear audit trail. * Operational debugging instinct. You've taken over a noisy exception queue and made it quiet by fixing causes, not by adding alerts. * You've implemented complex designs faithfully and quickly, and you can talk a designer through a trade\-off without losing the intent. * Database mastery. Expert SQL and relational design, and transactions that hold under load during scheduled auto\-pay batches. * API\-native. Webhooks, idempotency, eventual consistency, and reconciliation are your default vocabulary. * Product\-owner thinking. You understand the flow of funds and how to tell a worried borrower exactly where their money is. * Pragmatism. You know when a queue and a lambda are the answer and when they are three new partial\-failure modes. * You've implemented credit decisioning or underwriting logic in production alongside data scientists: turning a model or policy spec into a reliable, versioned, testable service, with shadow mode, backtesting, and a clean rollout. **Bonus:** workflow engines (Temporal, Step Functions or similar); credit or risk modeling; direct experience with Stripe, Plaid, Modern Treasury, or Increase; asset\-backed or secured lending; design systems or internal tooling for operations teams; KYC/KYB, bank partnerships, or audit\-readiness exposure. You collect, or you have a view on where this market is going. ### **HOW WE'LL INTERVIEW YOU** We'll be specific so you can prepare. Before any of it: download the app, put a card up, make a bid, and try selling. Every round assumes you've used the product, and we expect your point of view to sharpen as you go. For this role, go through the cash advance flow: how an offer is presented, what happens after you accept, what you're told while you wait for funds, and where it made you hesitate. We will ask. * Recruiter screen, 30 minutes, Google Meet. Come ready to talk about the metric you own today and how you're performing against it, why Alt specifically, and how you're actually using AI. We'll align on comp and answer your questions. * Hiring manager, Mina Quon, 30 minutes * Technical Assignment \- 45 minutes * Architecture and system design, 60 minutes. * Culture interview, 30 minutes. * Leore, our founder and CEO, 30 minutes. Everyone who joins Alt meets Leore. Come with a point of view on where you'd take Alt's credit product first. * Reference checks, 15 minutes with a former manager(s) . **Compensation:** $200,000 – $220,000 per year, plus equity for all full\-time employees. **What we offer:** ================== ***For full\-time Employees*** * We cover 85% of your medical, dental, and vision, and up to 50% for dependents. HSA/FSA available * Generous PTO that people actually take * Parental leave at full salary * $200/month wellness \+ $100/month home office stipend * Free DoorDash Pass membership, because dinner shouldn't be a decision * Remote\-first (for most positions), with WeWork access when you want a room with other humans * 401(k) * Alt Equity to all full\-time employees Compensation Range: $200K \- $220K

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Product
jobs.description: **Company** ----------- Pramaana Labs is a frontier AI lab building the verification layer for AI. Founded in 2025 and headquartered in Palo Alto, we turn complex human knowledge, including tax codes, legal rules, clinical guidelines and security protocols, into a formal representation, so every AI answer can be traced, challenged, and proved. Pramaana's architecture pairs foundation models trained to formalize and reason with a symbolic world model encoded in Lean 4\. Pramaana was founded by a team out of Google, DeepMind, and Glean, combining frontier AI researchers and formal methods experts. **The Role** ------------ We’re looking for a full\-stack Product Engineer to turn Pramaana’s research into products that customers and developers can use and trust. You’ll make complex reasoning accessible through intuitive interfaces and thoughtful developer experiences, helping users understand, inspect, and verify AI outputs. This is a hands\-on, early\-stage role spanning customer\-facing applications, developer APIs, and new product experiments. You won’t be confined to one feature or product. You’ll help discover what users need, build the experience across the stack, and improve it through real\-world use. You’ll work closely with product, design, engineering, and research, taking ownership of projects from the MVP through production. We’re looking for someone who cares about both how AI works and how people experience it \- and who enjoys making complex technology feel straightforward. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Build complete product experiences.** Take problems from initial exploration to working software, owning the frontend, backend, data models, integrations, and testing needed to deliver a useful result. * **Create thoughtful, responsive interfaces.** Build workflows that help users bring in knowledge, review rules, ask questions, and inspect results and supporting evidence. Pay attention to interaction details, accessibility, loading states, and errors. * **Develop reliable APIs and services.** Build the systems behind document processing, asynchronous jobs, verification workflows, and customer integrations. Make progress, failures, and recovery understandable to users. * **Turn research capabilities into usable products.** Partner with researchers to integrate models, agents, and verification services. Help bridge the gap between a promising technical demonstration and an experience customers can depend on. * **Learn directly from users.** Work with customers and internal stakeholders to understand their workflows, test assumptions, and identify useful improvements. Instrument features and use feedback and usage data to guide iteration. * **Own quality beyond launch.** Write tests, review code, monitor the features you ship, and investigate production issues. Improve performance, security, and reliability as usage grows. * **Build foundations that support multiple products.** Create reusable components, services, and integration patterns. Make practical decisions about what to share, what to keep simple, and when a prototype needs a more durable implementation. **You Will Thrive in This Role If You Have** -------------------------------------------- * **Minimum 2–3 years of software engineering experience**, with examples of products or features you’ve shipped and improved. We value meaningful hands\-on ownership more than a particular title or background. * **Strong full\-stack fundamentals.** You’re comfortable building interfaces with TypeScript and React, backend services with Python or Node.js, and working with APIs and relational databases. You may be stronger on one side of the stack, but you’re willing to work across both. * **Product judgment and attention to detail.** You think about the user’s goal, question unnecessary complexity, and care whether the final experience is understandable—not just technically functional. * **Practical experience delivering production software.** You’re familiar with testing, version control, code review, deployment, and debugging. You understand the basics of authentication, authorization, and handling user data responsibly. * **Comfort working through ambiguity.** You can break a loosely defined problem into manageable steps, test an approach, and adjust as you learn. * **Ownership, curiosity, and clear communication.** You follow through on what you build, surface problems early, and work well with people across engineering, design, product, and research. **Especially Strong Candidates May Also Have** ---------------------------------------------- * Experience building applications with LLM APIs, retrieval, agent workflows, or evaluation systems. * Experience with enterprise software, developer tools, or workflows involving complex documents, structured knowledge, or auditable decisions. * Strong frontend craft, including experience building editors, data visualizations, or other information\-rich interfaces. * Experience taking a startup product, substantial side project, or open\-source tool from an idea to active users. Prior experience in formal verification is not required. We’re looking for strong builders who are curious about the technology and motivated to make it useful.

jobs.description: Company: University of Missouri\-Columbia Division: College of Engineering City: Columbia State: MO County: Boone County Country: USA Email Address: umhrexecutivesearch@umsystem.edu Website URL: http://hrs.missouri.edu/find\-a\-job/academic/index Posted: 10/12/2026 Director, Quantum Innovation Center, Associate/Full Professor **Director, Quantum Innovation Center, Associate or Full Professor** The University of Missouri (MU) seeks an innovative, collaborative, and visionary leader to serve as the inaugural Director of the Quantum Innovation Center (QIC), an interdisciplinary initiative advancing research, education, workforce development, and strategic partnerships in quantum computing and quantum information science. The Director will lead a dynamic collaboration spanning the University of Missouri System, academic institutions, and industry partners nationwide, while building on MU’s existing strengths in quantum computing and related fields. The Center also provides opportunities to connect quantum research with complementary areas of innovation across the University creating pathways for interdisciplinary collaboration and emerging applications of quantum technologies in health and biomedical research. Reporting to the Dean of the College of Engineering and working collaboratively across the University, the Director will provide strategic leadership for the continued development, growth, and national visibility of the Center. The successful candidate will build and strengthen interdisciplinary collaborations, cultivate external partnerships, support faculty recruitment and development, and identify opportunities to advance MU’s role within the rapidly evolving quantum ecosystem. This is an exceptional opportunity for a nationally recognized scholar and collaborative leader to shape the future direction of a growing interdisciplinary center while contributing to the University of Missouri’s broader strengths in research, education, and innovation. The position includes a tenured faculty appointment at the rank of Professor or Associate Professor in the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science Department or another appropriate academic department. **Key Responsibilities** * **Provide strategic leadership and vision** for the Quantum Innovation Center, advancing its research, education, workforce development, and innovation mission in alignment with University and national priorities. * **Build and expand a high\-impact quantum research portfolio** by identifying emerging opportunities, establishing strategic priorities, and developing interdisciplinary research initiatives across engineering, physics, chemistry, mathematics, computer science, and related fields. * **Recruit and engage exceptional faculty and researchers** whose scholarship advances the Center’s priorities, expands MU’s research capabilities, and creates opportunities for new interdisciplinary collaborations and externally funded research. * **Build interdisciplinary research teams and strengthen research development**, supporting competitive proposals to federal agencies, national laboratories, industry sponsors, foundations, and other funding partners. * **Advance graduate and undergraduate research and postdoctoral training**, creating opportunities for students and trainees to engage in quantum\-related research and prepare for careers in quantum science and technology. * **Lead the development and expansion of innovative education and workforce development programs**, including certificates, workshops, internships, experiential learning, and continuing education that respond to evolving workforce needs. * **Strengthen pathways from education to careers** by developing relationships with industry, government laboratories, national security organizations, graduate programs, and other employers and training partners. * **Develop and sustain strategic external partnerships** with industry, national laboratories, federal agencies, professional organizations, and other organizations to expand sponsored research, internships, workforce development, and collaborative educational opportunities. * **Serve as a visible ambassador for the Center and MU**, strengthening its national and international reputation and representing the Center at regional, national, and international forums. * **Cultivate philanthropic and other external support** in partnership with University Advancement and academic leadership, while identifying opportunities for strategic investment and industry engagement. * **Establish effective governance and operating practices** that foster interdisciplinary collaboration, support long\-term growth and sustainability, and ensure effective coordination across participating departments, colleges, and disciplines. * **Provide responsible stewardship of Center resources, programs, and activities**, developing sustainable approaches to resource allocation and operations while ensuring alignment with University poli uting, artificial intelligence, or related fields. * Experience working across academic, governmental, industrial, and community sectors. * Distinguished record of scholarship and externally funded research. * Demonstrated success leading interdisciplinary research initiatives, programs, centers, or collaborative teams. * Experience developing partnerships with industry, government agencies, national laboratories, foundations, or other external stakeholders. * Strong record of strategic planning, program development, and organizational leadership. * Outstanding communication, organizational, and leadership skills. **Visa Sponsorship Information** Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. The University will not sponsor applicants for this position for employment visas. **Application Materials and Process** Applications must be submitted through the University’s website. Job posting ID is \#61321 Candidates should include a cover letter outlining qualifications and a detailed curriculum vitae. A total of five references will be requested during the **final phase of the interview process.** Applications will be reviewed as they are received. The posting will remain open until filled. Specific academic home(s) of candidates will be determined throughout the hiring process. This is not a remote opportunity. To nominate a colleague or for questions about the application process or role, please contact the Marilyn Green at mnw266@missouri.edu **Handling of Application Materials** After initial review by the committee, all uploaded materials may be shared with all faculty in the prospective department. For affiliations and joint appointments materials may be shared with all faculty in all departments involved. **Community Information** Columbia, Missouri, has been consistently rated as one of the most desirable places to live and work in the U.S. This college city of 128,000\-plus residents has the best of both worlds — small\-town convenience and warmth with urban sophistication and amenities. Located halfway between St. Louis and Kansas City, Columbia boasts affordable housing, moderate cost of living, broad cultural and economic opportunities, award\-winning public schools, and a regional airport that is expanding its offerings. Popular cultural events include the annual True/False documentary film festival, the monthly First Fridays Art Walk and the spring Unbound Book Festival. As a SEC institution, college athletics plays a major role in Columbia’s social scene, with ample opportunities to attend Mizzou sporting events. Mizzou’s campus is adjacent to downtown Columbia, within walking distance of restaurants, clothing stores, ice cream shops, and music venues. Downtown’s shopping corridor is packed with designer boutiques, jewelers, florists, and bookstores. Finally, Columbia is known for having an outstanding array of year\-round outdoor activities. It boasts multiple city parks and an outstanding state park, Rock Bridge State Park. The region’s caves, forests, streams and cliffs offer endless exploration for outdoor adventurers. The popular MKT Trail takes cyclists and hikers all through Columbia and links to the 225\-mile Katy Trail, which stretches across the state. **Benefit Eligibility** This position is eligible for University benefits. For additional information on University benefits, please visit the Faculty \& Staff Benefits website at https://www.umsystem.edu/departments\-staff/human\-resources/benefits\-retirement **Equal Employment Opportunity** The University of Missouri is an Equal Opportunity Employer. To request ADA accommodations, please call the Office of Equity \& Title IX at 816\-235\-6910\.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: Altana is the network for trusted trade. Our AI\-powered product network empowers governments and businesses to build a more resilient and secure global economy while keeping trade flowing. **The Opportunity at Altana** The Engineering organization is responsible for building the product that brings this vision to life. We are creating a platform fundamentally driven by AI, which scales to a massive trove of data, and a diverse customer base; it is a complex system that will stretch engineering in many directions. The best teams here ship work customers come to rely on, and that takes a particular kind of engineering practice. It means starting inside the customer's workflow rather than at the ticket. It means treating every release as a hypothesis you can prove or disprove. It means reaching for AI as a primary building block, not a feature you bolt on at the end. And it means owning a product end‑to‑end, from the first conversation through the telemetry six months later. As an Engineering Manager at Altana, that's the work, and you'll build and lead the team doing it. You'll embed with product and design, turn hypotheses about where the real pain is into shipped, adopted products, and own the hiring, growth, and performance of the engineers on your team. Your success is measured the same way the team's is: by the value it delivers to customers, how quickly and steadily it ships, and how well its systems hold up as output grows. **You Will** * **Build the team and help each person grow.** Own performance management end to end, and use each engineer's career goals to shape what they work on. * **Stay close to customers, and bring your team with you.** Get on customer calls, review session recordings, and know the top friction points in your area at any moment. Make sure your engineers see customer problems firsthand too. * **Hold the bar on solving the right problem.** Partner with product and design to define the problem before choosing a solution, and push back on work that isn't grounded in customer evidence. * **Keep your hands in the work.** Contribute meaningful code, know your domain's architecture and tech debt, and set the standard for quality. The balance will shift toward management as the team grows. * **Build AI\-native, and verify it.** Treat LLMs, agents, evals, and retrieval as standard building blocks. Hold a clear standard for how AI\-assisted code is checked before it reaches customers. * **Make commitments the team keeps.** Run a planning process that produces realistic plans, flag risks early, and deliver cycle after cycle. * **Make the team faster over time.** Use shared engineering metrics to find bottlenecks and remove them. Know where the team's time goes, and pay down operational debt before it slows you down. * **Own what you run.** Keep incidents rare and responses fast, share on\-call load fairly, treat cost as a design input, and work with our security team to keep your area secure. * **Create a team where people do their best work.** Build a culture that handles ambiguity well and makes everyone feel safe sharing ideas. **You Have** * Real\-world professional experience writing back end or data\-driven software in demanding environments. * Strong hands\-on engineering skills. You've deployed production code to cloud environments, and you can still ship work you're proud of. Demonstrated experience working on large, complex problems. * Experience leading a team, either as an engineering manager or as a tech lead who has taken on real people responsibilities like coaching, feedback, and hiring. * A track record of staying close to customers, turning their problems into well\-scoped, shipped work, and delivering incremental releases from prototype to production. * Experience running planning and delivery for a team that consistently hits its commitments. * Comfort owning operations, including incidents, on\-call, and system cost. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, and good judgment about when to handle something yourself and when to escalate. **Nice to have, but not required** * Experience building production systems with LLMs, agents, evals, or retrieval. * Experience using engineering metrics such as DORA or SPACE to improve how a team works. * Background in trade, supply chain, compliance, or working with government customers. **This role is based in Brooklyn, NY, USA with hybrid work flexibility and candidates must be within commuting distance from our Williamsburg, Brooklyn office** **US Salary Range and Benefits** $240,000 \- $285,000 USD The salary range, to the extent specified for this role, is a good faith statement of the minimum and maximum levels of the annual based salary for the position. The base salary offered to a successful candidate will depend on a wide range of compensation factors, including, but not limited to, work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Competitive equity grants are included   coverage, all at no cost to you, so you know that you and your loved ones are covered in case of an emergency. * 401(k) Savings: Save for and invest in your future using our Fidelity 401(k) retirement savings program. * Commuter Benefits: Save money on your commute by setting aside pre\-tax funds for public transit or parking! * Wellness: Because we value mental and emotional health, every Altana employee has access to a free premium subscription to Calm, the \#1 app for meditation, sleep, and mindfulness. * Pet Insurance: Pets are family too! Keep them healthy with Wishbone insurance and / or our Total Pet vet service and telehealth discount plan. * Employee Assistance Program: Free access to confidential personal support. * Dependent Care FSA: You will have access to a Dependent Care FSA, which allows you to set aside pre\-tax funds for childcare expenses The recruiter assigned to this role can share more information about the specific compensation and benefit details associated with this role during the hiring process. ### **Our Values** Our values are the core beliefs that shape who we are, what we stand for, and how we behave.They form the foundation of Altana's culture and integrity and guide how we hire, design, build, and connect with each other and our customers. * **Trust:** Our customers and partners entrust us with missions of the highest importance. We rely on each other to deliver, to speak openly, and to hold ourselves accountable. * **Resilience:** In a world of uncertainty and complexity, our work must withstand challenges, evolve with conditions, and ensure reliability over time. Resilience is both how we operate and what we deliver. It's how we respond when things don't go to plan –– we adapt, we support each other, and we keep moving forward. * **Stewardship:** We are stewards of every mission we touch. Because our work impacts lives and futures, we hold ourselves accountable to delivering mission impact and never compromising. Our responsibility extends beyond individual projects to the broader system of global trade. We believe that stewardship starts from within so that we can bring focus, creativity, and excellence to our work. Each of us is personally responsible for fostering a workplace where people can thrive. And we are stewards of the greater good of the company. By holding ourselves and each other accountable, we build a culture of innovation and collective success that reflects the scale of our mission. * **Courage:** Courage is what unlocks the seemingly impossible for our customers. It's the core value that drives us make bold moves and take on big, complicated network problems—the ones others avoid. We know success isn't guaranteed, but we have the audacious vision to believe a solution is possible and to build it. Courage fuels our growth mindset. It means embracing challenges that make us stronger, and it's demonstrated by how we approach hard conversations and complex projects. We are creating a platform fundamentally driven by AI, which scales to a massive trove of data, and a diverse customer base; it is a complex system that will stretch engineering in many directions. Shipping products that customers actually adopt, not just products that ship, takes a particular kind of engineering practice. It means starting inside the customer's workflow rather than at the ticket. It means treating every release as a hypothesis you can prove or disprove. It means reaching for AI as a primary building block, not a feature you bolt on at the end. And it means owning a product end‑to‑end, from the first conversation through the telemetry six months later. As a Senior Engineer at Altana, that's the work and you'll lead others doing it. You'll embed with product and design, get on calls with users, form hypotheses about where the real pain is, and lead a small team turning those hypotheses into shipped, adopted products. You'll measure your work in customer outcomes, not commits. **You Will** * **Spend real time with customers.** Sit alongside them in their workflows, watch where they get stuck, and translate what you learn into product bets your team is willing to ship behind. * **Partner with the product team to decide** ***what*** **to build, not just** ***how***. Form hypotheses about customer value, design the smallest experiment that could prove them out, and learn fast. Push back on briefs that aren't grounded in evidence. * **Take new product surfaces from 0 to 1\.** Pitch, prototype, ship, and drive adoption with real users.
