jobs.title: Senior AI Enablement Engineer
jobs.description: **About Beazley Security** Beazley Security is a global cybersecurity firm committed to helping clients enable advanced cyber defenses that reduce risk with quantifiable results. We’re comprised of top talent from private industry, government, intelligence, and law enforcement who are specialists in threat detection, incident response, digital forensics, offensive security, risk management, and cyber resilience. As a subsidiary of a specialty insurance giant, Beazley Insurance, we’ve been at the forefront of cyber insurance management and breach response activities for business clients in the US, UK, and Europe since 2017\. As Beazley Security, the company will have an expanded scope, leveraging nearly two decades of cyber incident experience, a strong services division, and a business strategy focused on growth, to realize our goals and deliver benefits to clients. As a company, we are committed to upholding our core values of Belonging, Integrity, Service, Accountability, and Curiosity. We believe these values are essential to creating a strong and inclusive workplace culture, as well as to deliver world\-class cybersecurity solutions to our clients worldwide. As Beazley Security, these values will continue to thrive, with an extra emphasis on expansion of our capabilities and capacity in helping solve unique client challenges. **Summary** Beazley Security has Claude and Microsoft Copilot deployed across the company. The next step is putting agents to work across every team in the business. This is our first hire dedicated to making that happen. You’ll work with operations, sales, finance, and other non\-technical teams to find manual work worth automating. You’ll build agents in Claude and Copilot Studio, get them into daily use, and measure the time they save. Early on you’ll build most of them yourself, while teaching teams to build their own. You’ll have a big say in what we tackle first and how we build it. This is the first hire for what we plan to grow into a team, so a lot of what you set up early will stick. Beazley Security protects client data and systems for a living, so you’ll build security and privacy into every agent from the start. You’ll help us establish safeguards to ensure that agents can go into production quickly and safely, by building upon our existing agentic security tooling and capabilities.**Responsibilities** * Spend time with teams across the business, watch how the work gets done, and pick the problems where an agent saves hours or removes a manual, error\-prone step. Agree on what success looks like before you build. * Turn a stream of AI ideas into a short, ranked backlog with a clear call on each: build it, help the team build it, or leave it alone. * Estimate what each agent will cost to run, including licensing and token consumption. Use our pre\-agreed guardrails so low\-risk agents go live quickly, and bring in Security, IT, Legal, or Privacy when a use case needs a closer look. * Design, build, test, and deploy AI agents and supporting automation using the Claude Platform and Microsoft Copilot Studio. * Build a group of champions across the business, run hands\-on build sessions and office hours, and create the templates and playbooks teams use to build their own agents safely. * Help maintain a record of every agent in production with its owner, data sources, and access. Evaluate new AI tools when teams ask about them and recommend whether we adopt them. **Your First 90 Days** * **Days 1 to 30:** Get to know Beazley Security. Sit with at least three teams, map their most painful workflows, and build your first agent yourself. Get it into real use, even if it’s small. * **Days 31 to 60:** Two or three agents in production, each measured against a baseline of “value”. A published intake process, and your first AI champions identified. * **Days 61 to 90:** At least one team can point to manual work that’s gone. The agent register and build playbook are live. * **After that:** Champions build their own agents using your patterns, and your results justify the next hire onto this team. **What You'll Have** * Executive buy\-in and support. You report to our Chief Product and Technology Officer, who uses AI every day and has built several agents for internal use. Expect quick decisions and direct help when a project gets stuck. * A first project. A business sponsor and workflow lined up before day one. * A fast review path. Guardrails agreed with Security and Legal before you start, so low\-risk agents don’t sit in a queue. **Qualifications** * You’ve built AI agents or automations that are in daily use, with low\-code tools like Copilot Studio or with code (Python, TypeScript, and the Claude API). * You have hands\-on experience with prompt and context design, retrieval, tool use, and evaluating agent output, and you know where LLMs fail. * You’ve integrated with REST APIs, MCP servers, connectors, and enterprise authentication. * You’ve typically spent four or more years in a business\-facing technical role such as solutions engineering, solutions consulting, business analysis, automation, or platform delivery. * You can learn a finance or sales operations workflow from the people who run it and build something that improves it. * You know when a use case needs a security or privacy review before it goes anywhere, and you can estimate what an agent will cost to run on Copilot credits or Claude API usage. * You’ve run workshops or training for non\-technical audiences, and you write clearly. * You’d rather ship a small agent that works than constantly plan and iterate on a big one. **Preferred** * Experience in cybersecurity. * Experience running an AI champions program, community of practice, or citizen developer program. * Experience setting up lightweight AI guardrails, like an agent inventory or risk tiers, that keep teams moving quickly. * Familiarity EU data protection requirements. * **When you apply, please** **include a link or a short screen recording of something you built.** **Beazley Security Offers** * Competitive salary and bonus. * Flexible working arrangements. * Generous leave policies including 3 months paid parental. * 100% of employee\-only insurance premiums covered (healthcare, dental and vision). * Up to 5% matched 401k contribution. * Opportunities for career advancement and ongoing training. * Participation in industry conferences and events.

jobs.description: New York Engineering In office Full\-time **What is Bilt?** Bilt is the membership for where you live. What started as a way to reward people on their largest expense has turned into an ecosystem connecting our members, property managers and local merchants. Travel, dining, fitness, everyday spend. We are building systems across payments, credit, loyalty, and commerce all at once. We run lean and move quickly. Every person here has a real impact on what gets built and how fast it happens. This role comes with real ownership and high expectations. If you prefer clearly defined lanes and structure, this will feel uncomfortable. If you want to build quickly, have a real say in what gets built, and work on products used by millions, you will likely do your best work here. **What is Bilt?** ----------------- Bilt is the membership for where you live. We started by rewarding people on their biggest expense, rent, and have grown into a network connecting members, property managers, and local merchants across dining, travel, fitness, and everyday spending. **The role** ------------ Concierge runs in the Bilt app, on the web, and over SMS, iMessage, and email. Members use it for dining, rent, payments, travel, and support. Restaurants and property managers use it to talk with their customers, and their staff use it as an assistant. It handles tens of thousands of conversations a day, with 2–3x spikes at the start of every month, and you'll build and run the backend behind all of it. **What you'll work on** ----------------------- * Agent capabilities end to end: tools, workflows, prompts, and the integrations with Bilt and partner systems behind them * The agent runtime: multi\-agent orchestration, context and memory, prompt caching, and routing across frontier and open\-weight models * Performance: p50 and p99 across the full request path, bursty traffic, and cost per conversation * Eval harnesses, LLM judges, and conversation replay, so every model and prompt change is measured before it ships * Assistants for merchants' staff that work from the business's own data, and browser agents that can act where no API exists * Proactive features that drive engagement with members and merchants' customers: briefings, follow\-ups, and outreach that land at the right moment * The conversation platform: one inbox where the agent, merchant staff, and Bilt support share threads across SMS, iMessage, email, web, and in\-app chat * Messaging: realtime streaming replies, attachments, message ordering and idempotent delivery, carrier and iMessage sending limits, and handing off to a person at the right moment * Authentication and fine\-grained authorization, so the agent only sees and does what it should for members, merchants, and staff **How we build** ---------------- We are an AI\-native team. Agents are part of how we write, review, debug, and operate everything. * **Writing.** Coding agents like Claude Code and Devin write much of our code. You design it, review it, and own what ships * **Reviewing.** Every PR gets AI review against rules we write down (prompt\-cache pitfalls, security, performance) before a human codeowner signs off * **Debugging.** Agents have access to our production tooling through an internal MCP gateway: logs, traces, analytics, feature flags, and the service catalog. Investigations usually start with an agent pulling the evidence * **Sharing context.** Repos carry agent instructions, and we keep a shared library of skills and playbooks, so recurring work becomes a single command and every agent starts with the team's context * **Owning.** Each engineer owns a large surface from design through rollout and on\-call. We ship daily behind flags, treat performance and availability as acceptance criteria, and read real conversations, not only dashboards **You have** ------------ * 4\+ years building and operating backend services in production * Strength in at least one backend language and experience running services in the cloud. We mostly use Python (FastAPI), Java (Quarkus), and Go on Google Cloud * Solid distributed systems fundamentals (async processing, pub/sub, idempotency, retries, caching), and you debug across services with logs, traces, and metrics * Hands\-on experience with LLMs, at work or on your own, and curiosity about making them reliable * Product judgment: you can read a bad conversation and tell whether the cause is the prompt, a tool, the data, or a service * Daily use of AI coding agents, and good judgment about when to trust their output * Clear writing. Design docs, PR descriptions, and the prompts you give agents all matter here **Bonus** --------- * Shipped an LLM\-powered feature to real users, and can explain what broke and how you measured it * Agent frameworks (Google ADK, LangGraph, or similar), tool calling, evals, LLM\-as\-judge * Model serving and inference: provider routing, open\-weight models, latency and cost tuning * Messaging or realtime infrastructure * Browser automation or computer\-use agents * Identity and access: OAuth/OIDC, token exchange, fine\-grained authorization **Benefits** ------------ * **Compensation** \- We offer a competitive salary with a meaningful stake in the company via equity and our performance bonus program * **Health insurance for you (\& your loved ones) from day one \-** Enjoy a One Medical Membership, wellness stipends, family programs and more, on us. We’ve got you and your family covered from day one. * **401k plan with a match \-** Retirement may feel more like a pipe dream than a reality but we’re here to help you get there. * **Commuter FSAs \-** We believe the best ideas come from being together in one place. We just don’t think getting there should be so expensive. * **UNLIMITED PTO \-** Because we believe that working hard shouldn’t mean always working. Take time for yourself as often as you need it. * **Exclusive Employee only Bilt Points \-** We give our employees unique opportunities to earn points throughout their time at Bilt. * **Team Events \-** We believe in human connection so we hold events to help our employees break from the monotony of the typical work week. At Bilt Rewards, we believe in transparency and we do our best to make sure the company and our candidates are on the same page as it relates to compensation. In addition to posting salary ranges for our open roles, candidates should expect to be asked about compensation expectations and requirements early on in their interview process. Our goal is to highlight when expectations and Bilt’s salary range may be out of sync, and work with the candidate to determine whether it makes sense to continue conversations. We are considering candidates with differing levels of expertise for this position. Leveling will be based upon your experience and performance in the interview process. Where a new hire falls within a range will be based on their skills and experience, and how these competencies compare across other employees in the same role. Bilt's bands are designed to allow for individual compensation growth within the role. As such, new hires typically start at the lower end of the range. Bilt Rewards performance and outcomes \- should you join the company, you will have the opportunity to grow your salary over time. The salary range for a **Back End / AI Engineer** is **$170,000 \- $300,000** *(based on YOE/level)***,** and you will be eligible for equity and an annual performance\-based bonus. Req ID: R349

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Frontend
jobs.description: **About Block Labs** ==================== Block Labs is a premier technology studio operating at the bleeding edge of **Web3, Artificial Intelligence, and iGaming**. We don't just ship features; we engineer high\-scale, production\-grade platforms that power the next generation of digital products. We are a collective of senior engineers, product strategists, and builders who refuse to compromise on architecture. Whether we are designing autonomous multi\-agent AI systems, building decentralized financial infrastructure, or architecting high\-frequency iGaming platforms, our standard is excellence. We move fast, but we build for the long term. If you are looking to work alongside a team that values deep technical expertise, thoughtful system design, and product ownership, Block Labs is where you belong. **The role** ============ We are building the frontend of a multi\-brand consumer platform in React, Next.js and TypeScript: one codebase serving several brands, where launching a brand should be a matter of configuration, not a copy. You will be the most senior frontend engineer in the company and the person the platform’s UI depends on. We don’t hire into squads. We work as a small number of very strong individual contributors, each owning a product end to end and shipping with AI agents at a pace that used to take a team. You get an outcome and constraints, not a backlog: you find the decisions nobody has made, scope the work, build it, ship it and stay accountable for how it behaves in production. Product ideas often arrive as working prototypes built with AI tools by people outside engineering. Your job is to steer them into production, not to reject them or rebuild them from zero. **Key Responsibilities:** ========================= * Own the frontend end to end: architecture, conventions, quality bar and production behaviour of a multi\-brand platform, with no spec handed to you. * Make adding a brand a configuration change: theming, brand\-aware routing and content, and clean boundaries between shared and brand\-specific code, all on a live product. * Build and own the design system and component library that engineers, designers and AI\-assisted prototyping all draw from. * Turn product prototypes into production features fast, and build the workflow and tooling that make this repeatable. * Ship with AI coding agents every day as your main way of working, with the checks that keep quality high at agent speed, and raise the bar for how others use them. * Ship consumer\-facing UI with real attention to detail, performance and accessibility. * Take UX and product concerns straight to the people who own the product, with alternatives and working examples, not just objections. **About You:** ============== * 8\+ years building production consumer\-facing web applications, several of them at Staff or equivalent ownership. * You have taken a frontend from a rough brief to production and owned it, and you can say exactly what was yours, what was your team’s and what was your agents’. * AI coding agents are how you build, not a helper. You have your own setup and can say precisely where agents make you faster, where they produce plausible but wrong output, and how you catch it. * Deep expertise in React, Next.js and modern TypeScript, with clear opinions on rendering strategies and when each is the wrong choice. * Hands\-on experience building or re\-architecting multi\-brand, multi\-tenant or white\-label frontends. * You have built or owned a design system and can discuss consistency versus flexibility, adoption and governance. * Strong UI and UX sensibility: you notice the small things and fix them without being asked. * Comfortable working with non\-engineers who build with AI tools, and you design for their output to be usable. * Demonstrable Core Web Vitals work in production. * You thrive with autonomy and light process, and you write clearly. Strong command of written and verbal English. **Nice to have** ================ * Experience with real\-time, high\-interaction consumer interfaces where latency and feel matter. * Background in fintech, crypto, real\-time gaming and entertainment platforms, or other high\-traffic consumer products. * Tooling, skills or integrations you built so agents work better inside a specific codebase or design system. * Working knowledge of CI/CD and cloud environments. **What this role is not** ========================= * Not a management or lead role. Influence comes from what you ship. * Not a pure architecture role. You write production code every day. * Not for someone who wants a team, a backlog or a complete spec before starting. **What kind of culture can I expect?** Mature, mission\-driven, and low\-ego. We value clarity over noise, outcomes over theatrics, and pace without chaos. If you’re one of the smartest minds in your craft and want to build with other experts, you’ll feel at home here.

jobs.description: AI Engineer 4 (Gen AI Platform Services) At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real\-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world\-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI \& ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world\-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high\-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build. **Team Description:** The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand\-in\-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI, in responsible and scalable ways for the highest leverage impact. **What You’ll Do:** * Partner with a cross\-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI\-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One. * Design, develop, test, deploy, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, agents and multi\-agent workflows, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc. * Leverage a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, PyTorch, and more. * Invent and introduce state\-of\-the\-art foundation model optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems. * Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One. * Own the end\-to\-end architecture for complex AI systems \- ensuring maintainability, observability, and ethical alignment * Define and maintain service\-level objectives (SLOs) for AI reliability, including latency, uptime, and model performance drift * Collaborate with infrastructure engineering to optimize GPU/TPU utilization and accelerate model inference pipelines * Lead cross\-functional technical reviews for new AI system deployments, ensuring security, data governance, and compliance standards are met * Mentor Principal and Senior Associates on scalable design, performance tuning and research\-to\-production translation **The Ideal Candidate:** * You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. jobs.title: MMS/RPG Engineer
jobs.description: Specialization: IBM i / RPG I Location: Remote (US) CapNexus is an AWS consulting partner specializing in AI and cloud engineering. We build and deliver software through agentic engineering: we build and operate the systems that produce code, direct AI tooling to accelerate delivery, and exercise the judgment that keeps AI\-generated work correct. Everyone at CapNexus works fluently inside our delivery system, which combines agentic tooling, spec\-driven development, evidence\-based quality, and AI\-augmented delivery governance. **Who You Are and What You'll Do:** CapNexus is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to own complex software outcomes: designing and building applications, APIs, and services, and raising the bar for the engineers around you. You'll work through our agentic delivery system, where AI tooling carries the mechanical load and you own the architecture, the correctness of what ships, and the growth of the people you mentor. We care more about how you think about building systems than which language you learned first. In this role, you'll focus on IBM i: building and supporting RPG applications, the DB2 for i data behind them, and the integrations that connect them to the rest of the business. **Responsibilities:** * Build and maintain IBM i applications in free\-format RPGLE, SQLRPGLE, and CL, using ILE concepts such as procedures, service programs, and modules. * Work with DB2 for i through SQL and DDS, including physical and logical files and subfiles. Integrate IBM i applications with other systems through web services, JSON and XML, FTP, and the Integrated File System (IFS). * Support changes through testing, deployment, and post\-deployment, and resolve technical issues directly with client teams. * * Set coding and testing standards for IBM i work, and identify where modernizing an application pays off. * Own the technical outcome for a system area or major feature set: propose the approach, define the task breakdown, and deliver with minimal escalation. * Design APIs and data models that account for cost, scale, and failure, and build in observability (logging, tracing, and metrics) from the start. * Work with Cloud Engineers on infrastructure as code and CI/CD so what you build deploys the same way every time. * Partner with the Solutions Architect on solution design and with the Engagement Manager on delivery, and turn designs into a build plan the team can execute. * Set code\-quality standards for your area, and mentor Software Engineers I and II through pairing and reviews that teach, including how to direct AI tooling and check what it produces. * Join architecture presentations and technical deep\-dives alongside the Solutions Architect when the client needs your depth. **How You'll Work: Agentic Engineering:** You own outcomes on complex work, exercise architectural judgment, and raise the bar for those around you. * **Agentic tooling.** Set the tooling approach for a codebase or engagement: which work goes to a conversion engine, which is spec\-driven build, where the human\-in\-the\-loop gates belong, and how the toolchain is wired for the problem at hand. * **Spec validation and readiness.** Own the quality of the handoff from specification to build. Make sure specs are executable and actually satisfy the requirements, and hold delivered work to a defined readiness bar. When generated code is wrong, fix the spec, not just the output. * **Validating AI output.** Be the final judgment on correctness for high\-risk changes, including in unfamiliar domains, by designing the evidence that proves behavior is preserved. * **Delivery\-system ownership.** Design and maintain the project\-specific setup of our delivery tooling (steering, agent roles, templates, quality gates, and metrics) as durable capability, not one\-off scaffolding. **Judgment over correctness:** you can tell when confident, plausible\-looking AI output is quietly wrong. Tooling does the mechanical work; you're accountable for whether it's right. **Qualifications:** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * A strong grasp of architecture concepts: event\-driven and service\-based design, API design, data modeling, separation of concerns, and designing for change. * Experience owning a significant system from design through production, and mentoring the engineers who built it with you. * Working knowledge of CI/CD and infrastructure as code. * Hands\-on experience with spec\-driven or agentic development workflows, where specs drive code generation, for example Kiro, Claude Code, Amazon Q Developer, or Cursor with rules. Using AI only for autocomplete or snippets doesn't count. * A track record of catching what AI\-generated or refactored code gets quietly wrong, and of building the tests and gates that prove behavior is preserved. * Hands\-on experience programming on IBM i (AS/400, iSeries): free\-format RPGLE, SQLRPGLE, CL, and OS/400 commands. * Strong SQL skills on DB2 for i, plus working knowledge of DDS, subfiles, and older RPG (RPG III and fixed format). * Experience with IBM i Access Client Solutions or iSeries Navigator, the IFS, and JSON and XML. \| * Experience with Blue Yonder (JDA) MMS. **Nice to Have:** * Experience with AWS or application modernization, such as integrating IBM i applications with AWS services or moving IBM i workloads to modern platforms. * Experience with Java, including Java on IBM i or RPG\-to\-Java modernization. * Experience supporting IBM i in an enterprise data center. * Background in retail. **Our Culture:** Four keystones guide how we work: * **Customer obsessed, delivery focused.** We deliver what we promise. Trust \= consistency × time. * **Learning and sharing.** We hire lifetime learners, and teaching others matters as much as knowing. * **Growth and scalability.** We value cross\-functional skills over role boundaries, and simple solutions over clever ones. * **All work is strategic.** Every engagement, big or small, is a chance to earn trust that lasts. **We offer:** Job Type: Full\-time Benefits: Medical, dental, 401(k), and more CapNexus is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and safe environment for all employees. Experience comes in many forms, and we're dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly align with what we have listed. We look forward to hearing from you. **No Agencies Please!**

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer - Remote
jobs.description: **Applied AI Engineer** **About Capsule** Capsule is rebuilding the pharmacy experience to be smarter, friendlier, and faster. For over a decade, we have offered free same\-day home delivery. Today, we operate nationally and have raised over $500M from premier healthcare and tech investors. To eliminate prescription friction, our ClearRx product integrates directly with specialty practices' EMR systems. We handle insurance benefit checks, prior authorizations, patient communications, and delivery on their behalf. AI powers our scale. We build end\-to\-end AI agents for prescription workflows, backed by human judgment where needed. Our engineers leverage AI coding tools, partner closely with business teams, and directly impact patient and provider care. **About the Role:** As an Applied AI Engineer, you will work directly with business stakeholders to understand key Capsule workflows and build AI agents that improve them. You will own projects end to end, from mapping the process to delivering production systems that drive measurable business outcomes, with a "right and fast" approach. * Partner with business stakeholders to map key workflows end to end and identify opportunities for automation and process improvement * Design, build and deploy AI agents, along with the APIs, services and workflows that support them, using Python, Kotlin or other programming languages your team uses * Build evaluations and backtesting to measure agent accuracy before launch, and monitor performance in production * Define success metrics for each project, track results against them, and iterate until business goals are met * Write Technical Specs that communicate architectural approaches and present them to internal peers for review and feedback * Provide mentorship to other engineers through code reviews and architecture reviews **Requirements:** * You have 3 \- 8 years of overall software engineering experience * You are an expert in one or more mainstream programming languages such as Python or Kotlin * You have experience building and deploying LLM\-based applications or AI agents in production * You have experience designing evaluations and monitoring for AI systems * You use AI coding tools as a regular part of your development workflow * You have experience developing and maintaining full\-stack applications, including both frontend and backend services * You are comfortable working directly with business stakeholders and translating their needs into technical solutions * You have been part of a team that owned software components critical to driving business outcomes **What We Offer** * The starting anticipated earnings for this position is between $130,000 and $200,000 base salary contigent on performance and leveling. * Compensation packages include base pay and benefits * Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage * The opportunity to work alongside some of the brightest minds in healthcare and technology * The opportunity to execute on a high\-impact mission, to build a pharmacy that works for everyone, within a $425 billion pharmacy industry touching 70% of Americans once a month Capsule is committed to hiring the best team possible to build a pharmacy that works for everyone. We have a diverse set of problems to solve, and believe that we need a diverse set of perspectives to deliver the best possible solutions to those problems. We look for talent from a wide range of backgrounds \- including but not limited to \- race, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, disability, and veteran status.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II
jobs.description: **Who we are** At CarGurus (NASDAQ: CARG), our mission is to give people the power to reach their destination. We started as a small team of developers determined to bring trust and transparency to car shopping. Since then, our history of innovation and go\-to\-market acceleration has driven industry\-leading growth. In fact, we're the largest and fastest\-growing automotive marketplace, and we've been profitable for over 15 years. **What we do** The market is evolving, and we are too, moving the entire automotive journey online and guiding our customers through every step. That includes everything from the sale of an old car to the financing, purchase, and delivery of a new one. Today, tens of millions of consumers visit CarGurus.com each month, and \~30,000 dealerships use our products. But they're not the only ones who love CarGurus—our employees do, too. We have a people\-first culture that fosters kindness, collaboration, and innovation, and empowers our Gurus with tools to fuel their career growth. Disrupting a trillion\-dollar industry requires fresh and diverse perspectives. Come join us for the ride! **Role overview** CarGurus' Conversion team is looking for a Software Development Engineer II (Backend) to help dealers close more of the leads we send them. We turn shopper activity on our marketplace into a clear picture of who each buyer is and what they're looking for, then recommend the next move to the salesperson working that lead. Thousands of dealerships rely on it every day. You'll work in the Java and Spring Boot services behind all of this: enriching each lead as it arrives, consuming high\-volume event streams, and serving the APIs that power the dashboards dealers work in. It's a small team, so you'll take real ownership early. You'll partner closely with product, design, and other backend and frontend engineers to move projects from technical design through implementation and launch, and you'll see the result in dealer adoption and close rates. **What you'll do** * Design, build, and ship features in the Java and Spring Boot services that enrich every lead and power the insights dealers act on every day * Own your work from technical design through testing, code review, and production, with support from the team when you need it * Work with high\-volume event streams and the data behind them (Kafka, MongoDB, Redis) to keep shopper data fresh and APIs fast * Build intelligence features, including LLM\-backed ones, that recommend a dealer's next move rather than just handing them data * Diagnose and fix production issues across services, share in on\-call, and improve the alerting and observability we rely on * Partner with product and design to break ambiguous problems into scoped, shippable work, with a real say in what we build and how * Help raise the bar on how we test, deploy, and operate the services we own **What you'll bring** * 2\-4 years of hands\-on software development experience in a professional setting * Proficiency in Java, ideally with Spring Boot * Solid working knowledge of MongoDB or another NoSQL datastore, and comfort with SQL * Practical understanding of RESTful API design, microservices, and distributed systems, including event streams or message queues (Kafka, SQS, or similar) and caching trade\-offs * Hands\-on experience with AWS and cloud infrastructure * A strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and complexity analysis * A habit of writing automated tests, and a sense for which tests a change actually needs * Experience or interest in leveraging AI coding tools to accelerate development (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) * Nice to have: Python, and hands\-on experience with LLM or agent frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph * Clear communication, curiosity, and a bias toward shipping, with genuine interest in learning the dealer domain **Working at CarGurus** We reward our Gurus' curiosity and passion with best\-in\-class benefits and compensation, including equity for all employees, both when they start and as they continue to grow with us. Our career development and corporate giving programs, as well as our employee resource groups (ERGs) and communities, help people build connections while making an impact in personally meaningful ways. A flexible hybrid model and robust time off policies encourage work\-life balance and individual well\-being. Thoughtful perks like daily free lunch, a new car discount, meditation and fitness apps, commuting cost coverage, and more help our people create space for what matters most in their personal and professional lives. CarGurus may require in\-person interviews as part of our hiring process, particularly for positions based in our Boston and Dublin offices. Candidates selected for an in\-person interview will be notified in advance. Please be aware that travel expenses are the responsibility of the candidate. **We welcome all** CarGurus strives to be a place to which people can bring the ultimate expression of themselves and their potential—starting with our hiring process. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. We foster an inclusive environment that values people for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. That's why we hope you'll apply even if you don't check every box listed in the job description. We also encourage you to tell your recruiter if you require accommodations to participate in our hiring process due to a disability so we can provide the appropriate support. We want to know what only you can bring to CarGurus. \#LI\-Hybrid

jobs.title: AI Engineer III
jobs.description: Description: **About Us** Cerium Networks is a lifecycle\-driven technology partner. We bring together advanced systems integration and professional services to design, deliver, and optimize the platforms our clients depend on, spanning cybersecurity, networking, data center, collaboration, and customer experience solutions—all amplified by AI at every layer. From intelligent automation to data\-driven insights, we help organizations harness AI to transform operations, enhance experiences, and accelerate business value, while our commitment to continuous innovation and lifecycle engagement creates meaningful growth opportunities for our associates to lead in a rapidly evolving, AI\-driven world. We are seeking an AI Engineer III to join our Data \& AI implementation services team to help build and deliver custom\-built features and software solutions on Cerium’s AI Agent Platform hosted on Azure. This is a builder role where you will be a hands\-on developer creating and implementing software solutions for Cerium’s customers. Primary responsibilities focus on designing, developing, and implementing secure and reliable generative AI solutions and application features to build agents and automate workflows for our clients. jobs.title: Senior Protocol Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** We're partnering with **Quant**, a global leader in digital transformation and technology solutions, seeking a ***Senior Protocol Engineer*** to join their team. **About Quant:** Almost all the money in the economy is commercial bank money, and almost none of it moves on chain. Quant is a leading provider of programmable money infrastructure, and our technology changes that: it lets banks issue, move and settle tokenized deposits around the clock, automatically and securely, while staying connected to the systems they already run on. It is already deployed in regulated environments with central and commercial banks in the UK and around the world, including work on the digital pound and the digital euro. The Clearing House, whose networks clear and settle more than $2 trillion a day, has now selected Quant to power its On\-Chain Money Initiative: a new interoperable payments network that will let financial institutions of all sizes clear and settle tokenized deposits, with connectivity to the RTP® and CHIPS® networks. Our technology provides the network's interoperability, orchestration and transaction\-management layer, enabling payments that settle immediately and transactions that trigger automatically once agreed conditions are met. Through our Tokenized Deposits\-as\-a\-Service solution, banks of any size can join without building new infrastructure themselves. The network is expected to become available to participating institutions in the first half of 2027, with use cases across corporate treasury, liquidity management, cross\-border payments and digital asset settlement. We are building the New York team that will run it. **Job Description** **Senior Protocol Engineer** **Role summary** Owns significant workstreams within the smart\-contract release train (TD Coin, Settlement Orchestrator, Fiat Relay, Fusion Root, Orchestrator Factory) and contributes to maintaining the Fusion\-specific upstream diff against Optimism, guiding Protocol Engineers through implementation. **Key responsibilities** * Design and build components within the smart\-contract release train. * Contribute to maintaining and testing the Fusion\-specific upstream diff against Optimism. * Guide Protocol Engineers through implementation and review their work. * Carry the on\-call escalation rotation and join incident bridges for protocol\-behavior issues. * Support external audit preparation and remediation for assigned components. **Qualifications** **Required experience \& qualifications** * 5\+ years in blockchain/DLT, smart\-contract engineering or backend distributed systems. * Strong Solidity/EVM (or equivalent) and integration skills. * Experience with rollup/upstream\-diff maintenance (Optimism stack or comparable) an advantage. * Comfort carrying production on\-call responsibility. **Success measures** * On\-spec, on\-time delivery within the release train. * Post\-release defect and rework rate. * On\-call response within target.

jobs.title: Principal Security Architect - Cybersecurity Engineering - Remote
jobs.description: Join the transformative team at City of Hope, where we're changing lives and making a real difference in the fight against cancer, diabetes, and other life\-threatening illnesses. City of Hope’s growing national system includes its Los Angeles campus, a network of clinical care locations across Southern California, a new cancer center in Orange County, California, and treatment facilities in Atlanta, Chicago and Phoenix. This role defines security architecture standards, engineering roadmaps, and technical control strategies that protect clinical, research, business, and technology environments across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid infrastructures. The position leads the architecture and engineering of identity security, network security, cloud security, endpoint security, application security, data protection, and infrastructure security capabilities. Develop technical standards, design documentation, architecture diagrams, and executive presentations. Mentor cybersecurity engineers and architects. * Provide architectural guidance for secure adoption of AI, machine learning, cloud\-native services, biomedical technologies, IoT, and emerging enterprise technology platforms. * Follows established City of Hope and department policies, procedures, objectives, performance improvement, attendance, safety, environmental, and infection control guidelines, including adherence to the workplace code of Conduct and Compliance Plan. * Practices a high level of integrity and honesty in maintaining confidentiality. * Performs other related duties as assigned or requested. **Your qualifications should include:** **Minimum Education:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Management Information Systems, Computer Information Systems, Computer or Electrical Engineering, or a related field. OR * Three additional years of relevant experience may substitute for the minimum education requirement. **Minimum Experience:** * Nine years or more of progressive cybersecurity experience with significant depth in security architecture, security engineering, or both; or a master’s degree and seven years of relevant experience. * Demonstrated experience designing security controls across complex, multi\-vendor enterprise environments and applying risk analysis, risk assessment, and risk management practices **Pref. Certification/Licensure:** * CISSP, CCSP, SABSA, Microsoft Azure Security Engineer, AWS Security Specialty, or equivalent advanced security architecture and engineering certifications. **Preferred Experience:** * Enterprise cybersecurity engineering and architecture in healthcare, life sciences, or another highly regulated industry. * Design and implementation of Zero Trust architectures and microsegmentation programs. * Cloud security architecture across Azure, AWS, and hybrid environments. * Identity and access management, privileged access management, and identity governance solutions. * Security automation, infrastructure as code, DevSecOps, container security, and Kubernetes security. * Large\-scale deployment and management of enterprise security platforms and controls. **City of Hope employees pay is based on the following criteria: work experience, qualifications, and work location.** **City of Hope is an equal opportunity employer.** **To learn more about our Comprehensive Benefits, please****CLICK HERE****.**

jobs.description: #### **About Clockwork Systems** **Clockwork.io – Software Driven Fabrics to increase GPU cluster utilization** Clockwork Systems was founded by Stanford researchers and veteran systems engineers who share a vision for redefining the foundations of distributed computing. As AI workloads grow increasingly complex, traditional infrastructure struggles to meet the demands of performance, reliability, and precise coordination. Clockwork is pioneering a software\-driven approach to AI fabrics by delivering **cross\-stack observability** to catch and quickly resolve problems, **workload fault tolerance** to keep jobs running through failures, and **performance acceleration** that dynamically routes and paces traffic to avoid congestion. #### **To learn more, visit** **www.clockwork.io****.** ### **About the Role** We're building infrastructure for fault\-tolerant, high\-performance distributed GPU training. You'll work at the intersection of GPU systems, high\-speed networking, and distributed coordination—designing and implementing systems that run at scale. This is a systems building role. You'll dig into internals, understand why things break under pressure, and design solutions that handle the messy reality of distributed systems. ### **What You'll Do** * Design and implement low\-level systems software for GPU clusters * Work with internals of frameworks like PyTorch, NCCL, CUDA runtime—not as a user, but modifying and extending them * Build components that make large\-scale GPU training more reliable and efficient * Debug complex distributed/concurrent systems where failures are subtle and non\-deterministic * Own systems end\-to\-end: from design through production ### **What We're Looking For** Required: Systems building experience You've designed and built complex systems—not just deployed or operated them. Examples: * Kernel subsystems, device drivers, or OS\-level components * Distributed storage, databases, or coordination systems * Runtimes, profilers, or performance tooling * Network stacks, protocols, or high\-performance I/O systems * Large\-scale infrastructure at the systems layer Core technical skills: * Strong C/C\+\+ in systems contexts * Deep understanding of concurrency, memory models. * Experience reasoning about distributed system behavior: consistency, ordering, partial failures * Comfortable reading and modifying large, unfamiliar codebases Nice to have: * GPU programming (CUDA) or GPU systems experience * High\-performance networking (RDMA, InfiniBand) * ML framework or runtime internals * Cluster scheduling or orchestration systems *We believe strong systems engineers pick up domain\-specific tools quickly. We value your ability to reason about complex systems over checkbox familiarity with our specific stack.* **Enjoy** * Challenging projects. * A friendly and inclusive workplace culture. * Competitive compensation. * A great benefits package. * Catered lunch. Compensation for this position will vary based on the skills and experience you bring, as well as internal equity considerations. For candidates hired at the posted level, the expected base salary range is $150,000 \- $210,000\. In addition to cash compensation, this role is eligible to participate in the **company's equity program**, which may include stock options granted in accordance with the company's equity plan and subject to approval and applicable vesting schedules. **Clockwork Systems is an equal opportunity employer.** We are committed to building world\-class teams by welcoming bright, passionate individuals from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. We believe diversity drives innovation, and we grow stronger together.

jobs.title: AI Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description: * This is not a traditional software engineering role. The AI Customer Assurance Engineer sits at the intersection of customer support, product support, security/compliance, and AI\-enabled service delivery. * The primary focus is responding to customer information requests, managing product documentation, partnering with security/legal/product teams, and helping improve AI tools used in customer\-facing support processes. * Ideal backgrounds include Customer Assurance, Product Support, Technical Account Management, Customer Success Engineering, Security Compliance, Information Governance, or Technical Support. * Strong communication, stakeholder management, and compliance/security knowledge are more important than hands\-on software development or infrastructure engineering experience. **Job Title:** AI Customer Assurance Engineer / AI Product Support Engineer **Location:** Research Triangle Park (RTP), NC **Onsite/Remote/Hybrid:** Remote (sporadic onsite presence in RTP) **Duration:** Long term ongoing contract **What will you be doing?** **Position Overview:** The AI Customer Assurance Engineer is responsible for delivering accurate, timely, and high\-quality responses to customer information requests while helping to advance the team's use of AI to improve service delivery. This role combines product subject matter expertise with responsibility for training and refining the AI tools that support customer\-facing teams. The ideal candidate is a customer\-focused problem solver with a strong technical foundation and an interest in applying AI to improve service quality. You will be responsible for owning customer information requests for assigned products, ensuring accurate and consistent responses, and maintaining up\-to\-date product documentation. This role is responsible for training and refining the AI tools that help the team respond to customers more efficiently, ensuring AI\-generated content is accurate and appropriately reviewed. The AI Customer Assurance Engineer partners with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders to resolve complex requests, improve processes, and maintain compliance with data privacy and regulatory standards. The successful candidate will be a motivated self\-starter with a solid technical background, capable of balancing hands\-on customer engagement with helping shape the future of AI\-enabled service delivery. **Who You Are:** * A detail\-oriented problem solver with a track record of delivering accurate, high\-quality customer support. * Possess working knowledge of information management, customer data requests, and compliance considerations. * Comfortable working with emerging AI tools and interested in helping shape how AI supports customer service. * Skilled at managing multiple requests, prioritizing effectively, and meeting deadlines in a dynamic environment. * Thrive in collaborative, cross\-functional environments and build strong relationships with collaborators at all levels. * Analytical and resourceful, with sound judgment in ambiguous or complex situations. * Passionate about continuous improvement and committed to maintaining high standards of service quality and accuracy. **Responsibilities:** * Own and respond to customer information requests for assigned products, ensuring accuracy and consistency. * Maintain up\-to\-date product documentation and knowledge resources for customer\-facing teams. * Review and help train the AI tools used to support customer requests, improving accuracy and response quality over time. * Partner with internal teams to research and resolve complex or escalated customer requests. * Build and maintain relationships with internal stakeholders and partners to ensure service needs are met. * Identify and help implement best practices, tools, and technologies to optimize service delivery. * Monitor performance metrics and contribute to continuous improvement efforts. * Support change management as new processes and technologies are adopted. * Ensure compliance with relevant data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements. * Provide coverage and knowledge\-sharing support for teammates as needed. **Qualifications:** **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Management, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 3\+ years of experience in customer support, information management, or a related role. * Background in security or compliance, with essential domain knowledge of the products and customer requests supported. * Strong analytical, creative, and strategic problem\-solving skills. * Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across product, engineering, security, and legal teams. * Ability to navigate ambiguous situations and exercise sound judgment with incomplete information. * Strong communication skills. * Interest in or experience working with AI\-enabled tools Pay: $45\.00 \- $47\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Experience: * Technical support: 6 years (Required) * AI Tools: 2 years (Required) Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Network Incident Response Engineer
jobs.description: The **Senior Network Incident Response Engineer** will provide hands\-on network operations and incident response support in a large\-scale global enterprise supporting manufacturing facilities, warehouses, and office locations. This role requires an operations\-first mindset, strong troubleshooting skills, and the ability to respond quickly to network incidents impacting business operations.The successful candidate will work within a 10\-person operations team supporting a high\-volume enterprise environment, handling LAN, WAN, SD\-WAN, wireless, routing, switching, and connectivity incidents while partnering closely with senior engineers and internal customers. This individual will be expected to begin contributing to incident management activities within the first week and progress rapidly through structured training and mentorship. **3x a week onsite** **Responsibilities** * Respond to and resolve high\-priority network incidents, including P1 incidents requiring immediate engagement and rapid service restoration. * Manage and progress P2 and P3 incidents within the operational support queue. * Support manufacturing, warehouse, and office locations throughout North America and the broader global enterprise. * Perform troubleshooting across OSI Layers 1 through 4 to isolate faults and restore services. * Diagnose network outages, slowness, connectivity issues, hardware failures, software defects, and performance degradation. * Troubleshoot Layer 2 technologies including VLANs, trunking, MAC address tables, spanning\-tree operations, switching loops, and wireless connectivity. * Troubleshoot Layer 3 technologies including IP addressing, subnetting, inter\-VLAN routing, routing tables, WAN connectivity, and BGP operations. * Analyze Layer 4 connectivity issues involving TCP, UDP, firewall policies, application reachability, session establishment, resets, and timeouts. * Support SD\-WAN operations and troubleshooting activities utilizing Cisco vManage. * Investigate site outages and node failures to determine root cause and implement corrective actions. * Coordinate with internet service providers and telecommunications carriers to resolve WAN and circuit\-related issues. * Troubleshoot wireless saturation, RF interference, roaming issues, access point connectivity problems, and endpoint wireless challenges. * Identify network changes, hardware failures, software bugs, and external factors contributing to incidents. * Use network monitoring, observability, and troubleshooting platforms to identify affected infrastructure and accelerate service restoration. * Participate in daily operational review meetings and dashboard reviews to prioritize workload and track incident progress. * Work alongside senior engineers to learn enterprise troubleshooting methodologies and operational best practices. * Support incident response activities in a zero\-trust network environment. * Participate in an on\-call rotation supporting critical production networks. **Day\-to\-Day Environment** * Review operational dashboards and incident queues daily. * Manage approximately 120 active operational tickets in a fast\-paced support environment. * Support a network environment experiencing significant annual incident volume. * Work with multiple monitoring and observability platforms to locate and resolve issues. * Collaborate with engineering teams, local site contacts, network providers, and internal stakeholders. * Utilize a broad collection of operational and troubleshooting tools while continuously expanding technical expertise. QualificationsRequired Qualifications * CCNP certification. * 6\+ years of enterprise network engineering, network operations, or incident response experience. * Strong hands\-on troubleshooting experience in large enterprise environments. * Deep understanding of TCP/IP networking fundamentals and the OSI model. * Experience troubleshooting Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking issues. **Strong knowledge of:** * Switching and routing * VLANs * STP (Spanning Tree Protocol) * BGP (Border Gateway Protocol) * WAN technologies * IP subnetting and binary concepts * LAN and wireless networking * Experience supporting Cisco enterprise networking environments. * Experience troubleshooting network hardware failures and software defects. * Experience working directly with Cisco TAC and third\-party service providers. * Ability to interpret logs, interface statistics, routing information, and network telemetry data. * Strong understanding of redundant network designs and Layer 2 loop prevention. * Knowledge of firewall concepts and network traffic flows. * Excellent communication and customer service skills. * Ability to work effectively in a high\-volume operational environment. * Self\-starter mindset with strong ownership, curiosity, and willingness to learn. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with Cisco SD\-WAN and Cisco vManage. * Experience supporting manufacturing environments. * Experience supporting wireless networks at scale. * Experience with DDI technologies (DNS, DHCP, and IP Address Management). * Exposure to load balancing technologies. * Experience working within zero\-trust environments. Tools \& Technologies * Cisco SD\-WAN (vManage) * Cisco Catalyst Center * Cisco Switching and Routing Platforms * Cisco Wireless Technologies * ThousandEyes * ServiceNow * LiveNX * Glean * Network Monitoring Platforms * ISP and Carrier Portals * BGP * STP * VLANs * TCP/IP * UDP * DDI Technologies Work Schedule Hybrid schedule requiring at least 3 days onsite each week in Warren, Michigan. One to two remote workdays per week. * Participation in an on\-call rotation: * **Day \& Evening (24Hour) on\-call assignment** approximately once every 10 days. * Weekend support approximately once every 10 weeks. **Weekend coverage** runs from **Saturday at 6:00 AM through Monday at 6:00 AM.** * Work schedules are adjusted during on\-call and weekend support periods. **What Success Looks Like** * Begin reviewing and supporting live incidents within the first week. * Achieve approximately 60\-70% operational readiness within the first month. * Demonstrate strong incident ownership and troubleshooting capabilities. * Continuously expand technical knowledge through collaboration with senior engineering staff. Pay: $55\.00 \- $60\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Benefits: * Health insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Software Engineer II - Sales Development
jobs.description: Software Engineer II \- Sales Development Job Description **Company Overview** CoStar Group (NASDAQ: CSGP) is a leading global provider of commercial and residential real estate information, analytics, and online marketplaces. Included in the S\&P 500 Index, CoStar Group is on a mission to digitize the world’s real estate, empowering all people to discover properties, insights and connections that improve their businesses and lives. We have been living and breathing the world of real estate information and online marketplaces for over 35 years, giving us the perspective to create truly unique and valuable offerings to our customers. We’ve continually refined, transformed, and perfected our approach to our business, creating a language that has become standard in our industry, for our customers, and even our competitors. We continue that effort today and are always working to improve and drive innovation. This is how we deliver for our customers, our employees, and investors. By equipping the brightest minds with the best resources available, we provide an invaluable edge in real estate. **Position Overview** As a **Software Engineer II** on the Sales Development team, you will be responsible for building software that supports CoStar Group’s sales teams, with a particular focus on high profile AI initiatives. Our team is building AI solutions that prep sales representatives to have well\-informed and highly\-tailored conversations with prospects and customers. You will help solve real business problems end to end, contributing across the full software development lifecycle from requirements and design through development and production. CoStar is investing heavily in artificial intelligence to accelerate software delivery, improve platform observability, automate research and business workflows, enhance product experiences through intelligent agents and skills, and improve data quality across enterprise systems. Successful candidates will demonstrate a willingness to learn, adopt, and apply AI technologies responsibly to solve complex business and engineering challenges. This position is located in **Richmond, VA** and offers a schedule of Monday to Thursday in office and the option to work from home on Friday. **Responsibilities** * Build customer\-facing web applications using React and TypeScript. * Contribute to design discussions and code reviews, and help keep our engineering standards high. * Build AI\-powered capabilities, such as agents, skills, and tools, that streamline workflows for our sales teams. * Partner with Product, Sales, and Data teams to turn real business problems into shipped solutions. Use AI\-assisted development and testing to deliver quickly while owning the quality and reliability of what you ship. * **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor’s Degree required from an accredited, not\-for\-profit, in\-person college / university * 3\+ years of professional software development experience using modern engineering practices, including Git and CI/CD. * Experience building web applications and RESTful APIs using C\#/.NET and React/TypeScript. * Experience working with relational and/or search\-based data platforms, such as SQL Server and OpenSearch, including data modeling and query optimization. * Exposure to AI\-assisted development or AI\-powered applications, including tools and technologies such as AI coding assistants, large language models (LLMs), or prompt engineering. A track record of commitment to prior employers * **Preferred Qualifications and Skills** * Strong communication skills with both business and technical partners * Familiarity with AWS services such as Lambda, DynamoDB, and SQS * Experience implementing AI agents, workflow automation platforms, or intelligent search solutions Experience with CRM or sales\-facing products * **What's in it for you?** When you join CoStar Group, you’ll experience a collaborative and innovative culture working alongside the best and brightest to empower our people and customers to succeed. We offer you generous compensation and performance\-based incentives. CoStar Group also invests in your professional and academic growth with internal training and tuition reimbursement. Our benefits package includes (but is not limited to): * Comprehensive healthcare coverage: Medical / Vision / Dental / Prescription Drug * Life, legal, and supplementary insurance * Virtual and in\-person mental health counseling services for individuals and family * Commuter and parking benefits * 401(K) retirement plan with matching contributions * Employee stock purchase plan * Paid time off * Tuition reimbursement * On\-site fitness center and/or reimbursed fitness center membership costs (location dependent) * Access to CoStar Group’s Employee Resource Groups Complimentary gourmet coffee, tea, hot chocolate, fresh fruit, and other healthy snacks * The final salary or hourly rate offered for this role will fall within the range set forth below based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, geographic location, skills, and competencies. Base Compensation: $108,000 \- $140,000 annually We welcome all qualified candidates who are currently eligible to work full\-time in the United States to apply. However, please note that CoStar Group is not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position. \#LI\-KW1 CoStar Group is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer; we maintain a drug\-free workplace and perform pre\-employment substance abuse testing

jobs.title: Azure DevOps Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** As an Azure DevOps Site Reliability Engineer, you will make an impact by designing, implementing, and optimizing secure, scalable, and automated cloud solutions on Microsoft Azure. jobs.title: Distinguished Software Engineer
jobs.description: Credit Acceptance is proud to be an award\-winning company recognized both locally and nationally across multiple workplace categories. Our world\-class culture is shaped by dedicated team members who are driven to succeed as professionals individually and together as a team. Backed by a strong product, exceptional people, and a stable financial foundation, we’ve grown into a leading provider of used and new car financing across the country. Our Engineering and Analytics Team Members utilize the latest technology to develop, monitor, and maintain complex practices that help optimize our success. Our Team Members value being challenged, are encouraged to express their ideas, and have the flexibility to enjoy work life balance. We build intrinsic value by partnering with all functions of our business to support their success and make strategic business decisions. We focus on professional development and continuous improvement while enjoying a casual work environment and Great Place to Work culture! Credit Acceptance makes vehicle ownership possible for consumers other lenders decline, through a dealer network, an originations and servicing platform, and pricing and decisioning models refined over decades. The technology estate underneath this business was built project by project over a long period, and modernizing it is the largest engineering opportunity at the company. As the Distinguished Engineer, you are the senior\-most individual contributor in Technology, reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer. You will set the multi\-year technical strategy for the company while staying close enough to the code and systems to remain credible — this is not an architect role that reviews designs from a distance, nor a strong engineer role that goes deep in a single domain. Two things sit at the center of the job: the target architecture for the enterprise, and the architecture for running AI agents across it. You will not own a team; you will own the hardest technical problems the company has, and get them resolved by convincing the people who do own the teams. **Outcomes and Activities** * **Enterprise target architecture:** Convene the principal and staff engineers who own each domain to define the end\-state architecture across originations, servicing, marketplace, data, and AI, and use it to drive the multi\-year plan. Ensure every component has a defined interface with stated inputs and outputs, every unmade decision has a written principle standing in for it, and the document states honestly how close the organization is to the end state. Publish the architecture, including the tradeoffs that were rejected and why. * **Agentic AI architecture across the enterprise:** Own the enterprise agent architecture spanning servicing and collections, the dealer side, originations, and internal engineering and back\-office workflows, built on one common foundation rather than one stack per team. Establish a governed way for agents to discover and call business capabilities, data, and tools, using the Model Context Protocol as the integration layer. Define an identity and authorization model that treats an agent as a first\-class actor with its own least\-privilege entitlements, along with observability, evaluation, and cost controls that work consistently for every agent. Set policy on what an agent may decide independently versus what stays with a person, and define where that line moves and on what evidence. Design the architecture to produce an examiner\-ready record of what each agent saw, recommended, and touched, and set the evaluation and adversarial testing approach that makes agent outcomes defensible. Ensure the same foundation and controls apply to agents built by outside firms on the company's behalf. * **Migration off on\-premises infrastructure:** Own the technical strategy for migrating transactional and analytical workloads off on\-premises infrastructure to the company's strategic targets — AWS for transactional workloads and Databricks for analytical workloads — determining what lifts and shifts, what replatforms, what gets re\-architected on the way versus after, and what the steady\-state cost looks like. Own the resilience and recovery architecture for the target state. * **Data platform architecture:** Set the architecture for change\-data\-capture\-based ingestion, streaming where warranted, and a modern warehouse with no job\-scheduling dependency, moving the organization from largely batch analytical data movement to real time. Help settle the open question of who owns the transactional and analytical data models. * **Real\-time decisioning, model serving, and experimentation:** Architect for pricing and credit model and scorecard updates that drop in as a layer rather than requiring a multi\-quarter rebuild, and for an experimentation platform that supports orders of magnitude more concurrent experiments than a conventional release process allows. * **Marketplace and search architecture to solve enterprise\-wide problems where no precedent exists and to own cross\-team shared infrastructure. * **Strategic Independence:** Ability to define and execute technical strategy for the entire organization, partner closely with executives, mobilize resources, and drive consensus across stakeholders at all levels. * **Visionary Leadership:** Bold strategic thinking paired with curiosity, ingenuity, and resourcefulness; recognized industry\-level thought leadership and a commitment to lifelong learning. * **Customer and Market Insight:** Company\-wide expertise in customer needs, using deep customer and market understanding to shape product and technical strategy and anticipate the impact of industry trends. * **Technical Writing:** Ability to produce architecture documentation clear and complete enough for others to act on independently. * **Executive Communication and Influence:** Ability to build consensus and influence direction across organizational and executive boundaries without formal authority. * **Talent Development:** Ability to raise the technical bar of engineers across the organization, including staff and principal engineers who are not direct reports. **Target Compensation:** A competitive base salary range from $232,500 \- $341,000\. This position is eligible for an annual variable bonus of cash and equity. Bonus amounts are based on individual performance. Final compensation within the range is influenced by many factors including role\-specific skills, depth and experience level, industry background, relevant education and certifications. Candidates who reside in the following major metropolitan areas may be eligible for a premium on top of the posted range based on their specific zone: San Francisco, Seattle, Boston, New York City, Los Angeles and San Diego. INDENGLP \#zip \#LI\-Remote **Benefits** * Excellent benefits package that includes 401(K) match, adoption assistance, parental leave, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive medical/ dental/vision and many nonstandard benefits that make us a Great Place to Work **Our Company Values:** To be successful in this role, Team Members need to be: * Positive by maintaining resiliency and focusing on solutions * Respectful by collaborating and actively listening * Insightful by cultivating innovation, accumulating business and role specific knowledge, demonstrating self\-awareness and making quality decisions * Direct by effectively communicating and conveying courage * Earnest by taking accountability, applying feedback and effectively planning and priority setting **Expectations:** * Remain compliant with our policies processes and legal guidelines * All other duties as assigned * Attendance as required by department **Advice** ! We understand that your career search may look different than others. Our hiring team wants to make sure that this would be a fit not just for us, but for you long term. If you are actively looking or starting to explore new opportunities, send us your application! **P.S** . We have great details around our stats, success, history and more. We’re proud of our culture and are happy to share why – let’s talk! Required degrees must have been earned at institutions of Higher Education which are accredited by the Council for Higher Education Accreditation or equivalent. Credit Acceptance is dedicated to providing a safe and inclusive working environment for all. As part of our Culture of Compliance, we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and value our culturally diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of the person’s age, race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status, criminal history, or any other legally protected characteristic. California Residents: Please click here for the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) notice regarding the personal information Credit Acceptance may collect from you.

jobs.description: **About DAT** DAT Freight \& Analytics is an award\-winning employer of choice and a next\-generation SaaS technology company that has been at the leading edge of freight and logistics innovation for nearly five decades. Founded in 1978, DAT operates the largest freight marketplace in North America — processing 250 million\+ load posts annually and maintaining one of the largest repositories of freight market transaction data in the world. On a defined path to $1 billion in revenue, DAT deploys a suite of software solutions, machine learning models, and intelligent automation tools that help brokers, carriers, and shippers price freight accurately, source capacity, reduce risk, and operate more efficiently. With nearly 700 teammates across offices in Denver, CO; Portland, OR; Seattle, WA; Springfield, MO; Toronto, ON; and Bangalore, India, DAT combines the credibility of a multi\-decade market leader with the drive of a company that is not done disrupting the industry it helped build. For more information, visit www.DAT.com **Job Application Deadline:** 11/30/2026 **The Opportunity** As a Sr AI Engineer, you'll build and own the platform that power our agentic solutions at DAT. Freight is an uncertain business, and the models we ship reduce that uncertainty: rate forecasts, load\-to\-truck matching, document extraction, fraud signals, and the agentic workflows our brokers and carriers use to move freight faster. None of that reaches a customer without a platform that makes training, serving, evaluating, and monitoring models routine instead of heroic. incidents involving AI services, perform root cause analysis, and implement preventative measures. **The Skills and Experience You'll Bring** * 10\+ years of experience in software engineering,
