with models you've taken from notebook to production traffic and then kept healthy. * Strong development language skills ideally using TypeScript/js, Java, or Go, with the software engineering discipline to build libraries other teams adopt willingly. * Extensive AWS experience with production systems, ideally including EKS/Kubernetes, Lambda, Redpanda, MSK/Kafka, S3, and Secrets Manager, plus infrastructure\-as\-code with Pulumi, Terraform or similar. * Hands\-on experience serving models at scale: containerized inference, GPU scheduling, autoscaling, batching, and the tradeoffs between real\-time, streaming, and batch scoring. * Practical experience with LLM systems in production, including retrieval\-augmented generation, vector databases, prompt and context management, tool\-calling or agent frameworks, and managed model APIs such as Amazon Bedrock. * Prov ous problem spaces, writing clear system design documents and operations runbooks, and driving alignment across Engineering, Product, and Operations. * Proven mentoring track record, especially helping engineers and data scientists grow in system design, observability, and operational excellence. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain trade\-offs and system behavior clearly to engineers, product managers, and non\-technical stakeholders. **Bonus Skills** * Experience with model fine\-tuning, distillation, or parameter\-efficient training, and a clear point of view on when it beats prompting. * Background in marketplace, pricing, forecasting, or document extraction problems. jobs.description: Location: San Diego, CA, United States Business: Energy Systems Position type: Full Time Contract type: Permanent Employee Job ID: 7781 **Overview** ------------ ### **About us** We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence. As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations. **About Energy Systems** We help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. We do this by assuring that energy systems work safely and effectively, using solutions that are increasingly digital. We also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry. ### **About the role** The **Senior Data Engineer** is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining data services, APIs, backend systems, and AI\-ready data foundations that support scalable platform capabilities across Digital \& Transformation. Working within the Data \& AI Engineering section, this role contributes hands\-on engineering expertise across Python, SQL, FastAPI, data modeling, API development, and cloud\-native platform technologies. The role supports both deterministic domain workflows through robust backend services and AI\-enabled capabilities through clean, structured, searchable, and governed data foundations. Working closely with Product, AI Engineering, Application Engineering, Solution Engineering, Platform Reliability, Architecture, and Security teams, this role translates complex business and domain requirements into reliable, performant, secure, and maintainable software solutions. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with practical experience delivering APIs, backend platforms, data services, and cloud\-based solutions within agile product development environments. **This position will be in our San Diego, CA; office, presenting a dynamic hybrid schedule where employees will typically spend three (3\) days per week working from either a DNV office or client location/site. Further details regarding role\-specific requirements will be shared during the interview process. Other DNV offices may also be considered.** **What You'll Do** **Software Engineering \& Solution Delivery** * Design, develop, test, and maintain APIs, and platform capabilities that support Product and Engineering objectives. * Contribute hands\-on engineering expertise across solution design, implementation, code review, testing, documentation, and production support. * Translate business requirements and domain expertise into scalable, maintainable, and production\-ready software solutions. * Follow and contribute to engineering standards for API design, data modeling, testing, observability, documentation, and maintainability. * Develop reusable services and components that enable consistent implementation across platform capabilities. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver secure, high\-quality, and reliable software solutions. * Support software solutions that enable applications, workflows, analytics, reporting, and AI\-enabled capabilities. **API Development \& Platform Integration** * Design and build Python\-based services and FastAPI endpoints that expose platform capabilities and domain\-specific functionality. * Develop reliable SQL solutions for storing, querying, transforming, validating, and serving business data. * Collaborate with Application Engineering teams on API contracts, integration patterns, performance considerations, and system interoperability. * Implement secure, scalable, and maintainable APIs that support internal and customer\-facing applications. * Contribute to integration solutions connecting applications, data services, AI\-enabled capabilities, and enterprise platforms. * Support adoption of reusable platform services, shared capabilities, and standardized integration patterns. **AI\-Ready Data Foundations** * Prepare, structure, validate, store, retrieve, and govern data used by AI\-enabled workflows, analytics solutions, search capabilities, and customer\-facing applications. * Contribute to data preparation approaches including metadata enrichment, retrieval optimization, evaluation datasets, and quality feedback mechanisms. * Partner with AI Engineering teams on retrieval\-augmented workflows, document processing pipelines, evaluation activities, and AI solution development. * Develop and maintain AI\-ready data assets that are secure, traceable, maintainable, and suitable for downstream consumption. * Support the implementation of deterministic business lo screening **What is Preferred** * Background in energy, renewables, infrastructure, assurance, certification, or other technically complex industries is a huge plus. * Experience working in product\-led, platform\-based, or software\-as\-a\-service environments. * Experience deploying agents in a secure and efficient way * Experience developing backend services, platform APIs, or shared engineering capabilities. * Familiarity with low\-code or hybrid development environments. * Experience integrating software solutions across multiple systems or enterprise platforms. * Experience supporting AI\-enabled applications, retrieval\-based systems, document processing workflows, or machine\-learning\-adjacent solutions. * Familiarity with vector databases, data governance, observability, lineage, or AI data preparation workflows. * Experience with Azure cloud services, Azure DevOps, cloud security patterns, identity management, and enterprise platform security. * Experience contributing to reusable software standards, API guidelines, architectural patterns, or shared engineering practices. **\*\*Immigration\-related employment benefits, for example visa sponsorship, are not available for this position\*\*** **Benefits** ------------ Please note that some benefits may vary depending on location, business area, and employment terms. Please confirm with your recruiter. ### **Profit Share** You’ll be part of our global profit share scheme that means we all share in our success as a business. If we profit, so do you. This will be part of our Total Compensation approach each year and depends on our year\-end results. ### **Personal Development** You’ll have a lot of opportunities to learn and grow. Whether it’s building your network, having resources to plan and realise your career goals or enjoying genuine freedom to satisfy your curiosity, we’ll make sure you’re always growing and developing. ### **401(k)** DNV provides the option for eligible employees to enroll in our professional managed 401(k) plan. We’ll match up to a percentage of employee elected investment, which will become fully vested after a few years. ### **Healthcare and more** You’ll have multiple medical plans to choose from including Dental, Vision, RX plans, AD\&D, Critical Illness, ST/LT Disability, Paid Parental Leave, Virtual TalkSpace Therapy. ### **Additional benefits** ID theft protection, generous PTO accrual including paid volunteer time off, company paid holidays, discounted pet insurance, dollar\-for\-dollar charitable donation matching, Dollars for Doers, additional vacation hours purchase plan, commuter benefits, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), tuition reimbursement. ### **Values\-led organization** Our values show a commitment to employees and the community they serve. These serve a guiding light on our journey to fulfill our Purpose of safeguarding life, property, and the environment. Driven by these Values, you’ll have the opportunity to give back through not only charitable matched giving, but through direct support to community organizations and as a mentor to students in underserved communities. **Diversity, Equity and Inclusion** ----------------------------------- At DNV, our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is not only an ethical choice, but also a business decision. Diversity, fairness, and a sense of belonging are a source of strength for our people, our business, and our customers, and help us to deliver on our purpose, vision, and values. about DEI **Working here** ---------------- Since 1864 we’ve been dedicated to safeguarding life, property and the environment. Today we remain at the forefront of new technologies and techniques to help our customers transform for a more sustainable future. At DNV you can expect to deliver career and industry defining work. You’ll be given the time to build your network, the resources to support your development, and the freedom to satisfy your curiosity and desire to learn. about Working here

jobs.description: **About Doss** ============== **DOSS is building an Operations Cloud for the real world.** ------------------------------------------------------------ A modern, AI\-native platform for physical product businesses to manage the flow of goods, dollars, and data in real time, across: * Procurement * Inventory * Orders * Fulfillment * Finance **Built to replace spreadsheet chaos and rigid, consultant\-heavy ERPs.** Fast time\-to\-value, adaptable as the business evolves. Through our Adaptive Resource Platform (ARP) and unified operational data model, teams deploy quickly, automate workflows, and make changes without months of re\-implementation. **We recently raised a $55M Series B**, co\-led by Madrona and Premji Invest. Participation from Intuit Ventures, Theory Ventures, General Catalyst, Contrary Capital, and Pathlight VC. DOSS is trusted by fast\-growing operators to run critical operations with speed, control, and confidence. **About the Role** ================== **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Design the core EAV data model \& schema‑as‑code platform** that powers every customer’s instance, balancing extreme flexibility with transactional integrity. * **Build a Git‑style version‑control \+ migration engine** capable of rolling forward/back complex schema and data changes on live production tenants in enterprise settings. * **Engineer AI‑assisted tooling** that uses foundation models to propose, validate, and apply new customer schemas and workflow definitions. * **Scale our white‑labeled data warehouse** (BigQuery/Snowflake‐like) for high‑volume, low‑latency analytics and automation workloads. * **Create Terraform‑like declarative APIs \& SDKs** so ops teams can treat business processes as code while you ensure security, tenancy, and performance. * **Deliver end‑to‑end observability \& search** across supply‑chain, finance, and ops data—surfacing business logic in plain language through AI‐native search. * **Build Enterprise guard rails** into a composable system to proactively detect anomalous behavior or risky emergent patterns * **Mentor and shape engineering culture,** partnering with product and design to turn unsexy back‑office pain into elegant, resilient systems loved by operators. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- **Experience** * Expertise building large scale ETL on databases like Postgres, Elasticsearch, DuckDB, Memgraph (Graph DB), etc * Using cloud services to build \+ deploy reliable web applications * Working in abstractions to build complex graph\-based architectures that scale * Communicating clearly, asking thoughtful questions, and collaborating effectively with both technical and non\-technical teammates. * Taking ownership of problems, and pushing work forward without needing constant direction. * Making sound technical decisions, understanding tradeoffs, and contributing meaningfully to complex discussions. * Breaking down ambiguous problems, investigating root causes, designing practical solutions, and driving them through execution. **Qualities** * Team player: you bring positivity, openness, and curiosity to the team every day. * Growth mindset: everything is an opportunity to learn and improve yourself, the team, and the company. * Craftsmanship: you care about making something of quality. * Pragmatic: you make the right decision based on circumstance, not theory. * Low Ego: you work best in collaborative environments where everyone supports the team. Compensation Range: $180K \- $210K

jobs.title: Technical Business Development Manager, Startup & VC Ecosystem
jobs.description: RDQ427R630 This role is in\-person and Bay\-Area\-based by design, so you can be in the room with founders and investors. At Databricks, we are obsessed with enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems, from security threat detection to cancer drug development. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform, so our customers can focus on the high\-value challenges central to their missions. Founded in 2013 by the original creators of Apache Spark™, Databricks has grown from a tiny corner office in Berkeley, CA, to a global organization with over 11,000 employees. Thousands of organizations, from small startups to Fortune 100, trust Databricks with their mission\-critical workloads, making us one of the fastest\-growing SaaS companies in the world and one of the top 5 most valuable private companies. ### **About the Role:** Databricks works with founders from the earliest days of their companies, when it is still just a team, an idea, and a lot of unproven AI. The Technical Business Development Manager for the Startup and VC Ecosystem owns the operational engine and the relationships behind that work, and the role is technical. You will run our startup program day to day, sit across from early\-stage founders and talk seriously about their AI systems, produce a steady cadence of founder and investor events in San Francisco, and work hand in hand with the events teams at the venture firms whose founders we most want to reach. You will work closely with Databricks Ventures. This role is built to grow: you will start close to the program, the founders, and the events, and over time, take on more of the relationships and the strategy for how Databricks engages the startup ecosystem end\-to\-end. This role asks for four things that rarely sit in one person: the discipline of an operator who tracks every applicant and commitment without dropping one, the hands of a builder who is genuinely fluent in AI and can talk to a founder as a peer, the ease of someone who earns the trust of founders and the partners at the best venture firms in the country, and the judgment to turn all of that into strategy for how Databricks wins the next generation of companies. Most strong candidates have two of these, and some have three. We are hiring for trajectory: you should already be strong in the operating and the building, and hungry to grow into relationships and strategy. This is one of the rare seats where operating, building, and relationship\-building are the same job. ### **The impact you will have:** * *Run the startup program*: Own the day\-to\-day operations of the program, including applicant intake, evaluation, scoring, routing, and offer decisions, with precise tracking of every applicant, commitment, and outcome. Run it on AI automation built with Databricks AI tooling such as Omnigent, Unity Gateway, Agent Bricks, etc. Strong, hands\-on proficiency with these tools is a requirement, not just knowing your way around them. * *Bring programmatic discipline*: Own the trackers, the automation, the quality bar, and the follow\-through so that nothing falls through the cracks. * *Be technical with founders*: Hold real technical conversations with early\-stage founders about their models, agents, data, and automation, and where Databricks and Neon fit. Earn their trust by being credible on the technology, not by pitching. * *Build and prototype*: Build the automation and internal tooling that runs the program, and stay hands\-on with the same AI tools founders use, so you can assess their technical ideas from a place of experience. This is developer relations at its most technical: close to the code and close to the builders. * *Assess and translate*: Assess each founder's technical capability and the strength of their idea, and carry what you learn back to Product and to Databricks Ventures. * *Run founder and investor events*: Design and run a regular calendar of founder and investor gatherings in San Francisco, including dinners, workshops, office hours, and demo\-day tie\-ins. Partner with the events and platform teams at leading venture firms to co\-produce these gatherings, and build durable relationships with those teams that deepen over time. * *Represent Databricks in the ecosystem*: Show up as a founder\-first, technically credible presence at founder and investor events, and grow into being one of the faces of Databricks across the venture community. * *Grow into ownership*: Work alongside Databricks Ventures on how we engage founders across the full arc of their journey, from a first look at their technology and ideas to whatever they build next, and grow into broader ownership of the startup function as you build trust and results. ### **What we look for:** This is a rare combination, and we know it. We are hiring for trajectory as much as for a finished resume: the strongest candidates are already strong on the first three and eager to grow into the rest. * Genuinely technical with AI. You build. You can prototype an automation, reason about an agent architecture, and get into the details of a founder's stack without hand\-waving. * A programmatic operator with an obsessive eye for detail. You run complex, multi\-track programs without dropping a thread. * The developer\-relations instinct. You earn credibility with builders by being one, and you can explain and teach hard technical ideas clearly. * Comfortable around early\-stage founders and investors, and ready to build relationships with top venture firms, starting with their events teams and growing toward their partners. * Experience helping design and run events that people actually want to attend. * Comfort switching between hands\-on technical work, operational execution, and strategic thinking in the same day. * Based in San Francisco. This role requires regular in\-person time with founders and investors in the Bay Area. * Empathy for founders and a long view of their careers. You understand that a founder's first company is rarely their last. * Nice to have: a background as a founder, an early engineer, or a forward\-deployed or solutions engineer; experience in B2B SaaS, AI and data infrastructure, or developer ecosystems. **Pay Range Transparency** Databricks is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The pay range(s) for this role is listed below and represents the expected salary range for non\-commissionable roles or on\-target earnings for commissionable roles. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job\-related skills, depth of experience, relevant certifications and training, and specific work location. Based on the factors above, Databricks anticipates utilizing the full width of the range. The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for annual performance bonus, equity, and the benefits listed above. Zone 1 Pay Range $118,900—$163,450 USD **About Databricks** Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT\&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data \+ AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30\+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram. **Benefits** At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. **Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio\-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics. **Compliance** **If access to export\-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.**

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: **Role Description:** ===================== Being a Product Manager at Defense Unicorns is more than just being part of the sparkliest Product team in defense tech. It means taking radical ownership over real products that make a real impact on real people. At Defense Unicorns, our mission is to make software a strategic deterrent, and our Product Management team clears the path. In this role, you'll report to the Director of Product and work with teams who deliver outcomes that are critical business enablers and directly support both our missions and other internal teams. This team's primary responsibility is the creation and maintenance of tooling and pipelines that support UDS application packaging, as well as maintenance of several packages which comprise our core software deliverables. **Responsibilities:** ===================== **The listed responsibilities are not exhaustive and additional responsibilities may be assigned based on the evolving needs of the organization. We are seeking a dynamic individual who is able to adapt and take on new responsibilities as they arise.** * Passion for the intersection of business, open\-source software, and national security * Participate in and foster open source communities around Defense Unicorns' open source projects * Comfortable owning a product vision end\-to\-end and being accountable for delivering to several customer segments, including both paid and OSS * Managing the expectations and delivery of outcomes of unicorns engineers entrusted to you * Establishing and clearly communicating vision and objectives at all levels of the company \- from engineers to executives * Continuously balance customer, business, and technical priorities with limited resources * Synthesizing external customer requests into an internal product roadmap * Discipline required to work in a fast\-paced, remote environment * Keep our Growth and Delivery teams aligned on roadmap and value proposition in order to support product pricing, customer segmentation, and customer needs * Experience managing, updating and using task, information and code management tools like GitHub, Notion, Hubspot, Google Workspace, etc. * Continuous learning is a must. Stay up\-to\-date with industry trends and best practices in Product Management, DevOps, regulated IT, and the CNCF community * Experience working with and continuously delivering software under Agile software development principles * Understand business strategy and adapt product strategy and roadmap to accomplish company objectives * Comfortable presenting information in customer facing engagements * Comfortable having technical conversations which engineering and design to trade off roadmap versus engineering effort needed **Preferred Experience and Qualifications:** ============================================ * A deep understanding of how DevSecOps pipelines operate and the tools which make them work * An understanding of core Kubernetes concepts, specifically images, Helm charts, and related technologies. * Excellent analytical skills with the ability to leverage data and metrics for informed decision\-making * Experience establishing a clear product roadmap and value proposition to prospective customers * Knowledge of and experience with monetization models for open source software ### **Who We Are** Defense Unicorns delivers mission value by streamlining software delivery so our customers can focus on the most important challenges. We share a vision of freedom and security for the advancement of progress and innovation. Our commitment to this vision, and to our mission\-driven customers, means a commitment to speed, user experience and optionality, without compromising security. Our team is composed of innovators, software engineers, and veterans with decades of experience delivering technology programs across the federal market. ### **What We Do** We create and deliver secure solutions for continuous software integration and delivery. Defense Unicorns consolidates the best practices for security pipelines, testing, and deployment automation in order to meet the high security requirements valued by mission owners. Our solutions are agnostic by design and we believe that growing a robust ecosystem of secure, cloud\-native software solutions can help enterprise customers inside and outside the federal market buy and integrate software more easily. ### **Who We Serve** Defense Unicorns' customers are mission\-focused leaders across public and private enterprises. We proudly support defense and civil agencies across the U.S. government and we work closely with the creators of leading\-edge software solutions to deliver value to the mission\-owner by improving the security and consumability of commercial software products. ### **What We Work On** * Kubernetes * Cloud Environments (AWS/GCP and Azure) * Infrastructure\-as\-code (like Terraform/Pulumi) * Continuous Delivery and automation tooling * GitOps * Containers * CNCF projects and open source products and packages * Helm/Kustomize\-Value Stream Mapping * Building and improving security delivery * Building Kubernetes and cloud native applications ### **Benefits Our Unicorns Enjoy** #### **Health:** * Medical/Dental/Vision * Premiums are 100% Company Paid * Health Savings Account * Life Insurance * Disability Insurance #### **Financial:** * 401k Retirement Plan * Company Stock Options * Home Office Budget #### **Leave:** * We offer all full\-time Unicorns Flexible Time Off (FTO) plus all Federal Holidays, one week for Thanksgiving, and two weeks for Christmas and New Year's * Paid Parental Leave #### **Learning:** * Reimbursement for approved trainings/subscriptions * Conferences (travel, lodging, and fees) *Don't have all the preferred experience or qualifications? jobs.description: DISQO is a leading provider of advertising intelligence, measuring brand and performance outcomes across every media channel to power data\-driven marketing decisions. Joining DISQO Nation means being part of a team that moves fast, thinks boldly, and is passionate about solving meaningful problems. At DISQO, our day\-to\-day roles are deeply integrated with AI. We actively empower every team member with cutting\-edge AI tools to automate repetitive tasks and streamline workflows, allowing you to focus your energy on high\-impact, strategic, and creative problem\-solving. Innovation isn't just something we talk about, it's how we operate. We challenge assumptions, embrace new ideas, and continuously push ourselves to build better solutions for our customers and each other. Our values guide how we work and win together. We **pursue outsized impact** by focusing on opportunities that drive meaningful results for our customers and our business. We **champion the customer** by putting their needs at the center of every decision and delivering solutions that create real value. And we are **relentlessly all in**, bringing energy, passion, and commitment to every challenge, every day. If you're energized by high\-growth environments, motivated by AI\-enabled productivity, and excited by the opportunity to do impactful work alongside talented, driven teammates, you'll feel right at home at DISQO. **About the role:** You'll work at the intersection of Site Reliability Engineering and Cloud Security, keeping our platform highly available, scalable and secure by design. We treat infrastructure as software and believe security should enable engineering velocity, not block it. You'll ship most infrastructure, automation and remediation work with AI coding agents. Your core job is to design the guardrails, reviews and tests that make that safe at scale, and to help build the internal agents that run a growing part of our reliability and security operations. The skill we value most is judgment: knowing when an agent's output is wrong, unsafe or not ready for production, and building systems that catch it when you're not looking. ### **What you will do:** **SRE \& Dev Ops:** * **Infrastructure as code:** Build and run secure, multi\-account AWS infrastructure with Terraform and GitOps. * **Kubernetes:** Operate and harden Amazon EKS workloads and the container platform. * **Service reliability:** Define, track and enforce SLOs, SLIs and error budgets across our microservices, including services that depend on LLMs (fallbacks, latency and cost budgets). * **Observability:** Run and improve our observability stack on Grafana, Newrelic * **Toil reduction:** Write automation in Python or Go. Agents do much of the authoring; you own the design, testing and review. * **Developer support:** Be the go\-to partner for engineering teams on infrastructure, deployments and environments. Help them debug build, pipeline and runtime issues, and turn recurring requests into self\-service. * **Infrastructure enablement:** Help teams provision and change infrastructure through reviewed Terraform and GitOps workflows, and support new services from first deploy to production readiness. * **CI/CD \& release:** Maintain and improve build and deployment pipelines, release processes and environment management so teams can ship quickly and safely. **Cloud Security****:** * **AWS security posture:** Own IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, GuardDuty, Security Hub, AWS Config, CloudTrail and Control Tower across our accounts. * **Zero trust \& identity:** Enforce least privilege and short\-lived credentials for people, services and AI agents alike. * **Network defense:** Design secure network boundaries, egress filtering and WAF rules that limit blast radius. * **Shift\-left security:** Embed SAST, SCA, container scanning and policy\-as\-code (OPA) into GitLab CI and ArgoCD without slowing teams down. * **Vulnerability management:** Scale scanning, triage and code review to match the growing volume of AI\-generated code. * **Secure by default:** Partner with product teams in design reviews so new services follow secure architecture patterns. * **Detection \& response:** Build detections mapped to MITRE ATT\&CK and respond to both reliability outages and security incidents as part of the on\-call rotation. **AI Native Platform Development****:** * **Internal agents:** Build and operate agents, MCP servers and skills that automate SRE and security workflows. * **Agent identity \& guardrails:** Treat agents as non\-human identities with scoped permissions, approval gates for high\-risk actions (such as production changes and IAM edits) and u bring to the role:** * **Experience:** 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Cloud Security Engineering roles. * **Cloud Expertise:** Strong production expertise with AWS core services, networking, multi\-account governance, and AWS\-native security tooling (IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub, KMS). * **Infrastructure as Code:** Advanced hands\-on proficiency with Terraform, GitOps, and configuration management. * **Containers \& Kubernetes:** In\-depth knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes (EKS) administration, deployment, and container runtime security. * **Coding \& Scripting:** Proven ability to write clean, modular automation code in **Python** or **Go** (not just configuring tools, but authoring custom automations, tooling, and integrations). * **CI/CD Integration:** Solid experience building, maintaining, and securing CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, ArgoCD, ArgoWorflows). * **AI Tooling Adoption:** Active, daily experience leveraging AI coding agents and development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) to accelerate delivery and automate workflows. * **Mindset:** Strong collaboration, clear communication, and a philosophy that security empowers development velocity rather than acting as a blocker. ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * **Certifications:** AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, AWS Certified Security \- Specialty, CKA/CKS (Certified Kubernetes Administrator/Security Specialist), or CISSP. * **SecOps / EDR Experience:** Familiarity with endpoint security (CrowdStrike), modern SIEM/SOAR platforms, and vulnerability management workflows. * **Compliance Frameworks:** Familiarity with SOC 2 Type I/II, ISO 27001, GDPR, and CCPA compliance requirements in cloud environments. $180,000 \- $195,000 a year**Your pay will be determined by your experience, work location, and other applicable factors.** \#LI\-MV1 At DISQO, we pride ourselves on having a positive, performance\-oriented workplace that includes a flexible hybrid approach, competitive medical benefits, and an amazing vacation policy. **Perks \& Benefits:** * 100% covered Medical/Dental/Vision for employee, competitive dependent coverage * Stock options * 401K * Generous PTO policy * Team offsites, social events \& happy hours * Life Insurance * Health FSA * Catered lunch and fully stocked kitchen * Paid Maternity/Paternity leave * Disability Insurance * Travel Assistance Program * 24/7 Counseling Services offered to Employees ***Note: The benefits noted above are for full time US based employees only.*** **DISQO is an equal opportunity employer. Discovery, innovation, and growth are possible when we open ourselves to new possibilities, perspectives, and approaches. That’s why, at DISQO, we welcome, support, and empower individuals from diverse backgrounds. Exceptional teams are rooted in extraordinary people, each with a unique story and a compelling set of skills. jobs.description: **About Distyl AI** =================== Distyl is an applied AI technology company partnering with the world’s most ambitious institutions to rearchitect critical operations for the frontier of AI. Our customers include the largest companies in telecom, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing, consumer goods, and global social organizations. This is a hands\-on role with scope matched to your experience, from owning complex delivery systems to setting technical direction across teams. Partner with Platform, Runtime, and Customer Delivery on integration and compatibility testing, configuration and schema changes, and recovery. Support customer\-registry distribution and offline packaging where required * **Agent\-enabled engineering.** Equip engineers with reusable coding\-agent tools to diagnose failures, propose fixes, and handle routine work. Include tests, scoped permissions, failure handling, and independent output validation; measure quality and time saved * **Software supply\-chain security.** Implement artifact signing and provenance, software bills of materials (SBOMs), isolated build runners, scoped CI credentials, and vulnerability gates. Integrate dependency and container remediation into engineering workflows * **Developer experience.** Understand engineers' workflows and remove friction with self\-service tools, documentation, and diagnostics that distinguish code failures from tooling issues. Use developer feedback to guide incremental migrations, earn adoption, and reduce manual work * **Engineering productivity and alerting.** Track build/test latency, pipeline reliability, flaky\-test rates, release lead time, and tooling adoption. Use these signals and developer feedback to reduce flaky tests and bottlenecks. Set service\-level objectives and route actionable alerts to owners **Who You Are** =============== * 10\+ years of experience in software engineering, developer productivity, SRE, or related infrastructure engineering roles * Experience enabling engineers to use coding agents through reusable tools, workflows, and guidance, with independent validation and scoped access * Experience owning production build, test, and release infrastructure across services and teams, including versioned release bundles and compatibility testing * Hands\-on experience with build systems, dependency management, reproducibility, performance diagnosis, and caching * Strong Python skills for building and debugging backend services and maintainable automation. Comfortable navigating unfamiliar code, including JavaScript frontends * Strong Linux fundamentals and experience building and maintaining secure container images. Working knowledge of Kubernetes, GitOps, infrastructure as code, and cloud deployment * Hands\-on experience implementing software supply\-chain controls. Demonstrated security judgment across permissions, credentials, dependencies, artifacts, and remediation * Experience building developer platforms, automated remediation, or reusable agent tooling adopted by other engineers * A record of improving build/test performance, release reliability, and tooling adoption using metrics and developer feedback * Experience independently leading complex projects and migrations. A record of setting technical direction and driving adoption across teams is especially valued. You defend technical choices with evidence and adapt to changing constraints * **Preferred:** Building and operating testing infrastructure in a microservices environment * **Preferred:** Distributing release artifacts to customer registries or restricted environments, including offline packaging **What We Offer** ================= * The base salary range for this role is $200,000\-$250,000, depending on experience, location, and level. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for meaningful equity, along with a comprehensive benefits package * 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents * Flexible time off * Retirement and financial planning benefits, including access to pre\-tax HSA, FSA, and commuter accounts, 401(k), and financial coaching resources * Comprehensive wellness benefits, including physical fitness, mental well\-being, and fertility and family\-building benefits through Carrot * Complimentary in\-office lunches and snacks provided * Access to state\-of\-the\-art AI models, generous usage of modern AI tools, and real\-world business problems * Ownership of high\-impact projects across top enterprises * A mission\-driven, fast\-moving culture that values curiosity, pragmatism, and excellence Distyl has offices in San Francisco and New York. This role follows a hybrid collaboration model with 3\+ days per week (Tuesday–Thursday) in‑office. *\#LI\-Hybrid* We believe diverse perspectives make our work stronger and more impactful. We are an equal opportunity employer and evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.description: **About the Team** ------------------ Agentic Foundations, part of New Verticals ML, builds the core AI/ML intelligence that powers high\-quality, scalable agents at DoorDash, and proves it through flagship agent experiences such as the Ask grocery assistant. We operate as a closed loop: new models, evals, and representations make our agents better, and real\-world agent usage surfaces the gaps that drive our next foundations work. **About the Role** ------------------ We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join Agentic Foundations with a primary focus on Vertical Agent Development. You will also help us bring this approach to new agentic experiences for Merchants and Dashers, turning promising ideas into production\-ready agents. This is a chance to work at the intersection of LLMs, agents, post\-training, and evals on problems that ship. You will partner closely with engineers working on agentic memory, agent\-compatible product representations, and post\-training of small language models (SLMs), so that what we learn from production agents feeds directly back into our foundations, and what we build there makes our agents better. impact on real customer tasks. * **Find the best balance of quality, latency, and cost:** run rigorous experiments, including fine\-tuning open\-weights models and deploying small language models (SLMs) where they can replace or augment larger LLMs. * **Launch new agents:** take agentic opportunities for Merchants and Dashers from early exploration to production. * **Turn foundations into product impact:** work with teammates on agentic memory, agent\-compatible product representations, and post\-training SLMs for steerable generative recommendation, and bring those capabilities into jobs.title: Staff Security Engineer, Security Enablement
jobs.description: **About the Role** ------------------ Global Safety and Security (GSS) protects our people, our sites, and the physical and logical systems that keep the business running. Our security and protection programs are never single\-team efforts: one rollout can touch physical security operations, customer experiences, site readiness, hardware provisioning, networking, cloud infrastructure, identity, and the data platforms above them — spanning many countries, on timelines tied to leases, permits, and vendors. **About the Team** ------------------ We are hiring a Staff Security Engineer to help design and deliver strategic and durable security services. You own the technical and architectural plan, strategic partner engagement with technology providers, the delivery sequence, the dependencies, and the program status leadership relies on. You are accountable for outcomes influencing teams that you don't manage. You will collaborate with software engineers, third\-party providers, physical security operations, project managers running site readiness and provisioning, and networking and cloud infrastructure partners, and you will keep managers, directors, and senior leaders informed. Security Enablement Engineering delivers security paved paths and capabilities that address systemic security issues through well\-designed customer experiences, easy\-to\-adopt and robust, well\-architected security solutions, systematically reducing organizational risk. **You're excited about this opportunity because you will…** ----------------------------------------------------------- * Own the design of our physical security systems integration layer — such as access control (PACS) and video management (VMS) platforms, the APIs they expose, and the connectors that carry their data into our systems of record. * Own end\-to\-end design and delivery of multi\-domain security services spanning physical security systems, hardware provisioning and site readiness, cloud and network infrastructure, identity and access management, key management, and the reporting/observability layers on top. jobs.description: **What’s Under the Hood** DriveTime Family of Brands is the largest privately owned used car sales finance \& servicing company in the nation. The DriveTime Family of Brands spans across DriveTime, Bridgecrest and SilverRock. You can find us at the intersection of technology and innovation as we use our proprietary tools and over two decades of industry knowledge to redefine the process of purchasing, financing, and protecting your vehicle. **That’s Nice, But What’s the Job?** **This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas or who need sponsorship now or in the future are not eligible for hire at this time.** In short, you will play a key role in designing, building, and supporting innovative software solutions that drive business success. As a Software Engineer, you will work on business\-critical initiatives, collaborate closely with product and business stakeholders, leverage cutting\-edge technologies including generative AI tools, and help deliver scalable, high\-quality applications that support strategic decision\-making across the organization. In Long, as the Software Engineer, you will be responsible for:* Partnering with business and product stakeholders to gather requirements and design, develop, test, debug, document, and support software applications * Leveraging generative AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate research, coding, debugging, documentation, and testing while maintaining high standards of code quality * Supporting integration efforts across APIs, data sources, and external systems to ensure seamless, secure, and scalable application connectivity * Designing and developing robust software solutions that support business\-critical initiatives * Collaborating with cross\-functional teams in an environment that encourages innovation and continuous improvement * Contributing to the development of scalable distributed systems and modern web applications * Developing and maintaining front\-end and back\-end application components * Writing and maintaining unit tests to ensure software quality and reliability * Staying current on emerging software development technologies, architectures, design patterns, and generative AI advancements * Communicating technical concepts, project status, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders **So What Kind of Folks Are We Looking For?** --------------------------------------------- * Ability to build strong cross\-functional relationships with business and technology partners * Strong verbal and written communication skills * Passion for continuous learning and professional development, particularly in AI and LLM technologies * Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities * Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively in a team environment * Ability to adapt quickly to evolving technologies and business priorities * Experience working on complex technical challenges and delivering practical solutions * Commitment to producing high\-quality, maintainable, and scalable software **The Specifics.** ------------------ * 3\+ years experience in software, web, or application development * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field or equivalent work experience * Experience with backend development frameworks such as Spring Boot, FastAPI, Gin/Fiber, or similar technologies * Experience with C\# and .NET development preferred * Experience developing and consuming APIs, including RESTful services, .NET Web API, MassTransit, and Async API * Experience with modern front\-end frameworks such as Angular, React, or Vue * Experience with client\-side SPA development * Experience developing unit tests * Experience deploying and supporting applications in cloud environments such as Azure, AWS, or GCP * Experience integrating applications with LLMs such as OpenAI using SDKs or frameworks including Semantic Kernel, LangChain, Foundry, or similar technologies * Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and/or TypeScript **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience building and supporting distributed systems at scale * Exposure to modern AI\-assisted software development practices * Experience working in agile development environments * Familiarity with cloud\-native architectures and microservices design patterns **So What About the Perks? Perks matter** * **We** **take a hybrid work approach,** finding balance between the benefits of in\-person and work\-from\-home environments. This position has an on\-site expectation of a minimum of three days a week. * **Medical, dental, and vision, oh my!** DriveTime Family of Brands covers a sizable amount of insurance premiums to ensure our employees receive top\-tier healthcare coverage. * **But Wait, There’s More.** 401(K), Company paid life insurance policy, short and long\-term disability coverage to name a few. * **Growth Opportunities.** You grow, I grow, we all grow! But seriously, DriveTime Family of Brands is committed to providing its employees with every opportunity to grow professionally with roughly over 1,000 employees promoted year over year. * **Tuition Reimbursement.** We’re as passionate about your professional development as you are. With that, we’ll put our money where our mouth is. * **Wellness Program.** Health is wealth! This program includes self\-guided coaching and journeys, cash incentives and discounts on your medical premiums through engaging in fun activities! * **Gratitude is Green.** We offer competitive pay across the organization, because, well… money matters! * **In\-House Gym.** We want our employees to be the best versions of themselves. So come early, take a break in your day or finish strong with a workout! * **Give Us a Reason (or not), and We’ll Celebrate.** Regardless of whether there is a holiday or not, we are finding ways to kick back and enjoy each other’s company outside of day\-to\-day work. * **Smart\-Casual Dress.** Come dressed in jeans (you’ll fit right in with the rest of us). * **Paid Time Off.** Not just lip service: we work hard, to play hard! Paid time off includes (for all full\-time roles) wellness days, holidays, and good ole' fashioned YOU time! For our Part\-timers, don't fear you get some time too...vacation time is available \- the more you work, the more you earn! **Anything Else? Absolutely.** DriveTime Family of Brands is Great Place to Work Certified! And get this: 90% of our rockstar employees say they feel right at home here. We could spend a lot of time having you read about ALL our awards, but we’ll save time (and practice some humility) just naming a few others; Comparably Awards: Best Company for Diversity, Best Company Culture and Best Company Leadership, oh and don’t forget Phoenix Business Journal Healthiest Employers (okay, we’ll stop there)! Hiring is contingent upon successful completion of our background and drug screening process. DriveTime is a drug\-free, tobacco\-free workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. And when it comes to hiring, we don't just look for the right person for the job, we seek out the right person for DriveTime. Buckle up for plenty of opportunities to grow in a professional, fun, and high\-energy environment!

processes, and enhance our products. * Continuously improve our engineering platform through automation, tooling, and AI\-assisted development practices. **Qualifications** Experience \& Technical Skills * 7\+ years of professional software development experience. * 5\+ years of Python backend development experience. * Strong experience developing RESTful APIs and microservices. * Extensive experience with PostgreSQL. * Experience building and supporting API integrations with third\-party platforms. * Strong understanding of distributed systems and asynchronous processing. * Experience designing, operating, and troubleshooting production systems. **Our Technology Stack** Languages \& Frameworks: Python, Django, REST APIs, JSON/XML Cloud \& Platform: Kubernetes, Azure AKS, Docker, Linux Data: PostgreSQL, SQL DevOps: GitHub, GitHub Actions, CI/CD Distributed Systems \& Observability: Celery, Flower, DataDog **Personal Attributes** * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills when necessary * Detail\-oriented with strong verbal and written communication skills **Preferred Education, Experience, and Qualifications:*** Commissioning Certification from ACG, BCxA, or ASHRAE * Certified Energy Manager (CEM) * Project experience in healthcare and higher education settings * Chilled Water, Heating Water, Steam, and Tower Water system project experience * Project experience with hydronic system distribution, including centralized and multi\-plant system configurations * Building automation, controls, and systems integration project experience * Experience with AutoCAD and REVIT software **Travel Requirements:*** 30%\-40% of time will be spent traveling to job site(s)/office location. **Physical/Work Environment Requirements:** Physical Activities:* Assessing the environment **Physical Demands:*** Medium work that includes adjusting and/or moving objects up to 50 pounds Pay Range: USD $91,449\.00 \- USD $122,080\.50 /Yr. jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description: Overview: **About ERMCO** Electric Research and Manufacturing Cooperative, Inc. (ERMCO) is the leading manufacturer of distribution transformers and engineered electrical solutions, serving electric utilities, Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), and industrial customers across North America. Headquartered in Dyersburg, Tenn., ERMCO delivers reliable, high\-quality products that power homes, businesses, and communities across North America. With commitments to safety, operational excellence, and continuous improvement, ERMCO is at the forefront of supporting grid modernization and energy transition. Our vertically integrated operations, customer\-focused culture, and investment in people and technology make ERMCO the Most Valued Partner for delivering resilient, sustainable power infrastructure for the future. **Summary** The Technical Project Manager (Process Engineering and Continuous Improvement) is responsible for developing and executing a portfolio of projects and initiatives that enable the Single\-Phase Pole Plant to achieve its strategic objectives including being viewed as the Most Valued Partner with its customers. The TPM will lead a team of Technical Process Engineers and be a key member of the Pole Plant Leadership team, reporting to the Pole Plant General Manager. ***This position is located onsite in Dyersburg, TN. through implementation and sustainment, ensuring delivery on time and within constraints (scope/cost/resources). * Establish project governance: charters, milestones, tollgates, RAID logs, change control, and stakeholder communication cadence. * Drive cross\-functional alignment and execution across Ops, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Planning/Scheduling, Maintenance, and EHS. * Translate business objectives into measurable targets using KPIs (throughput, lead time, WIP, FPY, scrap/rework, schedule adherence, OTD). * Establish financial and operational business cases for major projects the addition of new equipment and processes including automation. * Develops a high\-performing Process Engineering Team that is integrated into the Pole Plant. **Flow Optimization/Lean System load, execution discipline). * Lead Lean deployments: value stream mapping, line balancing, pull systems (Kanban), standard work, visual management, and point\-of\-use organization. * Build tradeoffs. **People Leadership*** Develop Process Engineers’ capability in modern lean tools and problem\-solving approaches. * Conduct regular 1:1s and development planning; build a strong bench of technical talent for growth and ramps. * Provide direct leadership, supervision, and development of a team of Process Engineers, including goal setting, prioritization, performance management, and Overview: The Enterprise Systems Architect in Enterprise Data \& Analytics will define and guide the future\-state architecture across customer\-facing product systems, enterprise business applications, data, integrations, and internal platforms. This is a senior, hands\-on architecture leadership role for someone who can translate business strategy into practical designs, roadmaps, standards, and decisions that delivery teams can execute. Operating at the enterprise and portfolio level, this role establishes cross\-enterprise architecture direction and guardrails and helps ensure approved decisions can be delivered, operated, and supported effectively. Delivery teams and solution architects remain accountable for detailed solution design and implementation within that direction. The role will report to the Chief Information Officer and serve as the enterprise architecture lead across the Eagleview technology ecosystem. The Enterprise Architect will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Finance, Sales, Customer Operations, Data and AI, Security, Business Applications, and Platform Engineering leaders. **This is a full\-time, remote role with salary range of $147,700 \- $190,000, bonus eligible.** Responsibilities: * Define current\-state, transition\-state, and target\-state architectures across customer journeys, product platforms, business applications, data, integrations, security, and infrastructure dependencies. * Build and maintain enterprise capability maps, value\-stream views, system context diagrams, integration views, and application portfolio views that clarify purpose, ownership, lifecycle, dependencies, duplication, risk, and strategic disposition. * Guide architecture for lead\-to\-cash, customer onboarding, ordering, fulfillment, entitlement, usage and consumption, billing, payments, service, financial reporting, and customer self\-service. * Clarify systems of record and governed information flows for customer, account, contract, product, pricing, order, entitlement, usage, invoice, payment, support, and operational data. * Evaluate how product systems such as consumption services and MyEV connect to business systems such as Salesforce, BillingPlatform, NetSuite, customer support tools, data platforms, and internally built applications. * Identify brittle handoffs, point\-to\-point integrations, manual workarounds, redundant platforms, unmanaged internal tools, legacy dependencies, and unclear ownership; convert findings into prioritized modernization, consolidation, and retirement roadmaps. * Set practical architecture principles for integrations and data, including API\-first and event\-driven patterns, data contracts, observability, resiliency, versioning, ownership, quality, auditability, and operational supportability. * Lead architecture discovery before solution choices become fixed, ensuring requirements reflect enterprise, customer, financial, operational, product, security, and cross\-functional needs. * Frame decision\-quality options for executives, including customer experience, operating model, cost, risk, delivery capacity, regulatory exposure, vendor dependency, and technical\-debt implications. * Evaluate vendor and platform proposals for business capability fit, interoperability, configurability, security, performance, total lifecycle cost, service commitments, vendor dependency, and viable exit options. * Embed identity, access, segregation of duties, data protection, resilience, privacy, compliance, jobs.title: Engineering and AI Operations Specialist
jobs.description: **\*\*No sponsorship/C2C is available for this position\*\*** **Engineering and AI Specialist** **Reports To:** Director of Technical Delivery **Location:** Remote **FLSA:** Exempt **Job Summary** The AI Operations Specialist builds and runs the internal AI tooling, automations, and pilots that make AI a practical, everyday part of how Elevate Digital's Engineering team delivers. Reporting to the Director of Technical Delivery, this role turns the AI operations roadmap into working software: maintaining agent pipelines and internal tools, testing new models and tools against real workflows, and keeping engineers unblocked as they adopt them. This is an execution\-focused role, not a standard\-setting one. Direction, governance, and org\-wide AI standards for Engineering remain owned by the Director of Technical Delivery; the AI Operations Specialist is the builder who makes that direction real, working alongside the Director on shared tooling projects rather than owning all of it independently. **Duties and Responsibilities** **Tooling \& Automation** * Build, maintain, and extend the AI tooling and agent pipelines Engineering relies on — including coding\-agent integrations, MCP servers, and internal bots or scripts — working alongside the Director of Technical Delivery on shared tooling priorities. * Keep existing automations reliable as models, APIs, and internal workflows change, monitoring for breakage and patching quickly. * Maintain a lightweight, current catalog of what tooling is live, what's experimental, and what's been retired. **Pilots \& Evaluation** * Run scoped pilots applying AI to specific internal workflows — ticket triage, documentation, code review assistance, onboarding, and similar — and report results back to the Director of Technical Delivery. * Hands\-on evaluation of new AI models, tools, and vendors as they emerge: what they're good for, what they cost, and whether they fit Elevate's delivery workflows. * Track basic usage, cost, and quality signals for AI tooling so adoption decisions rest on evidence rather than hype. **Enablement \& Support** * Support engineers adopting AI tooling day to day — answering questions, unblocking issues, and sharing practical techniques that actually work. * Produce lightweight documentation, guides, or walkthroughs so internal tools are usable by people other than the person who built them. * Surface friction, bugs, and gaps in existing tooling and pipelines back to the Director of Technical Delivery as input to the roadmap. **Required Competencies and Skills** * **Builder Mentality:** Genuine hands\-on drive to build and ship internal tools and automations — this role is defined by making things, not evaluating them from the sidelines. * **AI/LLM Practical Fluency:** Working knowledge of agentic workflows, prompt engineering, MCP, and RAG\-style patterns, gained through real building rather than credentials alone. * **Automation \& Scripting:** Comfortable writing scripts, integrations, and lightweight pipelines to connect tools and remove manual work. * **Judgment Under Ambiguity:** Able to size up a new tool or pilot quickly, form a point of view, and know when a decision needs to go to the Director of Technical Delivery rather than being made unilaterally. * **Documentation Habit:** Writes clear, lightweight documentation as a habit, not an afterthought, so tools and pilots are usable by others. * **Collaborative Execution:** Works well executing someone else's roadmap and priorities on shared tooling projects, without needing to own the strategy to stay motivated. **Experience and Education** * Solid grounding in programming fundamentals — able to read, reason about, and debug the code and systems they build, not just accept AI\-generated output at face value. This is not a "vibe coding" role. * Demonstrated experience building automations, scripts, or AI\-assisted tooling — through professional work, side projects, or hands\-on experimentation. What you've built and can explain matters more than where you learned to build it. * Practical, hands\-on experience with agentic coding tools, AI coding assistants, or LLM\-based pipelines, used deliberately rather than as a black box. * Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast\-changing technical territory where best practices are still being written. * Self\-taught and non\-traditional paths are welcome, provided they come with real engineering fundamentals. jobs.title: AVP - Design Validation & Learning, Biotherapeutics
jobs.description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. For more than 25 years, Lilly's Biotechnology Discovery Research (BioTDR) organization has advanced novel antibody and peptide therapeutics from concept through clinical development to market in areas of high unmet medical need. This role is based at the Lilly Biotechnology Center in San Diego, where we are expanding our computational capabilities to build a generative design platform. By bringing together AI/ML, protein engineering, automation, structural biology, and high\-throughput experimentation, BioTDR is creating an integrated de novo design platform capable of generating, ranking, and optimizing novel therapeutic antibodies and other biotherapeutics with improved activity, safety, manufacturability, and target coverage. Designs are rapidly evaluated through experimental validation, creating a continuous learning cycle that strengthens both models and discovery outcomes. The program is supported by dedicated capacity on LillyPod, our wholly owned 1,016\-GPU NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra SuperPOD. Help us push the de novo protein design frontier beyond binders to molecules that can become medicines, faster. Ready to make an impact? Join us. Primary Responsibilities **Our Generative Design platform has three pillars:** Generative Foundation Models, Generative Protein Design \& Optimization, and Active Learning \& Design Validation. The AVP of Design Validation \& Learning will define and execute the scientific strategy that determines how Lilly evaluates, validates, and continuously improves its de novo biologics design capabilities. This leader will establish the experimental learning systems, validation standards, benchmarking frameworks, and data generation strategies that transform computational predictions into actionable scientific insights and increasingly powerful design capabilities. This is a founding leadership role. You will build and lead a multidisciplinary team spanning model evaluation, active learning, computational biology, statistical methodology, physics\-based modeling, and experimental learning. You will be accountable for ensuring that every experimental outcome strengthens the platform's ability to design better therapeutic molecules over time. Responsibilities * Define the scientific strategy for evaluation, validation, and learning. Establish how model performance, design quality, and therapeutic impact will be measured across the platform, ensuring computational progress translates into meaningful experimental outcomes. * Define and establish rigorous benchmarks and validation standards. Establish evaluation frameworks that test generalization, prospective design performance, biological relevance, experimental success, and failure modes. Create a culture in which models are challenged against rigorous experimental benchmarks and evidence\-based decision making is standard practice. * Establish a closed computational\-experimental learning system. Partner closely with experimental scientists to connect model development with laboratory testing. Use predefined experimental metrics to evaluate models, uncover failure modes, and continuously improve subsequent generations of models and molecular designs. * Set the role of physics\-based approaches in the design stack. Decide where simulation, molecular modeling, and energy\-based calculations improve model performance and design capability, and define how they should be integrated with ML\-based approaches. * Active learning and proprietary data strategy. Define the scientific strategy for which experiments should be performed next. Partner with DMTA, automation, protein engineering, and discovery leaders to create proprietary data assets that compound in value for model training, evaluation, and future design cycles. * Translate frontier AI research into therapeutic impact. Embed AI capabilities directly into active discovery programs, identify high\-value opportunities where computational design can change program outcomes, and establish rigorous measures of impact including novel molecular solutions, hit rates, design precision, experimental efficiency, and advancement of differentiated therapeutic candidates. * Establish platform\-wide success metrics. Define how model performance, design quality, experimenta against experimental measurements in a drug discovery, molecular design, or related scientific setting. * Proficiency in Python and applied statistics, including calibration, uncertainty quantification, experimental design, and quantitative evaluation methodologies. Additional Preferences * Experience partnering with experimental teams on assay or campaign design. * Experience building benchmarking frameworks, validation suites, or evaluation systems adopted across multiple teams, research organizations, or discovery programs. * Experience applying molecular dynamics, free\-energy methods, enhanced sampling, or related simulation approaches to protein design, evaluation, or molecular understanding. * Expertise in protein stability, aggregation, viscosity, expression, manufacturability, or developability prediction. * Experience designing large\-scale experimental datasets intended for model training, validation, or active learning. * Experience with active learning, Bayesian experimental design, or sequential experimentation under constrained experimental budgets. * Working knowledge of binding and biophysical measurements including SPR, BLI, thermostability, expression, and related assay technologies. * Proven track record of building effective cross\-functional partnerships across computational, experimental, automation, and therapeutic discovery organizations to deliver shared scientific goals. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex computational, statistical, and experimental concepts for scientific leaders, experimental researchers, and executive stakeholders. Performs other job\-related responsibilities as requested or assigned. * **What's Available:** * Fulltime, 80 hours biweekly (1\.0 FTE) * Schedule: Monday\-Friday days * Location: Remote eligible role; While this role offers some flexibility in work location, candidates must reside within a reasonable commuting distance of La Crosse or Green Bay, WI due to occasional on\-site needs. In addition, candidates must reside in WI, MN, IA. * **Immigration sponsorship (e.g., H\-1B) is not available for this position.** Starting salary of $71,700 and up, based on your relevant years of experience. * **What You Will Need:** * Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of experience and education * Experience: 2\+ years of software development experience and proficiency in a variety of programing languages and integration platforms. * Experience with Microsoft Azure or other cloud platforms. * Exposure to AI\-assisted software development tools and practices. * Experience creating prototypes, proof\-of\-concepts, or innovative technology solutions. * Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, testing frameworks, and modern software engineering practices. * Strong problem\-solving, communication, and analytical skills. **In addition to the rewarding work, you'll receive:** ------------------------------------------------------ * A highly adaptable and mission\-driven organization with a work environment that supports you personally and professionally and a work culture where you are valued and appreciated * **Competitive Benefits:** A comprehensive and generous benefits package (Medical, Dental, Life Ins, HSA/FSA) ensuring your comfort and well\-being as a valuable team member * Substantial retirement contribution including a 401k match \& annual discretionary base contribution * **Work\-Life Balance:** Paid Time Off (PTO) combines vacation, sick, and personal days into one balance to allow you the flexibility to use your time off as you need * **Professional Development:** Support for your career growth through Professional Development Opportunities, our Tuition Investment Program, and our Career Development Center * **Additional Employee Discounts and Perks** Other benefits include a Wellness program with incentives, employer\-paid life insurance and AD\&D, optional short\-term and long\-term disability coverage, an employee assistance program, identity theft protection, pet insurance, Inspire \& Celebrate colleague recognition and rewards program, a discount program, and more! **If you are looking to be a part of a stable and growing mission\-driven organization, this may be the right opportunity for you!** **PRACTICES AND PROMOTES BEHAVIOR CONSISTENT WITH THE MISSION, VISION AND VALUES** : **Mission** : As a not\-for\-profit, patient\-centered healthcare network, we have headquarters in Green Bay and La Crosse, Wisconsin.
