This is our purpose. Together with our values — belonging, respect, excellence, accountability, teamwork and humility — our pillars set our foundation and our future.** **Equal Opportunity Employer**

jobs.title: AI Engineer (REMOTE)
jobs.description: EnableComp provides Specialty Revenue Cycle Management solutions for healthcare organizations, leveraging over 24 years of industry\-leading expertise and its unified *E360 RCM*™ intelligent automation platform to improve financial sustainability for hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs) nationwide. Powered by proprietary algorithms, iterative intelligence from 10M\+ processed claims, and expert human\-in\-the\-loop integration, EnableComp provides solutions across the revenue lifecycle for Veterans Administration, Workers’ Compensation, Motor Vehicle Accidents, and Out\-of\-State Medicaid claims as well as denials for all payer classes. By partnering with clients to supercharge the reimbursement process, EnableComp removes the burden of payment from patients and provider organizations while enabling accelerated cash, higher and more accurate yield, clean AR management, reduced denials, and data\-rich performance management. EnableComp is a multi\-year recipient the Top Workplaces award and was recognized as Black Book's \#1 Specialty Revenue Cycle Management Solution provider in 2024 and is among the top one percent of companies to make the Inc. 5000 list of the fastest\-growing private companies in the United States for the last eleven years. **Position Summary** The **AI Engineer** is a hands\-on individual contributor who builds, trains, and evaluates machine learning models. The role combines knowledge engineering and data analysis with applied reinforcement learning, and owns work end to end, from data and experiment design through training, evaluation, and reporting. The ideal candidate brings practical reinforcement learning experience, strong engineering discipline, and the ability to collaborate closely with domain experts and communicate results to technical and non\-technical audiences. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Work with domain experts to capture specialized knowledge and represent it in structured, usable form. * Analyze source material and datasets for quality, consistency, and coverage, and resolve issues with the appropriate stakeholders. * Perform exploratory and statistical analysis to inform data, modeling, and evaluation decisions. * Create and curate training and evaluation datasets, using both automated and human validation. * Design reinforcement learning environments, reward functions, and verifiers. * Train and fine\-tune language models using supervised and reinforcement learning methods such as PPO, DPO, and GRPO. * Establish baselines, run ablations, and diagnose training issues such as reward hacking, instability, and data leakage. * Follow the research literature and bring promising techniques into practice. * Manage experiments rigorously, including versioned configurations, reproducible runs, experiment tracking, and compute budgeting. * Design and extend evaluation frameworks, metrics, and benchmarks. * Compare models and approaches through structured experiments and A/B testing. * Document results, failures, and next steps in clear technical write\-ups. * Present findings to engineers, domain experts, and business leaders in language each audience can act on. ### **Requirements \& Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, machine learning, statistics, or a related field; MS or PhD preferred. Equivalent hands\-on experience will be considered. * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience training or fine\-tuning language models. * Demonstrated reinforcement learning experience, including designing an environment and reward function end to end and training a policy in it. * Working knowledge of policy optimization methods for language models, such as PPO, DPO, or GRPO, including their failure modes. * Strong Python and PyTorch skills, with fluency in the Hugging Face ecosystem and parameter\-efficient fine\-tuning techniques. * Experience building and evaluating LLM\-based agents or multi\-turn systems. * Experience designing evaluations for language models, including held\-out sets and automated grading. * Ability to analyze complex, detailed documentation and translate it into precise, structured, testable form. * Clear technical writing, with the ability to explain an experiment and its results concisely. * Comfort working directly with domain experts who are not machine learning practitioners. * Experience working with healthcare data or in another highly regulated industry is highly preferred. * Experience training models to produce structured or schema\-constrained output is highly preferred. * Experience with a broad range of reinforcement learning algorithms and advanced reward design is highly preferred. * Experience with knowledge representation approaches such as knowledge graphs or ontologies is highly preferred. * Experience generating and validating synthetic data for model training is highly preferred. * Publications or open\-source contributions in reinforcement learning, language model fine\-tuning, or model evaluation is highly preferred. * Experience handling sensitive data, including protected health information (PHI) under HIPAA is highly preferred. * Timely and regular attendance. * Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered * To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. ### **Special Considerations and Prerequisites** * Practices and adheres to EnableComp’s Core Values, Vision and Mission. * This is a 100% hands\-on individual contributor role. The AI Engineer owns experiments from design through code, training, and results. * Expect roughly half of the role to focus on reinforcement learning and model training, with the remainder split between knowledge engineering, data analysis, and evaluation. * Success requires sustained, close collaboration with domain experts and a genuine working understanding of the subject matter. * The underlying knowledge evolves over time. The AI Engineer must design data, training, and evaluation approaches that adapt to change without starting over. * All work must comply with HIPAA and EnableComp data policies, using de\-identified or synthetic data wherever possible. *EnableComp is an Equal Opportunity Employer M/F/D/V. All applicants will be considered for this position based upon experience and knowledge, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, marital, disabled or veteran status. We are committed to creating and maintaining a workforce environment that is free from any form of discrimination or harassment.* EnableComp recruits, develops and retains the industry's top talent. As the employer of choice in the complex claims industry, EnableComp takes pride in our continuous commitment to building and maintaining a culture centered around fostering the professional growth and development of our people. We believe that investing in our employees is the key to our success, and we are dedicated to providing them with the tools, resources, and support they need to thrive and grow their career here. At EnableComp, we are committed to living up to our core values each and every day, and we believe that this commitment is what sets us apart from other companies. If you are looking for a company that values its employees and is dedicated to helping them achieve their full potential, then EnableComp is the place for you. ***Don’t just take our word for it! Hear what our people are saying:*** *“I love my job because everyone shares the same vision and is determined and dedicated. People care about you as a person and your professional growth. There is a genuine spirit of cooperation and shared goals all revolving around helping each other.”* – Revenue Specialist *“I enjoy working for EnableComp because of the Core Values we believe in. EnableComp stands true to these values from empowering employees to ecstatic clients. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Build and deploy ML models for memory retrieval and contextual understanding. Create scalable ML infrastructure that powers intelligent memory systems. **What You'll Do** ================== * Design and implement ML models for memory retrieval and ranking * Build ML infrastructure and training pipelines * Deploy and monitor models in production at scale * Optimize model performance and latency for real\-time systems * Work with vector databases and embedding systems * Implement MLOps best practices and monitoring * Collaborate with research team to productionize new algorithms **What We're Looking For** ========================== * 4\+ years of ML engineering experience * Strong proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow) * Experience deploying ML models to production * Knowledge of MLOps, model serving, and monitoring * Understanding of NLP, embeddings, and retrieval systems * Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP) and containers * Strong software engineering fundamentals * Experience with large\-scale data processing **Nice to Have** ================ * Experience with large language models and prompt engineering * Knowledge of vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus) * Experience with recommendation systems or search * Background in information retrieval or ranking systems * Knowledge of model optimization and quantization * Experience with real\-time ML systems * Familiarity with transformer architectures

jobs.title: Research Engineer
jobs.description: Bridge the gap between cutting\-edge research and production systems. Build and implement research prototypes that push the boundaries of memory augmentation and contextual AI. **What You'll Do** ================== * Translate research papers and ideas into working prototypes * Collaborate with research scientists to implement novel algorithms * Build experimental systems for memory retrieval and contextual understanding * Optimize research code for production deployment * Design and run experiments to validate research hypotheses * Contribute to research publications and technical documentation * Bridge communication between research and engineering teams **What We're Looking For** ========================== * 3\+ years of experience in research engineering or applied ML * Strong programming skills in Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow) * Experience implementing research papers and prototyping novel ideas * Knowledge of machine learning fundamentals and deep learning * Ability to work independently and manage research projects * Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills * Experience with experimentation frameworks and A/B testing * Good communication skills for cross\-functional collaboration **Nice to Have** ================ * Published research in ML, NLP, or related fields * Experience with retrieval systems and vector databases * Knowledge of cognitive science or human memory research * Background in NLP or information retrieval * Experience with large language models and embeddings * Contributions to open\-source ML projects * PhD or Masters in Computer Science, ML, or related field

jobs.title: Research Scientist
jobs.description: Conduct fundamental research on memory systems, cognition, and AI. Define the scientific foundation for next\-generation memory augmentation technologies. What You'll Do * Conduct original research on memory augmentation and contextual AI * Design and execute experiments to test research hypotheses * Publish findings in top\-tier conferences and journals * Collaborate with engineers to transition research into products * Stay current with latest developments in AI, NLP, and cognitive science * Mentor research engineers and contribute to team growth * Present research findings to internal teams and external audiences What We're Looking For * PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Cognitive Science, or related field * 2\+ years of research experience (academic or industry) * Track record of publications in top conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ACL, etc.) * Deep expertise in machine learning, NLP, or information retrieval * Strong mathematical and statistical foundation * Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks * Excellent written and verbal communication skills * Ability to work on open\-ended research problems Nice to Have * Experience with memory systems or knowledge representation * Background in cognitive psychology or neuroscience * Industry research experience at top labs * Experience with large language models and retrieval systems * Postdoctoral research experience * Track record of research\-to\-product transitions * Experience leading research teams or projects

jobs.title: Principal Software Architect- Data Platform, Data
jobs.description: **Thank you for considering a career at Ensemble!** Ensemble is a leading provider of technology\-enabled revenue cycle management solutions for health systems, including hospitals and affiliated physician groups. They offer end\-to\-end revenue cycle solutions as well as a comprehensive suite of point solutions to clients across the country. Ensemble keeps communities healthy by keeping hospitals healthy. We recognize that healthcare requires a human touch, and we believe that every touch should be meaningful. This is why our people are the most important part of who we are. By empowering them to challenge the status quo, we know they will be the difference! O.N.E Purpose: * **Customer Obsession:** Consistently provide exceptional experiences for our clients, patients, and colleagues by understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations. * **Embracing New Ideas:** Continuously innovate by embracing emerging technology and fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation. * **Striving for Excellence:** Execute at a high level by demonstrating our “Best in KLAS” Ensemble Difference Principles and consistently delivering outstanding results. **The Opportunity:** As Principal Software Architect, you will serve as Ensemble’s senior technical authority on data platform engineering — a high‑level individual contributor, not a people manager. This is a software engineering role first: you will bring professional software architecture discipline — design patterns, modularity, repo structure, and system design — to a platform built on Databricks and Azure. You will re‑envision our architectural patterns, assess engineering practices across the organization, and establish a strong foundation for AI‑driven capabilities across the organization. Much of our data platform work is heavy software engineering: services and pipelines that live in Git repositories, move through code review, and are built, tested, and deployed like any other software system. You will architect and design a cloud‑native data platform built on Azure and Databricks, enabling trusted, governed, and reusable data products that accelerate insight generation, operational automation, and emerging AI use cases. You will also own the organization’s technology roadmap, staying ahead of emerging tools and techniques and recommending what we should evaluate or adopt next. jobs.title: Full Stack Developer / Product Engineer ONSITE -Scottsdale, Az
jobs.description: Full\-Stack Developer / Product Engineer \- LOCAL Candidates only **Public\-Posting Performance\-Based Hiring Profile** **Build the whole product. Own the outcome. Pivot fast without losing momentum.** **LOCATION** Scottsdale, Arizona \| Full\-Time \| On\-Site **SCHEDULE** Flexible start within the 7:00 a.m.\-6:00 p.m. work window **COMPENSATION** $100,000\-$130,000 base, depending on demonstrated capability **ROLE MIX** Approximately 50% front\-end / 50% back\-end development **CORE STACK** Python back end \| TypeScript front end \| AWS \| APIs \| Practical AI integrations **This is not a ticket\-taking developer role.** Envita is looking for a true full\-stack builder who can move comfortably between front\-end and back\-end development, take an incomplete request from a non\-technical stakeholder, clarify what actually needs to be built, and carry the solution through production. The role is approximately 50/50 front end and back end, with Python as the primary back\-end language. AI is an important part of the environment, especially practical AI and API integrations, but this is not a machine\-learning role and we do not want someone who relies on AI without understanding the code, architecture, risks, or output. **Position Purpose** ==================== The Full\-Stack Developer / Product Engineer will build secure, reliable, cost\-conscious products across Envita business units. The role requires strong full\-stack range, direct stakeholder communication, rapid learning, practical AI integration experience, and a high degree of self\-direction. A defining requirement is the ability to pivot immediately when business priorities change while preserving the state, visibility, and restart point of every other active project. **Why This Opportunity Stands Out** =================================== * End\-to\-end ownership from requirements and architecture through build, integration, deployment, testing, and production follow\-through. * True full\-stack scope with meaningful work on both the user\-facing front end and the Python back end. * Direct access to the people using what you build, including clinicians, pharmacy and laboratory operators, business leaders, and executives. * Practical AI work, including AI\-provider APIs and AI\-enabled product features, without requiring machine\-learning specialization. * Variety, autonomy, and visible business impact across multiple Envita entities rather than one narrow product lane. * A flexible daily start window designed to support an on\-site Scottsdale work environment. **What Exceptional Success Looks Like After the First Year** ============================================================ Envita leaders can bring this engineer an important business problem and trust that it will be clarified, translated into a practical technical solution, built across the full stack, deployed securely, and supported with clear status and documentation. The engineer is equally credible in front\-end and Python back\-end work, uses AI and external APIs intelligently, understands and can explain the code they ship, and is known for being able to change direction quickly when the business requires it without allowing lower\-priority projects to disappear or restart from zero. **SMART Key Performance Objectives** ==================================== These outcomes define success in the role. Demonstrated capability and comparable accomplishments matter more than years of experience, prior title, or exact framework overlap. **1\. Deliver the First Full\-Stack Product Fast** -------------------------------------------------- **Required outcome:** Take an assigned project from the initial stakeholder conversation through requirements clarification, front\-end and Python back\-end development, API integration as needed, testing, and production deployment. Target a meaningful demo by approximately day 21 and a production\-ready release by approximately day 45\. **Evidence of success:** The stakeholder confirms the solution solves the intended problem; the engineer can explain the architecture and code; appropriate testing, authentication, secrets handling, logging, and production controls are in place; and the solution operates reliably after launch. **2\. Pivot on a Dime Without Losing Momentum** ----------------------------------------------- **Required outcome:** Operate effectively across multiple active projects while being able to immediately redirect attention when leadership or business needs change. When one project becomes critical, shift the majority of effort to it without allowing other work to become invisible, confused, or difficult to restart. **Evidence of success:** Priority changes are acted on quickly; stakeholders are informed; paused work has a documented current state, next action, blocker, and restart point; the critical project accelerates; and previously active projects resume without unnecessary rework or loss of context. **3\. Own Requirements From Ambig modeling using Postgres or a comparable database, including schema design, indexing, transactions, and safe migrations. * REST/API design and integration experience, including authentication/authorization, validation, versioning, idempotency, structured errors, and reliability concerns. * Hands\-on AWS deployment ownership, including IAM/access control, secrets, networking fundamentals, logs/observability, and cost awareness. * Application\-security fundamentals, especially authentication vs. authorization, injection/XSS awareness, secret handling, transport security, least privilege, and sensitive data. * Unit and integration testing as a normal part of development, plus confidence standing up test coverage in existing or lightly documented systems. * Git fluency and the ability to navigate an unfamiliar repository and determine what the code actually does. * Meaningful practical AI experience, preferably integrating AI/LLM capabilities through APIs or building AI\-enabled product features. Machine\-learning model development is not required. * A recent, specific example of learning a new language, SDK, API, framework, or platform under deadline and successfully shipping with it. **What Separates Top Performers** ================================= * **Priority Agility:** Can change direction immediately when business priorities change, make the new priority successful, and preserve clean restart points for everything temporarily deprioritized. * **Full\-Stack Range:** Is genuinely comfortable delivering both user\-facing front\-end work and production Python back\-end services. * **AI Judgment:** Uses AI where it improves speed or quality, but never substitutes AI output for understanding, verification, security, or accountability. * **Requirements Discipline:** Asks clarifying questions before coding, confirms understanding, and avoids building the wrong thing quickly. * **Self\-Direction:** Creates structure when structure is light, keeps multiple projects visible, and escalates conflicts before they become surprises. * **Ship\-Quality Judgment:** Moves quickly while knowing which shortcuts are acceptable and which are not, especially around security, sensitive data, authentication, data integrity, and cost. * **Constructive Communication:** Explains choices and trade\-offs clearly and responds to changed priorities without defensiveness or loss of follow\-through. **The Environment** =================== This role is best suited to an engineer who enjoys ownership, variety, speed, and incomplete problems. Requirements may arrive verbally. Priorities can change during the week or during the day. An engineer may be progressing several projects and then be asked to focus almost entirely on one urgent initiative. Success requires flexibility without chaos: make the pivot, communicate it, preserve the state of the other work, and keep commitments visible. There may not always be a mature product\-management process, complete design handoff, dedicated DevOps support, or perfect documentation waiting before work begins. **Culture and Working Style** ============================= * Patient and business impact comes before technology for technology's sake. * Integrity, humility, gratitude, learning agility, respectful collaboration, confidentiality, and accountability matter in how the work gets done. * Strong performers are comfortable receiving direct feedback, revisiting assumptions, and changing course when the evidence or business priority changes. * We value people who are curious, dependable, solution\-oriented, technically accountable, and willing to own the consequences of their decisions. **Equal Employment Opportunity** ================================ Envita Medical Centers of America is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and considers qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals as required by applicable law.

jobs.title: Staff Mechanical Engineer, Advanced Product Development
jobs.description: Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost\-effective, multi\-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form! In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by *TIME* as a “Best Invention”, *MIT Technology Review* as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and *Fast Company* as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron\-air batteries is underway at our first high\-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia. Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now \- right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing \- might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better. **Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading \- you’ve come to the right place.** **Role Description** -------------------- Form's Advanced Product Development team is responsible for architecting and designing the next generation of our iron\-air battery system — the cell, module, pack, and the support systems that keep them running reliably for decades in the field. We work ahead of our production programs, translating breakthrough electrochemistry and system requirements into mechanical designs that can scale to high\-volume manufacturing. We're hiring a Staff Mechanical Engineer to develop the mechanical design of subsystems within our next\-generation battery and support systems. You will take ownership of thermal, fluid, and/or structural subsystem design, applying first\-principles modeling and analysis, building first\-of\-a\-kind designs for experimentation and verification testing, and iterating toward our next energy storage product. You'll work closely with battery scientists, materials engineers, electrical and controls engineers, and manufacturing engineers, bringing in\-depth subsystem expertise to the toughest interdisciplinary trade\-offs. *Relocation assistance is available.* ### **What you'll do:** * Own the mechanical design of one or more subsystems (thermal, fluid handling, or structural) within next\-generation energy storage systems, from concept through system verification * Contribute to high\-leverage trade\-offs across subsystem interfaces — performance, cost, manufacturability, and reliability — exercising judgment with guidance from senior/principal engineers on the most ambiguous calls * Build first\-principles analytical models that inform subsystem design decisions * Plan and execute first\-of\-a\-kind prototype builds and test campaigns to validate subsystem\-level design choices * Partner with manufacturing engineering on design\-for\-manufacturing and design\-for\-cost for the components and assemblies you own * Represent mechanical engineering in cross\-functional design reviews with electrochemistry, controls, program management, and compliance * Engage with vendors on sourcing and early\-stage development of novel components * Drive workflows using AI to increase speed and efficiency of the team * Champion safety, especially when introducing new lab processes, prototype hardware, or test methods ### **What you'll bring:** * Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field; Bachelor's with 7–10 years, or advanced degree with equivalent experience, in mechanical design of complex electromechanical or fluid/thermal systems * Demonstrated ownership of subsystem\-level design — including trade\-offs across thermal, fluid, and structural interfaces * Strong first\-principles grounding in thermo\-fluid systems, with experience translating analytical models into design decisions * Experience taking components or subsystems from early\-stage concept through manufacturing * Growing technical leadership — comfortable guiding junior engineers or leading focused workstreams (may coordinate or lead the work of other engineers) * Comfort operating with ambiguity in an early\-stage environment ramping toward production, with urgency to hit demanding schedule targets * Strong ownership mentality; eager to roll up sleeves and get hands\-on with hardware when necessary * Experience in energy storage, batteries, or another safety\-critical, highly regulated hardware industry is a plus *\#LI\-Onsite* *Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here.* *When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full\-time employees \- and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed.* *To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.* *If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion.* *Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will* ***never*** *solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process.* Compensation Range: $147,959 \- $221,973

From panel systems and seating to desks, storage, and more, our team is busy year\-round creating everything needed for a total office solution. We craft product that helps teams get things done while feeling good doing it, regardless of industry — because at Fríant, all work styles are welcome. **Summary/Objective** The AI Engineer designs, develops, deploys, and maintains scalable AI\-powered solutions that improve operational efficiency, business intelligence, customer engagement, and process automation across Fríant. This hands\-on role combines software engineering, machine learning, large language models, AI automation, and enterprise system integration. The position works with business stakeholders, IT, Customer Success, Operations, Sales, and Product teams to translate complex requirements into secure, production\-ready AI solutions and supports the full AI lifecycle from architecture and development through deployment, monitoring, governance, and continuous improvement. **Responsibilities** **AI Solution Development** * Design, build, and deploy AI and machine learning solutions that address business challenges and improve operational efficiency. * Develop and optimize machine learning and deep learning models for predictive analytics, classification, recommendation systems, and automation. * Build applications using large language models, Generative AI, and intelligent agents. * Design Retrieval\-Augmented Generation architectures that securely connect enterprise knowledge bases and business systems. **AI Automation and Agents** * Develop and manage AI agents that automate workflows, support business operations, and improve employee productivity. * Create intelligent document processing solutions for extracting, classifying, and analyzing structured and unstructured data. * Implement conversational AI solutions, virtual assistants, copilots, and chatbot platforms. * Design workflow automation using AI orchestration platforms, APIs, function calling, and tool\-use architectures. **Data and Integration** * Build and maintain reliable data pipelines for model training, inference, evaluation, and analytics. * Integrate AI solutions with CRM, ERP, customer support, eCommerce, knowledgebase, and other enterprise applications. * Develop APIs, microservices, webhooks, middleware, and event\-driven architectures that support AI deployment. * Partner with data engineers, IT, and business teams to define practical and scalable AI architecture. **AI Operations and Governance** * Monitor model and application performance, reliability, quality, cost, and business impact. * Implement MLOps and LLMOps practices for deployment, version control, automated evaluation, monitoring, and lifecycle management. * Apply responsible AI, privacy, security, data governance, and access\-control requirements. * Establish guardrails and risk controls for AI applications, and continuously improve accuracy, latency, scalability, and efficiency. * Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, operating procedures, and user guidance. **Competencies** * Strong analytical, critical\-thinking, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving abilities. * Ability to translate business challenges and user contributing effectively across cross\-functional teams. * Comfort working in a fast\-paced environment where technologies, priorities, and requirements evolve. * Strong commitment to responsible AI, security, privacy, and data governance. **Required Education and Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred. * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience developing and deploying AI or machine learning solutions in production environments. * Strong proficiency in Python and practical experience with SQL, Git/GitHub, REST APIs, and at least one application framework such as FastAPI or Flask. * Experience with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit\-learn, or Hugging Face Transformers. * Strong understanding of supervised and unsupervised learning, deep learning, neural networks, natural language processing, feature engineering, and model evaluation. * Hands\-on experience with enterprise Generative AI and LLM technologies such as OpenAI APIs, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic APIs, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, MCP, prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, function calling, AI agents, and RAG. * Experience with vector databases or search platforms such as Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, Chroma, or Azure AI Search. * Experience with at least one major cloud platform, including Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform. * Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, MLflow, model versioning, observability, performance monitoring, or automated evaluation frameworks. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience implementing AI within CRM, ERP, customer service, eCommerce, or knowledge\-management platforms. * Experience with Zoho CRM, Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics, Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, or Power Platform. * Knowledge of OCR, document intelligence, intelligent document processing, analytics, reporting, or forecasting solutions. * Experience supporting Customer Success, Operations, Sales, manufacturing, or warehouse\-distribution environments. * Experience with JavaScript or TypeScript and AI observability or prompt\-monitoring platforms. * Relevant Azure AI, AWS AI/ML, Google Cloud, or other industry certifications are a plus. **Work Environment** While performing the jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Commercial - #4978
jobs.description: Our mission is to detect cancer early, when it can be cured. We are working to change the trajectory of cancer mortality and bring stakeholders together to adopt innovative, safe, and effective technologies that can transform cancer care. We are a healthcare company, pioneering new technologies to advance early cancer detection. We have built a multi\-disciplinary organization of scientists, engineers, and physicians and we are using the power of next\-generation sequencing (NGS), population\-scale clinical studies, and state\-of\-the\-art computer science and data science to overcome one of medicine’s greatest challenges. GRAIL is headquartered in the Bay Area of California, with locations in Washington, D.C., North Carolina, and the United Kingdom. It is supported by leading global investors and pharmaceutical, technology, and healthcare companies. For more information, please visit grail.com GRAIL is seeking a Senior Software Engineer for the Commercial engineering team within our Technology organization. Our team builds and operates the patient\- and provider\-facing software behind the Galleri® test, including my.grail.com and provider.grail.com, along with the systems that collect and deliver the clinical data the test depends on. The software we write sits directly in the path between a patient ordering a test and a physician acting on the result, so correctness, reliability, and clarity matter as much as velocity. This is a backend\-leaning full\-stack role for an engineer who wants meaningful ownership. You will design and build cloud\-native services in Go on AWS and Kubernetes, and you will follow your work through to the React interfaces that patients and clinicians actually use. You will own systems end to end — design, implementation, testing, rollout, and production operation — and you will help raise the bar for the engineers around you. If you want your work to have a direct line to earlier cancer detection, this is a rare place to do it. This role is based in Sunnyvale, California. It offers a flexible work arrangement, with the ability to work from GRAIL's office or from home. Our current flexible work arrangement policy requires that a minimum of 60%, or 24 hours, of your total work week be on\-site. Your specific schedule, determined in collaboration with your manager, will align with team and business needs and could exceed the 60% requirement for the site. At our Sunnyvale campus, Tuesdays and Thursdays are the key days where we encourage on\-site presence to engage in events and on\-site activities. ### **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and operate backend services and distributed systems that power GRAIL's commercial offerings for the Galleri® test, including my.grail.com and provider.grail.com. * Own features and services end to end, from technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support. * Contribute across the stack, building and maintaining React interfaces used by patients, clinicians, and internal clinical operations teams. * Lead the technical design of projects of diverse scope, working independently and bringing designs forward for review at critical decision points. * Devise solutions where precedent is limited, adapting existing approaches and exercising judgment to select the right course of action. * Partner with product managers, clinical operations, and other engineering teams to turn ambiguous requirements into clear technical plans, advising senior stakeholders who may not share your technical background and adapting how you communicate to the audience. * Write and maintain automated tests and test protocols appropriate for software operating in a regulated healthcare environment. * Improve the reliability and observability of the systems you own, participating in on\-call rotation, incident response, and follow\-up remediation. * Raise engineering quality on the team through code review, pairing, and mentorship of less experienced engineers. * Identify and drive improvements to our tooling, CI/CD pipelines, and development practices. These responsibilities summarize the role's primary responsibilities and are not an exhaustive list. They may change at the company's discretion. ### **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Bioinformatics, or a similar technical field with 5\+ years of related experience, or a Master's degree with 2\+ years of related experience, or a PhD, or equivalent experience. * Professional experience designing, developing, testing, and maintaining production backend or full\-stack applications. * Professional experience building and operating services on a major cloud platform such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. * Proficiency in at least one backend programming language such as Go, Java, Python, or C\+\+. * Strong professional written and verbal communication skills. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience writing production Go, and experience with gRPC\-based service communication. * Experience building and maintaining production React applications. * Hands\-on experience with AWS specifically, including infrastructure as code using Terraform. * Experience operating containerized workloads with Kubernetes and Docker in production. * Experience designing and scaling microservice architectures, including service boundaries, versioning, and backward compatibility. * Strong working knowledge of relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL, including schema design and query performance, and of caching layers such as Redis. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing strategies, and agile development practices. * Experience building software in healthcare or another regulated domain, including familiarity with HIPAA, PHI handling, or software quality and validation requirements. * Experience with observability and reliability tooling, and a track record of improving system uptime. * Experience mentoring engineers or leading small project teams. * A demonstrated passion for designing and building practical, high\-quality software, and a desire to add value to the team. The expected, full\-time, annual base pay scale for this position is $169K\- $180K. At GRAIL, we believe in recognizing and rewarding the contributions our employees make to our mission and success. In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for additional compensation, including an annual bonus and/or other incentives, in accordance with applicable plans and the company's discretion. The posted range reflects our good\-faith estimate of the base pay we expect to offer for this position at the time of hire. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as the candidate’s experience, skills, qualifications, and other relevant considerations. At GRAIL, we invest in the health, well\-being, and future of our employees and their families. Employees in this role are eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support what matters most, including flexible time off or vacation, a 401(k) retirement plan with employer match, medical, dental, and vision coverage, and thoughtfully selected well\-being programs. Benefits are offered in accordance with applicable plans and policies. GRAIL is an equal employment opportunity employer, and we are committed to building a workplace where every individual can thrive, contribute, and grow. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other class or characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, and local laws. Additionally, GRAIL will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in a manner consistent with applicable law and provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please contact us at rc@grailbio.com if you require an accommodation to apply for an open position. GRAIL maintains a drug\-free workplace. We welcome job\-seekers from all backgrounds to join us! Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.title: Staff Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: GTI is a contract manufacturing partner supporting customers in renewable energy, power generation, infrastructure, and industrial systems. We fabricate custom designed, purpose\-built enclosures and skids for our customers and perform mechanical and electrical integration in\-house, delivering a true turn\-key product to our customers. Our scope spans Engineering, prototype builds, through full production, requiring teams that can move fast, adapt, and execute with precision. GTI Values: Safety I Quality I Customer Obsession I Speed I Agility **Position Overview** GTI is seeking a Staff Mechanical Engineer to provide senior technical leadership across complex modular power and industrial systems. This role will serve as a technical authority for mechanical system design, structural and thermal analysis, equipment integration, and troubleshooting while supporting projects from concept through manufacturing, testing, and production. The ideal candidate brings extensive hands\-on experience designing industrial equipment, generator enclosures, fabricated steel structures, equipment skids, and modular systems, along with strong engineering calculation capabilities and the ability to mentor engineers and solve complex cross\-functional technical problems. ### **Key Responsibilities** **Mechanical System Design \& Technical Leadership** * Lead mechanical system architecture and design for complex modular power and industrial systems. * Develop and review mechanical designs for generator enclosures, structural frames, equipment skids, sheet metal assemblies, weldments, and integrated mechanical systems. * Design and integrate generators, cooling systems, fuel systems, piping, exhaust systems, and associated aligned with customer requirements. * Work closely with Electrical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Program Management, and Operations. * Support prototype builds, production launches, design changes, and continuous product improvement. * Develop and maintain production\-ready mechanical drawings, engineering calculations, BOMs, specifications, and design documentation. * Provide technical guidance on fabrication, welding, machining, assembly, and mechanical integration. * Resolve complex manufacturing and product performance issues through improve design quality, efficiency, reliability, and repeatability across programs. ### **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline. * 12\+ years of relevant mechanical engineering experience, preferably in industrial equipment, power generation, modular systems, or custom manufacturing. * Demonstrated steel structures, industrial enclosures, equipment skids, weldments, or integrated mechanical systems. * Advanced proficiency in SolidWorks, including large assemblies, sheet metal, weldments, and manufacturing documentation. * Strong experience performing mechanical engineering calculations, structural analysis, and FEA. * Demonstrated ability to solve complex technical problems, lead design reviews, and mentor engineers. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with generator systems, BESS, modular data centers, or mission\-critical power infrastructure. * Experience with thermal management, airflow, cooling systems, or fluid system design. * Familiarity with ANSYS, SolidWorks Simulation, or similar engineering analysis tools. * Knowledge of applicable ASME, AISC, UL, or related engineering standards. * Professional Engineer (PE) license or FE/EIT certification. #### **Perks \& Benefits** GTI offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support jobs.title: Hempcrete Materials Research - (Piovesan)
jobs.description: **Posting Number** **Division** School of Engineering and Computing **Department** Col. of Engineering \& Business **Location** Erie, Pa **Position Summary** As a student research assistant on this Pennsylvania Manufacturing Innovation\-funded project, you will participate in the development and characterization of hempcrete and hemp\-based construction materials intended for use under demanding thermal and environmental conditions. The research will focus on understanding how the physical characteristics of hemp, material formulation, moisture absorption, and exposure to elevated temperatures affect hempcrete performance. Students will prepare experimental specimens, characterize hemp feedstocks, conduct controlled thermal and moisture testing, analyze experimental data, and assist in identifying material combinations that provide improved resistance to heat while maintaining desirable water\-absorption and insulation characteristics. This interdisciplinary project combines materials science, sustainable construction, thermal sciences, manufacturing, and experimental engineering. Students will gain hands\-on experience with sustainable building materials and may contribute to technical reports, conference presentations, peer\-reviewed publications, and potentially patentable innovations. **Career Readiness Learning Objectives** **Critical Thinking** – Student researchers will review scientific and technical literature, identify relevant material parameters, develop test methods, analyze experimental results, compare alternative hempcrete formulations, and determine which material characteristics most strongly influence thermal and moisture performance. **Communication** – Student researchers will develop technical writing and presentation skills by maintaining laboratory documentation, preparing figures and data summaries, contributing to project reports and manuscripts, and presenting results during project meetings and research events. **Teamwork** – Students will work as part of an interdisciplinary research team involving engineering, science, manufacturing, and sustainable\-materials applications. Students may also be expected to present findings from their work at **Celebrate Gannon** or another appropriate undergraduate research venue. **Key Responsibilities** **Hemp Feedstock Characterization** * Characterize hemp hurd and other hemp\-based raw materials used in hempcrete formulations. * Evaluate characteristics such as particle size, particle\-size distribution, bulk density, moisture content, morphology, and water absorption. * Investigate how hemp source, particle dimensions, processing, and preparation affect material performance. * Prepare and document hemp samples using controlled drying, conditioning, screening, or other preprocessing methods. * Assist in identifying hemp characteristics associated with improved thermal resistance and moisture\-management properties. **Hempcrete Formulation and Specimen Preparation** * Prepare hempcrete specimens using controlled combinations of hemp, binder, additives, and water. * Investigate the effects of hemp\-to\-binder ratio, water\-to\-binder ratio, material density, compaction, particle size, and other formulation parameters. * Fabricate specimens using standardized molds and repeatable laboratory procedures. * Measure specimen mass, dimensions, density, curing conditions, and other relevant physical properties. * Maintain accurate records of material batches and specimen preparation conditions. **High\-Temperature Testing** * Assist with controlled exposure of hempcrete specimens to elevated temperatures. * Study how temperature and exposure duration affect hempcrete structure and material properties. * Record specimen temperatures using thermocouples, infrared measurement systems, or other appropriate instrumentation. * Evaluate dimensional changes, mass loss, cracking, discoloration, degradation, and other observable effects following thermal exposure. * Compare the thermal response of different hempcrete formulations and hemp feedstocks. * Assist in determining which formulations retain desirable characteristics after high\-temperature exposure. **Moisture and Water\-Absorption Testing** * Measure water uptake and moisture absorption of hemp and hempcrete specimens. * Perform controlled immersion, humidity\-conditioning, drying, and gravimetric experiments. * Develop moisture\-absorption curves and compare absorption and drying behavior among different formulations. * Investigate relationships between hemp characteristics, material porosity, density, and water retention. * Evaluate formulations intended to provide increased water absorption or moisture\-buffering capacity while maintaining acceptable structural integrity. **Thermal and Physical Characterization** * Assist in measuring thermal conductivity, temperature gradients, heating and cooling response, or related thermal properties where appropriate. * Evaluate density, dimensional stabili ping experimental procedures and test fixtures as needed. **Experimental Design and Data Analysis** * Organize experimental datasets using spreadsheets or engineering\-analysis software. * Calculate material properties and summarize results using tables, plots, and statistical comparisons. * Assist in designing experiments to determine the effects of multiple material variables. * Identify trends linking hemp characteristics and hempcrete formulation to temperature resistance and water absorption. * Compare experimental findings with published research and relevant technical literature. **Laboratory and Safety Responsibilities** * Follow laboratory safety procedures when operating ovens, furnaces, heating equipment, cutting tools, mixers, instrumentation, and other laboratory equipment. * Use appropriate personal protective equipment. * Maintain clean and organized laboratory work areas. * Properly label, store, and document experimental materials and specimens. * Work under faculty supervision when conducting elevated\-temperature experiments. **Documentation and Reporting** * Maintain detailed laboratory notebooks and electronic experimental records. * Photograph and document specimens before and after testing. * Prepare graphs, tables, photographs, and technical summaries. * Participate in regular project meetings. * Contribute to progress reports, technical reports, conference presentations, manuscripts, and other project deliverables. * Present research findings internally and, when appropriate, at external research events. **Benefits** * Gain applied research experience in sustainable construction materials and advanced manufacturing. * Develop hands\-on experience with hempcrete and bio\-based composite materials. * Learn laboratory techniques for thermal, moisture, and materials characterization. * Gain experience in experimental design and engineering data analysis. * Develop skills applicable to careers in materials engineering, manufacturing, construction, sustainability, mechanical engineering, civil engineering, and product development. * Participate in interdisciplinary research involving engineering and science. * Potentially contribute to publications, presentations, technical reports, and intellectual\-property development. Prior experience with hempcrete is **not required**. **Required Qualifications** * Interest in sustainable materials, engineering, manufacturing, construction materials, or experimental research. * Willingness to perform hands\-on laboratory work. * Ability to follow written experimental and safety procedures. * Ability to accurately document experimental activities and results. * Willingness to work independently and as part of a research team. **Preferred Qualifications** * Coursework or experience in heat transfer, thermodynamics, materials science, chemistry, mechanical engineering, civil engineering, manufacturing, or related fields. * Familiarity with laboratory testing or experimental methods. * Experience with Microsoft Excel, MATLAB, Python, or similar data\-analysis tools. * Familiarity with CAD, fabrication, or experimental fixture design. * Experience using temperature sensors, data\-acquisition equipment, laboratory ovens, or materials\-testing equipment. * Strong organizational and technical documentation skills. **Physical Demands** The position involves laboratory and materials\-processing activities. Students should be able to safely lift up to 50 pounds when necessary and sit or stand for extended periods. Work may involve handling dry hemp materials, binders, molds, laboratory equipment, and cured specimens. Appropriate personal protective equipment will be required for specific laboratory activities. Own the operating plan across headcount, compensation, contractors, hosting and cloud, AI and large language model (LLM) costs, software, and tooling. * Build frameworks that connect R\&D investment to product roadmap outcomes. Evaluate business cases for new initiatives, AI capabilities, build\-versus\-buy decisions, and vendor commitments, and present risks and opportunities to leadership. * Define and track R\&D efficiency metrics, including R\&D spend as a percentage of revenue, cost per engineer, hosting cost per user, and AI inference cost per feature. Identify large\-scale savings and reallocation opportunities and see them through to completion. * Partner with People and R\&D leaders on hiring plans, location strategy, and organizational design. Keep headcount forecasts accurate and reconciled to actuals. * Lead the AI transformation of R\&D finance. Rethink planning, forecasting, and reporting workflows, and use AI tools to make them faster, more accurate, and more insightful. * Redesign FP\&A processes, policies, and planning and reporting systems for efficiency and effectiveness, with AI in the center. We don't use Excel for modeling. * A bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field. * Comfort working remotely and asynchronously, and the ability to use GitLab. * Preferred experience includes enterprise software\-as\-a\-service (SaaS) finance; direct CTO partnership; NetSuite, Sisense, Adaptive Planning, or SQL; or a Master of Business Administration (MBA), Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA), or Certified Public Accountant (CPA) qualification. *The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Databases Tempo | US | Remote
jobs.description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40\+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X. We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open\-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation\-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career\-defining opportunity. **This is a remote position. We are seeking candidates in US and Canada.** **The Opportunity:** -------------------- We build **Tempo**, the open\-source distributed tracing backend behind Grafana Cloud Traces and Grafana Enterprise Traces (GET). Tempo makes it easy to search traces, generate metrics from spans, and connect tracing data with logs, metrics, and profiles across the Grafana stack. 2026 is an inflection point for Tempo. After a major architectural upgrade and the launch of TraceQL metrics, we are shifting from foundational work to product and operational excellence, and evolving Tempo from a SaaS database into a platform that powers Grafana’s next generation of observability products (App Observability, Asserts, Traces Drilldown, and AI\-driven assistants). Over the next year, you will help us: * Make Grafana Cloud Traces “just work” for customers by eliminating rough edges, confusing limits, and hidden failure modes. * Achieve operational excellence at scale as we grow from close to 50 cells today into triple digits this year, with autoscaling, parameterized rollouts, and aggressive toil reduction. * Evolve Tempo into a platform enabler: higher\-density APIs, trace aggregation, TraceQL metrics math, and machine/LLM\-friendly interfaces that downstream products and agents can build on. * Push performance further: faster query latency at hundreds of MB/s ingestion and performant 30\-day query ranges to match competitors. * Prepare Tempo for an agent\-driven world: larger, burstier, higher\-cardinality workloads, and new categories of AI\-powered workflows, such as assistant\-driven triage and “why is this slow?”\- style investigations. **What You’ll Be Doing:** ------------------------- As a Senior Engineer on Tempo, you will own technical direction on the hardest problems in our roadmap and raise the bar across the team. * **Deliver significant technical projects.** Take well\-scoped, multi\-month initiatives from problem framing through rollout, e.g., trace aggregation APIs, Limitless Tempo, autoscaling cells and customer limits, or query engine improvements. jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Description: HALO Branded Solutions is a global leader in branded merchandise, uniform programs, and recognition solutions, and we're building something new. We're assembling a dedicated Agentic Systems team to design and build the intelligent systems that will transform how we take an order from ideation to delivery. That means reimagining the full order management lifecycle: quote capture, supplier and decorator coordination, shipping, PO and invoicing as a platform where AI agents do the work that today requires dozens of manual handoffs across customers, sales, operations, and finance. We're not experimenting with AI. We're building production systems that will run the business. HALO is looking for a AI Platform Engineer who will make the platform real: building, running, and hardening the AI harness (runtime layer), control plane (governance layer), and operations control center (observability layer) in close partnership with the AI Platform Architect. This is the role that sits between architectural vision and working production infrastructure, implementing the orchestration framework, building the shared state and memory layer, establishing the integration contracts, and ensuring the platform is reliable enough that every agent running on it actually works. The Architect draws the blueprint; you build the building and keep it standing. This is not a junior role with a senior title. This is a systems\-first engineering role with serious development depth. The decisions you make at the implementation level, how state is managed across agent handoffs, how the runtime is structured so deploying a new agent doesn't require rebuilding the platform, how failure is isolated so one agent's problem doesn't cascade, determine whether HALO's agents work in production. That's the responsibility this role carries. If you're a strong systems engineer with deep distributed systems instincts who is ready to move into AI infrastructure, or an experienced AI platform engineer who wants to build something from the ground up, this is the role. **Responsibilities** **Build and** **operate** **the orchestration infrastructure.** Implement the multi\-agent orchestration layer that all HALO agents run on, managing routing between agents, retry logic, circuit breakers, payload validation, and sequencing. This infrastructure lives outside of individual agents, not inside them. Framework selection is an Architect\-level decision; implementation and ongoing operation are yours. **Own shared state and memory.** Design and implement the state management layer that lets agents pass context across handoffs without losing information: session state, cross\-agent memory, and the persistence model that supports both short\-lived task agents and longer\-running workflow agents. **Build the** **agent** **runtime environment.** Own the infrastructure agents execute on: deployment pipelines, environment management, model version pinning, and the scaffolding that makes deploying a new agent a configuration exercise, not an infrastructure project. The Agent Developers should be able to ship a new agent without filing a ticket to you first. **Define and enforce** **integration** **contracts.** Work directly with the AI Integration Engineer to establish and maintain the contracts governing how agents request data: format, latency guarantees, error handling. Own the API gateway layer between the orchestration platform and the external systems agents interact with. **Own platform reliability.** Uptime, failure isolation, incident response for agent failures, and the runbook for what happens when an agent behaves unexpectedly in production. This is an ongoing operational responsibility. The platform is never "done" in a way that lets you stop thinking about its reliability. **Provide the observability infrastructure.** Implement the platform\-level hooks: logging interfaces, trace endpoints, policy enforcement points that the Governance Engineer instruments. The observability standards live with the Governance Engineer; the infrastructure that makes those standards enforceable lives with you. Requirements: * 5\+ years of software or platform engineering with genuine depth in distributed systems: state management, failure modes, event\-driven architecture, or API platform engineering * Experience building or operating infrastructure that other engineers build on, platforms with downstream consumers who depend on their reliability * Production experience with at least one agent or LLM orchestration framework (AWS AgentCore, LangGraph, CrewAI, LangChain, or equivalent) or strong distributed systems instincts and demonstrated ability to ramp quickly * Comfort with operational ownership and being accountable for reliability **You'll** **stand out if you have:** * Hands\-on experience building multi\-agent orchestration infrastructure in production * Familiarity with agent state and memory patterns: how context persists across agent turns, sessions, an r information. There are 5 sections to complete in total, including General information, Work History, Education, Compliance, and optional demographic questions. Once you have successfully submitted your application, you will receive a submission confirmation email from our system. **Application Deadline:** Applications are reviewed and processed only when there is a specific need or opportunity, rather than on a fixed schedule or at a set deadline. Because they are reviewed on an as\-needed basis, a job posting will be removed once the position has been filled or is no longer available. **More About HALO:** At HALO, we energize our clients' brands and amplify their stories to capture the attention of those who matter most. That’s why over 60,000 small\- and mid\-sized businesses partner with us, making us the global leader in the branded merchandise industry. * **Career Advancement**: At HALO, we’re passionate about promoting from within. Internal promotions have been key to our exponential growth over the past few years. With so many industry leaders at HALO, you’ll have the opportunity to accelerate your career by learning from their experience, insights, and skills. Plus, you'll gain access to HALO’s influential global network, leadership opportunities, and diverse perspectives. * **Culture**: We love working here, and we’re confident you will too. At HALO, you’ll experience a culture of ingenuity, inclusion, and relentless determination. We push the limits of possibility and imagination by staying curious, humble, and bold breaking through yesterday’s limits. Diversity fuels our creativity, and we thrive when each of us contributes to an inclusive environment based on respect, dignity, and equity. We hold ourselves to a high standard of excellence with a commitment to results and supporting one another with accountability, transparency, and dependability. * **Recognition**: At HALO, your success is our success. You can count on us to celebrate your wins. Colleagues across the company will join in recognizing your milestones and nominating you for awards. Over time, you’ll accumulate recognition that can be converted into gift cards, trips, concert tickets, and merchandise from your favorite brands. * **Flexibility**: Many of our roles offer hybrid work options, and we pride ourselves on flexible schedules that help you balance professional and personal demands. We believe that supporting our customers is a top priority and trust that you and your manager will collaborate to create a schedule that achieves this goal. HALO is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We insist on an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information (including characteristics and testing), military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Inclusion is a core value at HALO and we seek to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people. HALO participates in E\-Verify. services of our global control systems program. * Train and develop to build a skillset to serve as market sector and core service subject matter expert (SME). * Mentor junior staff and assist section manager in identifying development opportunities to achieve team goals and objectives. * Develop a skillset to serve as Design Manager on mid\-scale, large scale, or complex control systems projects,
