jobs.title: Data Engineer / ITS Data Governance
jobs.description: **Location Detail:** 9 Farm Springs Rd Farmington (10566\) Work where **every moment** matters. Every day, more than 40,000 Hartford HealthCare colleagues come to work with one thing in common: Pride in what we do, knowing every moment matters here. We invite you to become part of Connecticut’s most comprehensive healthcare network. The creation of the HHC System Support Office recognizes the work of a large and growing group of employees whose responsibilities are continually evolving so that we and our departments now work on behalf of the system as a whole, rather than a single member organization. With the creation of our new umbrella organization we now have our own identity with a unique payroll, benefits, performance management system, service recognition programs and other common practices across the system. **Position Summary:** As a Data Engineer, you will design, build, deploy, and support enterprise data solutions that capture, integrate, transform, govern, and make data available for analytics, AI/ML, generative AI, operational reporting, research, and other enterprise use cases. The Data Engineer will help architect, implement, and operate robust, scalable data infrastructure across on\-premises and cloud environments, with a primary focus on Hartford HealthCare's enterprise data and digital platform (H2D2\). This role will also provide dedicated engineering support to the enterprise Data Governance program by implementing data\-quality controls, master data management (MDM), reference data management (RDM), metadata, lineage, and governance requirements as reusable capabilities within the H2D2 data fabric. **Position Responsibilities:** **Key Areas of Responsibility** Design, develop, test, deploy, and operate automated, scalable data pipelines and reusable ingestion frameworks for batch, streaming, and near\-real\-time workloads. Implement incremental ingestion, transformation, orchestration, observability, error handling, and recovery patterns. Monitor and troubleshoot pipeline performance and reliability, resolve bottlenecks, and automate controls that protect the quality, security, integrity, availability, and maintainability of HHC data solutions. Provide data\-engineering support for the enterprise Data Governance program. Build and maintain automated data\-quality rules, profiling, validation, reconciliation, exception management, and monitoring capabilities; publish measurable data\-quality results; and partner with data owners and stewards to investigate root causes and remediate defects at the appropriate source or transformation layer. Engineer and support master data management (MDM) and reference data management (RDM) capabilities, including source integration, matching and survivorship logic, hierarchy and crosswalk management, reference\-code synchronization, data\-standard enforcement, and distribution of trusted master and reference data to downstream consumers. Partner with data architects, the Data Governance Office, interoperability, analytics, research, security, and other data\-engineering teams to embed governance into the H2D2 fabric. Implement metadata capture, business and technical lineage, classification, ownership and stewardship attributes, access and retention controls, and policy\-as\-code or reusable control patterns across Bronze/Raw, Silver/Curated, and Gold/Governed data layers. Create and maintain technical documentation, including source\-to\-target mappings, data dictionaries, logical and physical models, lineage, interface specifications, data\-quality rules, operating procedures, runbooks, and support documentation. Ensure metadata and documentation remain synchronized with deployed solutions. Contribute to software engineering, data engineering, data architecture, DevSecOps, and governance standards across the team and broader organization. Participate in design and code reviews, promote reusable patterns and automated testing, and support a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, innovation, and responsible data use. **Working Relationships:** **This Job Reports To (Job Title):** Director Data Engineering and Architecture. ### **Qualifications** **Education** * Minimum: bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or related quantitative field * Preferred: Master’s degree in healthcare administration, computer sciences or related field **Experience** * Minimum: o 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in data software development including applications running on premise and/or cloud environments (GCP, AWS or Azure) o Experience implementing automated data\-quality profiling, validation, reconciliation, monitoring, and exception\-management controls. o Working knowledge of data governance concepts, including metadata management, technical lineage, data classification, stewardship, and policy enforcement. o Experience integrating governance controls into cloud data pipelines, lakehouse architectures, or enterprise data platforms. o 2\+ years of experience in data software development that includes building data and digital platforms for batch or streaming ingestion, processing the data for analytics, and storing the data in various stages o Extensive experience multiple programming languages (Python, C/C\+\+, SQL etc.) o 2\+ Years experience in ETL design and data modeling implementation, and maintenance. o Proactive and self\-motivated with a passion for continuous learning and staying updated with best practices, new features, and emerging technologies. o 2\+ years of Experience with specialized data architecture (e.g., data lake, lake house, data fabric, data mesh) * Preferred: o 3\+ years of experience working with Cloud native development. GCP preferred. o Experience with enterprise MDM and RDM platforms, including matching, survivorship, hierarchy, crosswalk, and reference\-code management. o Experience with metadata catalog, lineage, or data\-quality platforms; Informatica CDGC, Cloud Data Quality, or MDM experience is preferred. o Healthcare data experience involving Epic, FHIR, HL7, OMOP, clinical terminology, or other governed clinical and research data standards. o 3\+ years of experience in data software development that includes building data and digital platforms o Understanding of FHIR and other Health Level 7 (HL7\) communication standards and clinical documentation architecture. o 3\+ years of Experience with specialized data architecture **Knowledge, Skills and Ability Requirements** time and project management skills; demonstrated skills in verbal and written expression of ideas; in person and virtual presentation skills; good command and understanding of data engineering and architecture concepts. **We take great care of careers.** With locations around the state, Hartford HealthCare offers exciting opportunities for career development and growth. Here, you are part of an organization on the cutting edge – helping to bring new technologies, breakthrough treatments and community education to countless men, women and children. We know that a thriving organization starts with thriving employees\- we provide a competitive benefits program designed to ensure work/life balance. Every moment matters. And this is **your moment.**

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description: Company Description By working at Harvard University, you join a vibrant community that advances Harvard's world\-changing mission in meaningful ways, inspires innovation and collaboration, and builds skills and expertise. We are dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming environment where everyone can thrive. **Why join Harvard Medical School?** Harvard Medical School's mission is to nurture a diverse, inclusive community dedicated to alleviating suffering and improving health and well\-being for all through excellence in teaching and learning, discovery and scholarship, and service and leadership. You’ll be at the heart of biomedical discovery, education, and innovation, working alongside world\-renowned faculty and a community dedicated to improving human health. This is more than a job \- it’s an opportunity to shape the future of medicine. Join our team of researchers, engineers, and designers to shape a future in which humans and AI collaborate to solve the most challenging biological and medical problems! **About the Department of Biomedical Informatics** The HIDIVE Lab in the Department of Biomedical Informatics at Harvard Medical School conducts research at the interface of human and artificial intelligence. We create methods and tools that enable humans and machines alike to interact with and generate insights from biomedical data, combining state\-of\-the\-art biomedical informatics, data visualization, and AI/ML techniques across the full spectrum of biomedical data. An overview of recent publications of the lab can be found on Google Scholar. We value diverse viewpoints, creative thinking, and bold initiative in a highly collaborative and interdisciplinary work environment. The HIDIVE Lab has an international reputation for creating high impact data visualization tools and we are driven to solve the most challenging design and engineering problems where biomedical data, humans, and AI meet. We would love to have you on our team! Job Description We are seeking a Software Developer with 1\-3 years of professional software development experience who wants real ownership of production software and meaningful exposure to biomedical research. Under the guidance of senior developers, you will help integrate a natural\-language conversational AI system for exploring biomedical metadata and visualizations into biomedical data portals, including developing APIs and packages to move visualizations in and out of these systems. You will work with researchers, designers, and engineers to build tools that allow scientists to efficiently query, visualize, and understand complex biological data through natural language and direct interaction with visualizations. This role offers an opportunity to develop software at the intersection of AI, scientific discovery, and interactive data visualization \- contributing to widely used biomedical data resources and community tools. **Core Responsibilities:** * Develop and maintain web\-based software for biomedical data discovery and visualization. * Participate fully in the software development life cycle across multiple concurrent projects. * Identify, triage, and resolve software bugs and performance bottlenecks using browser developer tools across multiple browsers and devices to ensure a seamless, high\-performance user experience. * Write tests and documentation, and maintain reliable, open\-source code. * Participate in code reviews, issue tracking, and iterative product development. * Contribute to utility tools for metadata management and file format handling for genomic, single\-cell, and bioimaging data (e.g., VCF, BAM, BigWig, BED, OME\-NGFF, Zarr, SpatialData, etc.). * Containerize workflows using Docker or similar tools for portability and reproducibility. * Deploy, monitor, and maintain cloud\-based services supporting lab software and data portals. * Collaborate with researchers and domain experts to translate scientific needs into software features. * Contribute to academic publications, technical reports, and documentation for both lay and specialist audiences. * Stay current with emerging technologies in data visualization, AI, software development, and computational data science. * Abide by and follow the Harvard University IT technical standards, policies, and Code of Conduct. Qualifications **Basic Qualifications:** * Minimum of two years’ post\-secondary education or relevant work experience **Additional Qualifications and Skills:** * 1–3 years of professional software development experience. * Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, shell scripting, and modern web frameworks (React, Vue). * Familiarity with REST/GraphQL APIs, CSS, and component\-based design patterns. * Experience with automated testing, version control (e.g., GitHub), and collaborative software development workflows. * Strong problem\-solving and communication skills. * Working knowledge of automated testing, version control (e.g., GitHub), and package distribution (e.g., npm, PyPI). * Experience with Vitessce, Gosling, D3\.js, or similar visualization libraries. * Familiarity with WebGL/WebGPU or emerging visualization trends is a plus. * Familiarity with LLMs, natural\-language interfaces, and AI\-powered development tools to improve efficiency and enhance metadata\-driven applications. * Background in bioinformatics data formats, molecular biology, or genomics/single\-cell/spatial biology data. * Experience contributing to open\-source projects is a strong plus. Additional Information * **Term:** This is a 1 year term position from the date of hire, with the possibility of extension, contingent upon work performance and continued funding to support the position. * **Standard Hours/Schedule:** 35 hours per week * **Visa Sponsorship Information:** Harvard University is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position * **Pre\-Employment Screening:** Identity * **Other Information:** All interviews will be conducted remotely using a video conferencing platform. * **Staying Informed About Your Application:** Due to the high volume of applications, we may not always be able to reach out right away, but you can track your status anytime through the Careers@Harvard portal. \#LI\-DK1 **Work Format Details** This position has been determined by school or unit leaders that the duties and responsibilities can effectively be performed fully remotely at a non\-Harvard location. Employees in fully remote positions must work all scheduled hours in a Harvard registered state in compliance with the University’s Policy on Employment Outside of Massachusetts. At the discretion of the department, fully remote employees may occasionally be required on site at a Harvard location. Certain visa types and funding sources may limit work location. Individuals must meet work location sponsorship requirements prior to employment. **Salary Grade and Ranges** This position is salary grade level 057\. Please visit Harvard's Salary Ranges to view the corresponding salary range and related information. **Benefits** Harvard offers a comprehensive benefits package that is designed to support a healthy work\-life balance and your physical, mental and financial wellbeing. Because here, you are what matters. Our benefits include, but are not limited to: * Generous paid time off including parental leave * Medical, dental, and vision health insurance coverage starting on day one * Retirement plans with university contributions * Wellbeing and mental health resources * Support for families and caregivers * Professional development opportunities including tuition assistance and reimbursement * Commuter benefits, discounts and campus perks Learn more about these and additional benefits on our Benefits \& Wellbeing Page. **EEO/Non\-Discrimination Commitment Statement** Harvard University is committed to equal opportunity and non\-discrimination. We seek talent from all parts of society and the world, and we strive to ensure everyone at Harvard thrives. Our differences help our community advance Harvard's academic purposes. Harvard has an equal employment opportunity policy that outlines our commitment to prohibiting discrimination on the basis of race, ethnicity, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, religion, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law or identified in the university's non\-discrimination policy. Harvard's equal employment opportunity policy and non\-discrimination policy help all community members participate fully in work and campus life free from harassment and discrimination.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Tenant
jobs.description: **What We’re Building** Honeycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do! We’re working with well known companies like HelloFresh, Slack, LaunchDarkly, and Vanguard and more across a range of industries. This is an exciting time in our trajectory, we’ve closed Series D funding, scaled past the 200\-person mark, and were named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startups of 2022 and 2023! If you want to see what we’ve been up to, please check out these blog posts and Honeycomb.io press releases. **Who We Are** We come for the impact, and stay for the culture! We’re a talented, opinionated, passionate, fiercely inclusive, and responsible group of bees. We have conviction and we strive to live our values every day. We want our people to do what they truly love amongst a team of highly talented (but humble) peers. **How We Work** We are a fully distributed company, which means we believe it is not where you sit, but how you deliver that matters most. We invest in our people and care about how you orient to our culture and processes. At the same time we imbue a lot of trust, autonomy, and accountability from Day 1\. \#LI\-Remote Honeycomb is an observability platform that helps engineering teams understand how their software behaves in production. Our Tenant team is behind Honeycomb Private Cloud, a brand new product that allows customers to have their own Honeycomb instance. ### **What you'll do** * **Own delivery of Honeycomb Private Cloud** — the infrastructure, tooling, and operational processes that let enterprise customers run Honeycomb inside their own cloud environment. * **Grow the product** — we anticipate significant growth in the next year; help us meet sales goals and build relationships to support it. * **Work at the customer boundary** — partner with Field Engineering, Support, and Sales on PoCs, security reviews, access negotiations, and contract asks, and help the team know when to take feedback and when to help us show the customer what good looks like. * **Lead across the org** — Private Cloud depends on many engineering teams across the org. We maintain a tight drift between SaaS and Private Cloud, and this role will need to be able to understand and prioritize work that touches all parts of our engineering org. * **Feedback loops for developers.** We learn a lot about Honeycomb as a product while building Honeycomb. Ensure that we push Private\-Cloud\-inspired tooling back into our SaaS infrastructure so each side continues to make the other better. * **Build the team** — grow and develop a small, tenured, senior, very high\-context team; remove the single points of failure that come with that; hire and onboard the next engineers to scale the team as the product offering scales. ### **What we're looking for** * 1\+ year as an Engineering manager for a highly technical, senior team. * You have a solid track record as an engineer, influencing without authority, and leaving things better than you found them. * You've managed or led a team that carried a real production on\-call rotation, and you treat operational health as a core requirement. * Experience shipping and operating software in environments you don't fully control — on\-prem, private cloud, BYOC, or managed single\-tenant. You know what version skew, partial telemetry, and customer security constraints do to a roadmap. * Enough Kubernetes and AWS fluency to review a design, ask the challenging questions, and be useful in an incident review. You don't need to be the person writing the Terraform. * Comfort being customer\-facing with enterprise buyers: security questionnaires, access models, procurement, escalations. * Ruthless prioritization on a small team with an enormous surface area — you can name what you decided *not* to do, and why. * Hiring and onboarding engineers into a domain with a steep ramp. * Comfort with AI tooling, and a point of view on where it helps and where it doesn't. **Bonus points** * Familiarity with observability / OpenTelemetry (Honeycomb's domain). * You're still hands\-on and enjoy contributing to and reviewing code (welcome, but it won't be your primary role here). * Background in Go, Terraform, Kafka, and large\-scale data infrastructure. * FedRAMP, GovCloud, or regulated\-industry compliance experience. * A field\-adjacent past — solutions architecture, consulting, or deployment engineering. Base Salary based on level of experience $208,260 \- $234,000 USD **What you'll get when you join the Hive:** * A stake in our success \- generous equity with employee\-friendly stock program * It’s not about how strong of a negotiator you are \- our pay is based on transparent levels relative to experience * Time to recharge with unlimited PTO * A distributed\-first mindset and culture (really!) * Home office, co\-working, and internet stipend * Full benefits coverage for employees, with additional coverage available for dependents * Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave, regardless of path to parenthood * Annual development allowance * And much more... **Please note we cannot currently sponsor or support visa transfers at this time.** Additionally, in compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work. **Phishing and Recruitment Scam Warning:** We take your security seriously. Please be aware that recruitment scams are increasingly common and scammers may create email addresses or websites to impersonate Honeycomb employees. To help protect you: * All communications will come from an **@honeycomb.io** email address + We occasionally work with external recruiting agencies. These partners will use legitimate business email addresses—**never personal accounts like Gmail or Yahoo**. * Our recruiting process will **never** ask you to provide financial or sensitive personal information, including but not limited to: + Social security or tax identification numbers + Credit card numbers + Bank account information **Diversity \& Accommodations:** We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace—where people of all backgrounds, identities, experiences, and abilities are welcomed, valued, and supported. We recognize that there is no single path to success and embrace nontraditional career journeys and diverse perspectives as key to building stronger, more innovative teams. We strive to ensure an inclusive experience throughout every stage of our hiring process and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations as needed. If you require accommodations or accessible formats at any point during our hiring process, please let your recruiter know. As an equal opportunity employer our hiring process is designed to put you at ease and help you show your best work. If there’s anything we can do to improve your experience, we’re always open to feedback. **Privacy Notice:** If you apply for a job at Honeycomb and your application is unsuccessful (or you withdraw from the process or decline our offer), Honeycomb will retain your information after your application for a period of time in accordance with local laws. We retain this information for various reasons, including in case we face a legal challenge in respect of a recruitment decision, to consider you for other current or future jobs at Honeycomb, and to help us better understand, analyze and improve our recruitment processes. For more information regarding our privacy practices please see the Honeycomb Privacy Notice. If you do not want us to retain your information, or want us to update it, please contact privacy@honeycomb.io. Please note, however, that we may retain some information if required by law or as necessary to protect ourselves from legal claims.

jobs.description: Huron is redefining what a global consulting organization can be. Advancing new ideas every day to build even stronger clients, individuals and communities. And, we’re developing strategies and implementing solutions that enable the transformative change they need to own their future. Our accounting, finance, human resources, IT, legal, marketing and facilities management professionals work collaboratively to support Huron’s collective strategies and enable real transformation to produce sustainable business results. Join our team and create your future. This person works alongside a Huron business team. They turn the business problem into an AI solution design on Microsoft Azure that the engineers can build. Between what the business needs and what the engineers build. * Set the measures. jobs.title: Product Architect
jobs.description: **Summary** ----------- **The Opportunity** Hyatt Hotels Corporation seeks an enthusiastic Product Architect to join our Digital Sales \& Events team. In this role, you will be collaborating closely with the broader digital, technology and business teams, where you’ll be instrumental in continuing to make Hyatt a leading hospitality company. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests. **Who We Are** At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest\-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues. As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers. **Why Now?** This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception. **How We Care for Our People** What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious *100 Best Companies to Work For®* list since 2013\. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong. We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include: * Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally * Flexible work schedule * Work\-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on\-site fitness center * A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption * Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match **Who You Are** As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results\-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally. **The Role** The Product Architect provides architectural leadership for a digital product area, with a primary focus on data architecture. This role develops a deep understanding of Hyatt’s legacy data models, systems, and integrations, and helps product and engineering teams make sound decisions as business requirements evolve. The Product Architect assesses how proposed capabilities and changes affect the data model, data flows, integrations, and downstream consumers. They work with product, engineering, database, and platform teams to define solutions that preserve data integrity and support reliable, secure, and scalable applications. * Understand and document core legacy data models, including how key entities, business rules, and integrations are used across the Hyatt ecosystem. * Translate business requirements into data and application architecture, identifying impacts to existing models, interfaces, processes, and downstream systems. * Provide architectural direction across the product area, including application services, APIs, integrations, and platform dependencies, so solutions meet business needs and work reliably across the broader ecosystem. * Evaluate options and recommend architectural direction, explaining tradeoffs and implications for the product and its data. * Guide teams on data design, relational modeling, SQL, APIs, event\-driven integration, and application architecture patterns. * Coordinate solution strategies across teams so systems and data integrations work together and can scale. * Identify and optimize recurring operational processes that depend on product data and systems, such as monthly and annual sales data cycles. Coordinate execution, clarify ownership and controls, and reduce manual effort and failure risk. * Define and coordinate operational validation after maintenance windows, releases, and other system changes. Confirm that critical applications, integrations, and data processes are functioning as expected, and ensure issues are triaged and resolved with the responsible teams. * Establish and document architecture decisions, standards, and reference designs, including through RFCs. * Partner with internal and external stakeholders, and mentor engineers in data design, scalability, reliability, and operational practices. * Evaluate tools and frameworks when they address a clear product or architecture need. **Qualifications** ------------------ **Experience Required:** * 10\+ years of experience working in complex enterprise technology environments, including software engineering or architecture. * Demonstrated experience designing application and data architectures for scalable, reliable, and secure systems. * Strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of relational database design, data modeling, and data migration. * Experience analyzing business requirements and determining their impact on existing data models, integrations, and downstream consumers. * Experience planning data and application integrations across operational databases, data warehouses or lakes, and external APIs. * Experience designing or supporting data pipelines and integrations; familiarity with event\-driven architectures and Apache Kafka. * Experience with REST APIs and integration platforms such as Apigee or nginx. * Experience improving and coordinating recurring business or technology operations, including scheduled data processes, post\-maintenance validation, issue triage, and cross\-team follow\-through. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills; able to explain architectural tradeoffs to technical and business partners. * Working knowledge of modern application development and delivery practices, including Java\-based services, source control, CI/CD, and cloud or container platforms. **Experience Preferred:** * Experience with Hyatt’s systems or similarly complex legacy enterprise data environments. * Experience with dimensional modeling and data warehousing. * Experience with Agile and DevOps practices. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience. The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all\-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary. **We welcome you:** Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better. *We value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. Hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.* *The salary range for this position is $130,000 to $155,000\. This position is also eligible to earn incentive awards and an annual bonus. The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work. Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.*

jobs.title: Principal Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Diagnostic Imaging \& Telemedicine** is seeking an analytics\-focused **Data Engineer** to serve as the technical owner and lead for the DI\&TM analytics data platform and semantic layer, a business\-critical data product supporting financial, clinical, operational, and strategic decision\-making. This role is accountable for defining and leading the technical direction, architecture, standards, and roadmap for the data foundation that enables analysts, operational leaders, business partners, applications, and AI\-enabled solutions to confidently access and use trusted data. The engineer treats the semantic layer as a strategic data product—establishing consistent definitions, relationships, business logic, data models, documentation, and reusable patterns that enable trusted metrics and datasets across multiple use cases. The role owns the technical evolution of this foundation and independently identifies opportunities to improve scalability, reliability, performance, automation, data quality, accessibility, and cost. The ideal candidate brings deep **expertise in data engineering and analytics engineering**, with specialized knowledge of database architecture, data modeling, modern transformation practices, and analytics platforms. The role requires the ability to interpret complex and ambiguous business and technical problems, evaluate trade\-offs, and recommend scalable solutions that may influence architecture and data practices beyond Diagnostic Imaging \& Telemedicine. The incumbent serves as a recognized technical expert and best\-practice resource for data modeling, dbt, Snowflake, SQL, and modern analytics engineering practices. This role provides technical leadership and mentorship to data analysts and engineers and establishes engineering standards and development practices across the group. Working with a high degree of autonomy, the role sets technical priorities in alignment with business objectives and operates independently except in the most complex or enterprise\-level situations. **This is a fully remote position with the opportunity to travel to our corporate headquarters.** **In this role, you will:** --------------------------- * **Owns and leads the technical strategy and architecture for the DI\&T analytics data platform and semantic layer,** ensuring the data foundation can reliably support current and future financial, clinical, operational, and strategic business needs. * **Designs and develops scalable data models and curated datasets** that transform raw data into trusted, reusable data products for business, financial, clinical, and operational analytics. * **Defines and leads the architecture of the analytics semantic layer**, including standardized business logic, metrics, dimensions, relationships, and definitions that enable consistent and reliable reporting and analysis across Diagnostic Imaging and Telemedicine. * **Leads the development and evolution of reliable production data pipelines and transformation** processes integrating data from operational systems, data warehouses, integration hubs, data lakes, and other enterprise sources. * **Translates business and analytical requirements into scalable data solutions**, partnering closely with Business Analysts, Data Analysts, and operational stakeholders to understand needs and develop data products that are fit for purpose and reusable across multiple use cases. * **Solves complex cross\-system data problems where established patterns or precedents may not exist**, applying broad technical and business perspective to identify root causes, evaluate alternatives, and develop innovative solutions. * **Establishes and applies data modeling, engineering, and governance standards**, including naming conventions, documentation, data definitions, lineage, version control, testing, and development practices that improve the consistency and maintainability of the analytics environment. * **Ensures data quality, accuracy, reliability, and accessibility** by implementing validation, testing, monitoring, and error\-handling processes and proactively identifying and resolving data issues. * **Provides technical leadership and mentorship to data analysts, data engineers, and other technical team members,** raising the organization's capabilities in SQL, data modeling, Git, dbt, testing, documentation, and engineering practices. * **Serves as the recognized subject matter expert and best\-practice resource for data modeling, dbt, Snowflake, SQL, and analytics engineering** within Diagnostic Imaging \& Telemedicine and with partner teams across IDEXX. * **Monitors data pipeline and model performance**, identifies bottlenecks, failures, and gaps, and implements sustainable solutions that improve reliability and reduce manual intervention. * **Partners with technology and engineering teams to evolve the data architecture**, identifying opportunities to centralize fragmented data, automate manual workflows, improve system integration, a inability and can clearly articulate and defend architectural decisions. * Deep Snowflake or equivalent analytical platform experience, including analytics engineering, performance tuning, architecture, cost optimization, workload management, and data model design. * Advanced experience with dimensional, wide\-table, and hybrid modeling approaches, including designing models at the appropriate grain for scalable downstream analytics. * Expert SQL capabilities. This is a hands\-on technical role and requires continued development and review of production code. * Production data engineering experience, including building and maintaining pipelines, orchestration, monitoring, error handling, and operational support. Airflow or equivalent orchestration experience preferred. * Strong Git and CI/CD experience, including establishing and enforcing code review, branching, testing, deployment, and engineering discipline across a technical team. * Python or other scripting language experience preferred. * Experience applying AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude, Snowflake Cortex Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent technologies to improve engineering productivity and solution development. * Demonstrated ability to evaluate technical trade\-offs and make architecture decisions involving scalability, performance, cost, reliability, maintainability, and business value. * Demonstrated ability to influence architecture and system design across organizational boundaries while partnering with enterprise engineering and technology teams. * Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear recommendations for technical and non\-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership. * Strong understanding of data governance, data lineage, business definitions, naming conventions, metadata, and context engineering and their role in creating trusted and reusable data products. * Demonstrated ability to work independently, exercise sound technical judgment, and determine priorities with limited direction. * Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to address complex, ambiguous, and novel technical problems where established solutions may not exist. **What you can expect from us:** -------------------------------- * Salary of $140000 to $160000 * Opportunity for annual cash bonus * Health / Dental / Vision Benefits Day\-One * 5% matching 401k * Additional benefits including but not limited to financial support, pet insurance, mental health resources, volunteer paid days off, employee stock program, foundation donation matching, and much more **Why IDEXX** ------------- We’re proud of the work we do, because our work matters. An innovation leader in every industry we serve, we follow our Purpose and Guiding Principles to help pet owners worldwide keep their companion animals healthy and happy, to ensure safe drinking water for billions, and to help farmers protect livestock and poultry from disease. We have customers in over 175 countries and a global workforce of over 10,000 talented people. So, what does that mean for you? We enrich the livelihoods of our employees with a positive and respectful work culture that embraces challenges and encourages learning and discovery. At IDEXX, you will be supported by competitive compensation, incentives, and benefits while enjoying purposeful work that drives improvement. **Let’s Pursue What Matters.** *IDEXX values a diverse workforce and workplace and strongly encourages women, people of color, LGBTQ individuals, people with disabilities, members of ethnic minorities, foreign\-born residents, and veterans to apply.* *IDEXX is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition, or any protected category prohibited by local, state, or federal laws.* \#LI\-KS1

analysis, and implement corrective actions in partnership with Agile teams and support groups. * Support software delivery through CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, deployment processes, monitoring, We do this by living our values, and through a relentless focus on the success of our customers and partnering with our employees to think and act like owners. We believe in sustainability through the development and distribution of a broad range of global brands designed to meet the needs of our customers in both efficient and responsible ways. For more information visit: www.irco.com. **Job Overview** Ingersoll Rand is seeking a highly motivated, Engineer to Order (ETO) Engineer to join an interactive and dynamic team where safety, quality, creativity, and continuous improvement are paramount. This is a role designed for a recent graduate or engineer with limited industry experience who is eager to learn centrifugal compressor design fundamentals specific to our customer orders. Working under the guidance and mentorship of your peers and manager, the ETO Engineer will detail mechanical design and design verification while building the technical foundation needed to grow into an independent contributor. Assignments are typically well\-defined in scope and reviewed regularly to support learning and skill development. **Responsibilities** * Design support: Assist in developing and releasing mechanical designs for centrifugal compressor components under the direction of your functional engineering manager, including 3D models, drawings, and bills of material. * Team collaboration: Participate in cross\-functional discussions with our Tendering and Commercial teams, Product Management, Manufacturing, Quality, Sourcing, and Service teams to understand how product and customer specific requirements translate into design solutions. * Product validation: Support the design, build, and test of centrifugal compressors made to customer specifications. * Communication: Communicate progress, questions, and roadblocks clearly and proactively to mentors and the team; actively seek feedback to accelerate learning. * Travel: Ability to travel, including internationally, up to 5%. **Qualifications** * BS in Mechanical Engineering; 3\+ years of related design or product development experience * Solid undergraduate foundation in mechanical design, machine design, mechanics of materials, manufacturing processes, and/or engineering fundamentals. **Preferred Qualifications** * Exposure to turbomachinery, rotating equipment, or pressure\-containing equipment through coursework or internships is a plus. * Familiarity with CAD/PLM tools (NX and Teamcenter), finite element analysis, or programming is a plus. * Demonstrated eagerness to learn, strong work ethic, and ability to work in a team environment. **Core Competencies** * Working knowledge of computer systems and basic Microsoft Office. * Strong command of the English language with the ability to communicate clearly in writing and speech with peers, mentors, and leadership. * Ability to absorb, organize, and apply new technical information quickly. * Self\-motivated, responsible, detail\-oriented, coachable, and personable, with a genuine desire to receive and act on feedback. * Ability to own and manage assignments within a supportive team environment while developing and agile resilience to change within specific customer constraints and aggressive schedules. **Travel \& Work Arrangements / Requirements** * The location for this position is Buffalo, NY. **Pay Range** The pay range for this role is Min \- 70000 \- Max \- 90000 . The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location. **What We Offer** At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership — taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment, as well as our individual health and well\-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better. Our range of benefits includes health care options like medical and prescription plans, dental and vision coverage, as well as wellness programs. Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond. Ingersoll Rand Inc. (NYSE:IR), driven by an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset, is dedicated to helping make life better for our employees, customers and communities. Customers lean on us for our technology\-driven excellence in mission\-critical flow creation and industrial solutions across 40\+ respected brands where our products and services excel in the most complex and harsh conditions. Our employees develop customers for life through their daily commitment to expertise, productivity and efficiency. For more information, visit www.IRCO.com.

jobs.title: AI Principal Software Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description: **Position Summary:** The AI CoE Principal Software Engineer will report to the Sr. Director, AI Center of Excellence, in the Technology Department. This role is the most senior individual contributor on the team and the technical owner of the enterprise AI engineering foundation, including the semantic router, model and harness hosting, the enterprise AI gateway, and the AI operations layer used across the business. The role is responsible for setting AI engineering architecture and standards and then building them, carrying a multi\-year capability roadmap from discovery through prototype, validation, and production scale. Primary duties include designing and building the shared AI platform and semantic routing layer; product inference and personalization, partnering with AI\-Ops on monitoring, evaluation, and governance guardrails; building secure, compliant AI integration patterns for a regulated financial services and health and benefits environments; leading agentic pipeline and multi\-agent orchestration work; delivering production AI services for CoE\-enabled business functions; developing reusable reference architectures for other engineering teams; managing AI unit economics; prototyping emerging AI capabilities; mentoring senior and lead engineers; and partnering with security, risk, compliance, and data governance. This role does not have direct reports. **Duties \& Responsibilities:** * Architect, build, and operate the shared enterprise AI platform, including core semantic data, model, harness, and hosting capability used across developer and in\-product personalization use cases. * Design and maintain intelligent request routing using semantic analysis and deterministic logic to direct requests to the best\-fit LLM, internal tool, or agentic pool, using cost, latency, and privacy as routing criteria. * Partner with AI\-Ops to enable metric\-based reporting, quality, performance, and drift monitoring across live systems, build model evaluation harnesses, and establish governance guardrails for safe AI use at scale. * Design and implement secure, compliant AI integration patterns appropriate for a regulated financial services environment. * Build and scale agentic pipelines and multi\-agent orchestration across the software development lifecycle, from pilot through measured engineering capacity across product teams. * Deliver production AI services supporting document intelligence and claims adjudication, conversational and voice self\-service, call intelligence, fraud and anomaly detection, and regulatory monitoring. * Develop reusable reference architectures and standard patterns so other engineering teams and embedded consultants can build AI solutions without rebuilding the foundation. * Evaluate unit economics for AI workloads, including cost per transaction, token and inference spend, latency budgets, and build\-versus\-buy and self\-host\-versus\-vendor decisions. * Identify and prototype emerging AI capabilities relevant to the business and technology roadmap, including fast, focused feasibility spikes with clear recommendations. * Lead hands\-on training sessions and pair directly with engineering teams on new development methods and prototype or pattern adoption. * Monitor the AI landscape and translate findings into roadmap recommendations on what to pilot, what to watch, and what to decline. * Set technical direction and standards for embedded AI consultants and the coaching network to scale AI delivery capacity beyond the CoE. * Mentor senior and lead engineers across business units, review AI designs, and serve as the escalation point for complex agentic and integration issues. * Partner with security, risk, compliance, and data governance teams to support safe and compliant AI delivery. * Perform other duties as assigned. Requirements: **Education \& Experience:** Minimum required: * Bachelor of Science Degree in Computer Science. * AI Practitioner Certifications are a plus * 12\+ years building and operating production software, including 4\+ years delivering production AI/ML systems and 2\+ years of LLM or agentic systems in production, with a track record as the most senior technical owner of an enterprise\-scale platform. **Skills \& Abilities:** * Architecting and operating production agentic workflows as state machines, including branching logic, retry and recovery paths, and precise control over multi\-step process flow. * Deep fluency with AI\-assisted development environments such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or ONA, with a track record of driving adoption and measured impact across engineering teams. * Semantic routing and model orchestration, including embedding\-based intent analysis, deterministic fallback logic, and policy\-based model selection across multiple providers on cost, latency, and privacy criteria. * Observability and AI Ops for non\-deterministic systems, including distributed tracing, behavioral analysis, usage and quality metrics, drift detection,  and staff engineers, and communicating trade\-offs to executive stakeholders. * Ability to own a multi\-year capability roadmap, moving work from discovery through prototype, production validation, and scale against defined business metrics. * Ability to move fluidly between abstract system thinking and tactical, incremental delivery while managing stakeholders and delivering against a critical path. * Financial services, healthcare benefits, or other regulated industry experience preferred, with HSA/FSA, claims, custody, or payments domain exposure especially valuable. * Knowledge of AI governance and compliance frameworks preferred, such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, model risk management, SOC 2, or HIPAA control environments. * Experience with rapid prototyping and feasibility assessment in an R\&D or innovation capacity preferred. * Experience facilitating technical learning sessions or pairing with engineers at varying skill levels preferred. * Multi\-agent system design experience preferred, including role assignment and coordination, agent\-to\-agent conversation patterns, and code execution loops for iterative problem solving. * API and integration experience across REST, event\-driven, and MCP patterns preferred, including integrating AI into systems of record and workflow platforms. **Other Requirements:** * Ability to occasionally work outside normal business hours to meet project deadlines as needed. * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. Req Benefits: The compensation for this position will vary depending on factors such as your location, skills and experience. The compensation package may also include incentive and bonus opportunities. Through solutions including automatic rollover services, health savings accounts, emergency savings, and custody services, Inspira is focused on delivering better outcomes for all. Learn more at inspirafinancial.com. Our values shape how we show up every day. We **Lead with Heart** by acting with compassion, empathy, and doing what's right; **Cultivate Trust** through integrity, transparency, and accountability; **Aim Higher** by never settling for what's expected and continually raising the standard; and **Win Together** by collaborating inclusively to achieve the best outcomes. jobs.description: * Sunnyvale, CA, United States * Not Remote * Engineering * JOB211540 ### **Company Description** At Intuitive, we are united behind our mission: we believe that minimally invasive care is life\-enhancing care. Through ingenuity and intelligent technology, we expand the potential of physicians to heal without constraints. As a pioneer and market leader in robotic\-assisted surgery, we strive to foster an inclusive and diverse team, committed to making a difference. For more than 25 years, we have worked with hospitals and care teams around the world to help solve some of healthcare's hardest challenges and advance what is possible. Intuitive has been built by the efforts of great people from diverse backgrounds. We believe great ideas can come from anywhere. We strive to foster an inclusive culture built around diversity of thought and mutual respect. We lead with inclusion and empower our team members to do their best work as their most authentic selves. Passionate people who want to make a difference drive our culture. Our team members are grounded in integrity, have a strong capacity to learn, the energy to get things done, and bring diverse, real world experiences to help us think in new ways. We actively invest in our team members to support their long\-term growth so they can continue to advance our mission and achieve their highest potential. Join a team committed to taking big leaps forward for a global community of healthcare professionals and their patients. Together, let's advance the world of minimally invasive care. ### **Job Description** As an Embedded Software Engineer in the Future Forward organization, you will work at the forefront of innovation, rapid prototyping, and new product development. You’ll collaborate with talented cross\-functional teams—including engineers, clinicians, and product managers—to advance Intuitive’s robotic surgical platform, driving the entire product lifecycle from concept to launch. In this role, you will design, develop, and integrate embedded and platform software across a complex robotic system, interfacing with hardware, firmware, control algorithms, vision pipelines, user interfaces, and test infrastructure, including fault\-injection and diagnostic frameworks. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Position Title: *Data Engineer* **This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. now and in the future without sponsorship.** **Reporting Structure:** ======================== This position will be part of the Data Engineering group, reporting to the Director of Data Engineering. **About the role** John Burns Research and Consulting (JBREC) is a housing research and consulting firm. Builders, investors, and lenders use our data to make decisions about where and what to build. That data has to be right, consistent, and explainable. We are hiring a Data Engineer to help build our governed analytics layer in dbt. You will turn legacy SQL Server logic into tested, documented dbt models. You will also implement the metrics behind our client data feeds, dashboards, reports, and AI\-assisted analytics tools, and recommend how they should be structured. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role. Most of your time will go to data modeling and metric implementation. The rest will go to keeping our newer pipelines reliable. **What you'll do:** **Build the governed model layer (about 50%)** * Build and maintain dbt models across staging, intermediate, and mart layers, following team conventions for naming, grain, and documentation. * Migrate legacy SQL Server and T\-SQL logic into dbt. Reconcile new outputs against existing ones before cutover so client\-facing numbers don't move unexpectedly. * Write tests and data contracts that catch problems before clients or analysts do. * Document every model so its meaning, source, and owner are clear to anyone who reads it. **Implement metrics in the semantic layer (about 25%)** * Partner with research and data science to turn agreed business definitions into precise, testable implementations with explicit grain, dimensions, and calculation logic. * Recommend how metrics should be structured and implemented, and flag inconsistencies or ambiguities in existing definitions. * Maintain metrics in our semantic layer as the single source for client data feeds, dashboards, PDF reports, and natural\-language analytics tools. * Help retire legacy reporting by moving its metrics onto the governed layer one at a time. **Keep our newer pipelines reliable (about 25%)** * Build and maintain ingestion pipelines on our modern stack for third\-party vendor data and public data such as Census releases. * Own day\-to\-day reliability for those pipelines: monitoring, alerting, triage, and runbooks that let anyone on the team resolve issues. **Throughout** * Work in Git with code review and CI. Review teammates' code and expect yours to be reviewed. * Use AI coding tools effectively within our review and governance standards. **What you bring** * 3\+ years in data engineering or analytics engineering, including at least 2 years building production dbt projects. * Strong SQL and dimensional modeling. You can explain why a model has the grain it has and what breaks if it changes. * Hands\-on experience with dbt testing, documentation, and project structure at scale (dozens to hundreds of models). * Experience migrating legacy SQL (stored procedures, views, T\-SQL) into a modern transformation layer, including validating that outputs match. * Working Python for ingestion, automation, and tooling. * Comfort with Git\-based workflows: branches, pull requests, code review, CI. * Clear writing. You document your work so others can use it without asking you. **Nice to have** * Experience with a semantic layer or metric framework (dbt Semantic Layer/MetricFlow, Cube, LookML, or similar). * Experience supporting natural\-language or AI\-assisted analytics, where metric definitions must be unambiguous. * Familiarity with Azure data services and SQL Server. * Experience with housing, real estate, economic, or Census data (ACS, PUMS, building permits). **How we work** You'll join the Data Engineering team within JBREC's technology organization, which also includes Software Engineering, Data Science, and IT. We treat governance as code: definitions, tests, and documentation live in the repository and go through review, rather than in separate catalog tools. You'll work closely with our research team, who are the experts on what the numbers mean. **Each full\-time employee receives:** * $12,500 towards our comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, prescription drug coverage, and flexible spending accounts including gym memberships and vacation assistance. * Company contributes 5% of their salary and profit sharing to their 401(k), even if they do not contribute. * 30 days of Paid Time Off including 3 weeks of personal time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays, and 5 paid days for our Winter Break when the company shuts down to rejuvenate. Compensation and title will be based on skills, experience, and abilities, which can vary by person. **We cannot hire anyone who requires sponsorship to work in the United States.** Disclaimer: Nothing in this job description restricts the company’s right to assign responsibilities to this job at any time as critical features of this job are subject to change at any time.

Team focus will shift over time as priorities change, so we're looking for someone who enjoys learning new parts of a system as much as going deep on one. You'll work across our technology stack: Typescript, React, PHP, Kotlin, and more – ship features end to end, and help the team make sound technical decisions as we modernize the platform. WHAT YOU'LL DO * Build complete features independently, from request handling and business logic through data persistence. * Design and build well\-structured REST APIs with clear resource models, consistent error handling, input validation, and documentation other teams can integrate against. * Write efficient SQL, manage schema migrations safely, and use transactions and Redis caching where they fit. * Apply secure design patterns as a matter of course, especially authentication, authorization, and input validation, which are central to identity work. * Author technical designs for features and moderately complex work, covering integration points, testing, observability, and deployment. * Instrument your code with structured logging and meaningful metrics, and design for failure when a dependency is slow or unavailable. * Investigate and resolve bugs and production issues independently, finding root cause rather than patching symptoms. * Write unit tests that cover edge cases and failure paths, and add coverage to existing code as you work in it. * Review teammates' pull requests promptly and give feedback that improves the code. * Work within our CI/CD pipelines and containerized environments, and troubleshoot build and deployment issues when they come up. We encourage the use of AI coding assistants and agents throughout your day\-to\-day work. You will stay accountable for everything you ship, so you must review, test, and understand what a tool produces. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR What you bring * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with most of it on the back end. * Hands\-on experience full\-stack experience in application development. You don't need to know our exact stack, but you need to have shipped code to production. * Working experience with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or similar): writing joins and aggregations, reasoning about query performance, and making schema changes. * Experience building or consuming REST APIs, including HTTP methods, status codes, and error handling. * A habit of writing unit tests and debugging systematically. * Familiarity with Git, pull\-request\-based code review, and CI/CD workflows. * Clear written and verbal communication. You raise blockers early, ask good questions in planning, and follow through on commitments. * Curiosity and adaptability. You pick up new languages, codebases, and domains quickly, and you're comfortable when team priorities change. Nice to have * Production experience with PHP and/or Kotlin (or another JVM language), TypeScript, React, React Native, Node * Experience with identity and access management: OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, enterprise SSO, or role\-based authorization. * Experience working in a large, long\-lived codebase while new services are carved out of a monolith. * Exposure to messaging and asynchronous patterns (queues, pub/sub, event\-driven workflows). * Experience with Redis or other caching layers, including cache invalidation trade\-offs. * Experience with Docker, cloud infrastructure, or infrastructure\-as\-code such as Terraform. * Experience with observability tooling: structured logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting. * Experience building integrations with external partner systems, or working in B2B SaaS. How you work * You own outcomes. You break work into small increments, ship working software often, and adjust when priorities change. * You communicate proactively. You share progress, blockers, and timeline risks without being asked, and you give reasonable estimates. * You collaborate across functions. You work well with product, QA, support, and other engineering teams, and you listen before you respond. * You connect your work to the bigger picture. You understand why the team is building what it's building and bring observations from your work back to the practice. * You're open\-minded and eager to grow. You take feedback well, seek out unfamiliar parts of the system, and help raise the bar for the team. WHAT MAKES KIPSU DIFFERENT * We’re a solid, stable company, and we enthusiastically embrace our founding startup spirit– everyone pitching in and working to the same goals. * Our culture– We have a team of highly motivated colleagues who are all in it together. We all succeed as one, and we all learn from our mistakes holding our interdependence in high regard. * Our unique philosophy– we bootstrapped this company ourselves and are in it for the long\-term. There is a distinct sense of purpose and ownership at Kipsu as we do things on our own terms. * Remarkable growth– with nearly a decade of advancement, we continue to accelerate. It’s an exciting time to be here. WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT HERE * Unity– Everyone here is committed to the same mission. Our core values are not platitudes but our pact. We believe in the best in each other while always reaching to be better. * Transparency– Our leadership gets into the details. We all gather for weekly space to discover how each team is doing so that we have a full understanding of the business and think like a CEO. * Trust– Our team members are given the trust and license to excel at their jobs, and are supported along the way to continuously grow. * Mentorship \- We all have more to learn and something to teach. The lessons are beyond technical. We celebrate our busy hive of shared growth. * Respect– Our success and future as an industry leader depend on actionable commitment to cultivating a diverse and equitable team. Everyone here has a voice that is heard and respected. We seek open and honest conversation on our journey to be active stewards of our shared communities. * Purpose– Everyone here is closely connected to the result of their work. Every day our team gets to see the impact of what they do enhancing the value of our customers’ work in their own professions. Our goals are explicitly tethered to our mission of building relationships. We are proud to offer a competitive suite of benefits including: health insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, 401K with a company match, unlimited/responsible vacation time, life insurance, flex spending account, and commuter benefits. The pay range for this role is $80,000\-$90,000/year depending on experience. One last thing – At Kipsu, we believe that our values, success, and future as a leader in our industry require a vibrant and diverse workforce. This is one of the many challenges we seek to solve, and we are intentional and active in recruiting talent of all identities and building an environment that is inclusive of all backgrounds. We need your contribution to our team. Please consider rolling up your sleeves and joining us on our journey.

As an IT Business Intelligence Data Modeler Engineer Senior I, you’ll play a critical role in shaping how data is structured, accessed, and for enterprise business intelligence. scalable data structures and solutions. * **ETL Development Support:** Contribute to the design of Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) processes to ensure efficient data movement into Business Intelligence (BI) platforms and warehouses. * **Data Quality \& Validation:** Implement checks and rules to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across systems. * **Performance Optimization:** flows while adhering to data governance standards. * **Data Security:** Help design access controls and security measures to protect sensitive data. * **Advanced Querying:** Develop and utilize Structured Query Language (SQL) queries for ad hoc analysis, troubleshooting, and data validation. * **Agile Collaboration:** Participate in Agile workflows across analysis, development, quality jobs.title: Manufacturing Test Engineer, Embedded Software
jobs.description: **About Knightscope** Knightscope (NASDAQ: KSCP) is a security technology company building the nation's first Autonomous Security Force — autonomous machines, AI\-driven software, and elite security professionals operating as one integrated managed service. The Company is on a mission to make the United States of America the safest country in the world. One Team. One Force. **The Role** We are looking for a hands\-on engineer to write the software that tests, calibrates, and releases every K7 vehicle that comes off our production line. This is primarily a software development role: you will design and write the test framework, station software, and embedded interfaces yourself, rather than configuring or maintaining an off\-the\-shelf test system. The software will talk directly to K7 embedded hardware: controllers, sensors, and onboard compute. It will verify each subsystem, calibrate sensors, load and check firmware and software images, and enforce the factory gates that keep a unit from shipping until it passes. **Location \- Sunnyvale, CA \- Onsite** **Starting Point** You will build the K7 end\-of\-line test software from the ground up: defining what gets tested and how, learning the hardware and firmware in detail, and designing the framework and station software yourself. You will work closely with hardware, firmware, autonomy, and manufacturing teams, and with the technicians who run the stations. We use modern tools, including AI assistants, as part of everyday development. **What You Will Do** * **Develop the test software:** Design and write the EOL test framework and station software from the ground up, including test sequencing, hardware drivers, logging, and pass/fail limits. * **Work with embedded systems:** Communicate with vehicle controllers and onboard compute over standard interfaces (e.g., CAN, Ethernet, serial); write low\-level tools and utilities to exercise and verify embedded hardware and firmware. * **Build factory software gates:** Flash firmware and software images, verify versions and configuration, and enforce pass/fail criteria so every unit is released in a known, approved state. * **Develop sensor calibration:** Implement calibration routines for vehicle sensors such as cameras, LiDAR, and IMUs, including target setup, algorithms, and acceptance limits. * **Create traceability:** Log serial numbers, calibration data, and test results to a central database, and build reports on yield, failure modes, and station performance. * **Build operator tools:** Create simple, reliable station interfaces that production technicians can run with minimal training. * **Support the line:** Debug test failures on the floor down to the hardware, firmware, or software level, and work with the owning teams on root cause. * **Maintain the codebase:** Use version control, code review, and automated testing; write test specifications and work instructions. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Electrical, Robotics, or Controls Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of software development for hardware test, manufacturing test, or embedded systems on vehicles, robots, or complex electromechanical products. * Track record of designing and writing test software or tooling from scratch, not only maintaining existing systems. * Strong Python for test automation and tooling; solid C or C\+\+ for embedded and hardware\-facing code. * Hands\-on embedded experience: microcontrollers and/or embedded Linux, firmware flashing and bootloaders, and debugging with tools such as JTAG/SWD debuggers, logic analyzers, and oscilloscopes. * Working knowledge of hardware interfaces and protocols such as CAN/CAN\-FD, Ethernet, USB, UART, SPI, and I2C. * Experience controlling test instruments programmatically (e.g., via SCPI). * Ability to read electrical schematics and wiring diagrams. * Software engineering fundamentals: Git, code review, and automated testing. * Effective, everyday use of AI assistants (e.g., Claude) for coding, debugging, and research: writes clear, well\-scoped prompts, breaks problems into steps, and critically checks AI output before it reaches production or hardware. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience calibrating cameras, LiDAR, IMUs, or other sensors in a production environment. * Experience with automotive diagnostics (UDS, OBD) and end\-of\-line flashing. * Experience with RTOS\-based firmware or Linux device drivers. * Background in autonomous vehicles, mobile robotics, EVs, or automotive Tier\-1 suppliers. * Experience with ROS/ROS 2, test frameworks (e.g., pytest, OpenHTF), MES, or test databases. **What Success Looks Like** * **Test coverage:** Automated EOL tests and software release gates that the production team relies on for every unit. * **Calibration and traceability:** reliable sensor calibration, with every unit traceable by serial number to its test and calibration records. * **Continuous improvement:** A documented, measurable EOL process with tracked yield and cycle time, and a clear feedback loop into engineering. **Compensation and Benefits** * **Base Salary:** $150,000 \- $185,000 * **Equity:** Stock options * **Benefits:** Medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off * **Location Requirement:** Full\-time, on\-site at Sunnyvale HQ
