jobs.title: Plant Engineer
jobs.description: Kymera International \- Specialty Materials that Shape the Future Plant Engineer **Reports to:** Engineering Manager **Work Location:** RTP Site \- Durham, North Carolina **FLSA Status:** Exempt Position Summary The Plant Engineer provides technical leadership for the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of a copper powder manufacturing facility. The role supports process improvement, equipment reliability, capital projects, utilities, facilities, and technical problem solving across the plant. This position partners with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, EHS, Purchasing, and external contractors to improve safety, capacity, product consistency, energy use, equipment performance, and long\-term asset condition. Essential Duties and Responsibilities * Provide engineering support for copper powder production equipment, furnaces, dryers, screening systems, mills, material handling systems, dust collection, utilities, packaging equipment, and facility infrastructure. * Lead or support capital projects from concept through scope development, budgeting, design, procurement, installation, commissioning, startup, and project closeout. * Develop technical specifications, equipment requirements, drawings, bid packages, project schedules, cost estimates, and contractor scopes of work. * Analyze equipment, process, quality, and maintenance data to identify constraints, recurring failures, energy losses, and improvement opportunities. * Lead root\-cause investigations for equipment failures, process interruptions, quality deviations, and safety\-related events; develop and verify corrective actions. * Support process optimization and equipment upgrades that improve throughput, yield, product consistency, maintainability, reliability, and operating cost. * Review and approve engineering drawings, equipment layouts, P\&IDs, electrical documentation, calculations, manuals, and vendor submittals within assigned responsibility. * Ensure engineering changes follow approved management\-of\-change, risk assessment, documentation, testing, training, and startup requirements. * Partner with EHS to incorporate machine safety, combustible\-dust controls, ventilation, guarding, electrical safety, environmental requirements, and other regulatory considerations into projects and modifications. * Support preventive and predictive maintenance strategies, equipment criticality reviews, spare parts recommendations, and improvement of maintenance job plans. * Coordinate contractors, consultants, vendors, and equipment manufacturers; monitor safety,quality, schedule, cost, and technical performance. * Support plant shutdown planning and execution, equipment installations, commissioning, acceptance testing, and post\-startup performance review. * Maintain accurate project files, equipment documentation, drawings, specifications, calculations, permits, and change history. * Prepare project justifications, status reports, risk updates, and technical recommendations for plant leadership. * Provide technical guidance and training to operations and maintenance personnel on new or modified equipment and processes. * Perform other duties and support site priorities as assigned. * This position does not have direct supervisory responsibilities unless specifically assigned. The role may lead project teams and provide technical direction to employees, contractors, consultants, and equipment suppliers. Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Manufacturing, Industrial, or a related engineering discipline required. * Three or more years of engineering experience in manufacturing, process industries, capital projects, reliability, or plant operations. * Experience supporting industrial equipment, controls, utilities, facilities, and production processes. * Experience developing project scopes, specifications, cost estimates, schedules, and contractor bid packages. * Ability to read and interpret equipment drawings, P\&IDs, electrical schematics, layouts, technical specifications, and vendor documentation. * Experience in metal powder, chemical, metallurgical, aerospace, food, pharmaceutical, or other process manufacturing is preferred. * Working knowledge of project management, root\-cause analysis, management of change, and equipment commissioning. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office and engineering, drawing, project\-management, or data\-analysis tools relevant to the work. * Professional Engineer licensure, project\-management certification, or Lean/Six Sigma training is preferred but not required. * Ability to work on\-site at the RTP facility in Durham, North Carolina and provide schedule flexibility based on project and plant needs. Skills and Competencies * Strong engineering judgment and practical problem\-solving skills in an operating manufacturing environment. * Ability to translate operational needs into clear technical scopes, designs, specifications, and implementation plans. * Knowledge of industrial equipment, process systems, utilities, instrumentation, controls, and facility infrastructure. * Project\-management skills with attention to safety, scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, and documentation. * Analytical skills for interpreting process, maintenance, quality, and equipment\-performance data. * Strong written and verbal communication with operators, technicians, leaders, contractors, vendors, and technical professionals. * Ability to lead cross\-functional problem solving and influence decisions without direct supervisory authority. * High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects and plant priorities. * Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across departments and sites. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are** At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission\-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities. **The Role** Your role The Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) is a delivery\-first role for early career engineers who want to work where AI systems meet real enterprise complexity. As an FDE, you will embed directly with customer delivery teams to help build, prototype, and deploy AI\-enabled solutions in production environments. This is not a traditional software engineering role and not classic consulting. It is a hybrid role designed for real\-world AI deployment, where success is measured by outcomes and production scaled solutions, not experiments. You will deliver defined technical components under guidance from senior engineers, while developing consulting fundamentals through direct customer exposure. You will work with modern AI development tools, generative and agentic AI architectures, and enterprise cloud platforms, learning how to translate technical work into customer value. What you will do * Customer Engagement \& Solution Integrity: Partner with customers to understand business challenges and translate them into high‑quality, fit‑for‑purpose technical solutions, prioritising the right outcome over the fastest one * Rapid Prototyping: Build and iterate custom AI solutions tailored to customer needs, leveraging agentic AI frameworks * Ownership, Deployment \& Partnership: Own delivery end to end, from scoping to production. Work as part of the customer team to engineer and deploy production‑ready solutions that drive adoption and measurable business outcomes. * Optimization: Troubleshoot and enhance system performance, scalability, and reliability * Field Intelligence: Systematically capture deployment learnings, document best practices, and proactively share insights to inform enhancements to Kyndryl’s core platforms and frameworks * Continuous Learning: Adapt quickly to emerging technologies and evolving customer requirements by engaging in ongoing professional development * Platform Contribution: Actively contribute to the evolution of Kyndryl’s AI platforms through feedback, code contributions, and collaboration with product teams Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID\-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of vaccination to align with their respective COVID\-19 vaccination policies. Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment. **Who You Are** Required skills and experience * Programming Proficiency: Demonstrable expertise in Python, (or another modern language such as C\#, Node.js or TypeScript); experience working with AI/ML frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch is a plus * Software Engineering: Solid grasp of the software delivery lifecycle, version control (Git \& GitHub), and data engineering tools such as Pandas and Spark * Cloud \& Distributed Systems: Experience with cloud AI platforms (AWS, Azure, Google AI) and distributed computing architectures Preferred skills and experience * Open\-Source Ecosystems: Familiarity with community\-driven AI tools and libraries, including Hugging Face and relevant repositories * T\-shaped Profile: Deep technical expertise in one or two domains, with broad understanding across AI/ML, cloud, and consulting * Agentic AI Systems: Experience designing, building, or integrating multi\-agent systems and orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, Agent Framework, AutoGen, CrewAI), including the development of agent protocols and coordination mechanisms * Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) \& Knowledge Systems: Practical knowledge of deploying RAG architectures and integrating structured and unstructured knowledge sources into AI solutions * Performance \& Security: Knowledge of system\-level optimisation and security best practices for scalable AI systems * Business Acumen: Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and communicate technical value to diverse stakeholders, including executive audiences * Flexibility: Willingness to travel and work on customer premises as required * Education: Degree\-level qualification in Computer Science, Informatics, Data Science, Engineering, or a closely related discipline \- or equivalent professional experience **Based in the Dallas\-Fort Worth metroplex (or ready to relocate immediately) with a hybrid schedule of 3 days onsite per week at the Frisco, TX** The compensation range for the position in the U.S. is $73,440 to $139,680 based on a full\-time schedule. Your actual compensation may vary depending on your geography, job\-related skills and experience. For part time roles, the compensation will be adjusted appropriately. The pay or salary range will not be below any applicable state, city or local minimum wage requirement. There is a different applicable compensation range for the following work locations: California (San Francisco Bay Area): $88,080 to $167,520 California (All Other): $80,760 to $153,600 Colorado: $73,440 to $139,680 Massachusetts: $73,440 to $153,600 New York City: $88,080 to $167,520 Washington: $80,760 to $153,600 Washington DC: $80,760 to $153,600 This position will be eligible for Kyndryl’s discretionary annual bonus program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Kyndryl’s applicable plans. You may also receive a comprehensive benefits package which includes medical and dental coverage, disability, retirement benefits, paid leave, and paid time off. Note: If this is a sales commission eligible role, you will be eligible to participate in a sales commission plan in lieu of the annual discretionary bonus program. Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis. Equal Opportunity Employer All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. **Being You** Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single\-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way. **What You Can Expect** With state\-of\-the\-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well\-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company\-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non\-profit organizations. At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed. **Get Referred!** If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description: **About Latent** ---------------- Latent is the enterprise pharmacy intelligence platform, powered by a clinical agentic engine, that enables health systems to grow their pharmacy operations and serve more patients. One engine works across the pharmacy journey to identify patients who qualify for care, improve medication access, capture eligible prescriptions and support patients throughout treatment. Latent’s platform enables more than 60 leading health systems that collectively serve an estimated 70 million people. Founded by Sriram “Sri” Somasundaram and Rishabh Jain, Latent has raised $80 million from Transformation Capital, Spark Capital, Conviction, General Catalyst, Y Combinator, and others. **The Role** ------------ We’re building the intelligence layer of American healthcare. Our systems sit directly in critical workflows and power how clinical AI is delivered and used in practice. You’ll be working on securing all aspects of Latent’s code, cloud, AI, and IT systems. You will be partnering with all Latent employees across engineering, product, legal, and GTM to safely enable Latent employees to move quickly without sacrificing security and compliance. **What You'll Do** ------------------ You’ll be a Security generalist, helping define, lead, and execute the roadmap in all aspects of Security. Here are some of the areas you will work in: * **Cloud Security** Mature and harden Latent’s cloud environment from a security and compliance standpoint into a secure\-by\-default stance so developers can ship code with confidence and the Infrastructure team doesn’t have to worry that their next Terraform apply will put everything on the open internet. * **AI Security** Employees at Latent use a lot of AI. Help us give all of our employees access to the latest and greatest AI\-powered tools in a secure and compliant way so our agents don’t run amok and do the wrong thing. * **Data Security** Latent’s business thrives on giving our users deep insights into their patient data, their pharmacy performance, and how our AI is performing. Help us secure our data warehouse so that our internal employees and customers get the insight they need without sacrificing our commitment to patient security and privacy. * **Application and Product Security** Latent’s developers ship a lot of code. Help us come up with ways to automate all aspects of the SDLC from a security perspective to ensure security is built in instead of being a bolt\-on afterwards. In addition, as Latent plans the next iteration of its application and agentic platform, help us come up with the right security requirements for new product features and enhancements. * **IT Security** Help our hard\-working IT folks secure Latent employee devices and applications. Automate security around IT and business applications including user lifecycle provisioning, just\-in\-time access, elevated access provisioning, and device hardening to ensure employees can do their job securely without thinking about security. * **Incident Detection and Response** Help the Security team investigate potential incidents, build detections that are specific to Latent’s environment, and work with our AI\-native MDR service to improve accuracy around escalated incidents. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- You’re a builder who holds yourself and others to high standards. You can design, develop, and create security automations and workflows using AI that can scale Latent’s security team. * **Ownership**: You don’t hand off problems or wait for someone to tell you what to do. Find our gaps, risks, and vulnerabilities and implement the solution. * **Bias for Action**: You won’t wait for someone else to solve a problem you’re in a position to solve. * **A Yes Mindset:** Latent’s Security team is not a no factory. While we put our foot down when the risk is high, our goal is to find creative solutions that 1\) Understand what an employee actually needs and 2\) That balances speed and security. * **Automation Mindset**: You’re always looking for ways to move faster by automating repetitive or manual work. * **Complexity Management**: You’re good at planning and building the simplest solution that gets the job done, with an eye towards the future as Latent scales quickly. You can take a complex and large product and break it down into focused, iterative steps that incrementally make our security and compliance posture better. * **Product Focus**: You’re comfortable working closely with the customers that use Latent’s security program: Latent’s employees! You love sitting alongside folks from all areas of the company, understanding their day to day, and crafting the perfect solution for them both now and in the future. **Technical Qualifications** ---------------------------- We really are looking for a little bit of a unicorn and someone who has done it all when it comes to security. If you’ve worked in multiple of these areas, this is the place for you! * You aren’t afraid to use coding agents to contribute solutions directly to the code base! (You don’t have to be a coding wizard Harry, but you do need to understand basic engineering principles to give your coding agent positive feedback if it spits out the wrong solution) * You’ve built out IAM workflows (Okta, SSO, SAML, JIT provisioning) to give employees just the right amount of access to get their job done * You’ve designed and rolled out managed settings for AI tools and coding agents to make sure employees have a good sandbox to work in to get their jobs done with AI * You have collaborated with developers to help them write secure code and secure features. * You’ve helped harden AWS cloud and CI/CD environments (Think well\-scoped IAM roles, hardening cloud environments to CIS standards, picking the right CSPM and driving down a findings backlog ect..) * You’ve helped build and maintain a vulnerability management program all the way up the stack (Server/Container/3rd Party OSS/Custom Code) * You’ve automated security and compliance requirements for MacOS and BYOD endpoints using an MDM * You understand your way around a security alert, security investigation, and can write and tune detections that are relevant to Latent’s environment **Nice to Have** ---------------- * You have experience working at an early stage startup doing security * You’ve worked with healthcare data before and can speak a little HIPAA * You’ve participated in or built controls for SOC2 audits **Why Join Latent** ------------------- * Backed by top\-tier investors including General Catalyst, Conviction, and Y Combinator * Work alongside a high\-caliber team building products our healthcare partners love * Work on mission\-critical problems at the intersection of AI and healthcare * Real ownership and visibility * High\-impact role on a small, fast\-growing team **Benefits** ------------ * Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity * Medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents * Flexible PTO policy * Paid parental leave * Fertility and family\-building stipend through Carrot Compensation Range: $200K \- $240K

jobs.title: Senior Agentic AI Engineer / AI R&D Lead
jobs.description: About Leading Edge Skills Leading Edge Skills LLC (LES) is an established California\-based organization and federal contractor delivering **leadership development, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, data analytics, technology training, and consulting** to defense agencies, civilian government organizations, and commercial clients. Our federal portfolio includes multi\-year programs with the **U.S. Navy's NAVSEA/NSWCDD, NAVSUP/Navy Supply Corps School, Naval Surface Warfare Center Port Hueneme Division, and the U.S. Army**. These engagements encompass leadership and advanced management development, AI and emerging technology applications, mission\- and capability\-based test and evaluation, digital engineering, modeling and simulation, cybersecurity education, and professional workforce development. LES has delivered **60\+ leadership development cohorts** under an ongoing Navy program. Our defense program footprint extends across **Dahlgren, Virginia Beach, Newport, Port Hueneme, and the San Diego region**, supporting scientists, engineers, military personnel, technical professionals, and senior leaders. Our broader experience includes cybersecurity workforce development for the California Department of Rehabilitation. **Our next strategic direction is technology research and development.** Building on our established defense contracting experience, LES is developing capabilities in applied AI, autonomous systems, cybersecurity innovation, intelligent decision\-support, and advanced simulation. We intend to pursue long\-term R\&D, SBIR/STTR, prototype development, and technology commercialization opportunities with DoD agencies and other federal organizations. We seek technically accomplished innovators who can bring original ideas, demonstrated engineering expertise, and a commitment to developing practical technologies that address defense mission challenges. Position Overview LES is seeking an accomplished **Senior Agentic AI Engineer / AI R\&D Lead** to help conceptualize, architect, develop, and validate innovative AI technologies for defense and government applications. We are particularly interested in engineers, researchers, and technical innovators who have personally designed and built functional AI systems, including agentic AI platforms, multi\-agent applications, intelligent decision\-support tools, autonomous workflows, and advanced analytical solutions. The successful candidate will contribute to emerging technology research, technical feasibility assessments, software architecture, prototype development, and selected federal R\&D pursuits. This is a hands\-on technical position for someone capable of **personally engineering and demonstrating technology**, not simply advising on AI adoption or delivering instructional programs. We value candidates with an entrepreneurial mindset who can recognize emerging technological opportunities and help transform promising ideas into defensible research concepts and commercially viable products. Key ResponsibilitiesAI Engineering and Prototype Development * Design, develop, and validate sophisticated agentic AI systems and LLM\-powered applications. * Engineer autonomous and human\-supervised AI agents that perform complex analytical tasks and support operational decision\-making. * Build multi\-agent workflows involving planning, reasoning, orchestration, information retrieval, and external tool integration. * Develop functional software prototypes using Python, AI frameworks, APIs, and contemporary development practices. * Implement retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), structured data pipelines, knowledge representations, and vector databases where appropriate. * Integrate AI components with secure backend systems, databases, cloud environments, and enterprise applications. * Develop systems incorporating explainability, audit trails, human oversight, and reliable outputs. * Personally test, troubleshoot, optimize, and demonstrate engineered solutions. Applied AI Research and Innovation * Identify innovative technical approaches to complex defense and government challenges. * Evaluate existing technologies and determine opportunities for meaningful technical advancement. * Formulate research hypotheses, feasibility experiments, and measurable technical objectives. * Investigate emerging capabilities involving agentic AI, multimodal systems, advanced reasoning, optimization, and AI evaluation. * Develop methods for assessing accuracy, reliability, robustness, scalability, transparency, and uncertainty. * Produce technical research findings, experimental evidence, feasibility reports, and documented demonstrations. * Contribute original ideas capable of supporting future technology development and intellectual property. Defense R\&D and SBIR/STTR Initiatives * Evaluate DoD technology requirements and determine whether innovative AI solutions are technically feasible. * Collaborate with LES leadership, systems engineers, defense SMEs, and other t nd technical documentation. * Ability to develop a proof of concept independently or lead a small technical development team. * Strong analytical thinking, independent problem\-solving, and technical communication skills. Cyber Simulation, Digital Twins, and Test Environments * Architect and develop cybersecurity simulation platforms, virtual cyber ranges, and experimental testbeds. * Build realistic, isolated environments fo arch on advanced persistent threats, cyber resilience, and mission assurance. * Experience working with military, defense, aerospace, or mission\-critical cybersecurity systems. * Familiarity with digital engineering, mission\-based test and evaluation, and systems\-oriented technical research. * Prior involvement in SBIR/STTR, DARPA, DoD R\&D programs, or prototype development initiatives. * Research publications, patents, public code contributions, technical demonstrations, or commercially developed cybersecurity products. * Experience as a cybersecurity product developer, startup founder, principal engineer, or technical R\&D lead. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States. LendingTree and its affiliates ("LendingTree") will not provide or assume sponsorship for employment visas for this position, now or in the future.** **The Opportunity** As a Data Engineer at LendingTree, you'll build the pipelines, models, and data services behind reporting, analytics, and data science across our lending and insurance businesses. You'll tackle complex integration and modeling challenges, improve reliability and cost efficiency, and apply practical AI tools to help the team deliver better data solutions faster. **How You'll Make an Impact** * Build and operate scalable batch and real\-time streaming pipelines, ETL/ELT workflows, and database applications across multiple lines of business, with clear plans for schema changes, retries, and recovery. * Design dimensional models and reusable datasets for business, analytics, and data science needs. Perform complex data analysis to validate business rules, identify trends and anomalies, and uncover opportunities. * Own the reliability and efficiency of your data solutions: automate quality checks, monitor freshness, tune performance and compute costs, and participate in the on\-call rotation to resolve incidents and prevent recurrence. * Create reusable frameworks and development patterns that improve delivery speed and consistency. Apply automated testing, code review, and repeatable deployments; maintain technical standards, runbooks, and learning materials. * Partner with business users and engineering teams to clarify requirements, resolve issues, and contribute to the data engineering roadmap, including platform capabilities, priorities, technical trade\-offs, and delivery estimates. * Apply AI tools to development, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting. Validate generated code and results, protect sensitive data, and assess whether these tools improve quality and reduce delivery time. **Who You'll Work With** You'll join the Data Engineering team, working with your manager, fellow engineers, and partners in analytics, data science, product, and business operations across Lending and Insurance. You'll also collaborate with platform and infrastructure teams to manage dependencies, support production services, and turn business priorities into practical data solutions. **What You'll Bring** * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in data engineering, including data warehousing, ETL/ELT development, and analytics, with a record of delivering and supporting production solutions. * Advanced SQL skills, including writing, tuning, and debugging complex queries and using data analysis to investigate problems. * Experience designing data lakes and warehouses on scalable, distributed platforms, with an understanding of batch and streaming integration patterns. * Strong dimensional modeling skills and sound data warehousing practices, including defining grain, fact and dimension tables, and how historical changes are represented. * Ability to deliver projects with minimal guidance in an Agile team, using testing, version control, documentation, and systematic troubleshooting to build maintainable solutions. * Clear written, verbal, and data presentation skills, including the ability to understand business needs and explain findings and technical decisions through documentation, presentations, or dashboards. **What Will Help You Thrive** You're curious about the business behind the data, learn new tools thoughtfully, communicate issues early, and share both credit and lessons learned. Experience in any of the following is a plus: * Snowflake virtual warehouses, performance and cost tuning, Streams and Tasks, and/or SQL Server. * Matillion, dbt, or similar tools for data integration and transformation. * Python, C\#, or PowerShell for integration and automation; Git/GitLab for collaboration and CI/CD workflows. * Power BI, Tableau, or Streamlit for dashboards, data applications, and communicating insights. * using AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or Maia to accelerate coding, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting while validating generated code and results. * S. in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **What Success Looks Like** * Production pipelines meet agreed freshness and reliability targets, with clear monitoring, ownership, and recovery procedures. * Business, analytics, and data science partners use tested models with consistent definitions and less manual reconciliation. * Query tuning and pipeline improvements produce measurable reductions in runtime, compute cost, or recurring incidents. * Reusable frameworks, useful documentation, and validated AI workflows shorten delivery time while maintaining quality. **Life at LendingTree** We're a collaborative, entrepreneurial team that's curious, creative, and always ready to roll up our sleeves and get things done. You'll work alongside smart, driven people who care about doing great work — and about helping each other succeed. We believe the best ideas come from different perspectives, and we're committed to creating a workplace where people feel welcomed, valued, and empowered to make an impact. You'll have the trust and flexibility to do your best work, the opportunity to take ownership and try new things, and teammates who genuinely enjoy working together. And while we work hard, we don't take ourselves too seriously. We celebrate wins, recognize great work (our **GSD — Get Stuff Done — Award** is a fan favorite), and make time to have some fun along the way. Come grow with us, make an impact, and help us build what's next. **What We Offer** We want you to feel supported at work and beyond. Our benefits and programs are designed to help you stay healthy, recharge, plan for the future, and bring your best to whatever matters most to you. * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) matching * Generous time off * Wellness programs and resources * Annual performance bonus eligibility **Base Pay:** The base pay range for this position is $100,000\-130,000; pay offered may vary based on location, internal factors, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. **Incentive Compensation:** This position is eligible for an annual performance bonus. **Work Authorization:** This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship. Please do not apply for this role if you will need employer sponsorship now or in the future to begin or continue employment. **Everyone Belongs Here** LendingTree is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion (or creed), gender, gender expression, age, national origin, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or military status. If you believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or to submit an application, please email us at humanresources@lendingtree.com. CCPA Disclosure

jobs.title: Product Engineer, AI & Automation
jobs.description: **Position:** Product Engineer, AI \& Automation **Department:** Digital Experience **Role Overview:** The Operational Efficiency team works with departments across the organization to reduce manual effort in daily operations. This role is the team's primary builder. You will take processes that are currently slow, repetitive, or error\-prone and turn them into working automations, applying AI capabilities where they fit the problem. Most of your time will be spent building: writing code, connecting systems, designing and testing agents, and maintaining what you have already shipped. Requirements will reach you as problems rather than finished specifications, so you will work directly with the teams whose processes you are automating to understand how the work is performed before deciding what to build. We are looking for someone with five or more years of experience who has delivered automations that people depend on daily and who has supported them over time. **What you’ll get to do:** *Build* * Design and build automations across operational workflows, including data movement, document handling, reporting, intake and routing, and notifications. * Connect existing systems using REST APIs, webhooks, scheduled jobs, and integration platforms, working within the organization's current technology stack wherever possible. * Build components that use large language models where they are the right tool for the problem, including extraction from unstructured documents, classification, routing, summarization, and drafting. Design the prompts, test them against representative data, and define the accuracy required before launching. * Determine where human review is required, set confidence thresholds that route uncertain cases to staff, and define what happens when the model produces incorrect output. * Handle supporting work with the same care as the build itself, including data validation, idempotency, credential management, environment separation, and documentation sufficient for another engineer to take over. *Define and scope* * Work with department leads to document current\-state processes and identify automation candidates, quantifying the time and cost each process consumes today. * Assess feasibility and recommend alternatives when a process change or a configuration change in an existing system would solve the problem more effectively than a new automation. * Translate operational needs into technical requirements and divide work into phases that deliver value early. * Set clear expectations with stakeholders on accuracy, exception handling, and scope. This matters especially for AI\-assisted steps, where acceptable error rates should be agreed in advance. *Own and maintain* * Own each automation through its full lifecycle, including monitoring, response when upstream systems change, iteration as processes evolve, and retirement once it is no longer needed. * Build in monitoring and alerting so that failures surface quickly instead of going unnoticed. * Maintain documentation and runbooks so that support does not depend on a single person. * Track and report impact, including hours returned, error rates, cycle time, and usage. *Support and enable others* * Train and support staff who want to build simple automations on their own, extending the reach of the team. * Contribute to the team's standards and patterns, including guidelines on what organizational data may be sent to external AI services. **Qualifications** Required * 5\+ years of professional experience building automations, integrations, or internal tools. * Strong Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript skills, with experience writing code that other engineers have maintained. * Substantial experience with REST APIs, authentication patterns, webhooks, and system\-to\-system integration. * Hands\-on experience building with large language models, including prompt design, structured output, and methods for evaluating output quality. * Working knowledge of SQL and experience with inconsistent or incomplete operational data. * Proven ability to work with non\-technical stakeholders, including gathering requirements, managing expectations, and supporting adoption. * Good judgment about which processes are appropriate for candidates for automation, and which are not. *Preferred* * Experience with integration or workflow platforms such as Workato, Make, n8n, Zapier, Power Automate, Airflow, or Temporal. * Experience with document processing, OCR, or extraction from unstructured sources. * Experience in a comparable operational environment where automations touch finance, HR, or customer\-facing workflows. * Familiarity with data governance and access controls in environments that handle sensitive records. **What is Lincoln Center for the Performing Arts?** Lincoln Center for the Performing Arts, Inc. (LCPA) is a cultural and civic cornerstone of New York City. We believe the arts play an important role in our lives: they nourish our hearts and minds, teach us valuable lessons and critical skills, and help us create community. We are resolved not to lose sight of what connects us, and we hope you will consider joining our talented, diverse team. **We are:** 1\. The manager of the 16\-acre Lincoln Center campus * We are one of eleven amazing resident arts organizations 2\. A leading Arts Presenter. * We curate numerous programs and performances, showcasing music, dance, and more 3\. An Education Hub. * We have reached 20 million students, educators, principals, and community members **Who are our people?** LCPA is a team of dreamers, collaborators, and entrepreneurs who use unique platforms in the heart of New York City and beyond to advocate for the transformative impact of artistic experiences. jobs.description: Forward Deployed Engineer Manager \| Senior Level \| Full time Job No. R00363945 \| Multiple Locations **We Are** Accenture Security helps organizations prepare, protect, detect, respond, and recover along with all points of the security lifecycle. Cybersecurity challenges are different for every business in every industry. Leveraging our global resources and advanced technologies, we create integrated, turnkey solutions tailored to our client's needs across their entire value chain. Whether we’re defending against known cyberattacks, detecting and responding to the unknown, or running an entire security operations center, we will help companies build cyber resilience to grow with confidence. Our team of the security sector’s brightest people uses the coolest tech to out\-hack the hackers and help clients build resilience from within. We blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security, and managed service solutions to rethink the entire security lifecycle. Do you have the deep functional and technical experience to help implement security solutions that align with our clients’ business objectives? Do you have the expertise to design and deliver solutions for establishing system user's credentials, and processes for applying those credentials to access enterprise systems and applications? **You Are** This is not a security consulting role. It is not a compliance advisory position. It is not a pen test engagement. A Cybersecurity Forward Deployed Engineer is a production engineer who works embedded inside a client’s enterprise—shoulder to shoulder with their security and engineering teams—to make AI systems secure, governed, and resilient in real, complex organizational environments. You own outcomes: reduced attack surface, production\-safe AI deployments, measurable security posture improvement. Agentic coding is not a supporting skill for this role—it is the primary method of delivery. You use Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot as your standard operating environment. Built to provide a centralized view of risk and compliance, with AI intelligence woven into the platform's core, LogicGate delivers real\-time insights and actionable data to help drive current business decisions, with the flexibility to scale alongside evolving business needs. LogicGate is at the forefront of this industry transformation, empowering enterprise professionals to navigate complex regulatory environments, manage critical uncertainty, and operate with integrity at scale. **Senior Software Engineer: Platform** ====================================== **About the Role** ------------------ As a Senior Software Engineer: Platform, you will design and scale the foundational APIs and backend services powering LogicGate's Risk Cloud platform. As enterprise GRC demands expand, you will tackle critical system bottlenecks, optimize cloud data stores, and ensure high\-availability multi\-tenant reliability. Working in Java/Kotlin, Spring Boot, and AWS, you will solve complex architectural challenges while elevating technical standards across the engineering chapter. In this role, your technical leadership will directly ensure our platform remains scalable, resilient, and performant. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **System \& Data Architecture:** Design and build high\-throughput backend services, core platform APIs, and distributed data stores using Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, Neo4j, Redis, PostgreSQL, and RabbitMQ to expand multi\-tenant Risk Cloud capabilities. * **Quality \& Continuous Delivery:** Write robust unit, integration, and service\-level tests while partnering with DevOps to evolve cloud infrastructure and automated CI/CD pipelines (AWS, Terraform, Docker, GitLab CI). * **Observability \& Optimization:** Monitor operational metrics, tracing, and alerts in Datadog to proactively diagnose system bottlenecks, optimize database query performance, and ensure platform health. * **Cross\-Functional Leadership:** Facilitate technical design reviews, decompose complex epics alongside Product and Design teams, and mentor engineers across squads to elevate code quality and execution. * **AI Workflow Efficiency:** Leverage AI coding assistants, LLMs, and modern developer automation tools to streamline engineering workflows, refactor legacy patterns, and accelerate feature delivery velocity. **What You Bring** ------------------ ### ***Required:*** * **Backend Expertise:** 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience developing enterprise backend systems using Java, Kotlin, or comparable JVM languages with Spring Boot. * **Distributed \& Cloud Systems:** Proven track record of designing, deploying, and maintaining high\-scale distributed systems and RESTful APIs in an AWS cloud\-native environment. * **Data \& Storage Proficiency:** Strong hands\-on experience with relational or non\-relational databases, caching mechanisms, and asynchronous message brokers (e.g., PostgreSQL, Neo4j, Redis, RabbitMQ). * **Testing \& Quality First:** Deep commitment to modern testing practices across the testing pyramid, treating test automation as an essential component of shipping software. * **AI Literacy \& Agentic Tooling:** Demonstrated curiosity and practical experience leveraging modern AI coding tools, LLMs, or AI agents (e.g., custom developer tools, agentic workflows, or automated assistants) to enhance problem\-solving, code quality, and engineering velocity. * **Distributed Work \& Team Engagement**: Thrives in a remote, highly collaborative engineering culture with willingness to attend occasional department onsites and company events. ### ***Nice to Have:*** * **LogicGate Tech Stack:** Direct hands\-on experience with LogicGate's tech stack: Java, Kotlin, Python, Spring Boot, Neo4j, Redis, RabbitMQ, Docker, Terraform, and GitLab CI. * **Architecture Knowledge:** Familiarity with graph database modeling, event\-driven architectures, or multi\-tenant SaaS application design. * **Full\-Stack \& SDLC Leadership:** Brings a holistic perspective to the software development life cycle \- combining deep backend expertise with a desire to work across the stack, optimize CI/CD pipelines, and apply infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC) best practices. Actual salaries may vary and will be based on factors such as the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Internal candidates who have current pay within or above the hiring range are still encouraged to apply if interested. **How We Work** At LogicGate, we empower organizations to transform risk into a strategic advantage. Our culture is built on execution, collaboration, and a shared commitment to excellence. We believe the strongest, most innovative teams are forged by diverse perspectives. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment where differences are celebrated and supported. **Global Total Rewards** We invest in our people with a comprehensive and competitive rewards package designed to support our team members across the US and the UK: * **Compensation \& Equity:** Competitive base salaries, variable compensation plans, and equity options. * **Health \& Wellbeing:** Comprehensive health, wellness, and lifestyle benefits tailored to your region. * **Time Away:** Generous paid time off and annual company holidays so you can recharge and return at your best. * **Growth \& Development:** Continuous career advancement through structured mentorship, leadership training, and premium learning platforms. *Recognized as a top workplace by Built In, Crain's Chicago Business, and the Chicago Tribune.*

jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer
jobs.description: At Moxie, we empower ambitious aesthetic entrepreneurs to build profitable, independent practices—without burnout, overwhelm, or guesswork. In just a few years, we've grown from an idea to a global, remote\-first team now supporting 700\+ practices nationwide. Our purpose is simple: to unlock sustainable success for aesthetic entrepreneurs, at every stage of their journey. **Staff Data Engineer** We're looking for a Staff Data Engineer to own Moxie's data infrastructure end to end: the pipelines (Prefect, Airbyte, Snowflake Openflow), the warehouse (Snowflake), and the modeling layer (dbt, Omni) that every number Moxie publishes depends on. Data and intelligence are Moxie's moat, and they are also where the gap between what we can do today and our full potential is widest. This is a highly visible seat on a small, ambitious team, and you close that gap. Day to day, you'll partner with Engineering on production schema changes (Postgres to Snowflake), work with Finance to model accounting logic, build and maintain pipelines, and keep business\-critical data available for internal teams and the practices we serve. Practice Intelligence and Practice 360 are built on this foundation, and you'll be the person who makes it solid. **Our Objectives for the Role** * Make every number Moxie publishes defensible: within six months the data stack is owned, alerted, lineage\-mapped, and documented end to end, and "is the number right?" has a yes\-answer for every priority metric flowing into Practice 360 decks, MBRs, Practice Intelligence reports, and Moxie Suite embedded reports * Own the dbt and orchestration layers, maintaining and evolving Moxie's dbt models (including financial reporting logic such as cash vs. accrual basis and incentive calculations and their downstream effect on metrics like AOV) and taking over the Prefect and Snowflake Openflow orchestration layer along with the observability platform that monitors it * Deliver one high\-impact project in your first quarter by scoping and shipping either the accrual basis accounting data model (so dbt and Omni support both cash and accrual reporting as we move upmarket) or modelling historical EMR data to work with existing practice KPIs so owners can understand the performance of their business before/after joining Moxie; neither exists today * Turn ad\-hoc work into owned process by establishing the SOPs and KPIs the stack has been missing: a monthly Vanta security review, a scoping and execution process for production schema changes, a triage workflow from job and test failures to resolution, and monthly infrastructure KPIs for performance and cost * Deepen the moat: by month nine you're proactively optimizing the stack (for example, Omni data refreshed every 15 minutes at predictable cost) and building the pipelines and models that move Practice Intelligence from descriptive to predictive to prescriptive, including safeguards for LLM\-generated content in data products **We're Looking For** * 5\-10 years of data engineering experience, with at least one stretch as an early data hire who took a system from "basics" to business\-critical * Deep dbt and SQL modeling skill applied to business logic: you've owned a dbt project of real complexity and can model financial concepts like cash vs. accrual accounting, incentive logic, and revenue definitions, and explain how a change upstream ripples through every downstream metric * Python and software engineering fundamentals strong enough to own orchestration: you've run production pipelines on Prefect, Airflow, Dagster, or similar, handled schema evolution from an operational database into a warehouse, and set up alerting and observability so failures are caught before stakeholders notice * A track record of leading end\-to\-end delivery: you gather requirements from non\-technical partners (Finance, Product, Sales), scope the work, make the architectural call, ship it, and can articulate the tradeoffs you chose and the business value that resulted * An ownership mindset about uptime, reliability, and cost; you treat data infrastructure as a living system that needs a steward, and SLAs, runbooks, KPIs, and cost optimization are things you build rather than wait to be asked for * Fluency with AI tooling in daily work (Claude Code, Cursor, n8n, or similar) and a point of view on where LLMs belong in a data stack and where they need guardrails * Someone who sees a data team as a driver of business outcomes, not a ticketing service; if "taking tickets from a queue" describes your ideal job, this won't be a fit **Why Join Us?** * You set the standard, not inherit one: as the second internal data hire on a small, ambitious team, your data patterns, conventions, and engineering philosophy become Moxie's * A data architecture competitors can't match: Moxie's vertical model captures clinical events (Service Menu Item x Service Type x Service Product) tied to appointments, providers, and patients, and every additional service we sell makes the dataset richer * A modern stack with room to grow (Snowflake, dbt, Omni, Airbyte, Prefect, GitHub) with AI tooling built into the workflow, and a tight Product and Engineering partnership so you see how the data you model changes what practices can do * A highly visible IC role executing C\-Suite level initiatives, with real input on the data roadmap and your own career trajectory At Moxie, we believe in creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, trusted, and included. Our team lives by our values: **act as owners, give more than we take, move with speed and care, and simplify and learn every day.** We welcome people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to apply. If you require any accommodations to fully participate in the interview process, please let us know, we’re happy to assist. Compensation Range: $78,000 \- $209,000

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Operator Tools
jobs.description: We are looking for a **Director of Engineering** to lead our Operator Tools division, the group that builds the AI\-driven features restaurant operators use every day. These tools show operators how their restaurants are performing, surface opportunities to save costs, and give them what they need to improve how they run their business. You will manage a group of engineering managers and also lead one of the division's teams directly. You'll own delivery, quality, and technical direction across Operator Tools, and you'll be a senior partner to product and design leadership in deciding what we build and how. This is a chance to shape how AI changes restaurant operations for thousands of independent restaurants across the US and Canada. MarginEdge is a SaaS platform for independent restaurants that simplifies complex operations and delivers actionable insights. Our system runs on AWS. Our services are built with Java/Spring Boot, and our front ends use React and React Native. For data, we use both NoSQL (DynamoDB) and relational (Postgres) databases. We also have a growing portfolio of IoT hardware products and integrations, like our SmartScale, that simplify kitchen tasks and collect real\-time data in restaurants. That data feeds the insights Operator Tools delivers. **MarginEdge: Where hospitality meets technology** As a team built by former (and current!) restaurant operators, our mission is to bring operators the same energy, attention to detail, and passion that they bring to their guests. Our culture is deeply rooted in service, partially because that’s where so many of our team come from (including everyone on our Business Development team), but also because we believe it is just the right way to run a business. We design our software with profound empathy for the complexity of running a restaurant, and the goal of making the magic just a little easier for operators by taking the complex (read: very annoying) back office tasks off their plate, while empowering them with real\-time data. Our founders share a deep history in both owning and operating restaurants and in building successful tech companies. We are venture\-backed and serve 12,000\+ restaurants across the US and Canada. We enable restaurants to make magic while knowing we are doing the same for them. We have the utmost respect for our clients and because of this, we are unable to hire their current employees. **What type of responsibilities will I have?** * Set the vision and engineering strategy for Operator Tools. Work with product and design leadership on a roadmap that brings cutting\-edge AI capabilities into practical, reliable features operators trust. Turn business goals into clear priorities, and make sound calls on where to invest, what to build, and what to leave out. * Lead, coach, and grow a team of engineering managers while also managing a team of engineers directly. Hire strong leaders, develop them, and build depth on the bench. Create a high\-performance culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement across the division. * Build an organization that stays at the cutting edge of what's possible. Keep a close eye on the latest advances in AI, and look for ways to use them in our products and to improve how your teams work. Hold a high bar on quality, security, and technical judgment throughout. * Own delivery and operational excellence for every system in Operator Tools. Put planning and execution practices in place that work across multiple teams, manage dependencies with the rest of the organization, and make sure your teams ship high\-quality software on predictable timelines. * Guide technical strategy and architecture for the division. Help teams balance moving fast against the long\-term health of the platform, and work with other engineering leaders to keep the approach consistent across MarginEdge. * Stay close to customers and the business. Use customer feedback, product analytics, and operational data to measure impact and find recurring pain points, and push for the investment needed to fix them. Clearly report progress, risks, and outcomes to executive leadership. **What qualifications or skills are required?** * 12\+ years of software engineering experience, including 6\+ years in engineering leadership and at least 3 years managing managers. * A proven track record of building and scaling multi\-team engineering organizations with a strong focus on delivery, quality, and culture. * Experience shipping AI/ML or LLM\-powered features to production, with a practical understanding of what it takes to make them reliable, measurable, and cost\-effective. * A strong software development background in Java and/or JavaScript (React), with the technical depth to evaluate architecture and challenge technical decisions. * Experience partnering with product and design leadership in a product\-driven environment, including shaping roadmaps together and prioritizing against business outcomes. * The ability t gh growth. * Experience with data platforms, analytics products, or real\-time insights and reporting. * Experience with IoT device management or hardware\-integrated products. * Hands\-on experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code to speed up software development. **Compensation:** The anticipated salary range for this role is **$185,000–$230,000** annually. Where a candidate falls within that range depends on a variety of factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus opportunities and our comprehensive benefits package. **What’s it like to work for MarginEdge?** Imagine the fun of a great restaurant \- surrounded by a team of people (including some that you help to manage!) who care about hospitality, care about quality, and care about each other \- then subtract the long nights, weekends, drunk customers at the bar...et voila, MarginEdge! We work hard, we work fast and we fuel our work with a commitment of transparency from leadership, straight talk and trust between teams. We believe that the best people do their best work when they feel empowered \- so whether you are remote or in our office (likely eating a catered lunch from our clients in our baller, brand new penthouse HQ in Ballston) you get to work with your manager to call your shot on what works best for you. Did we mention it has a full commercial kitchen and is walking distance (covered walking, that is) from the metro? **Benefits (Shut the Front Door, They are Amazing)** In order to fuel this rocket ship, we need to build a team as passionate about our work and product as we are. We believe that top talent (that’s you!) should feel deeply connected to their work, appreciated for the time they give to building our organization and have the balance necessary to give their best during work hours and all those after\-hours too. We do this by offering a suite of kick ass benefits not only to be competitive and catch the eye of super smart people (that’s you again!) but also provide the foundation for a career you love and a life outside of work you love just as much. * Unlimited Paid Time Off (and we mean it, we encourage your healthy work life balance!) * Medical, Dental, Vision, and Short/Long\-Term Disability Insurance (preventative care for the win) * Health Savings Account with employer match (dependent upon your medical plan selection) * Commuter benefits with employer contribution (excluding limos and helos \- for now) * Generous Life Insurance Plan * Short\- and Long\-term Disability * Company\-Paid Holidays * 401(k) and matching * Stock Options to buy into everything we are doing to support this industry * 12\-week fully Paid Parental Leave * Lunch catered twice a week at our HQ in Arlington (we exclusively cater from our clients, too! * A wellness program that sponsors healthy activities such as step challenges and provides discounts to gyms and fitness classes. ***Check out our 100% “Recommend to a Friend” rating from anonymous employee reviews on*** ***Glassdoor******.*** ***Oh, and our recognition in the Washington Post as a*** ***top small businesses*** ***to work for in 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025!*** ***And most important, what our customers think about our work on*** ***Capterra*** ***and*** ***G2 Crowd.*** **Our Fine Print is Bold:** We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran, marital, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law. You be you. While we are proudest of our commitment to exceptional culture and creating a truly excellent work environment, we see our benefits as an extension of that belief. Our benefits package is designed to be exceptionally competitive and a reflection of our commitment to a best\-in\-class workplace for all.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: Since 2001, Mid\-States has been family\-owned and operated, fabricating, installing, and servicing bulk material handling systems for grain, feed, milling, and processing facilities across the United States, Canada, and Mexico. design experience on material handling, agricultural, or fabricated industrial equipment (fewer years considered at the Mechanical Design Engineer level) * Strong grounding in machine design, statics, strength of materials, weldment design, and material selection * Experience with finite element analysis * Proficiency in Autodesk Inventor, or another 3D CAD platform and the ability to transition * A track record of taking designs from calculations through to released drawings * **Bonus:** experience with grain or bulk material handling equipment * **Bonus:** an EIT or PE * **Bonus:** Autodesk Vault, Inventor Nastran, or iLogic experience **Benefits** * 100% company\-paid high\-deductible health plan option, plus 2 PPO options * 5% 401(k) match * Annual profit sharing for all team members * Annual boot and eyeglass allowance * 2 weeks PTO in your first year, 8 paid holidays, and 2 floating days * Recognition for military and first responder employees **Who Thrives Here** * **Ownership:** Personal accountability to world\-class results. You own your product line, stand behind your calculations, and follow a problem all the way to root cause. * **Stewardship:** Cultivating what is entrusted to us. You build standards the whole team can rely on and invest in the designers learning from you. * **Tenacity:** Grit. Perseverance. jobs.title: Senior Engineer — AI Workload & Infrastructure Validation
jobs.description: **Location:** Plano, TX (hybrid) **Practice:** AI Infrastructure / GPU\-as\-a\-Service **About the role** Two halves, and both matter. You make the platform useful — enabling distributed training and production inference on the clusters we build. And you own our infrastructure validation offering: the independent, evidence\-based assessment that tells a customer whether the eight\-figure GPU estate they just bought actually performs the way the reference architecture promised. If you like building the benchmark that settles the argument, this is your role. **What you’ll do** **Workload engineering** \- Enable and tune distributed training: PyTorch DDP and FSDP, DeepSpeed/ZeRO, tensor and pipeline parallelism, NCCL tuning, MFU measurement and improvement. \- Architect inference serving — Triton, NVIDIA NIM, vLLM, TensorRT\-LLM — with quantization, continuous batching, KV\-cache and paged attention, and autoscaling to latency SLOs. \- Size inference platforms backward from customer SLOs: time\-to\-first\-token, inter\-token latency, concurrency, context length. \- Support the GenAI patterns customers actually ask for — RAG, fine\-tuning, agentic pipelines, vector database integration. **Validation offering** \- Build and own our GPU infrastructure validation suite: fabric validation, NCCL scaling curves, GPU burn and thermal/power soak, storage throughput, GPUDirect verification, reference\-workload MFU baselines. \- Deliver acceptance validation engagements and author the signed acceptance reports customers use to hold vendors to their commitments. \- Design the continuous\-validation service: post\-downtime revalidation, driver and firmware matrix certification, performance drift detection against baseline. \- Produce published benchmark methodology and reports that establish our technical credibility in the market. \- Own PoC workload design and the benchmark evidence that closes engagements. **What you need** * 5\+ years ML engineering, MLOps, or performance engineering with production GPU workloads. * Hands\-on distributed training on multi\-node GPU clusters — not single\-GPU or notebook\-scale work. * Production LLM inference serving: Triton, vLLM, or TensorRT\-LLM. * Rigorous benchmarking discipline — you can profile a system, explain where GPU time actually goes, and defend a number. * Strong Python; containers and Kubernetes\-native workflows (Kubeflow, Ray, Argo Workflows). * Clear technical writing. A validation report is a deliverable a customer pays for. **Nice to have** NVIDIA NIM and NeMo; MLPerf or formal benchmark program experience; test\-and\-validation engineering background; fine\-tuning at scale (LoRA/QLoRA); customer\-facing PoC delivery. **First 90 days** Reference training and inference workloads running on our platform with published benchmark numbers; v1 validation suite and report template delivered; first customer validation engagement scoped. Pay: $80\.00 \- $120\.00 per hour Application Question(s): * Are you amenable working on a hybrid work set up? * Are you comfortable working in a contract\-based role? * How much is your expected hourly rate? * What is your earliest available start date? Experience: * ML Eng, MLOps, or Perf Eng with production GPU workloads: 5 years (Preferred) Location: * Plano, TX 75023 (Preferred) Ability to Relocate: * Plano, TX 75023: Relocate before starting work (Preferred) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Plano, TX 75023

jobs.title: Integration Engineer

This includes applying governance best practices, automation, design, implementation, support of interfaces, and some operational work. jobs.title: Associate Software Engineer - Intelligence Systems
jobs.description: **Associate Software Engineer, Intelligent Systems** **Reports to:** Director of Intelligent Systems \& Integration **Role Overview** Monti Inc. is a Cincinnati\-based copper conductor manufacturer building practical internal systems across manufacturing, finance, HR, compliance, purchasing, and leadership workflows. As the Associate Software Engineer, Intelligent Systems, you will help design, build, test, and support internal AI\-enabled applications, automations, integrations, and workflows. We are looking for someone early in their career who is highly comfortable working with modern AI coding tools, cloud platforms, and real business systems. This role is ideal for a builder who may not have years of enterprise experience yet, but who learns quickly, uses tools like Codex and Claude Code fluently, and wants to help turn messy operational problems into useful software. This is not a research ML role. It is a practical engineering role focused on using AI tools, cloud infrastructure, APIs, databases, and business context to ship useful systems. The right person should be comfortable working with AI coding assistants, reading unfamiliar code, asking good questions, debugging across systems, and learning cloud and integration patterns quickly. **Key Responsibilities** Development \& AI Tooling * Build and maintain internal tools, automations, and AI\-assisted workflows. * Use Codex, Claude Code, and similar tools effectively as part of daily development. * Assist with LLM\-powered workflows such as classification, extraction, summarization, research, and document processing. * Write clear, maintainable code with tests where appropriate. Integration \& Systems Support * Help integrate systems using APIs, databases, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Azure, and third\-party platforms. * Help debug issues across systems, including application code, cloud services, logs, credentials, and data flows. * Support production systems with monitoring, documentation, and careful change management. Collaboration \& Documentation * Work with business users to understand real workflows before building solutions. * Document decisions, setup steps, known issues, and operational procedures. * Learn Monti’s systems and gradually take ownership of small\-to\-medium projects. Example Projects * Build an internal dashboard for tracking operational data. * Automate a manual SharePoint or Teams\-based workflow. * Help create an AI\-assisted document classification or extraction process. * Improve monitoring and alerting for an existing integration. * Build a small tool that helps purchasing, HR, finance, or operations move faster. * Help evaluate AI outputs using examples, review steps, and simple quality checks. What Success Looks Like Within the first 90 days, this person should be able to: * Understand Monti’s internal engineering workflow and development environment. * Use Codex and Claude Code productively to inspect code, make changes, test work, and document findings. * Ship a small internal automation or AI\-assisted workflow with guidance. * Debug a simple integration or cloud issue using logs, documentation, and support from the team. * Write clear documentation that helps future work move faster. * Show good judgment about when to automate, when to ask for review, and when human approval is needed. **Qualifications \& Experience** Required * Strong comfort using AI coding tools such as Codex, Claude Code, ChatGPT, or similar systems. * Basic software development experience in one or more languages such as TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, C\#, or similar. * Familiarity with Git, GitHub, pull requests, and code review workflows. * Basic understanding of APIs, databases, authentication, and cloud services. * Comfort working in a terminal and reading logs/errors. * Ability to learn unfamiliar systems quickly and ask clear questions. * Strong written communication and documentation habits. * Careful judgment when working with sensitive business data. Preferred * Experience with Azure, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Entra ID, or Microsoft Graph. * Experience with Terraform or infrastructure\-as\-code. * Experience building small web apps, scripts, internal tools, or automation workflows. * Familiarity with SQL and relational databases. * Experience using LLM APIs, structured outputs, RAG, agents, or prompt engineering. * Exposure to manufacturing, ERP, finance, HR, purchasing, or compliance workflows. * Interest in production reliability, monitoring, and secure system design. **Core Competencies** We want a curious, tool\-native builder who is excited by real operational problems. You do not need to be a senior AI expert. You do need to be comfortable learning in public, working with AI coding tools every day, and turning vague problems into working software. The ideal candidate: * Likes using AI tools as part of their engineering process. * Is not intimidated by cloud systems, APIs, or unfamiliar codebases. * Can move carefully around production data and business\-critical workflows. * Values useful, reliable systems over flashy demos. * Wants to grow into a strong AI systems engineer inside a real manufacturing business. **Why Join Monti?** At Monti Inc., you will work hands\-on with modern AI tools and real business systems, turning messy operational problems into software people use every day. This role offers a practical path to grow into a strong AI systems engineer inside a real manufacturing business, with the support of a team that values useful, reliable systems. *Monti, Inc. is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.*
