jobs.title: Onboard Vehicle Network Engineer
jobs.description: **Mission Summary:** Motional's Platform Infrastructure organization builds and operates the foundational onboard software systems that power our autonomous vehicles. Our responsibilities include system communications and IPC, networking, Linux operating system development and maintenance, high\-speed data logging and offload, and onboard system performance optimization. We are seeking an Onboard Vehicle Network Engineer to lead the design, evolution, and maintenance of our onboard vehicle network architecture. In this hands\-on engineering role, you will be responsible for defining the network topology, hardware interfaces, communication protocols, and network diagnostics for both our current generation of operational autonomous vehicles and our next\-generation vehicle platform. You will blend software engineering expertise with system\-level network design to ensure high\-throughput, low\-latency, deterministic, and resilient communication across all onboard compute nodes, sensors, and controllers. **What You'll Be Doing:** * Design and evolve the onboard vehicle network topology, including physical and logical architectures for both current operational platforms and next\-generation autonomous vehicles. * Define and implement network protocol stacks, communication standards, and messaging layers across compute nodes, sensors, microcontrollers, and actuators. * Write and maintain high\-quality software and tooling for network routing, monitoring, fault detection, diagnostics, and failover handling. * Partner with hardware, platform, and autonomy software teams to evaluate and select network hardware components. * Establish network performance budgets, Quality of Service (QoS) policies, network isolation/segmentation strategies, and latency/bandwidth constraints. * Build telemetry and monitoring tools to observe network health, bandwidth utilization, packet drops, and real\-time communication performance. * Diagnose and resolve complex, system\-level networking issues, including loss of communication, packet drops, latency jitter, and hardware controller errors. * Define maintenance, provisioning, and OTA firmware update strategies for onboard network switches and interface hardware. * Contribute to technical roadmaps for next\-generation onboard networking and communications infrastructure. **What We're Looking For:** * Strong background as a Software Engineer with demonstrated ability to write, debug, and maintain production code. * Deep understanding of embedded network architectures, network topology design, and system\-level communication flows. * Hands\-on experience with networking protocols and standards (e.g., Ethernet, TCP/IP, UDP, CAN/CAN\-FD, etc). * Proficiency in a modern programming language (C\+\+ is preferred, but experience in any modern language is acceptable). * Experience designing network security policies, traffic shaping/prioritization, QoS, and logical network isolation. * Ability to design and build software tools for network telemetry, packet inspection, and automated system diagnostics. * Experience collaborating closely across organizational boundaries with hardware, embedded Linux, system integration, and application engineering teams. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex network architecture decisions to diverse engineering audiences. **Bonus Points:** * Strong, practical coding experience in modern C\+\+ within embedded Linux or automotive software environments. * Experience with automotive network software architectures and protocols (e.g., AUTOSAR Classic/Adaptive, DDS, ROS/ROS2\). * Familiarity with automotive switch hardware, PHYs, and compute platforms (e.g., Broadcom, Marvell, NVIDIA DRIVE AGX platform). * Experience with hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) testing, network simulation, or bus heavy\-load stress testing. * Knowledge of Linux networking internals, socket programming, network device drivers, or eBPF\-based network monitoring. * Experience with automotive cybersecurity concepts (e.g., ISO/SAE 21434, SecOC, MACsec, onboard firewalls). * Familiarity with Bazel build systems and large\-scale software codebases. **Work Arrangement:** This role is hybrid from our Pittsburgh/Boston/LV office and requires in\-office days each week to support hands\-on system work and cross\-functional collaboration. \#LI\-AE1 **Motional is a driverless technology company making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We're driven by something more.** **Our journey is always people first.** We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move. **Higher purpose, greater impact.** We're creating first\-of\-its\-kind technology that will transform transportation. To do so successfully, we must design for everyone in our cities and on our roads. We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. Diversity helps us to see the world differently; it's not only good for our business, it's the right thing to do. **Scale up, not starting up.** Our team is behind some of the industry's largest leaps forward, including the first fully\-autonomous cross\-country drive in the U.S, the launch of the world's first robotaxi pilot, and operation of the world's longest\-standing public robotaxi fleet. We're driven to scale; we're moving towards commercialization of our technology, and we need team members who are ready to embrace change and challenges. Formed as a joint venture between Hyundai Motor Group and Aptiv, Motional is fundamentally changing how people move through their lives. Headquartered in Boston, Motional has operations in the U.S and Asia. For more information, visit www.Motional.com and follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube. *Motional AD Inc. is an EOE. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Provider and RWD Health Systems Applications
jobs.description: **Senior Product Manager, Provider and RWD Health Systems Applications** ======================================================================== Natera's RWD platform at the clinic connects an ecosystem of real\-world evidence, molecular data, and clinical insights to deliver actionable information to physicians. We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to help build and scale physician\-facing RWD applications. We seek to unlock the full potential of real\-world data to improve treatment outcomes and make molecular results actionable in everyday treatment decisions. In this role, you'll own a physician\-facing RWD application for a patient's molecular and clinical journey and workflow integrations behind it, partnering with cross\-functional product teams, engineering, AI/ML teams, and clinical teams to deliver intuitive tools centered on enriched patient insights. **What You'll Do** ------------------ **Advance Data Integration and Intelligence** * Collaborate with clinical product management, EMR, user experience product management, marketing, medical and a broad cross functional team to drive product strategy and roadmap, * Drive integration of genomic tests into the platform (Signatera/ctDNA, hereditary risk, tumor/normal and NGS profiling, liquid CGP, etc.) as part of a unified oncology digitized experience. * Work closely with AI/ML teams to build applications for patient\-level insights and clinic\-level insights, including cohort comparison, clinical trial matching, and cohort analytics back to individual patient care. * Partner with legal, privacy, and security so HIPAA obligations, PHI handling, and data\-governance requirements are designed into the product. **Elevate the User Experience** * Own the single\- and multi\-patient views that bring a patient's molecular results and clinical events together in one physician\-facing application. * Integrate AI\-powered clinical trial matching that connects patients and physicians to the most relevant investigational therapies based on molecular, clinical, and patient criteria. * Help reduce friction points at both the provider and patient level to enroll in clinical trials. * Partner across Natera to enable EMR/EHR integration and mobile access, ensuring seamless experiences for providers. * Contribute to an analytics framework that captures user analytics and informs continuous product development. **Enhance the Utility of Genomic Testing** * Support delivery of a physician\-facing platform that highlights therapies, tracks treatment response, and monitors disease progression in real time. * Ship tools and functionality to aid physician collaboration. * Connect molecular and clinical findings to relevant treatment pathways and outcomes data to make testing more actionable at the point of care. * Partner with Product Marketing, MSL, Sales, and Clinical Operations on enablement, training, and adoption. **Launch the De\-Identified Aggregated Research Platform for Health Systems** * Partner with the Health Systems BU to define, build, and launch a de\-identified, aggregated research platform that turns clinic data into a health\-system\-wide resource for precision medicine and research. **Engage Key Stakeholders** * Engage with physicians, KOLs, and academic collaborators to translate clinical needs into features. * Help track KPIs centered on the physician experience with RWD at the clinic. * Support representation of RWD at the clinic at conferences, industry forums, and customer discussions as needed. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- **Required:** * 5\+ years of product management or related experience, including experience in healthcare, engineering, genomics, or AI/ML. * Deep understanding of the oncology domain with direct experience building requirements and collaborating with physicians. * Experience building clinician\-facing software that fits into real clinical workflows. * Experience delivering AI/LLM\-derived clinical data into provider\-facing products, including human\-in\-the\-loop review, confidence labeling, and data transparency. * Backlog ownership: writing and grooming user stories in Jira and driving PM perspective in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, standups, retros). * Hands\-on with data: comfortable writing SQL (or equivalent) to check status, investigate issues, and measure outcomes, and in the habit of asking 'is this correct, and are we ready to ship?' * Track record of setting product KPIs and moving them, with specifics on adoption, engagement, and quality. * Fluency in oncology / genomics clinical concepts (staging, lines of therapy, biomarkers, MRD/ctDNA). * Commitment to user\-centered design thinking, with a track record of translating user needs into intuitive and impactful product experiences. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with clinical, technical, and commercial audiences. **Preferred:** * Using AI tools day to day to prototype and draft specs. * EHR integration experience (SMART on FHIR, HL7/FHIR, Epic or other EHR app ecosystems). * Strong technical fluency; comfortable working with engineers, scientists, and data teams, and reasoning about what AI/ML and LLMs can and can't reliably do. * Familiarity with PHI\-handling applications, HIPAA, or regulated clinical software. * Familiarity with FDA clinical decision support or SaMD considerations. **OUR OPPORTUNITY** Natera™ is a global leader in cell\-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women's health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives. The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world\-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you'll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you'll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management. **WHAT WE OFFER** Competitive Benefits \- Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. jobs.title: Cybersecurity Operations & Architecture
jobs.description: WORK OPTION: The NBA currently provides eligible employees the option of working remotely one day per week. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ **Position Summary** -------------------- The National Basketball Association (NBA) is seeking a strategic, highly collaborative, and technically credible Vice President, Cybersecurity Operations \& Architecture to lead the design, operation, and continuous improvement of cybersecurity capabilities across the organization’s global technology ecosystem. Reporting directly to the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), this role serves as the senior leader accountable for integrating enterprise security architecture with day\-to\-day cyber defense, incident response, threat detection, and infrastructure protection. The Vice President will establish security architecture strategy, standards, roadmaps, and reference architectures while ensuring those designs translate into sustainable operational controls, measurable detection coverage, effective response capabilities, and resilient technology services. The role will partner extensively with Cybersecurity, Enterprise Technology, Infrastructure, Engineering, Digital Products, Data \& Analytics, Media Operations, Basketball Operations, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, NBA teams, arena operators, and external technology partners. A core responsibility is setting NBA arena cybersecurity standards and making certain they are adhered to. This includes defining practical and enforceable requirements, guiding assessments and remediation, and addressing the security of arena IT, cloud\-connected services, operational technology, building and display control systems, game and event technologies, broadcast dependencies, and third\-party integrations. **Major Responsibilities** -------------------------- **Cybersecurity Strategy, Leadership \& Operating Model** --------------------------------------------------------- * Develop and execute an integrated, multi\-year cybersecurity operations and architecture strategy aligned with business priorities, technology roadmaps, risk tolerance, and the evolving threat landscape. * Lead and mature the Cybersecurity Operations and Cybersecurity Architecture functions, establishing clear accountability, decision rights, service models, performance expectations, and escalation paths. * Serve as a trusted advisor to the CISO and senior technology leadership on cyber risk, resilience, major technology investments, crisis readiness, and strategic security priorities. * Translate cybersecurity strategy into funded roadmaps, measurable outcomes, workforce plans, vendor strategies, and prioritized improvement initiatives. Promote a shared\-ownership model in which cybersecurity is embedded into technology planning, engineering, operational processes, and business initiatives. * **Enterprise Security Architecture Leadership** ----------------------------------------------- * Establish and maintain the NBA’s enterprise cybersecurity architecture strategy, roadmap, standards, design patterns, and reference architectures in partnership with cybersecurity, infrastructure, engineering, data, product, and business technology leaders. * Lead security architecture reviews for major technology initiatives and provide pragmatic guidance that balances cybersecurity risk, operational realities, resiliency, performance, cost, and business objectives. * Develop and maintain reference architectures for cloud services, applications, infrastructure, identity, data platforms, media operations, arena technologies, operational technology, on\-premises data centers, and third\-party integrations. * Ensure security requirements are incorporated early in technology planning, procurement, design, development, deployment, and lifecycle management. * Provide architectural leadership for identity and access management, network segmentation, zero trust, encryption, logging, monitoring, cyber resiliency, data protection, and secure connectivity. Represent cybersecurity in enterprise architecture, governance, design review, and technology investment forums. * **Security Operations, Detection \& Incident Response** ------------------------------------------------------- * Lead enterprise security operations, including continuous monitoring, threat detection, threat hunting, incident triage, containment, investigation, recovery coordination, and post\-incident improvement. * Define the strategy and operating model for security information and event management, detection engineering, automation, orchestration, case management, and operational metrics. * Improve visibility across cloud, hybrid, on\-premises, endpoint, identity, application, regional office, data center, arena, game, event, and broadcast environments. * Establish clear incident response roles, severity criteria, escalation protocols, executive communications, evidence handling expectations, and coordination with Legal, Privacy, Communications, business continuity, and ext Exceptional leadership, collaboration, stakeholder management, negotiation, and executive communication skills. * Demonstrated ability to lead through influence across complex, matrixed organizations and diverse external stakeholder groups. * Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to balance risk, operational needs, user experience, innovation, resilience, and cost. Ability to remain composed, decisive, and clear during high\-pressure incidents and high\-visibility events. * **Preferred Certifications** ---------------------------- One or more relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GIAC, CCSP, SABSA, TOGAF, AWS or Azure security certifications, or equivalent demonstrated expertise. **Why This Role Matters** ------------------------- The Vice President, Cybersecurity Operations \& Architecture serves as the strategic and operational bridge between secure design, effective cyber defense, business enablement, and resilience. By unifying architecture with operations, this leader will help ensure that security standards are practical, measurable, and sustainable, and that operational lessons continuously improve future designs. The role is especially important to protecting enterprise platforms, global offices, digital products, sensitive data, games, broadcasts, events, and arena technology, while enabling the NBA to innovate and operate with confidence. **Salary Range:** $360,000\-$415,000 **Job Posting Title:** Vice President Employees currently are eligible to receive an annual discretionary performance bonus, awarded at the sole discretion of the Company and subject to any terms and conditions set by the Company. jobs.title: Full-Stack Senior Developers
jobs.description: Natoli Engineering is hiring two senior full\-stack developers to design, build and run our software portfolio. For more than 50 years, Natoli has made tablet compression tooling, tablet presses and related equipment for manufacturers worldwide from its headquarters in St. Charles, Missouri. Our software includes instrumentation and control software for our presses, tooling management and inspection tools, customer portals such as TabletCAD and our online store, internal business systems, and natoli.com. This is a hands\-on, senior individual\-contributor role. You will write production code most days and take work from first conversation with a stakeholder through requirements, design, testing, deployment and support. The two developers share ownership of the portfolio and report to the Head of IT; neither role leads or manages a team. AI is central to how we will build software. We want developers who already use AI coding assistants and agents every day, know how to build AI into development tools and practices, and know where AI output needs a careful human check. You should also have shipped and maintained real enterprise software, care about quality and documentation, and explain technical trade\-offs clearly to non\-technical people. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **Portfolio ownership and technical direction** * Share ownership of Natoli's software portfolio with the other senior developer: software sold with our equipment, customer portals, internal business systems and natoli.com. Divide the work and back each other up. * Shape the technical roadmap and architecture for each application, and agree priorities with the Head of IT: new features, customer commitments, security fixes and technical debt. * Help set and follow engineering standards: coding conventions, branching strategy, code review and definition of done. * Review code from peers and contractors, and pair on the hardest problems. * Recommend build\-vs\-buy decisions and evaluate frameworks, libraries, vendors and tools. ### **AI\-enabled development** * Use AI coding assistants and agents \[such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or Cursor] every day across the SDLC: design, coding, refactoring, testing, code review and documentation. * Review, test and take responsibility for every line of AI\-generated code before it ships. * Build AI into Natoli's development tools and practices: AI\-assisted pull request review, test generation inside a TDD workflow, documentation generation, and AI steps in CI/CD pipelines. * Maintain the shared context that makes AI tools effective here: repository instruction files, prompt libraries, coding conventions, and connectors (such as MCP servers) to internal systems and documentation. * Work with the Head of IT on AI guardrails: approved tools, what code and data may go to which AI service, security review of AI output, and licensing and IP. * Add AI features to Natoli products and internal apps where they earn their place, such as search and assistants over technical documentation, using LLM APIs, retrieval and evaluation. * Measure the effect of AI on cycle time, defect rates and review effort, and evaluate new models and tools as they appear. * Share what works with colleagues across IT through demos, short guides and pairing. ### **Requirements and SDLC** * Gather requirements from customers, sales, support and internal users, and turn them into user stories, acceptance criteria and technical specs. * Own the full SDLC: discovery, design, build, test, release, maintenance and retirement. * Work in an agile cadence (Scrum or Kanban as each product needs) and help run backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives. * Estimate effort, track delivery and report status, risks and trade\-offs to the Head of IT. * Plan releases and versioning for customer\-facing products, including release notes and upgrade paths. ### **Architecture, data and performance** * Design secure, scalable, maintainable systems: front ends, APIs, services and integrations with third\-party systems (ERP, CRM, payments, identity). * Design relational schemas: normalization, keys and constraints, indexing, and safe, versioned migrations. * Choose the right data store for each job (relational, document, key\-value, search) and tune queries for performance. * Design caching at every layer (CDN, HTTP, application, distributed caches such as Redis), including invalidation strategy. * Design multi\-tenant patterns for SaaS products, including tenant data isolation. ### **Quality and testing** * Practice and champion test\-driven development (TDD). * Maintain a layered automated test suite: unit, integration, contract and end\-to\-end tests. * Build quality gates into the pipeline: test coverage, static analysis, linting and dependency and security scanning. * Triage production incidents, find root causes and write blameless post\-incident reviews. ### **CI/CD, cloud and operations** * Build and mainta skills, which are still scarce. Local pay data for AI skills is thin, so revisit the band after the first round of applicants. * Budget for both hires: $270,000–$330,000 combined base, plus bonus and benefits. * Hire both into the same band and set each offer by skills and experience, so the two peers are paid fairly relative to each other. * Pay toward the top of the band for FDA\-regulated software experience (21 CFR Part 11\), commercial software experience, or a stack that is hard to hire for locally. * Expected total cash per hire: about $142,000–$182,000\. * Other levers if base is tight: a $5,000–$15,000 signing bonus, extra PTO, a $2,000–$5,000 yearly training budget, and paid AI tool subscriptions. ### **Market benchmarks** Payscale, Built In and Orbyt pages listed under Sources · St. Louis base pay · checked October 2026 Each source reports a different spread, so compare the dots rather than the line lengths. Orbyt's modeled figures run highest; self\-reported Payscale and Built In data run lower. **Benefits, work arrangement and EEO statement** ------------------------------------------------ Fill in the brackets with your actual plan details. * Medical, dental and vision insurance, with \[X]% of premiums paid by Natoli * 401(k) with a \[X]% company match * \[N] days of paid time off plus \[N] paid holidays * Annual bonus program (5–10% target for this role) * $\[X] yearly professional development budget for courses, certifications and conferences * Company\-paid AI development tools and model access * Hybrid schedule: \[3] days a week at our St. Charles, MO headquarters, the rest remote * \[Paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, home\-office equipment] **Work authorization:** Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. \[Visa sponsorship is / is not available for this role.] **Equal opportunity:** Natoli Engineering Company, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other status protected by law. We provide reasonable accommodations during the hiring process on request. **Notes for the hiring manager** -------------------------------- * **Keep the title at senior individual contributor.** Avoid "Lead" or "Manager"; both attract candidates who expect direct reports and a higher band. * **Hire for complementary strengths.** Both hires must meet the same bar, but one could lean toward back\-end, data and equipment integration, the other toward front\-end, customer portals and natoli.com. * **Explain the two\-person structure.** Tell candidates how the two developers will split ownership and how decisions get made with the Head of IT, since neither one leads. * **Test AI skills directly.** Add a live exercise: a small task in a sample codebase using the candidate's own AI tools, then ask how they checked the output. Keep a system\-design session, a real pull\-request review and a requirements role\-play with a non\-technical stakeholder. * **Trim the must\-haves.** The required list has 15 items; move anything you would waive for a great hire into Preferred. * **Fill every bracket.** Your real stack and tools help candidates self\-select and cut screening time. * **Post the range.** Missouri does not require salary ranges in job posts. Illinois does for employers with 15\+ employees when the job may be done partly in Illinois, which can apply to hybrid hires living in the Metro East. Confirm with HR or counsel. **Sources** ----------- * Natoli Engineering home page (products, software and locations) * Payscale: Lead Software Engineer, experienced, St. Louis (19 profiles; updated March 2025\) * Built In: Lead Software Engineer, St. Louis (anonymous employee submissions) * Orbyt: Full Stack Developer salaries, St. Louis (modeled estimates, updated August 2026; also reports BLS OEWS May 2025 figures for software developers)

jobs.title: Frontend Architect
jobs.description: **About The Job** ================= Navan is an all\-in\-one travel, corporate card, and expense management solution that eliminates the hassles of corporate travel \& expense management while giving finance leaders real\-time spend visibility and control. The **Frontend Architect** plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of Navan's frontend infrastructure and developer experience across the organization. This role is central to architecting and maintaining the frontend platform that enables 20\+ engineering teams to deploy independently while maintaining high quality standards. The Frontend Architect is essential to our mission, building shared libraries, developer tooling, and infrastructure, evolving the platform for both human and AI\-assisted development, and driving performance and reliability initiatives. **What You'll Do** ================== * **Architect Micro\-Frontend Infrastructure:** Design and evolve micro\-frontend platform using Module Federation in React \& Angular. Create and maintain shared NPM packages enforcing consistency and patterns across the organization. Drive team collaboration through architectural governance, review processes, and cross\-functional alignment. * **Drive Developer Platform Strategy:** Create developer tools and automation that streamline workflows and boost productivity across engineering teams. Build repeatable AI\-assisted workflows for frontend implementation, browser testing, debugging, framework migrations, and delivery—from a task specification to a validated pull request. Author technical documentation and mentor engineers through code reviews. * **Enable Reliable Coding Agent Workflows:** Structure repositories, component libraries, documentation, and development environments so engineers and coding agents can reliably build, test, and extend the platform. Establish clear component contracts, runnable examples, predictable build and test commands, and reusable skills and integrations that provide relevant company context and actionable validation feedback. * **Establish Shared Patterns for AI\-Powered Experiences:** Partner with product and AI platform teams to establish shared UI patterns for AI\-powered experiences, including streaming responses, progress visibility, cancellation, error recovery, and user approval of consequential actions. Design reusable components with clear contracts that reduce integration time across teams. * **Strengthen Testing and Validation:** Establish fast, reliable feedback through component tests, browser automation, visual regression checks, and CI gates so changes can be validated consistently across teams. Define validation and human review requirements for AI\-generated changes. * **Drive Adoption and Measurable Outcomes:** Pilot new workflows with engineering teams, measure delivery time, escaped defects, reliability, and AI usage cost, and turn successful approaches into supported company standards. Verify that tools, integrations, and workflows operate successfully in the teams and environments where they are adopted. * **Partner on Secure AI\-Assisted Development:** Work with Security and the AI platform team to establish scoped tool access, safe handling of secrets and sensitive data, and clear accountability for agent\-generated changes. Define appropriate human review and approval boundaries for frontend workflows. * **Drive Reliability \& Performance:** Lead optimization initiatives to reduce bundle size and costs. Spearhead framework migrations delivering critical security fixes. Implement performance monitoring and optimization strategies that reduce latency and improve load times. **What We're Looking For** ========================== * At least 8 years of experience in frontend software development * At least 3 years of experience in frontend architecture with demonstrated organization\-wide impact * Deep expertise with React and TypeScript; experience with Angular is highly valued * Experience with micro\-frontend architectures (Module Federation, single\-spa, Web Components, or similar approaches) * Strong knowledge of build tooling (Webpack, Vite, Rollup) and monorepo management * Experience with testing strategies (unit, integration, E2E) and establishing testing standards across teams, including component testing, browser automation, visual regression checks, and CI validation * Hands\-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver production changes, with the ability to evaluate generated code, design effective validation, and explain where human review is necessary * Ability to demonstrate improvements in engineering delivery, quality, or reliability from AI\-assisted workflows and drive adoption across teams * Practical understanding of scoped tool access, secrets, sensitive data, and accountability for AI\-generated changes, in partnership with Security and AI platform teams * Excellent Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively collaborate with team members and drive consensus across multiple teams. * Nice to have: Experience with observability platforms, CDN optimization, Next.js or other meta\-frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and AWS Navan uses AI\-assisted Automated Employment Decision Tool (Metaview) to assist with evaluating resumes against job qualifications for this role. All final decisions are made by human recruiters and hiring managers. **Human oversight:** Metaview does not automatically reject candidates or make final hiring decisions. Our recruiters and hiring managers review all outputs and make the final hiring decision regarding every application. * **Your rights:** If you prefer to have your application reviewed without AI assistance, you may request a human evaluation by entering your email here. Your decision to do so will not affect how your candidacy is evaluated. Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about our processing of personal data, and your rights.

jobs.title: DC Facilities Engineer
jobs.description: **About Nebius:** Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full\-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in\-house AI/ML infrastructure. Built by engineers, for engineers. From large\-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI. Our team of 1,500\+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R\&D. **DC Facilities Engineer** **Level of Responsibility:** Independently operates, maintains, troubleshoots, and takes end\-to\-end ownership of critical power, critical cooling, liquid cooling, and DCIM/BMS infrastructure systems; participates in incident management and commissioning activities; and mentors Associate DC Facilities Engineers. **Role profile:** This is a critical role within Nebius data center operations. identify and escalate developing faults before they impact service uptime. * ndependently operate, monitor, and troubleshoot critical power distribution infrastructure including UPS systems, PDUs, RPPs, and in\- rack busbar power systems. * Manage and maintain critical cooling infrastructure including CRAHs, CRACs, CDUs, and RDHx; perform capacity checks and leakage inspections. * Participate in incident management for infrastructure\-impacting events; support root\-cause analyses, document findings, and contribute to CAPA execution under the direction of the Senior DC Facilities Engineer. * Operate and administer DCIM and BMS platforms; build and maintain dashboards, alerts, capacity reports, and infrastructure records. * Support deployment and commissioning of GB\-scale liquid\-cooled rack infrastructure including direct liquid cooling (DLC) systems, manifolds, and CDU connections. * Perform and own preventive maintenance tasks for all critical power and critical cooling systems; maintain accurate maintenance logs and compliance records. * Participate in site reviews, design reviews, and commissioning activities; prepare and review technical reports to document findings.and communicate results. * Enforce Nebius critical power and critical cooling safety procedures; act as safety lead for engineering work orders on live. infrastructure. * Collaborate with facilities, network, and technician teams on infrastructure changes, capacity expansions, and major deployments. * Support adherence to Nebius standards and policies through documentation review and active participation in commissioning and design activities. * Contribute to vendor and contractor coordination by supporting scheduling, site access, and execution of work per Nebius expectations and safe\-working practices. * Actively mentors and trains Associate Associate DC Facilities Engineers; guides them through systems operation, safe working practices, and structured skill development toward independent operation. **Expected capabilities / expectations** * Working proficiency across all critical power systems: UPS, PDU, RPP, in\-rack busbar, and generator interfacing. * Hands\-on experience with critical cooling systems: CRAH/CRAC, CDU, RDHx, and water\-side infrastructure including leak detection. * Competent DCIM/BMS administration: alert management, capacity modeling, and dashboard reporting. * Developing knowledge of GB rack liquid cooling technology, DLC manifolds, and heat rejection infrastructure. U.S. Data Center Career Framework \- Technical Career Framework * Ability to participate in and support incident management activities including RCA and CAPA documentation. * Strong documentation discipline: change records, maintenance logs, capacity data, and incident write\-ups. * Clear and confident communication with facilities, network, and vendor teams during changes and incidents. **Core Physical Requirements** * Ability to stand and remain on your feet for extended periods, typically four or more consecutive hours during active shift operations. * Ability to safely lift, carry, and position equipment weighing up to 50 pounds unassisted, and heavier loads with appropriate team\-lift protocols or mechanical aids. * Comfortable working at heights including ascending and descending ladders, raised platform equipment, and elevated data center infrastructure. * Ability to work in confined spaces such as under raised floors, within enclosed rack enclosures, and in cable management pathways. * Comfortable working in environments with variable temperatures, including cold aisle containment zones and active cooling infrastructure. * Manual dexterity sufficient to handle small form\-factor components, precision cabling, and fine connector installations. * Visual acuity sufficient to read equipment labels, small\-form\-factor interface indicators, and detailed wiring diagrams in variable * lighting conditions. * Ability to push or pull equipment carts, server sleds, and wheeled infrastructure weighing up to 500 pounds on level surfaces. **On\-Call Requirement** * This role includes on\-call participation to respond to after\-hours critical power and critical cooling events, infrastructure alarms, and urgent maintenance requiring prompt engineering response. **Benefits \& Perks:** * Competitive compensation * Career growth and learning opportunities * Flexibility and ownership * Collaborative and innovative culture * Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects * International environment and talented teams **What's it like to work at Nebius:** Fast moving \- Bold thinking \- Constant growth \- Meaningful impact \- Trust and real ownership \- Opportunity to shape the future of AI **Equal Opportunity Statement:** Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire. If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Internal Tools
jobs.description: **About North Cloud** The public cloud is rapidly evolving, with businesses investing over $200 billion annually in cloud technology. As AI accelerates demand for scalable infrastructure, cloud costs are soaring, and most teams still rely on spreadsheets to manage them. At North, we’re building the next\-generation cloud, AI, and data spend management platform. We give companies real\-time visibility, control, and automation over their digital asset finances so they can grow efficiently without wasting time or money. Backed by top\-tier investors and trusted by companies managing complex cloud environments, North is building the financial operating system for the public cloud. **About the Role** ------------------ ### **Be Our First Internal Tools Engineer** You'll be North's **first dedicated Internal Tools Engineer**, joining our Engineering team to build this function from the ground up. This is an opportunity to establish the technical foundation, architecture, and best practices for how we develop internal tools, integrations, and automations across the company. You'll have significant ownership over identifying opportunities, setting technical standards, and building scalable solutions that can be reused as North grows. Rather than inheriting an established roadmap or legacy systems, you'll help define what internal tooling looks like at North and shape how we approach automation across the organization. While this is a hands\-on individual contributor role, **your work will lay the groundwork for a future Internal Tools team**. As the company scales, the systems, processes, and engineering practices you establish will serve as the foundation for expanding the function. We’re looking for an **Internal Tools Engineer** to join our Engineering team and build the systems, automations, and tools that make North operate faster and more effectively. You’ll work across all of North to identify manual, repetitive, or inefficient workflows and turn them into reliable software. That could mean building an internal application from scratch, integrating systems through APIs, automating a multi\-step operational workflow, or using AI to eliminate work that previously required significant manual effort. You won’t just receive a list of tickets. We want someone who can understand a problem, determine whether and how it should be automated, propose a technical approach, and own the solution through production. We care about building internal systems with the same engineering discipline we apply to our customer\-facing product. The goal isn’t to create a collection of one\-off scripts—it’s to build reliable, maintainable, reusable tooling that can scale with the company. You’ll sit within Engineering while partnering closely with teams across North, giving you visibility into how the entire business operates and the opportunity to improve it through software. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * **Build internal tools from end to end.** Design, develop, deploy, and maintain applications and services that help North’s teams operate more efficiently. * **Automate manual workflows.** Identify repetitive or time\-consuming processes across the company and replace them with reliable software and automation. * **Build AI\-enabled workflows.** Use LLMs, APIs, agents, and other AI technologies where they can meaningfully reduce manual work or improve decision\-making. * **Connect our systems.** Build integrations between the platforms North uses across engineering and the broader organization, creating reliable data and workflow connections between them. * **Build Python services and APIs.** Develop maintainable backend services that power internal applications, integrations, and automations. * **Create internal interfaces.** Build lightweight dashboards, applications, and interfaces that make internal systems intuitive for non\-engineering users. * **Design reusable systems.** Build service layers, libraries, abstractions, and integrations that can support multiple workflows instead of solving the same problem repeatedly. * **Own architecture decisions.** Determine the right technical approach for new tools and automations, including when to build, integrate, automate, or keep a process manual. * **Own tools in production.** Monitor, debug, maintain, and improve the systems you build as workflows and business requirements evolve. * **Build for reliability.** Implement strong testing, observability, error handling, permissions, and guardrails so internal automations can be trusted. * **Work directly with internal users.** Understand how teams actually work, translate their problems into technical requirements, and iterate based on feedback. * **Experiment quickly.** Prototype new approaches—including AI\-powered solutions—while knowing when an experiment needs to become production\-quality software. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- * 3–7 years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems * Strong Python experience and the ability to write clean, maintainable, idiomatic code * Experience building backend services, APIs, integrations, or internal applications * Strong understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, and working with third\-party platforms * Experience automating workflows or building tools that meaningfully reduced manual work * Ability to take an ambiguous operational problem and independently turn it into a technical solution * Experience designing and operating production systems rather than only building prototypes * Ability to write reusable code and abstractions instead of relying on one\-off scripts * Strong fundamentals around Git workflows, code review, testing, and collaborative software development * Strong critical thinking skills—you reason from first principles, evaluate tradeoffs, and can explain why you chose a particular approach * Pragmatic use of AI and LLM coding tools: you use them to move faster while still understanding the code, architecture, and tradeoffs behind what you ship * Strong testing discipline and an understanding that internal tooling still requires reliability, security, and maintainability * Strong communication skills and the ability to work directly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders * Comfort operating independently in a fast\-moving environment where priorities can change quickly * A builder mentality—you naturally notice inefficient processes and start thinking about how software could make them better **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience building AI\-powered internal tools, agents, or LLM\-based workflows * Experience with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, tool calling, RAG, or agentic systems * Experience with workflow automation platforms such as n8n, Zapier, or similar tools * Experience building internal admin panels, dashboards, or lightweight frontend applications * JavaScript or TypeScript experience * Experience integrating SaaS platforms across functions such as engineering, sales, recruiting, finance, or operations * Experience with AWS and cloud infrastructure * Infrastructure\-as\-code experience with tools such as Terraform * Experience with databases, data pipelines, or event\-driven architectures * Experience in a startup or similarly fast\-moving environment * Experience owning an internal platform or tool from initial problem discovery through ongoing production support * Outstanding recognition in competitions, technical projects, open\-source work, or business ventures **Work Setup** -------------- We offer both hybrid work models based out of our Dumbo Brooklyn office, as well as remote US, with opportunities to travel to the office for team onsites. **Benefits** ------------ * Unlimited PTO * 16 weeks of paid parental leave (birthing parents receive an additional 4 weeks at 50% pay) * Two company\-wide breaks per year: one around Labor Day and one at the end of the year * Aetna Medical PPO plan with the majority of the premium covered by North * Dental and vision insurance * Flexible spending account (FSA) for health expenses and commuter benefits * 30\-day sabbatical every 4 years **Compensation** ---------------- **$150,000 – $200,000 base salary, depending on experience \+ equity** **The pay range for this role is:** 150,000 \- 200,000 USD per year(USA)

Required Qualifications * 3\+ years of professional PHP development experience. * Strong, hands\-on experience with Laravel and its ecosystem. * Practical experience with Laravel Nova, including building and customizing resources, fields, actions, and administrative interfaces. * Proficiency in Vue.js, including developing and maintaining reusable components and interactive user interfaces. * Strong practical knowledge of AI technologies, LLMs, and AI\-powered application development. * Experience integrating AI models or services into applications using APIs and building functional AI\-driven features. * Understanding of prompt engineering, structured outputs, model limitations, and strategies for improving AI response quality and consistency. * Ability to identify business processes that can benefit from AI, automation, and intelligent workflows. * Solid understanding of object\-oriented programming and MVC architecture. * Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs. * Proficiency with MySQL, including database design and query optimization. * Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows. * Familiarity with JavaScript and modern frontend development practices. * Understanding of authentication, authorization, and application security. * Ability to troubleshoot complex applications independently. * Strong communication, analytical, and problem\-solving skills. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with Laravel Filament. * Experience with Tailwind CSS. * Experience building AI agents, multi\-step AI workflows, or tool\-calling integrations. * Familiarity with vector databases, embeddings, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and semantic search. * Experience connecting AI services to internal databases, APIs, and business applications. * Familiarity with AI evaluation, output validation, error handling, and safeguards against unreliable model responses. * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools to improve coding efficiency, debugging, testing, and documentation. * Understanding of AI data privacy, security, and responsible handling of sensitive information. * Familiarity with Laravel queues, jobs, events, and scheduled tasks. * Experience with Redis and caching strategies. * Familiarity with AWS, DigitalOcean, or similar cloud infrastructure. * Experience integrating payment gateways such as Stripe. * Experience with automated testing using PHPUnit or Pest. * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines. * Experience developing healthcare, telemedicine, or other regulated applications. * Knowledge of HIPAA\-related technical safeguards and secure handling of sensitive data. What We’re Looking For Beyond technical expertise, we value developers who: * Take initiative and ownership of projects. * Can work independently without constant supervision. * Have a strong interest in AI and stay informed about evolving AI technologies and practical applications. * Can confidently evaluate, implement, and optimize AI solutions rather than relying solely on prebuilt tools. * Understand how to translate business needs into reliable AI\-powered technical solutions. * Communicate clearly and proactively. * Understand the importance of delivering reliable, secure, production\-ready software. * Are comfortable working with existing codebases and modernizing legacy systems. * Can balance development speed with code quality, security, and maintainability. * Enjoy learning new technologies and continuously improving existing systems. jobs.description: **Product Data Scientist (Growth)** **About OpenArt** ----------------------------------------------------- OpenArt is an AI Storytelling and Visual Creation Platform used by millions worldwide. We’re building the next generation of creative tools powered by cutting\-edge AI, enabling anyone to create videos, visuals, characters, and stories with unprecedented speed and imagination. We believe the future of creativity is AI\-native, and we’re shaping that future. ### **Why Join OpenArt** * **Ride an inflection point.** OpenArt has grown **7–10X in revenue over the past 2 years** in one of the hottest categories in tech. Every experiment you run compounds against a steep trajectory. * **Own the experimentation practice** — you'll be the person who defines how OpenArt tests, learns, and ships product changes with real statistical rigor. * **Direct impact on the funnel.** Your work will shape activation, conversion, monetization, and retention for millions of creators. * **Meaningful equity, real upside** at an early\-stage company with strong momentum. * **Cross\-functional partnership** with Product, Design, Engineering, and Data team. * **Build from 0 1\.** Experimentation infrastructure, growth measurement, and retention frameworks are being laid down now — you'll shape them. * High ownership, low process, fast iteration environment. **About the Role** ------------------ We're looking for a **Product Data Scientist** focused on **growth and retention** to be the analytical partner PMs and engineers rely on when they ship changes to OpenArt's product experience. This role sits at the intersection of **experimentation, product analytics, and growth strategy**. Your primary job is to turn data into product decisions that move the funnel — activation, conversion, monetization, and retention — through rigorous A/B testing and sharp behavioral insights. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, and Growth — designing and analyzing experiments across signup, onboarding, activation, paywall/pricing, feature adoption, and retention loops. You'll also do the deep\-dive analyses that shape *what* teams decide to build in the first place: funnel diagnostics, cohort behavior, LTV segmentation, and retention driver analysis. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ ### **Experimentation (primary)** * Design, run, and analyze **A/B tests and other causal experiments** across signup, onboarding, activation, monetization, and retention surfaces. * Set the bar for experimental rigor at OpenArt — help decide test sizing, MDE, run duration, primary/secondary metrics, and readout standards. * Debug and resolve tricky test issues — sample ratio mismatch, novelty effects, interaction effects, multiple comparisons, segment heterogeneity. * Build and evolve OpenArt's experimentation practice as we scale — playbooks, guardrails, and post\-launch validation. ### **Growth \& retention insights** * Deep\-dive analyses on the growth funnel: signup activation paid conversion retention resurrection. * Own retention analysis — identify what drives long\-term retention vs. churn, and translate that into product recommendations. * LTV and cohort analyses that shape pricing, packaging, and monetization decisions. * Behavioral segmentation — find the user segments that matter and what drives their behavior. * Opportunity sizing — quantify the potential impact of proposed product changes *before* engineering builds them. ### **Metrics \& measurement** * Define and own key product metrics (activation, engagement, retention, monetization) alongside PMs. * Build and validate dashboards that leaders trust. * Ensure metric definitions stay consistent across product, marketing, and finance. ### **Communication \& influence** * Translate analyses into crisp, opinionated recommendations that PMs, engineers, and execs act on. * Push back with data when a proposed experiment is underpowered, mis\-scoped, or measuring the wrong thing. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- ### **Core Requirements** * **3–6 years** of experience in data science or analytics supporting product, growth, or lifecycle teams (level and title flex based on candidate). * **Solid A/B testing depth.** You've designed, run, and analyzed a lot of experiments. * **Strong SQL and Python** — comfortable working with data end\-to\-end without hand\-holding. * **Solid statistical foundation** * **Product intuition and insight\-generation instinct** * **Excellent communication** — you can tell a clear data story to a PM, an engineer, or a CPO, and hold your own in a room with strong opinions. * **High ownership and comfort in ambiguity.** ### **Nice to Have** * Experience as an early hire at a consumer startup. * Experience with consumer products, marketplaces, or subscription businesses. * Experience with experimentation platforms (in\-house or vendor: Statsig, Optimizely, etc.). * Familiarity with causal inference methods beyond A/B tests (diff\-in\-diff, synthetic control, propensity matching, CUPED). * Experience with our stack: BigQuery, Amplitude, Metabase, Stripe, GCP. * Exposure to AI/ML products or generative AI. * Comfort working across time zones with a globally distributed team. ### **Tech Stack You’ll Work With** BigQuery, SQL, Python, Amplitude, Metabase, Stripe, GCP **Compensation** ---------------- * Competitive base salary and bonus program * Equity — meaningful ownership in what you build * High autonomy, high growth environment **Work Setup** -------------- * Bay Area preferred (hybrid allowed) * Visa sponsorship available * We’ll consider remote for exceptional candidates

jobs.description: **Are you looking to Optimize your life? Start your exciting path to a rewarding career today!** We are Optimum, a leader in the fast\-paced world of connectivity, and we're seeking driven and enthusiastic professionals to join our team, empower lives, fuel businesses, and drive innovation. Connectivity is no longer a luxury, but a necessity. A career at Optimum means you'll be enabling progress and enhancing lives by providing reliable, high\-speed connectivity solutions that keep the world connected. Our successes, now and in the future, are powered by our amazing product, a commitment to our people and culture, and the connections we make in our communities. If you are resourceful, collaborative, and passionate about delivering consistent excellence, Optimum is for you! **Job Summary** --------------- The Product Security organization helps Optimum move faster, securely. We're a team of engineers who work to enable other teams to build products as quickly as possible while continuing to protect our customers. We support developers in shipping secure code by building security tools and services, providing security training and expertise, and advocating for best practices in authentication, authorization, and safe data handling across the company. As the Lead Offensive Security Engineer, you will be a founding member of Optimum's Product Offensive Security team. This is a hands\-on role with a build mandate. You will personally attack our products, including software applications, APIs, mobile, IoT and embedded devices, SaaS platforms, and the AI systems and models increasingly embedded in them. You will also build the methodology, tooling, and AI agent workflows that turn that work into a durable, scaling capability. The charter spans four connected disciplines: threat\-led security assessments, penetration testing, product red teaming, and offensive AI engineering. Our focus is the products our customers touch rather than corporate infrastructure. We measure success by risk reduced and time\-to\-test collapsed, not by findings delivered. This role is built for a self\-directed, low\-overhead operator who ships outcomes without hand\-holding, treats AI as a native part of their daily workflow, and is energized by being the first to build something new. You will set the strategy, prove the model, and establish the standards and tooling that the engineers we hire behind you will run on. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Security Assessments * Stand up and scale the product security assessment function from zero, including the intake, scoping, and triage model that decides which products get assessed and at what depth. * Lead threat\-led assessments of new, existing, and acquired products, reasoning about trust boundaries, authorization models, and data flows to find design flaws dynamic testing misses. On high\-risk launches, run them early enough to change designs, not ship dates. * Reduce our dependency on third\-party testing engagements for low and moderate\-risk applications. * Automate the repeatable parts: data collection, threat model generation, control validation, and finding triage, so human judgment goes to the flaws that need it. 2\. Penetration Testing * Plan, scope, and execute hands\-on penetration tests across applications (web, API, mobile), IoT and embedded devices, multi\-tenant SaaS, product cloud environments, and AI systems (LLMs, agents, ML pipelines). * Produce prioritized, reproducible findings with remediation guidance engineers act on, and set the methodology, rules of engagement, and quality bar for the function. 3\. Product Red Team * Design and execute objective\-based red team operations against product environments, using emulation plans grounded in telecom threat intelligence, in partnership with detection and response. * Conduct adversarial testing of AI systems: prompt injection, model evasion, data poisoning, model extraction, agent and tool abuse, and AI supply chain attacks. 4\. Offensive AI Engineering * Build and operate an AI\-driven offensive capability, orchestrating commercial and open\-source agents to cut time\-to\-test and cost\-to\-test, including continuous autonomous testing of high\-value applications against a defined quality bar. * Build internal tooling and automation across the lifecycle, from recon through reporting and remediation tracking, that turns one\-off engagements into durable capability. 5\. Program and Partnership * Partner across the security organization to feed findings into threat models and secure\-by\-default guardrails, define the metrics that show whether this function is working, and set technical direction for the engineers who join it. **Qualifications** ------------------ * 10\+ years in security engineering, including 5\+ years hands\-on offensive security across penetration testing, red teaming, assessment, or vulnerability research, or equivalent demonstrated capability. Technical degree or equivalent experience. *  action and interaction we take part in, is driven by our three Guiding Principles: Do What’s Right, Drive One Optimum, and Make It Happen. jobs.title: Senior Support Engineer, Product Data Quality & Resolution
jobs.description: **Senior Support Engineer, Product Data Quality \& Resolution** **Role Purpose** The Senior Support Engineer is responsible for investigating and resolving complex product\-data issues that prevent hardware from being successfully onboarded into Oracle data centers. Acting as a technical point of contact for operational support, the role partners with Oracle's global manufacturing partners, Product Engineering, Data Centre Operations, and cross\-functional engineering teams to investigate technical issues, identify root causes, and drive timely resolution of critical operational incidents. The successful candidate will manage technical investigations, recommend corrective actions, and identify opportunities for systemic improvement. Responsibility for implementing product or process changes will transition to the appropriate Product Engineering or Program Management teams once investigation and recommendations are complete. This role supports a global operational environment and participates in a follow\-the\-sun support model, including scheduled weekend and after\-hours coverage as required. **Technical Support \& Investigation** * Investigate and resolve complex product\-data issues impacting hardware onboarding into Oracle data centers. * Monitor, prioritize, and respond to technical support tickets within the operational support queue. * Perform technical triage to identify root causes and determine appropriate resolution paths. * Collaborate with Oracle's global manufacturing partners to investigate and resolve product\-data quality issues while ensuring corrective actions are measurable, verified, and minimize future recurrence. * Monitor daily manufacturing data feeds to identify data\-quality issues and operational exceptions requiring investigation. * Perform detailed root cause analysis, including writing SQL queries to examine raw database records and investigate non\-standard technical issues. * Read and interpret XML and JSON data to identify missing, incorrect, duplicated, or improperly formatted product information. * Utilize REST services to retrieve, validate, and submit product data where required. Use Python, where appropriate, to analyze, transform, or validate data supporting technical investigations. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Partner with Product Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Data Centre Operations, and other cross\-functional teams to coordinate technical investigations. * Recommend corrective actions that address underlying system or process issues rather than individual incidents alone. * Initiate and coordinate recommendations for systemic improvements while transitioning implementation ownership to the appropriate Product Engineering or Program Management teams. * Where investigations require work at remote manufacturing or data centre locations, coordinate appropriate handoff to the responsible Product Engineer or operational team. Track investigations, recommendations, and follow\-up activities through completion to ensure timely resolution. * **Operational Excellence** * Prioritize technical issues based on business impact, operational urgency, and data center onboarding risk. * Effectively manage competing priorities within a fast\-paced operational support environment. * Produce clear investigation reports, root cause analyses, and technical documentation. * Develop and contribute to operational knowledge articles, troubleshooting documentation, and support best practices. * Identify opportunities to improve operational processes, workflows, and data quality based on investigation outcomes. Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, from engineering teams to senior leadership. * **Required Skills and Experience** **Technical Skills** * Strong analytical, investigative, and root cause analysis skills. * Experience writing SQL queries for technical investigation and data analysis. * Strong Microsoft Excel skills for data analysis and reporting. * Ability to read and interpret XML and JSON. * Experience working with REST APIs and related data sources. * Basic Python programming skills for data analysis and automation. * Understanding of data validation and product\-data quality principles. * Familiarity with server and rack\-level hardware, configuration, and topology. Understanding of Product Bills of Materials (BOMs) and parent\-child component relationships. * **Professional Skills** * Ability to coordinate technical investigations across multiple teams and geographic regions. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Confidence communicating with both technical teams and senior leadership. * Strong organizational and prioritization skills. * Ability to perform effectively under pressure while managing multiple concurrent investigations. * Experience identifying and recommending systemic improvements that reduce recurring operational issues. Ability to collaborate effectively with globally distributed cross\-functional teams. * **Measures of Success** Success in this role will be demonstrated through: * Reduction in product\-data issues impacting hardware onboarding into Oracle data centers. * Faster investigation and resolution of critical operational incidents. * Reduced recurrence of issues through effective root cause analysis and recommended corrective actions. * Improved product\-data quality across Oracle's manufacturing partner network. * Earlier identification and resolution of data\-quality issues before products reach Oracle data centers. * Effective collaboration and communication across Manufacturing, Product Engineering, Data Centre Operations, and other global teams. * High\-quality technical documentation and knowledge sharing that improves operational efficiency. Consistent delivery of technical support within a global 24x7 operational environment. * **Location** : Houston, TX \| Austin, TX \| Nashville, TN

jobs.title: AI Solutions Developer
jobs.description: **AI Solutions Developer** ========================== Full\-time · Remote (US) P3 Adaptive is an AI and data consultancy built on Microsoft technologies: Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft 365, and Azure. We're hiring a software engineer to build AI applications across client engagements, our own products, and reusable tools for our consultants. In this role, you'll partner with clients and the consultants who know their data, work through the problem together, and build the software that solves it, whether that's an agent that answers questions about company data or an app that takes a repetitive task off someone's plate. **Why this job is different** ============================= **You'll know why you're building it.** Every project starts with a client problem we think we can solve or a tool our own team needs. Each solution is built for that client's situation. If it stops making sense, we change course. **We're honest with clients.** We don't sell anyone the wrong thing. Ever. When something isn't a good fit, we say so. **Direct client contact.** You'll be on the call with clients from the first conversation through go\-live. Nobody in between translating requirements. Real conversations with real people about real problems. **AI is how we work.** You'll use coding agents like Claude Code and Codex every day. They'll write a lot of the code. You pick the right tool for the job, decide what gets built, check that it works, and own what ships. **Remote, with a life.** We're fully remote in the US and overlap for a few core hours on weekdays. Working faster doesn't mean working more. We mean it about having a life outside work. **What you'll actually do** --------------------------- **The consulting work:** * Leading client conversations to understand the business problem behind the request, then translating it into what to build. * Keeping projects on track: raising risks early, keeping each milestone demonstrable, and flagging scope changes the moment you see them. * Training client teams so they can own and run what you build. * Spotting the next problem worth solving for a client and bringing it to your account team. * Demonstrating solutions to colleagues and clients. You'll explain how they work, answer questions about their limitations, and discuss what's needed to put them into use. **The engineering work:** * Building and maintaining AI applications and agents, taking features from a prototype through testing and deployment. * Connecting applications to Power BI semantic models, Fabric data, and other business systems through APIs, with appropriate sign\-in and access permissions. * Investigating bugs and performance problems, checking AI responses against the underlying data, and improving application reliability. * Creating examples, templates, and documentation so other people can use and maintain what you build. * Trying new AI tools on practical problems and sharing what's worth using and why. We're looking for someone who enjoys figuring things out and brings ideas of their own. You'll have support and code review from the team, with responsibility for the work you take on. Independent experimentation matters here, and so does knowing when to ask a question or work through a problem with someone else. **What you need** ----------------- **Consulting Skills** * You care as much about business impact as technical polish. * You can translate a client's frustration into a technical and human solve. * You're comfortable presenting to a C\-suite or a front\-line manager, with the professional presence clients trust with their business. * Clear communication. You can explain a technical decision to another developer and describe what an application does to someone who doesn't write code. **Engineering Skills** * Three or more years of software development experience, including maintaining applications after launch. * Experience building web applications with React and TypeScript, including connecting interfaces to APIs and working with application data. * Hands\-on experience developing software with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex. You can provide useful context, guide the work, review changes, and verify the results. * Solid programming fundamentals. You're comfortable using Git, reading unfamiliar code, and tracing problems through an application. * An understanding of Power BI and Microsoft Fabric concepts, including how data is organized and modeled for reporting and analysis. Hands\-on experience with these products is welcome but isn't required. * Familiarity with the Microsoft ecosystem and the basics of cloud services, authentication, and permissions. **Nice to have** Experience with Next.js, Python, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Graph, or MCP would be useful. Previous consulting work or experience building tools for other developers would also help. **What we offer** ----------------- * **Base salary:** $125\-150k * **Full benefits:** Medical, dental, vision, life, 401k * **Remote work:** US\-based team. Your home office wherever makes you happiest * **Professional growth:** Time built in to try new tools on real problems and share what you find. People here want to see you grow, and they'll jump in when you're stuck **Our values** -------------- We hire for the same five values in every role at P3: * **Reliable.** You do what you said you'd do, and what you ship keeps working. * **Adaptable.** The tools change every month. You change with them, and you change course when a project stops making sense. * **Proactive.** You flag a problem the moment you see it, and you fix the small things before anyone has to ask. * **Invested.** You care whether the client's business actually gets better. * **Direct.** You say plainly what works, what doesn't, and what you don't know yet. **About P3 Adaptive** --------------------- We've been modernizing organizations' relationship with data since 2010\. We pair deep technical skill with business sense, and we skip the deck theater and the jargon. Our teams are small, senior, and hands\-on, and work doesn't pass through a chain of handoffs. We're building on top of the AI wave. If you want to build the AI that changes how companies use their data, we're ready to meet you. *P3 Adaptive is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Period.* *This position is open to people authorized to work in the United States. We don't sponsor work visas.*
