jobs.title: Support Engineer II
jobs.description: **Support Engineer II** **Location:** Cincinnati, OH/Northern KY Hybrid (every other Friday onsite) **About the Role:** Path Forward IT is seeking a **Support Engineer II** to provide intermediate technical support primarily by phone and ticketing system, with occasional onsite assignments. The role is responsible for following established procedures, monitoring ticket queues, and maintaining service level agreements (SLAs) for tickets and calls. **Key Responsibilities:** * Document all activities, projects, and tickets daily in the ticketing system. * Handoff and document in\-progress tickets before the end of each shift. * Monitor ticket gateway and designated queues. * Escalate issues according to IT Glue documentation. * Resolve escalations from the Level I team as assigned. * Create or update IT Glue articles with new customer findings. * Assist with ISP and vendor calls for service outages. * Build client rapport during onsite visits (in\-person troubleshooting, site walkthroughs, client interaction). * Travel up to 25–50% as assigned. **Expectations:** * Maintain established call and ticket SLAs as defined by manager. * Maintain customer satisfaction (CSAT) scores as defined by manager. * Submit weekly timesheets by end of shift Friday. * Work and document established billable hours each week. * Be available for on\-call weeks and company\-wide outage responses. * Meet annual goals and objectives set in HRIS with quarterly reviews. **Technical Proficiencies:** * **Ticketing software:** Incident management and time tracking. * **Remote support:** Running scripts and pushing actions. * **Active Directory:** Strong knowledge of domain controllers, group policy, and security groups. * **Virtualization:** Strong knowledge of VMware/Hyper\-V for incident and operational support. * **Microsoft Windows/Servers:** Strong knowledge of patching, maintenance, and differentiating physical/virtual servers; ability to add new drivers to print servers. * **Networking:** Strong troubleshooting skills (DHCP, DNS, VLAN, and circuit/ISP issues). * **AzureAD and Microsoft 365:** Strong working knowledge. * **Microsoft Servers and Network Equipment:** Installation, troubleshooting, and training. * **Project Documentation:** Proficiency with central repositories for project documentation. * Maintain a strong understanding of technical infrastructure (servers, networks, and applications). * Software as assigned. **Physical Requirements:** * Ability to handle equipment, talk, hear, read, write, and interpret documents. * Occasionally lift and move objects up to 25 pounds (with or without reasonable accommodations). **Why Join Path Forward IT?** Path Forward IT, a Blue Alliance company, is a nationally recognized managed services provider (MSP) that exclusively supports the healthcare industry. Ranked among the top 15% of MSPs nationwide, we deliver world\-class IT services that ensure technology never stands in the way of patients receiving the care they need. Our work is driven by urgency, empathy, and a patient\-centered mindset. We understand the critical nature of healthcare operations and prioritize our work to empower providers to focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional care. Founded in 2002, Path Forward IT has grown to a team of over 100 professionals located across 40\+ states. We foster a collaborative, career\-focused culture where team members thrive. Many of our employees have been with us for years, and we regularly celebrate 5\- and 10\-year milestones. **A Team Environment Built for Growth:** Joining Path Forward IT means working alongside IT specialists supporting complex, enterprise environments. As part of the Blue Alliance network, you gain access to a community of hundreds of peers and experts across the country. This means more opportunities for learning, professional development, and career advancement without losing the close\-knit feel of a smaller team.You’ll enjoy the best of both worlds: * The autonomy and client engagement typical of a local MSP * The resources, support, and structure of a leading national IT services organization **A Unique Opportunity Through Blue Alliance:** As a Blue Alliance partner company, Path Forward IT provides team members with unmatched opportunities to learn, lead, and succeed. Each company in the network maintains its unique identity while working toward shared goals. If you’re looking to make a meaningful impact and grow your career in a supportive, future\-focused environment, this is the place for you. **Benefits of working at** **Path Forward** **IT:** * Be part of a fun, awesome team * 9 paid holidays * 401K Retirement with matching contributions * Excellent medical, vision and dental insurance * Life insurance and disability insurance * Cell phone stipend * 3 weeks PTO **Top Reasons our Employees Love Being Part of the Blue Alliance Family:** * Entrepreneurial Culture * Fast\-paced Flow, with a Variety of Projects * Collaborative Work Environment * Training \& Certifications * Career Growth Opportunities **Ready for the next step?** The greatest rewards are reserved for those who want to be better and then put in the hard work, to be their best version of themselves. Interested applicants should click to submit their resume and application above.*Please be* *advised* *we,* *Path Forward IT,* *participate* *in E\-Verify.*

This is a unique opportunity to define engineering standards, influence technical strategy across multiple teams, and pioneer modern AI\-assisted engineering practices. As a senior technical leader, you'll help establish the technical patterns, frameworks, and best practices that enable teams to build reliable, scalable, and intelligent data solutions. You'll partner with engineers, product leaders, and data practitioners to solve complex business challenges while advancing the future of our data platform. ### **About Pax8** Pax8 is a leading cloud marketplace that connects managed service providers, technology vendors, and businesses around the world through a modern, streamlined platform. jobs.title: Sr. Backend Engineer
jobs.description: Peek is the operating system powering the experiences industry \- from museums and attractions to tours and activities. With over $7B in bookings, Peek’s AI\-powered platform has helped thousands of merchants to increase revenues, save time, and deliver seamless guest experiences. Customers include MoMA, Whitney Museum, Seattle Aquarium, Bryant Park \& Looping Group. The company has raised over $150 million from institutional investors Westcap, Goldman Sachs, and SpringCoast Partners. Learn more at www.peek.com. As a remote\-first company recognized by Forbes as one of America's Best Startup Employers and by Built In as a 2025 and 2026 Best Place to Work, we are a global team of "Peeksters" who "Obsess Over Our Customers," "Accomplish Big Things," "Collaborate With Purpose," and "Get Better Every Day. **The Role** ------------ We work on several systems: our ACME operations management suite, embeddable scheduling and booking widgets, B2B and B2C sales and support tooling, and custom solutions for enterprise operators. The work is technically varied and the stakes are real: operators depend on this software to run their businesses. We’re hiring a Senior Backend Engineer with strong technical depth who is also highly effective with AI\-assisted development. You reason independently about complex systems, find the problems that aren't obvious from the requirements, and use AI as a tool to build faster while owning every decision it informs. That means you know how to break down ambiguous problems, delegate to agents, review their work critically, and course\-correct when things go sideways. You'll join the platform team, working deep in our existing systems, including ACME Core, to make other teams faster and safer, using AI\-assisted development as a force multiplier for your engineering judgment, not a replacement for it. The platform team works closely with DevOps, who own our infrastructure, so this is a backend\-focused role rather than an infrastructure one. Over the past few months, we've seen a step\-function improvement in the reliability and capabilities of long\-running AI agents. We're adapting our engineering practice to match, and we want strong backend engineers who are already building this way and excited to push it further. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Work as part of the platform team, improving the backend systems, tooling, and practices that other teams build on. Feature development is still part of the role where it fits. * Identify automation opportunities across the engineering workflow (repetitive manual work, slow or fragile processes, recurring operational toil) and build the solutions, using AI agents where they help. * Enable other teams: build and maintain shared services, libraries, and APIs, make the right way the easy way, and unblock engineers who depend on the platform through guidance, documentation, and code review. * Own security fixes and dependency updates across our backend systems: triage vulnerabilities, plan and ship upgrades safely in an existing codebase, and make sure they don't break the teams and services that depend on them. * Identify and diagnose performance bottlenecks, and recognize scalability limits before they become production problems. * Reason about concurrency, failure modes, and reliability across APIs and integrations. * Own your services in production: monitoring, debugging, performance, and reliability. When something breaks, you get to root cause and fix it properly. * Contribute to our AI\-first engineering culture, share patterns, document what works, and help the team level up on how we build with AI. * Use AI tools fluently \- Claude Code, Augment or equivalent, to compress implementation time, then critically review everything that comes out of them. AI makes a strong engineer faster; it does not replace technical judgment. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- **Required** * 5\+ years of professional backend development using Java, with a meaningful track record of shipping and operating production systems. * Strong system design: you make sound architectural decisions, think about tradeoffs, edge cases, and what happens when things scale or fail, and you know when a simple solution is enough. * Strong backend fundamentals: API design, integrations, concurrency, failure modes, and service reliability. * Deep understanding of database behavior: data modeling, query design, indexing, and the performance implications of your choices. * Proven ability to diagnose performance bottlenecks and debug complex production issues to root cause, including problems that aren't obvious from the requirements. * Comfortable working in an existing, evolving codebase: you can get up to speed quickly, make safe incremental changes, and leave things better than you found them, without defaulting to rewrites. * Hands\-on, daily use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or equivalent) in a production engineering workflow, as a force multiplier on top of strong fundamentals. * Ability to critically evaluate AI\-generated code: catch logic errors, identify security issues, assess maintainability, and own what gets merged regardless of how it was written. * Clear communicator: you can articulate why you made a technical choice, flag when a spec has holes, and disagree constructively. * Interest in Elixir or functional programming languages as we expand our stack **Nice to haves** ----------------- * Experience building B2B SaaS products, ideally with complex multi\-tenant data models or transactional workflows. * Experience on small, high\-output teams where you've had to make architectural calls without a committee. * Familiarity with frontend development and JavaScript/TypeScript (Angular or modern JS frameworks), enough to collaborate effectively with frontend engineers and understand how your APIs are consumed. * Experience on a platform, internal tooling, or developer\-enablement team, including security patching and dependency upgrades in a large existing codebase. * Background in the travel, hospitality, or experiences industry. **What We Value** ----------------- A few things that define how we build: * Depth first. We value engineers who understand how systems actually behave: databases, concurrency, failure modes, and performance. AI amplifies that understanding; it doesn't replace it. * Judgment over speed. AI compresses implementation time. What differentiates engineers now isn't typing speed or memorized syntax, it's the ability to make the right calls on what to build, how to build it, and when it's not ready to ship. * Ownership. You built it? You own it. That includes AI\-generated code. You know when to use agents and when to do it yourself. * Directness. We want people who ask hard questions, surface problems early, and are willing to push back on a bad spec rather than build it and hope for the best. * Quality as a habit. Peer code reviews, test coverage, and clean APIs are not optional. We move fast, but not by cutting corners on the things that compound. Peek Travel Inc. is an equal\-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. If you are unable to apply due to incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at talent@peek.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for disability assistance as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Product Builder
jobs.description: **Position Summary** The Product Builder owns a feature from technical kickoff through merged, released code. Working from a validated problem, prototype, and specification produced by Product and Design, the Product Builder designs the system, plans the implementation, and directs AI coding agents to produce the code \- then carries accountability for its correctness, security, and long\-term maintainability. This role is defined by ownership of a complete feature. Product Builders produce architecture, contracts, program design, and verified working software. The primary means of producing code is the direction and review of AI agents, which makes judgment, system design decisions, and rigorous review the central skills of the role. Product Builders work on an applications platform maintained by the Application Platform Architect, and against data contracts and standards owned by the Data Platform Architect. **What You Own** * Feature architecture. System design, component and feature contracts, data model, endpoint and API design, and the constraints and requirements the feature must satisfy. * Program design. Test approaches and seams, program layout and call stacks, component trees and dependencies — defined before implementation begins, because agents build from the plan you write. There can be crossover here with the Application Platform Architect making for collaborative opportunities with that role. * Vertical slices. Implementation order, the multi\-repository coordination map, and incremental pull requests linked to their tracked issues. You decide how the work is sequenced and how the agent is orchestrated to build it. * Agent orchestration. Translating architecture and program design into effective agent tasking; evaluating agent output critically; recognizing when generated code is plausible but wrong, subtly unsafe, or architecturally inconsistent. Keeping your agent orchestration flow up to date, effective and efficient for the product(s) you work on and own. * Pull request quality. Agentic code review, CI/CD checks, unit tests, and security and SAST scans. Human review of the evolving codebase and validation that the implementation matches the intended architecture. * Release readiness. Shared accountability with Product, Design, and Leadership that a feature is ready to go to the field. **What You Participate In** * Technical kickoff. You join the walkthrough of problem, outcomes, prototype, and constraints, and you are expected to surface technical risk early \- before architecture begins \- rather than discovering it mid\-implementation. Collaboration with the Product team is essential throughout product building and starts here. * Cross\-functional review. You work directly with Design on QA against the prototype, with Product on AI evaluation results and scope drift, and with the platform architects when a feature requires a capability or data contract that does not yet exist. **What You Do Not Own** Problem framing, success metrics, research, prioritization, and the product specification are owned by Product, Design, and Leadership. The shared repositories, CI/CD pipeline, and data platform are owned by the platform architects. Product Builders influence all of these and are expected to push back when something is wrong \- but the decisions rest elsewhere. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience * Experience building and shipping production software * Demonstrated ability to design a system \- not just implement one \- including data modeling, API design, and defining contracts between components * Strong code review skills, with the judgment to identify correctness, security, and maintainability problems in code you did not write * Working knowledge of automated testing strategy: what to test, where the seams are, and what adequate coverage looks like * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control workflows, and secure development practices including static analysis and dependency scanning * Ability to decompose a feature into incremental, independently reviewable slices * Clear written and verbal communication with non\-engineering partners, including Product, Design, and clinical stakeholders * Ability to work with protected health information in accordance with HIPAA and internal data governance requirements **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience directing AI coding agents or working extensively with AI\-assisted development tooling * Experience in healthcare technology, particularly home health, hospice, or post\-acute care * Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7 and FHIR * Experience integrating with third\-party clinical or operational platforms * Experience working in a monorepo with shared CI/CD infrastructure * Exposure to evaluating AI\-driven product features, including defining evaluation criteria and test cases **Core Competencies** --------------------- Systems thinking. You reason about how a change propagates through a system, not just whether a function returns the right value. Verification discipline. You treat generated code as a proposal requiring proof, not as an answer. You are comfortable saying an implementation is wrong even when tests pass. Ownership. You carry a feature to shipped and correct, including the unglamorous parts — error states, offline behavior, edge cases, and rollback. Collaboration across disciplines. You engage seriously with clinical and product context rather than treating requirements as a queue. **Why Join Us?** Something else that sets us apart from other companies is the quality of our most valuable resources – our people! We are dedicated to living out our culture as defined by our core values, “**CAPLICO**”: * Customer Second – We prioritize and support our team so they can deliver exceptional care. * Accountability – Own your work and outcomes. * Passion for Learning – Grow continuously with curiosity and culture. * Love One Another – Build authentic, respectful, and trusting relationships. * Intelligent Risk Taking – Innovate and challenge the status quo. * Celebrate – Recognize the small wins, they add up! * Ownership – Be the CEO of your role. **Additional Benefits:** * True Work\-Life balance – We believe in taking care of yourself before you take care of others! * Full benefits package (medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match) * Paid time off, holiday pay, and professional development Your voice matters! \- Work with other passionate and high\-achieving leaders who care deeply about patient outcomes and team success. * **About Pennant Services** We support over 250 home health, hospice, senior living, and home care operations across 19 states. Our Service Center model empowers local leadership while providing centralized clinical, legal, HR, IT, and compliance support to help ensure high\-quality care. www.pennantgroup.com The employer for this position is stated in the job posting. The Pennant Group, Inc. is a holding company of independent operating subsidiaries that provide healthcare services through home health and hospice agencies and senior living communities located throughout the US. Each of these businesses is operated by a separate, independent operating subsidiary that has its own management, employees and assets. More information about The Pennant Group, Inc. is available at http://www.pennantgroup.com.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, AI
jobs.description: PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding *what can be built, where, and how*. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest\-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean\-energy, and infrastructure development across the country. Despite being a $1\.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de\-risk projects, and scale with confidence. As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization. We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top\-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber. **Our HQ is in New York City with a hybrid schedule (3 in\-office days per week). We prefer NYC\-based candidates or those open to relocation.** **Role Overview** ================= We're hiring a Staff/Principal Engineer to build PermitFlow's core product AI Assistant, infrastructure, and workflow agents. This is a role that will require UX and technical acumen to deliver high quality agents in a genuinely complex domain, while also up\-leveling our core agentic infrastructure and data flywheel. Submitting a permit means comprehending construction documents, extracting project details, confirming every requirement has been met and often filling in pdf forms. Errors compound across steps and a failed submission adds real cost for our customers as projects slow. The ideal candidate will mix an exceptional history of product delivery with true experience building AI and Agentic infrastructure from the ground up. You ship quickly, instrument everything, hold a high quality bar, and stay close to the users of what you build. This role reports directly to our VP of Engineering. We're hiring at Staff or Principal, with the level based on past experience and interview performance. **What You'll Do** ================== * Own the agent architecture. Design the reasoning loop, planning and decomposition strategy, state and session model, and recovery behavior for long\-running tasks. * Build the context layer. Retrieval, memory, and context\-window management over project documents, jurisdictional requirements, prior submissions, and customer\-specific conventions. * Design the action surface. Define the tools the assistant can call, the permissions model around them, and the human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints for actions that are expensive or irreversible. * Make evaluation the engine of progress. Stand up offline and online eval harnesses that measure task completion and failure modes. Build the iteration loop that lets the whole team improve agent quality on evidence. * Set the bar for the org. Establish the abstractions, SDKs, and review standards other engineers build agentic features on. * Stay close to the customer. Sit with permit coordinators and builders, watch the assistant fail in real conditions, and bring that back into the system design. **What We're Looking For** ========================== * You've shipped an assistant or agentic product at meaningful scale * Deep, current knowledge of the agentic stack (tool calling and tool design, context engineering, memory, retrieval, orchestration patterns, etc) * You’ve built eval harnesses that changed what a team worked on, and you can articulate what makes an eval trustworthy. * You are a genuinely strong software engineer, not an AI specialist who needs someone else to make it production\-ready. You’ve owned services in production and you write code that other people are glad to inherit. * You operate with earned authority. You influence through demonstrated judgment, working code, and clear writing rather than title or mandate. * 10\+ years of software engineering experience with recent time spent building LLM\-powered products. **What We Offer** ================= * Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high\-growth company * 100% company\-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees \+ healthcare FSA * 401(k) savings plan * Unlimited PTO and paid family leave * Home office \& equipment stipend * Daily in\-office lunch and dinner provided * Commuter benefits (pre\-tax transit and parking) *PermitFlow provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or family status, as protected by applicable law.* *We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.* Compensation Range: $250K \- $300K

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Perception
jobs.description: ### **About Us** At Pickle Robot, we're on a mission to automate global supply chains with Physical AI. Our robots work alongside warehouse teams to unload trucks and containers — one of the toughest, most understaffed jobs in logistics — making the work safer, faster, and more efficient for the people doing it. Loading trucks comes next, followed by the Dill Autonomy Engine: generalized autonomy that will eventually orchestrate robots across entire logistics processes. We're looking for a rigorous and self\-directed Senior Machine Learning Engineer to own machine learning problems end\-to\-end on the systems that decide how our robots grasp packages. This role will focus on problem formulation, building the data engines that feed our models, training and experimentation, and the evaluation rigor that tells us whether a model is genuinely better. Our platform and robotics engineers own runtime integration and edge deployment, so you can stay focused on the modeling loop. ### **What You'll Do** * Own ML Problem Formulation: You will turn ambiguous picking performance goals into well\-posed ML problems, deciding what the model predicts, how labels and rewards are defined, what loss to optimize, and what "better" actually means. This is the core of the role. * Build the Data Engine: You will own dataset strategy end\-to\-end, from large\-scale synthetic scene generation and distributed cloud dataset jobs to scene diversity filtering and self\-supervised label generation. You will identify when the data, rather than the model, is the bottleneck, and fix it. * Train and Iterate on Large Vision Models: You will fine\-tune large backbones with multiple task\-specific heads, run disciplined experiments, and know both which experiment to run next and when to stop. * Own Evaluation and Verification: You will define offline metrics that predict on\-robot outcomes and online metrics that help you improve performance on edge cases. * Drive Technical Excellence: As a senior member of the team, you will conduct rigorous code reviews, mentor engineers earlier in their careers, and contribute to the perception and grasping roadmap. * Hand Off Cleanly to Production: You will produce deployable models with sane latency budgets, exportable graphs, and reproducible artifacts, partnering with the engineers who own runtime integration and inference optimization rather than owning that yourself. ### **What You'll Bring** * 5\+ Years of Experience in Machine Learning and Computer Vision, including models you personally carried from problem statement to measured outcome. * A track record of framing problems. You can translate high\-level product requirements into specific engineering tasks and explain technical trade\-offs to non\-expert stakeholders. * Hands\-on Experience Building Datasets at Scale: generation or collection, curation, automated quality assurance, coverage and bias analysis, and active learning to systematically close edge cases. * Rigorous Evaluation Habits: baselines, ablations, metric design, and a clear sense of when a result is real. * Expert\-level Python and PyTorch skills. * Comfortable with cloud training infrastructure (GCP or AWS), Docker, and experiment tracking tools. * **Professional experience with at least one of the following:** + Developing and training multi\-task models + Developing and training multi\-modal models + Developing and training multi–view models + Self\-supervised, outcome\-based, or reward\-driven learning. ### **Pay at Pickle** At Pickle Robot Company, we believe transparency builds trust. The salary range listed here is provided in accordance with Massachusetts law and reflects what we reasonably and in good faith expect to offer for this role. We often consider candidates at different levels of seniority, and final compensation will reflect the level at which a candidate is hired, along with factors like experience and location. ### **Pickle Perks** Pickle provides best\-in\-class benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance; unlimited vacation; paid federal and state holidays; 401(k) contributions of 5% of your salary; company\-covered travel expenses; and other perks to make your working life more fun, comfortable, and productive. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.description: PlanITROI is hiring a proven, hands\-on AI Agent builder who specializes in B2B lead generation. You must have personally architected, built, deployed, and operated AI agents that generate measurable B2B prospecting results. **We're seeking an AI engineer who can build the intelligence behind the system** AI agents that use tools, make decisions, coordinate workflows, and turn enterprise buying signals into qualified sales meetings. If you are an expert at building AI agents for B2B lead generation and can prove they work, we want to meet you. **About PlanITROI** 25 years of success. Global industry recognition. Founder\-led. No corporate red tape. An ambitious future powered by AI and Robotics! For more than 25 years, PlanITROI has helped enterprise organizations maximize the financial value of retired technology through IT lifecycle management, repair, refurbishment, redeployment, remarketing, reverse logistics, and secure IT Asset Disposition (ITAD). PlanITROI is recognized in Gartner's ITAD Market Guide, is an IAITAM Platinum Sponsor, and has built our business around reuse\-as\-intended\-use, prioritizing reuse over recycling. **Our mission:** Maximize the financial value of technology while extending its useful life. Every device we recover creates value for clients, reduces unnecessary electronic waste, and gives technology a second life as affordable technology. **Why you'll love working here** **Founder\-led. Move fast. Get things done.** Work directly with entrepreneurial leadership. No layers of corporate bureaucracy or endless approval cycles. Great ideas get heard, tested, and implemented. **Built like an AI startup, backed by an established company.** Bring your engineering ideas to a business with 25 years of enterprise relationships, operating experience, and real market opportunities. **Engineer something big.** Build AI agents capable of researching 5,000\+ enterprise accounts, identifying buying signals, reaching 250,000\+ potential right contacts, and generating qualified meetings at scale. **See measurable results.** Your agents will directly influence enterprise revenue and help more technology get repaired, reused, and returned to productive use. **Work with people who value builders.** We believe in optimism, discipline, humility, ownership, continuous improvement, and recognizing teammates who help others succeed. **Your mission: Build an intelligent AI\-powered lead generation engine** Design, build, deploy, and continuously improve an interconnected system of specialized AI agents that identifies enterprise buying opportunities and converts them into qualified meetings. You will own the technical outbound engine end to end, from buying\-signal detection and account intelligence to contact discovery, multichannel orchestration, CRM integration, experimentation, and measurement. Our target market (ICP) includes enterprise organizations with 5,000 to 1,000,000\+ employees, 80%\+ mostly knowledge workers with complex buying committees, and existing technology providers. Your challenge is to find the right buyer, recognize the right moment, and create a compelling reason to engage in PlanITROI. *This role reports to the Founder \& CEO and the Chief Strategy Officer. You'll work directly with them and the VP of Marketing, with no layers in between.* **Your goal:** Qualified enterprise meetings generated and MSA's signed! **What you will build and own** * **AI Intent Signal Detection Agents.** Identify, ingest, evaluate, and score buying signals, including technology refresh cycles, leadership changes, office moves, M\&A, RFP activity, contract timing, job postings, technology initiatives, and social activity. Trigger the right next action. * **AI Buying Committee Intelligence Agents.** Identify high\-value ICP accounts, research enterprise organizations, map buying committees, select the best 1 to 5 contacts for each entry point, validate contact information, and continuously track changes. * **AI Personalization \& Challenger Messaging Agents.** Combine account intelligence, buying signals, persona\-specific pain points, account history, and incumbent\-provider context to create relevant, personalized outreach at scale. * **AI Multichannel Orchestration Agents.** Coordinate email, LinkedIn, voicemail drops, AI calling where appropriate, and human SDR/BDR follow\-up. Manage sequencing, timing, channel rules, routing, and next\-best actions. * **AI Objection Handling \& Follow\-Up Agents.** Recognize and respond intelligently to objections such as "We already have a provider." Maintain conversational context, determine appropriate follow\-up, and escalate to humans when needed. * **AI Performance \& Optimization Agents.** Measure results across signals, personas, channels, and campaigns. Identify winning and losing hypotheses, recommend experiments, and improve qualified meeting conversion. *These are functional capabilities, not a requirement to deploy six separate agents. You will desi  agents that run on top of them is. We are seeking proven hands\-on expertise in: * **AI agent engineering:** LLMs, tool calling, reasoning workflows, agent memory, state management, multi\-agent orchestration, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * **Agent frameworks:** LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, or comparable frameworks. * **Software development:** Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, APIs, webhooks, custom integrations, and automation architecture. * **GTM integrations:** Salesforce, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, 6sense, Bombora\-type intent sources, and AI calling/voicemail platforms. * **Enterprise prospecting:** Intent signals, ICP scoring, buying\-committee identification, contact resolution, enrichment, personalization, objection handling, and multichannel sequence design. * **Production operations:** Agent monitoring, debugging, data quality, CRM synchronization, deduplication, deliverability, compliance, error handling, and auditability. * **Scale:** Engineering reliable systems capable of very high outbound volumes, reaching 250,000\+ contacts across email, LinkedIn, and voicemail, while protecting platform limits, accuracy, compliance, and deliverability. * This role opreates on Eastern Time Zone You must understand both the technical engineering and the B2B prospecting strategy required to turn agents into a functioning revenue system. **What success looks like** * **Qualified meetings generated:** Your primary business outcome. Meetings must satisfy defined ICP, persona, and business\-need criteria. * **Signal\-to\-meeting conversion:** How effectively your agents convert meaningful buying signals into conversations and qualified meetings. * **Contact Precision:** Reaching the right decision\-makers and buying committees. * **Agent deployment velocity:** How quickly you turn a campaign idea into a reliable, working agent and live test. * **Multichannel conversion:** Positive responses, conversations, qualified meetings, and opportunities by signal, persona, channel, and campaign. * **System reliability:** Data accuracy, deliverability, CRM integrity, routing, compliance, and scalability. * **Learning rate:** How quickly do you identify what isn't working, fix root causes, and scale what produces results. **Our hiring process: Show me, don't tell me** We hire proof, not interviews alone. We're not interested in theoretical AI expertise or polished presentations about what agents might do. The process has three stages: * **Live demo.** Show us AI agents you personally built and deployed for B2B lead generation, and the results they produced. * **Build a project.** Build an outbound agent from a campaign premise we give you, using your own tools. * **Live technical session.** Demo your build, work a live account, and walk us through your architecture. Across these stages, be ready to show: * Your agent architecture, decision logic, prompts, tools, data integrations, and orchestration. * How your agents identify opportunities and execute prospecting workflows. * How do your agents handle exceptions, incomplete data, failures, and human intervention? * Real performance data: qualified meetings, pipelines, conversions, or measurable improvements your systems produced. **Ready for the challenge?** If you love solving difficult technical problems and want to build something ambitious, PlanITROI is where you can make an impact. Bring your engineering expertise, working agents, ideas, and your drive to succeed. We'll bring 25 years of industry experience, enterprise relationships, a substantial market opportunity, and the ability to move fast. **Build the agents. Own the results. Help us grow.** *PlanITROI offers a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, a 401(k) with company match, paid time off, and more. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and value diversity at all levels of the organization.* Learn more: PlanITROI.com \| NextraTech.com \| DigitalDreamsProject.com

We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go\-to\-market for a category that does not fully exist yet. **Your Role** ------------- Every serious AI team evaluating infrastructure asks the same question: will this actually run my workload better, faster, or cheaper than what I have today? Most vendors answer with slides. We want to answer with benchmarks on the customer's own workload, and then design the production architecture that delivers on them. As our Founding Solutions Architect, your mission is to make Prime Intellect the technical winner in every deal. You will own the path from workload discovery through architecture, benchmark, proof of concept, and production design. You will sit with customers' ML engineers to understand what they are actually training and serving — GPU type, cluster requirements, networking, utilization and performance objectives — then design the right architecture on Prime infrastructure, run the POC against their baseline and the competitive alternatives, and turn latency, throughput, utilization, and cost results into a technical business case that holds up under scrutiny. This is a founding role. There is no playbook yet for how we prove technical wins; you will write it. The benchmark methodologies, reference architectures, and POC frameworks you build will become how Prime Intellect sells to every lab and enterprise that follows. **Responsibilities** -------------------- **Technical Discovery \& Architecture** * Lead deep technical discovery across training, post\-training, and inference workloads * Understand each customer's GPU requirements, cluster topology, networking, storage, utilization patterns, and performance objectives * Design customer architectures on Prime infrastructure that meet those objectives and are ready for production * Partner with engineering on migration and deployment requirements so what we design is what gets shipped **Benchmarks, POCs \& the Technical Business Case** * Own workload benchmarks and proofs of concept against customer baselines and competitive alternatives * Translate latency, throughput, utilization, and cost results into a defensible technical business case for ML engineers and executive buyers alike * Set the standard for benchmark quality: methodology, reproducibility, and honest comparison * Drive time to technical validation down with every deal **Playbooks \& Platform Adoption** * Develop repeatable benchmark and reference\-architecture playbooks that scale beyond you * Support technical evaluation and adoption of Model Factory, bringing customers from compute onto the full training stack * Feed what you learn from customer workloads back into product and research priorities **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * Strong ML infrastructure, distributed systems, cloud, or GPU\-compute background * Working knowledge of modern training and inference stacks, CUDA/GPU environments, and model\-serving patterns * Customer\-facing experience in solutions architecture, sales engineering, forward\-deployed engineering, or a similar role * Ability to communicate fluently with both ML engineers and executive stakeholders — and to know which conversation you are in * A strong bias toward proving claims with real customer workloads and benchmarks rather than slides * High ownership — you see gaps and build the fix before anyone asks * AI\-native in how you work: you use LLMs, automation, and programmatic tools to move faster **Bonus:** * Hands\-on experience running or optimizing large\-scale distributed training (FSDP, Megatron, DeepSpeed, or similar) or high\-throughput inference (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT\-LLM) * Experience benchmarking across hardware generations (H100, H200, GB200\) and interconnects (InfiniBand, RoCE) * Background at a GPU cloud, neocloud, hyperscaler AI team, or frontier lab infrastructure team * Experience building a solutions or forward\-deployed function from scratch **How We Measure Success** -------------------------- Technical win rate · POC\-to\-commercial conversion · Time to technical validation · Benchmark quality · Deployment readiness · Model Factory technical attach **Why This Role** ----------------- You will be the technical face of Prime Intellect in every deal that matters, working directly with the ML teams at labs and enterprises deciding where to build — and with our own research and engineering teams on what the platform needs to win. You will see more real\-world training and inference workloads in a year than most engineers see in a career, and you will define how a new category of infrastructure proves itself. **What We Offer** ----------------- * Cash compensation range of $250–$320k \+ meaningful equity * Flexible work (remote or San Francisco), with travel to customer sites as needed * Visa sponsorship and relocation support * Professional development budget * Team off\-sites and conferences * A front\-row seat to building the infrastructure layer for open AI

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer – Microsoft Fabric & Healthcare Integrations
jobs.description: **Senior Data Engineer – Microsoft Fabric \& Healthcare Integrations** **Location:** Dallas–Fort Worth, TX **Employment Type:** Full\-Time **Work Arrangement:** In\-Office **Compensation:** 125,000–150,000 per year, depending on experience **About the Role** We are a growing multi\-site healthcare organization building a centralized data and analytics platform to support better operational decision\-making, reporting, automation, and future AI initiatives. We are looking for a hands\-on Senior Data Engineer to lead the development of this data foundation. This is not primarily a reporting or dashboard development role. You will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the infrastructure that moves data from our core operational systems—including our electronic health record (eClinicalWorks) and CRM (HubSpot)—into Microsoft Fabric. You will have significant ownership over how our data platform is designed from the beginning and will work directly with operational and technical stakeholders to turn fragmented healthcare and business data into reliable, reusable data products. **What You Will Build** Your initial focus will be establishing our Microsoft Fabric environment and creating a scalable data architecture that can support the organization long term. You will: * Design and implement our Microsoft Fabric data architecture using OneLake, Lakehouse/Warehouse, Data Factory pipelines, notebooks, and related Fabric services. * Build and maintain data ingestion pipelines from eClinicalWorks, HubSpot, APIs, databases, files, and future enterprise systems. * Work with REST APIs, FHIR APIs, webhooks, batch exports, and other integration methods to reliably extract source\-system data. * Establish raw, validated, and analytics\-ready data layers using a medallion\-style architecture. * Clean, standardize, deduplicate, and reconcile data across systems. * Develop data models for patients, referrals, appointments, providers, procedures, cases, outcomes, and other operational entities. * Develop methods for matching records across systems when identifiers are inconsistent or unavailable. * Create reusable curated datasets that support Power BI reporting, operational analytics, automation, and future AI applications. * Implement incremental loading, change detection, schema management, error handling, logging, alerting, and pipeline monitoring. * Establish data quality checks and processes for identifying incomplete, inconsistent, or unexpected source data. * Implement appropriate security, access controls, and governance practices for healthcare data. * Use Git and CI/CD practices so data pipelines and transformations are version\-controlled, documented, and maintainable. * Monitor Fabric usage, performance, capacity, and cost as the platform grows. * Document architecture, data definitions, pipelines, dependencies, and operating procedures. * Maintain and improve the platform after the initial implementation rather than treating the project as a one\-time migration. **First 6–12 Month Priorities** A successful candidate should be able to take ownership of the platform from architecture through production. Early priorities will include: * Assess our existing systems, data sources, reporting requirements, and Microsoft environment. * Design and configure the initial Microsoft Fabric architecture. * Establish secure and reliable ingestion from HubSpot and eClinicalWorks. * Create a raw historical data layer that preserves source\-system data. * Build cleaned and standardized datasets that reconcile information across systems. * Create an initial analytics\-ready data model for high\-priority operational reporting. * Implement automated pipeline monitoring, data\-quality validation, documentation, and recovery processes. * Establish engineering standards that allow additional data sources and use cases to be added without rebuilding the platform. **Required Experience** We are looking for someone who has actually built and operated modern data platforms, not someone whose experience is primarily reporting or visualization. Strong candidates should have: * 4\+ years of professional data engineering, data platform, or data integration experience. * Hands\-on experience building production solutions with Microsoft Fabric or a closely related Azure data stack. * Strong SQL skills. * Strong Python and/or PySpark skills. * Experience designing ETL/ELT pipelines and data ingestion frameworks. * Experience with Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse, OneLake, Data Factory/Pipelines, notebooks, Delta tables, or equivalent technologies. * Experience integrating third\-party systems through REST APIs. * Experience implementing incremental data loads rather than relying only on full data refreshes. * Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, relational modeling, lakehouse architecture, and analytics\-oriented data modeling. * Experience troubleshooting API authentication, pagination, rate limits, schema changes, malformed records, pipeline failures, and other real\-world integration issues. * Experience with Git, source control, and CI/CD practices. * Experience implementing monitoring, logging, data\-quality validation, and alerting for production pipelines. * Ability to work independently and make practical architectural decisions in an environment where the data platform is still being built. **Healthcare / Integration Experience** Healthcare experience is strongly preferred. Experience with any of the following would be particularly valuable: * Healthcare EHR/EMR data * eClinicalWorks * FHIR / HL7 * Healthcare operational or clinical data models * HIPAA\-regulated data environments * Patient identity matching or Master Patient Index concepts * HubSpot APIs and CRM data * Microsoft Entra ID and Azure security * Microsoft Purview or other data governance tools * Power BI semantic models Direct eClinicalWorks experience is a major plus but is not required if you have strong healthcare API/FHIR integration experience and can quickly learn unfamiliar source systems. **What This Role Is Not** This is not a Power BI developer position with occasional data engineering responsibilities. Power BI knowledge is useful, but the primary responsibility is building the reliable data infrastructure underneath reporting, analytics, automation, and AI applications. We need someone comfortable working at the level of APIs, pipelines, Python, SQL, data models, cloud architecture, security, and production operations. **What Success Looks Like** Within the first year, we want to have a maintainable Microsoft Fabric environment where data from our major systems is automatically collected, validated, standardized, and made available through trusted datasets. Instead of analysts repeatedly extracting and cleaning data manually, the organization should be able to rely on centralized datasets with clearly defined metrics and lineage. The platform should also be designed so additional sources, analytics use cases, automation, and AI capabilities can be added over time without rebuilding the underlying infrastructure. **Why This Role Is Different** You will be joining at the beginning of our data platform build rather than maintaining an architecture that has already been established. You will have significant influence over the architecture, engineering standards, data models, and technologies that become the foundation for how the organization uses data going forward. This is a strong fit for someone who enjoys building systems, solving difficult integration problems, and owning a data platform end\-to\-end. Pay: $125,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.description: **Job Summary** --------------- RadarFirst is seeking a Lead Platform Engineer, AI \& DevSecOps Engineer to lead the next stage of our cloud, security, reliability, and AI operations maturity. This role will own the platforms, practices, and operating model that enable our engineering teams to build, deploy, monitor, secure, and continuously improve production SaaS systems and agentic AI capabilities. Since launching RadarFirst's first agentic AI offering using AWS Bedrock, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and AgentCore Gateway, we are expanding the DevOps remit to include production\-grade AI infrastructure and operations. The person in this role will help mature the environment required by customers in highly regulated industries, including governance, secure agent/tool access, observability, continuous LLM and agent evaluations, traceability, incident response, cost controls, and operational readiness for future agent development. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role. The right candidate is an experienced platform, DevSecOps, or SRE leader who can set direction, build shared engineering practices, mentor others, and create a more DevOps\-forward engineering culture across historically siloed teams. This position can be based out of our HQ in Portland, OR, or remote from anywhere in the U.S. **Our Technical Stack** ----------------------- Our front end is built with Angular and Material Design, using TypeScript for strong typing and maintainability. Backend services are written in Go and Nest.js. Technologies currently in use include Packer, Ansible, Docker, Terraform, CloudFormation, Python, Go, Bash, Datadog, Git, TeamCity, Jira, Slack, and Google's productivity suite. We deploy on AWS using EC2, ECS, RDS\-hosted PostgreSQL, S3, OpenSearch, Lambda, SES, CloudWatch, IAM, and related AWS services. Our agentic AI environment uses AWS Bedrock, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and AgentCore Gateway, with a growing need for AI\-specific observability, evaluation, governance, and operational automation. **Essential Responsibilities \& Duties** ---------------------------------------- ### **Platform and Reliability** * Own and evolve the DevSecOps, platform engineering, and AI operations roadmap, with clear goals for reliability, security, deployment maturity, developer productivity, auditability, and customer readiness. * Design, implement, and operate secure, scalable, fault\-tolerant AWS infrastructure for SaaS and AI workloads. * Implement automation to reduce manual deployment, provisioning, compliance, monitoring, and support work. * Monitor platform KPIs and cost drivers, including cloud spend, token consumption, model usage, latency, error rates, deployment frequency, change failure rate, recovery time, and operational toil. ### **AI Operations** * Lead the operational maturity of RadarFirst's agentic AI platform, including the management of AWS Bedrock, AgentCore, AgentCore Gateway, agent/tool governance, policy controls, observability, evaluation workflows, and cost management. * Build observability across infrastructure, applications, and agentic workflows, including logs, metrics, traces, token usage, latency, error rates, tool invocation behavior, evaluation results, and customer\-impacting SLOs. * Partner with Engineering, Product, Security, Compliance, and Customer\-facing teams to ensure AI systems meet expectations for regulated industries, including auditability, access control, privacy, traceability, incident response, and defensible governance. * Define and evolve CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, and release\-management practices that improve speed, safety, reproducibility, and rollback confidence. ### **Security and Governance** * Lead incident response and reliability improvement efforts, including post\-incident reviews, root\-cause analysis, alert tuning, runbooks, operational readiness reviews, and long\-term remediation. * Maintain and improve security practices across cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, secrets management, authentication, authorization, vulnerability scanning, and software supply chain controls. ### **Leadership and Culture** * Create shared engineering standards and paved paths that help product engineers ship safely without waiting on bespoke DevOps support. * Drive a DevOps\-forward engineering culture by reducing team silos, improving ownership models, clarifying operational responsibilities, and coaching teams on secure, observable, supportable software delivery. * Mentor DevOps, platform, and software engineers; help develop future technical leaders and raise the organization's operational bar. Opportunity exists for people management for a small team. **Qualifications** ------------------ * 10\+ years of experience in DevOps, DevSecOps, SRE, platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, or a closely related engineering role. * Proven track record designing and operating production AWS infrastructure for SaaS or enterprise software environments. * Experience leading technical cal, and troubleshooting skills. ### **Strong Plus** * Hands\-on experience with AWS Bedrock, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, AgentCore Gateway, or comparable agentic AI platforms. * Experience implementing LLM or agent evaluation frameworks, including automated regression tests, golden datasets, human review workflows, prompt/version management, safety checks, and release thresholds. * Experience building governance for agent tool access, including policy enforcement, identity, permissions, audit trails, redaction, approval flows, and controlled access to internal systems. * Experience with OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, Datadog, Langfuse, Arize/Phoenix, Promptfoo, TruLens, OpenAI Evals, or similar AI observability/evaluation tools. * Experience with regulated customers in healthcare, insurance, financial services, government, or privacy/security\-sensitive industries. * SaaS scale\-up experience. * Certifications or training such as SANS/SEC\-540, SSCP, CISSP, CAP, CSSLP, HCISPP, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, AWS Certified Security Specialty, or AWS Certified Machine Learning Specialty. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more likely to doubt the strength of their qualifications, so we encourage you to submit an application if you're interested in this role despite any reservations you may have about your background or skill set. **Who We Are** -------------- At RadarFirst, our mission is to make regulatory risk and data privacy simple, actionable, and sustainable. We're transforming how organizations handle incidents and compliance with automated, purpose\-built SaaS solutions. Recognized as pioneers in privacy, we've earned patents, industry awards, and the confidence of some of the world's most highly regulated industries, from healthcare and insurance to finance and beyond. ### **Our Values** * Build What's Next * Be Good People * Own the Outcome * Customer Success is Our Success * True Transparency ### **Why Join RadarFirst?** At RadarFirst, our team is filled with smart, thoughtful, and forward\-thinking contributors who are experts at what they do. Our culture of innovation and trust is paramount to our success. We work hard, but we also encourage and support a healthy work/life balance. We offer a generous package of benefits and perks that make RadarFirst a great place to work, including: * Comprehensive benefits that include medical and dental, 401k, Life and Disability insurance, generous flexible time off policy, paid holiday time, and 12 weeks paid parental leave. Plus flexible spending accounts for medical, dependent care, and commuter expenses * Community outreach programs to encourage giving back to our community both as a group and individually * Commitment to anti\-racism work and accountability to our short\-term and long\-term equity \& inclusion action plan RadarFirst is a community\-first organization, operating on a hybrid model. We actively support all employees working in the way they need. For those who wish to work from the office, these are some features of our downtown Portland office: * On\-site amenities such as indoor bike racks, showers, lockers, and gym facilities * Casual work environment in an ideal central location, close to great food, shopping, and transportation options *This employer participates in E\-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I\-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E\-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, this employer is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. Employers can only use E\-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the Form I\-9\.* The salary range for this role is $155,000 \- $175,000 \#LI\-REMOTE

jobs.title: Manager - Software Engineering
jobs.description: Grow Your Career. Impact Lives. Shape the Future of Consumer Finance. At Regional Finance, growth is more than a strategy. It's an opportunity for our people to thrive. Over the past several years, we have expanded significantly, creating new career paths, leadership opportunities, and professional development experiences across our organization. As a proud NYSE\-listed company, we serve more than half a million active customers through a network of 360\+ branches across 20 states and a rapidly growing digital platform. With approximately $2\.1 billion in net finance receivables, nearly double our position in 2020, our momentum reflects both the strength of our business and the dedication of our team. If you're passionate about helping people, driven by growth, and excited to contribute to a company transforming the future of consumer finance, we invite you to join our team and build something meaningful with us. **Job purpose** This group builds and runs the technology behind RMC’s consumer lending business, including the loan application, origination, and servicing platforms our branches and customers depend on every day. We want a technology leader who combines solid technical knowledge with a strong focus on uptime, data integrity, and customer experience. You will own the delivery and day\-to\-day health of these applications, keep them reliable and compliant, and manage our operations teams to improve the way we serve our clients. **Duties and responsibilities** Regional Management Corporation (RMC) is seeking an experienced, empathetic, and quality\-focused Software Engineering Manager to lead the teams that build, support, and run our loan application platforms within the Software Engineering team. We are working to develop the RMC’s next\-generation platform. We are employing new paradigms such as cloud computing on AWS, lightweight microservices, event\-driven architecture, and relational and non\-relational databases to deliver elastically scalable, distributed, and highly resilient software services. The Software Engineering Manager role will partner with the digital product management team, branch operations, and other internal clients to understand business inquiries, drive requirements, propose solutions, and deliver multiple cross\-functional projects and integrations between different systems. This is a unique opportunity to build and institutionalize a reliable, best\-in\-class engineering ecosystem on premises or in the public cloud. You will partner closely with the lead engineers on your team’s technical direction, while owning people leadership, hiring, performance, delivery commitments., and the production health of your applications. Loan applications: You will own the systems that support the loan lifecycle, from application intake, identity verification, credit bureau and decisioning integrations, and underwriting, through loan booking, servicing, and payments. You will understand how changes to these applications affect branches, customers, compliance, and finance. Production support: You will lead production support for these applications, including on\-call rotation, incident response, root cause analysis, and permanent fixes. You will manage the support queue in ticketing system, keep business stakeholders informed during incidents, and reduce repeat issues over time. Platform reliability: You will own the reliability of the platform. This includes defining service level objectives (SLOs) for availability and performance, improving monitoring and alerting, reducing incident volume and time to recover (MTTR), managing release and change risk, and planning capacity and disaster recovery testing for business\-critical lending systems. **Minimum Qualifications** * BA/BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Master’s degree a plus * 12\+ years of experience, including software engineering and 2\+ years leading or managing engineering teams or application support teams * Hands\-on experience supporting production applications, including incident management, root cause analysis, and on\-call operations * Working knowledge of loan origination, servicing, or payments applications * Strong technical foundation in modern application architecture, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure * Must pass drug screen and other pre\-employment screenings **Preferred Qualifications** * Proven track record as a Software Engineering Manager managing multiple Agile Squads/Teams that work on multiple projects in an Agile environment. * Experience communicating with users, operations teams, other technical teams, and senior leadership, explaining technical issues, incidents, and designs in clear business terms. * Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching, and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers. * Prior experience in the Consumer Lending Industry, including loan application, origination, or servicing platforms (e.g., NLS) * Experience leading teams that delivered AI or LLM\-powered features into production, including guardrails, evaluation, and responsible\-AI practices * Experience with site reliability practices such as SLOs, error budgets, observability tools (e.g., Datadog, Splunk, or AWS CloudWatch), and disaster recovery testing * ITIL or IT service management experience, ideally with Jira Service Management **Critical Competencies** * Good interpersonal skills and ability to work well with others; friendly presence and helpful attitude. * Excellent oral and written communication skills., including clear incident updates and executive summaries. * Good problem\-solving and decision\-making skills. Ability to manage shifting priorities remains effective during production incidents, and exercise patience and professionalism during stressful situations. * Maintains and consistently demonstrates a general knowledge of company guidelines, processes, practices, and procedures. * Maintain adequate knowledge of operating systems and application software used to provide a high level of support. * Builds high\-performing teams through coaching, clear expectations, and regular feedback. * Develop technical knowledge of each system used within the company profile and specialized knowledge of certain nominated areas. * Drives predictable delivery while balancing speed, quality, security, and regulatory compliance. * Understands the opportunities and risks of AI in regulated consumer lending and guides teams to adopt it responsibly. * Takes ownership of platform reliability, treating uptime, data integrity, and customer impact as core measures of team success. *If you are a job applicant who resides in the state of California, please review our California Employee Privacy Policy at the following link:* Regional Management Corp Consumer Privacy Policy \| Regional Finance Regional is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, transgender status, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, uniform service, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law (“Protected Characteristics”).
