jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: ***Posting Type*** Hybrid/Remote ***Job Overview*** Who We Are Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI‑powered, cloud platform, Relativity aiR, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high‑stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial. The world’s largest law firms, corporations and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we’re deeply committed to expanding access to technology for academic institutions through Relativity Academic and supporting pro bono legal work through Justice for Change. What We Do At Relativity, engineers don’t just write code, they harness AI tools to architect, optimize, and deliver scalable software faster and shape the future of legal technology. They shape how industries uncover critical insights, ensure compliance, advance access to justice and continuously evolve our platform using the latest technologies, including cloud\-native architectures, AI capabilities, and modern developer tooling. Our AI powers privacy programs, identifies confidential information, and detects language indicating misconduct. We’re reimagining how legal professionals uncover truth at scale, and engineering is at the heart of that transformation. If you’re passionate about solving hard problems, designing for scale, and building tools that matter, while working in a culture that values transparency, innovation, and shared success, Relativity offers the opportunity to make a measurable difference in the marketplace. ***Job Description and Requirements*** **About the Role** Relativity's design system is moving to UX, and we are building its next generation. You will own its technical architecture: how the library is built, packaged, published, and consumed by every product team at Relativity, and how it stays correct as the product migrates to it. The framework is chosen, the first components exist, and it ships through our micro frontend. Everything past that will be owned by you: packaging, release and versioning strategy, and testing. You will also own the migration strategy for the libraries it replaces. ***Job Description and Requirements*** * Own the technical architecture of the design system: module format and packaging, peer dependencies, the publish path to Artifactory and CDN, and how two versions of the library coexist on a single page under micro frontends. * Set the versioning, deprecation, and breaking\-change policy for a library 60\+ repositories depend on, and define the migration architecture that moves them across. * Define the build, release, and testing strategy, including automated visual regression and the token pipeline that keeps design and code from drifting. * Architect the library to be correctly consumable by AI coding agents, so generated frontend code is compliant and accessible by default rather than by manual review. * Define the accessibility standard the platform builds against, with conformance validated in the pipeline rather than caught downstream, and support the compliance obligations our customers require. * Own reliability and incident response across the new library and the legacy libraries, and build the severity and escalation model the team does not have today. * Resolve complex, cross\-organizational technical problems through deep technical expertise, collaboration, and hands\-on implementation. Drive frontend engineering standards across teams through design and code reviews, patterns, documented standards, and coaching, and align technical execution with product strategy and delivery commitments. * **What we’re looking for** **Required Qualifications** * 10\+ years building and operating frontend systems that other engineering teams depend on. * Demonstrated technical leadership across multiple teams or domains. * Strong background in architecture, security, and reliability at scale. * Ability to define technical direction and drive cross\-team alignment. * Experience translating business goals into technical strategy. * Proven ability to influence without formal authority. * Strong mentorship and technical communication skills. * Deep React and TypeScript experience. * Experience owning build and release tooling for a published package, not just consuming one. * Deep experience with semantic HTML and CSS, and accessible component patterns. **Preferred Qualifications** * You have built and maintained a design system that multiple teams depend upon. * You are fluent with AI\-development tools like Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or Cursor. * You can plan a design system migration that teams will follow, including the conversations where a team pushes back or a change breaks them. * You can explain packaging decisions to a designer and a design decision to a platform engineer. * You have set an accessibility standard other teams built against, with validation automated rather than manual. * You have modernized a large legacy frontend system **Why We Could Be A Great Fit** * Impactful Mission: *Organize Data, Discover the Truth and Act on It* \- Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading law firms managing high\-stakes matters on our platform. * Engineering Culture: Continuous delivery, strong observability, and end\-to\-end ownership. * Inclusive Environment: Diverse backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger. * Community Impact: Volunteer opportunities and company\-sponsored charitable programs. * Compensation \& Benefits: Competitive salary, health and retirement programs, wellness resources, discretionary time off (DTO), parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers, two annual company breaks, home office stipend, and an equity program. **Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.** This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long\-term incentives. The expected salary range for this role is between following values: $174,000 and $262,000 The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position. **Required Skills:** Algorithms, Automation, Debugging, Distributed Systems, Performance Tuning, Problem Solving, Project Management, Software Development, System Designs, Technical Leadership

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer II, Stage Machining
jobs.description: At Relativity Space, we're building rockets to serve today's needs and tomorrow's breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that's just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known. Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven't been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you're in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you'll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we're writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it's early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us. **About the Team:** The Stage Manufacturing team turns design into reality, owning the build of Terran R's primary structures. This isn't about turning the same bolt every day; it's about building the systems to build the rocket. Engineers and technicians work side by side, with deep collaboration and real\-time feedback, to shape how we build better and faster. With a manifest and a launch date, it's up to the team to deliver on Terran R: solving challenges in real time, optimizing for scale, and constantly improving processes. As the vehicle evolves, so will the factory, with opportunities to apply automation, machine learning, and advanced technologies. What we build here sets the blueprint for the future of scaled launch. **About the Role:** * Share ownership of operations on our 2 large 3\-axis mills (20'x8'), 2 large 5\-axis mills (20'x8') and VTL (20' diameter) * Help introduce new products to these machines as well as improve current high\-volume work across the 2 large 3\-axis mills (20'x8') and 2 large 5\-axis mills (20'x8') * Collaborate closely with a diverse team of engineers specializing in design, manufacturing, and reliability, as well as internal production teams and external vendors, leveraging their collective expertise to drive progress * Create work instructions, specifications, and best practices across multiple high\-fidelity processes. Help standardize processes across the manufacturing team * Help establish new machining work centers by championing the tooling and process definition needed to build parts for Terran R * Support the shop floor through live issue resolution and provide upstream feedback as we innovate the next generation of manufacturing technology * Provide Design for Manufacturing feedback to structures teams during the development phase and through the first prototype and flight build **About You:** * Bachelor's degree in manufacturing, aeronautical, mechanical engineering, or other engineering discipline * 5\+ years progressive and related experience required * 3D \& 2D design/drafting skills per ASME Y14\.5M (NX preferred) * Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to interface with engineering and manufacturing groups to understand process constraints and provide design inputs for improved manufacturability * Direct experience with CNC milling and turning operations across multiple materials * Understanding of machine programming (G\-code) and machine set\-up * Strong engineering fundamentals in statics, mechanics of materials, process improvement/factory design, fastening and joining, machining **Nice to haves, but not required:** * Extensive experience with CNC milling, turning, and drilling operations across multiple materials * Aluminum experience and large parts \>6' is preferred * Extensive experience with designing work holding for complicated machining operations * New product introduction of an aerospace hardware system into a manufacturing, test, and production system with proven success * Experience in managing projects in a fast\-paced environment **We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.** ***If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact us at*** ***accommodations@relativityspace.com******.*** ***Please note: Relativity Space does not accept unsolicited resumes, candidate profiles, or referrals from recruitment agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited submission \- via email, our website, social media, or directly to an employee \- will be deemed the property of Relativity Space, and no fee will be owed absent a current, fully executed agreement with Talent Acquisition that specifically authorizes submissions for the applicable role.***

jobs.title: AI-first Software Developer (On-site)
jobs.description: About the role Retrevr builds AI tools for veterinary practices: an AI receptionist that answers calls and texts, plus a full practice management platform covering scheduling, patient records, charting, pharmacy, labs, and payments. We're hiring a Software Developer to join our small engineering team in Provo. Demand for new features has outgrown what our current team can ship, so we're moving quickly on this hire. You'd be the third developer on the team, which means your work is visible immediately and you'll have real influence over how things get built. Most of our platform was built with AI coding agents, and that's how we keep shipping fast. We need someone who is extremely proficient with AI\-assisted development: you can keep several agents productive at once, give them specs they can actually follow, and catch what they get wrong before it reaches a clinic. Speed with AI matters here, and so does knowing when not to trust it. The work splits between two areas: internal systems our sales team depends on, and the product vet clinics use every day, including the AI inside it. You'll touch both. This role is open to developers with roughly 1–5 years of professional experience. We care more about how you think, how fast you pick things up, and how well you build with AI than about a specific number of years. What you'll do \- Build and ship features end to end with AI coding agents (Claude Code is our daily driver), from React/Next.js UI to Postgres and edge functions \- Work across the clinic side of the product: scheduling, patient charts, pharmacy, labs, and checkout \- Run agent sessions in parallel, each with a clear spec, and review everything they produce before it ships \- Test and harden AI\-written code for security, data integrity, and performance. We handle patient records and payments, so this matters. \- Help build the AI in our product: the voice receptionist, AI\-assisted charting, and an in\-app assistant for clinic staff \- Develop and improve the internal tools our sales team runs on — dashboards, workflows, reporting, integrations \- Deploy and monitor your own work on Vercel and Supabase, and fix what breaks \- Sit down with the sales team, figure out what they actually need, then build it What we're looking for \- Extremely proficient with AI coding tools: you use Claude Code, Cursor, or similar agents every day and can show us exactly how you work \- Strong enough fundamentals to know when the AI is wrong: JavaScript/TypeScript, React, SQL, and auth \- 1\+ years of professional experience building web applications (internships and substantial side projects count) \- Comfort with Git and a pull request workflow \- Clear communication, and a habit of asking questions early rather than getting stuck quietly \- Comfortable with shifting priorities — on a three\-person team, this week's plan sometimes changes \- Able to work on\-site in Provo, UT Nice to have \- Veterinary or healthcare software experience, or time spent working in a vet clinic \- Next.js App Router (server components, server actions) and Vercel deployments \- Supabase: Postgres, row\-level security, edge functions \- Building with LLM APIs, voice AI, or MCP \- Stripe, Twilio, or other third\-party API integrations \- Tailwind CSS \- Testing with Jest, Vitest, or Playwright \- Experience building internal tools or CRM/sales integrations \- Startup or small\-team experience What we offer \- $50,000 – $85,000 per year, depending on experience \- Unlimited PTO \- A real say in technical decisions and the tools we use \- Short feedback loops: what you build goes live in days, not quarters \- Direct access to the people making product and business decisions Hiring process We're moving quickly on this one: \- Short intro call (\~20 minutes) \- Technical conversation with the team, including a walkthrough of something you've built \- A short live session where you build something small with your own AI setup \- Offer We aim to go from first call to decision within about a week. How to apply Apply through Indeed with your resume. In a couple of sentences, tell us how you build with AI (your tools, your workflow, a project you're proud of) and include a link if it's public. No cover letter required. Retrevr is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager - Data Catalog
jobs.description: **About Rippling** ------------------ Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses. **About the role** ------------------ At Rippling, Product is responsible for turning extraordinary technical depth into simple, powerful products for our customers. As the Lead Product Manager for Data Catalog, you will own the semantic, ontology and governance layer that makes Rippling’s first\-party, third\-party, and customer\-created data understandable and usable by both humans and AI. This is a foundational product leadership role for Rippling’s Data Cloud and AI strategy. You will define how data is represented, governed, discovered, and used across payroll, HR, IT, finance, external systems, customer datasets, and developer\-built applications. Your work will help Rippling AI answer customer questions correctly, take the right actions, and give internal and external developers a reliable interface into Rippling’s data graph. You will be the product lead for a new, high\-leverage area that touches nearly every Rippling product and depends on deep collaboration across engineering, AI, platform, product, and customer\-facing teams. This is a rare opportunity to own the company context layer for AI at Rippling. **What you will do** * Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution for Rippling’s Data Catalog. * Define how first\-party, third\-party, and customer\-generated data is represented semantically across the Rippling platform. * Build the catalog capabilities that allow Rippling AI to interpret natural\-language questions, resolve ambiguity, map requests to the right data, and return accurate answers or actions. * Establish governance models for sensitive data, including access controls, permissions, and policy\-driven usage across payroll, HR, IT, finance, and external\-source data. * Create the product interface between Rippling AI, Data Cloud, internal product teams, external developers, and the underlying data graph. * Work across approximately ten dependent engineering teams and product areas to identify shared data\-modeling patterns, remove adoption friction, and drive catalog usage at scale. * Build feedback loops with customers, customer\-facing teams, data analysts, engineers, AI teams, and developers to understand hidden pain points and continuously improve the product. * Influence executive and cross\-functional stakeholders on investment priorities, trade\-offs, sequencing, and long\-term platform direction. * Define and track the success metrics that show whether the catalog improves AI accuracy, developer velocity, governance quality, and customer outcomes. **What you will need** ---------------------- * Experience as a senior product leader owning complex data, platform, infrastructure, analytics, AI, or developer\-facing products at meaningful scale. * Deep familiarity with data platforms, data warehouses, databases, analytics products, semantic layers, metadata systems, data governance, or adjacent B2B data products. * Strong product judgment in ambiguous technical domains, with the ability to turn broad platform goals into crisp strategy, roadmap, and execution. * A nuanced understanding of customer needs, business objectives, competitive dynamics, and industry trends in data and AI. * Demonstrated ability to lead through influence across multiple product and engineering teams, including senior stakeholders and executives. * Strong systems thinking, especially the ability to model data relationships, dependencies, permissions, edge cases, and downstream product implications. * Excellent communication and storytelling skills; you can explain deeply technical concepts clearly and persuade teams to make high\-quality decisions quickly. * AI fluency, including a strong understanding of what good context looks like for an LLM and how product systems can improve AI accuracy and actionability. * A track record of building products that internal teams or developers adopt because they improve quality, speed, flexibility, and reliability. * Comfort operating with high ownership in a late\-stage startup environment where the answer is not already defined. * Production AI experience is a plus, especially experience building products that provide context, grounding, retrieval, governance, or tool/action interfaces for AI systems. * Founder or early product leadership experience may be valuable if paired with strong evidence of building complex, customer\-facing products at scale. **Additional Information** -------------------------- Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role. This role will receive a competitive salary \+ benefits \+ equity. The salary for US\-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here. A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below. **The pay range for this role is:** 174,000 \- 290,000 USD per year(US San Francisco Bay Area)

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **OUR STATEMENT** The San José State University Research Foundation (SJSURF) is committed to building a work environment where everyone can show up as their own self and have an opportunity to contribute, develop, and advance in their career. Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) are core values of the organization. We strive to attract, retain, and develop employees who reflect the community and society where we work and live. The Research Foundation aims to develop a culture where everyone feels welcome, shares their views, and where differences in backgrounds and perspectives are seen as adding value. The Data Engineer supports SJSU's Campus Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence initiatives through the development, integration, and maintenance of enterprise data solutions. The position contributes to the development and maintenance of data pipelines and data models that integrate information from multiple university systems into trusted, governed data platforms used for institutional reporting, analytics, and data\-driven decision\-making. **GENERAL NATURE OF POSITION** Working under the guidance of senior technical staff, the Data Engineer applies knowledge of computer science, information systems, database technologies, programming, data architecture, and cloud\-based data platforms to develop and support enterprise data solutions. The position works with technical teams and university stakeholders to analyze requirements, troubleshoot data and system issues, design technical solutions, document business and technical requirements, and support vendor and locally developed systems. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES** 1\. Develop, test, implement, and maintain data pipelines and integration processes that extract, transform, and load data from multiple enterprise source systems into SJSU's data warehouse and analytics platforms. 2\. Develop and maintain SQL queries, database objects, data transformations, and data models in support of reporting and analytics requirements. 3\. Apply programming and scripting languages such as Python, Java, SQL, or similar technologies to develop, maintain, and support data solutions. 4\. Analyze source\-system data structures, relationships, and business rules to support integration into enterprise data platforms. 5\. Troubleshoot data pipeline, integration, database, and production data issues by reviewing SQL queries, source data, system logs, application logic, and code; collaborate with senior developers and other technical teams to resolve more complex issues. 6\. Develop and maintain processes to validate data quality, integrity, consistency, and completeness. 7\. Develop and deploy scalable, secure, and reliable data solutions in cloud environments to support analytics and business operations. 8\. Support data solutions using relational databases, cloud computing environments, data lakehouse technologies, and platforms such as Oracle, Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform. 9\. Apply established data architecture, ETL/ELT, data warehousing, metadata management, and database design principles when developing and maintaining data solutions. 10\. Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, application developers, system administrators, and functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical data requirements and solutions. 11\. Support analytical methodologies including segmentation, statistical analysis, regression, forecasting, data mining, and predictive modeling as appropriate. 12\. Provide production support for applications and data solutions, ensuring SLA compliance through effective monitoring, troubleshooting, incident resolution, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance. 13\. Analyze structured and unstructured datasets to identify trends, anomalies, relationships, and information useful for university decision\-making. 14\. Support the team in building trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders through reliable, accurate data work. 15\. Follow IT policies and standards for maintaining consistency across SJSU campus. 16\. Stay current on technology trends and proactively share learnings with the team.. **INTERPERSONAL CONTACTS** Reports to the Project Director. Interacts with SJSU Information Technology regularly. **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES** None; however, the position may provide technical direction, advice, or mentoring. **QUALIFICATIONS** **Education and Experience** Required * Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical or quantitative field that includes coursework in programming, databases, data structures, systems analysis, statistics, or comparable computing disciplines. * 1 \+ year of professional experience in data engineering, database development, software development, data integration, data analytics development, business applications, or a closely relate employee and eligible dependents. * Life, AD\&D, LTD with supplemental coverage opportunities. * 14 paid federal \& state holidays. * Retirement Plan: 403 (b) employee contribution plan component and a 403 (b) employer contribution component, which vests immediately. * Vacation\-hour accruals and separate sick\-hour accumulations. * Employee discounts. * Paid training and professional\-development conferences. Please visit the Benefits \& Compensation page on the SJSURF website for more detailed information. **APPLICATION PROCEDURE** To apply for this position, an applicant must submit a formal application for employment. Select "Apply" to complete the SJSURF online employment application via Workday. **REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION** The SJSURF is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with physical or mental disabilities in the employment, recruitment, examination, interviewing, and hiring processes. If you are a job seeker with a physical or mental disability, and you require a reasonable accommodation to search, apply, or interview for a job opening or otherwise need a reasonable accommodation during the application and hiring process, please contact us at foundation\-jobs@sjsu.edu. jobs.title: Manager, DevOps
jobs.description: Supplier.io is the data foundation that enterprises build their supplier decisions on. Fragmented, duplicated, and unreliable supplier data quietly limits the ROI of source\-to\-pay platforms, analytics, risk, and AI initiatives, so we resolve, enrich, and continuously maintain the industry's most complete supplier identity, then put it to work for the teams that buy and the suppliers themselves. Relied on by companies across the Fortune 2000 for accurate data, our platform helps corporate procurement, finance, and compliance teams manage their vendor master, source diverse and sustainable suppliers, and mitigate risk, all from one verified identity instead of a dozen disconnected systems. Our solutions turn that foundation into action: accurate data and continuous maintenance for teams managing a fragmented vendor master, sourcing intelligence built resolving even the hardest\-to\-identify suppliers, small, local, and diverse businesses, for teams tracking sustainability and compliance, and direct visibility for the suppliers themselves into where they stand with the enterprises that buy from them. Whether you're resolving vendor records, sourcing alternatives, or measuring program results, Supplier.io transforms complexity into clarity, so teams can lead with confidence and build supply chains that deliver for both business and community. For more information, visit www.supplier.io. **The Opportunity** The Manager, DevOps is a hands\-on leader who sets direction, builds durable processes, and develops the team that keeps our cloud platforms reliable, secure, and cost\-efficient. You will manage and grow the team while staying close to the technology, and you will be measured on the systems you put in place: how we plan, how we release, how we observe our environments, and how the team executes. The ideal candidate has built high\-functioning DevOps practices before and knows how to bring structure and accountability to a team without slowing it down. **What You Will Do*** Own the DevOps roadmap and delivery commitments across all Supplier.io environments, serving as the single point of accountability for DevOps direction and priorities. * Manage, coach, and develop the DevOps team and own hiring for the team as it grows, including defining roles, interviewing, and onboarding. * Establish and enforce core operational processes, including change management, release management, environment promotion standards, incident response and postmortems, on\-call coverage, and documentation and runbook standards. * Bring legacy, undocumented infrastructure under version control and documentation, and own disaster recovery and business continuity planning, including defined recovery time and recovery point objectives for our critical systems. * Bring planning discipline to the function, including sprint planning, estimation, and clear delivery commitments. * Define and drive the observability strategy, delivering centralized visibility across all environments with clear standards for monitoring, logging, alerting, and APM, and owning the related tooling decisions. * Own the cloud cost optimization program, including committed\-use discounts, right\-sizing of compute and databases, and reduction of logging and storage costs. * Drive security and compliance hygiene in partnership with the security function, including least\-privilege access, access reviews, key rotation, certificate automation, and vulnerability remediation. * Stay hands\-on: build and review CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and Kubernetes workloads alongside the team, and lead by example on technical standards. * Partner directly with Data Engineering to own the infrastructure and tooling that keeps their pipelines running: Snowflake account and warehouse administration, Airflow orchestration infrastructure, and secrets and connection management for data pipelines. * Coordinate with the STAC on infrastructure decisions, such as cloud architecture, Kubernetes, and CI/CD tooling, that affect the broader platform, so infrastructure choices stay aligned with company\-wide architecture standards. * Participate in the on\-call rotation alongside the team, especially early on, to stay close to the systems and set the standard for response quality. * Build a culture of automation, accountability, and continuous improvement across the DevOps team and the broader engineering organization. * Partner with software development, data engineering, AI, and platform teams to keep environments consistent and delivery fast, safe, and reliable. * Evaluate emerging tools and practices, and make pragmatic decisions about what to build, buy, and adopt. **What You will Need to Succeed:** * 10\+ years in DevOps, cloud engineering, or infrastructure roles with progressive responsibility, including 3\+ years leading or managing engineers with hiring, coaching, and performance responsibility. * A track record of building processes that stick: change and release management, incident response, planning and estimation practices, and documentation standards in a growing organization. * Experience bringing legacy or undocumented infrastructure under management, including introducing Infrastructure as Code and disaster recovery planning where neither existed before. * Strong hands\-on proficiency with CI/CD platforms (Azure DevOps, GitHub, Jenkins, or similar), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, Helm), and containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes). * Deep experience with Google Cloud Platform. AWS and Azure experience is beneficial. * Experience defining and implementing an observability strategy across multiple environments, including monitoring, logging, alerting, and APM tooling decisions. * Experience managing cloud spend, including committed\-use or reservation strategies, right\-sizing, and cost accountability. * Excellent communication skills, including the ability to set clear expectations with engineers, influence peers across engineering, and present plans and results to executives. * Judgment to balance keep\-the\-lights\-on operations, project delivery, and longer\-term automation investments. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience building or managing distributed teams, including offshore execution teams. * Experience consolidating infrastructure and operations across acquired platforms. * Experience with security automation, compliance frameworks, and policy\-as\-code. * Familiarity with CI/CD for data pipelines and AI/MLOps practices. **We do no accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment/search firms.** Supplier.io participates in E\-Verify. For more information, click here. We will provide the Social Security Administration and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security, with information from each new employee’s Form I\-9 to confirm work authorization. Supplier.io is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. Supplier.io is unable to sponsor work visas (e.g., H\-1B, TN, OPT, etc.) for US positions. Candidates must meet in\-country work authorization requirements. jobs.title: Senior AI Data & Analytics Engineer II
jobs.description: **Who we are** Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video\-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. **About the role:** Want to build the data foundation powering AI and self\-serve analytics at scale? As part of Samsara's Marketing Data and Analytics (MDA) Engineering team, you will shape the technical roadmap alongside our BI and Data Science peers. You will architect core Databricks pipelines, Gold Layer tables, and semantic models, turning ambitious, ambiguous business challenges into high\-value data products, autonomous agents, and cross\-functional automation. This role is open to candidates residing in the US. **You should apply if:** * **You want to impact the industries that run our world:** Your efforts will result in real\-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. * **You are the architect of your own career:** If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment. * **You're energized by our opportunity:** The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers. * **You want to be with the best:** At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. Youwill be surrounded by a high\-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best. **In this role, you will:** * Partner on defining the strategy and multi\-quarter roadmap for MDA's data and AI foundation. * Architect and own Samsara's marketing data infrastructure: ETL/ELT pipelines, Databricks Gold Layer tables, and the core data models that power segmentation, targeting, automation, and analytics. * Design the semantic layers, data dictionaries, and structured documentation that enable self\-serve BI and conversational analytics, partnering with the BI team to ensure core sales and marketing KPIs are built on trusted, well\-modeled data. * Translate ambiguous business questions from Marketing, Sales, and R\&D into clear requirements and scalable solutions, working autonomously without dedicated PM support and influencing decisions with data and sound reasoning. * Lead complex, cross\-team initiatives end to end: stand up new data pipelines and integrations quickly, manage risk across interdependent teams, and own the reliability and data quality of what ships. * Serve as the senior technical lead for the team's hardest problems: raise the bar for engineering quality and code review, remove bottlenecks that slow multiple teams, and mentor engineers and analysts. * Drive the strategic use of AI to solve ambiguous, high\-impact problems: build AI\-enabled data products and agents, with the integrations, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation practices that keep them reliable and trustworthy. * Identify and automate manual workflows with AI across Marketing and GTM teams, taking ideas from concept to prototype to production and influencing org roadmaps. * Ship high\-quality Python and SQL, increasingly by directing agentic coding tools, while holding a high bar for reviewing and verifying AI\-generated work before it reaches production. * Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices. **Minimum requirements for the role:** * 8\+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or AI engineering, including deep hands\-on data engineering experience. * Expert\-level Python and SQL, with strong hands\-on data modeling and DBT experience. * Deep experience with data warehouse and lakehouse architectures, ETL/ELT, and the modern data stack, including hands\-on Databricks (or similar, such as Snowflake or BigQuery).  re engineering background beyond data or AI engineering, with a track record of turning ambiguous, unfamiliar problems into well\-architected, delivered solutions. * Expertise in data visualization and building dashboards for sales and marketing KPIs. * Familiarity with go\-to\-market data and systems: CRM (e.g., Salesforce), marketing automation, web analytics, and MarTech tools. * Experience building interactive applications with Streamlit, Claude workflows, or web frameworks. * Data science, machine learning, or predictive analytics experience. * Comfort working in an exploratory environment, testing and iterating on new data sources and methodologies. **Total Rewards** At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high\-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above\-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance\-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high\-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above\-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long\-term success: a flexible, employee\-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. **Flexible Working** At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in\-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on\-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. **Belonging at Samsara** At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. **Accommodations** Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. **Our Commitment to Authenticity** We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. **Fraudulent Employment Offers** Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us\-greenhouse\-mail.io or @mail3\.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: Senior Architect, Digital Technology
jobs.description: **Who we are:**Samsonite is the worldwide leader in superior travel bags, luggage, and accessories combining notable style with the latest design technology and the utmost attention to quality and durability. For more than 100 years, Samsonite has leveraged its rich heritage to create unparalleled products that fulfill the travel lifestyle needs of conscious movers everywhere. With a portfolio of brands including Samsonite, Tumi, American Tourister, High Sierra, Gregory, Hartmann, and Lipault Paris, our products are sold in over 100 countries in North America, Asia, Europe and Latin America through our company\-operated retail store, websites and a variety of retail partners. Senior Architect, Digital Technology will architect, design, and deliver business initiatives that drive revenue and/or improve efficiency working in Samsonite’s Digital Technology team. The individual will maintain an in\-depth view of the organization’s technologies and architectures around Ecommerce systems. This role will be accountable for an aspirational roadmap for the Digital stack with a focus on industry specific trends, emerging technologies, and strategic differentiators. The individual will present and socialize the current and future state of Digital Products and Platforms to various stakeholders. This is a hybrid role; we work on site 4 days and remotely 1 day weekly. * Operating as a Forward Deployed Engineer, this role works directly on the front lines of implementation, helping Ecommerce business units integrate and maximize the value of AI/non\-AI products and platforms. * Strong understanding of SFCC, SFRA, CDN, NodeJS, ETL, Build Processes, Web Vitals, Code quality evaluations, Atlassian processes, and Microservices. * Experience in implementation and integration of various solutions such as Product Information Management (PIM), Content Management Systems (CMS), Digital Asset Management (DAM) and A/B Testing Solutions. * Expert understanding of Payment and Order Management systems and integration concepts – REST, SOAP, Batch, SFTP, API Gateways. * Deep understanding of Content Delivery Networks, Network traffic routing and Service Workers. * Experience in headless architecture, progressive web apps (PWA) as well as API Orchestration with an overarching focus on performance optimization. * Demonstrated ability architecting multi\-tenant systems and platforms with a focus on building reference applications, across a variety of platforms. * Knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud and Salesforce Service Cloud is a plus. * Knowledge of IT security and regulatory compliance (PCI, PII, etc.) * Excellent analytical and technical skills and ability to lead, direct and challenge teams in process, methods, and approach. * Strong communication, leadership, and negotiation skills to work closely with business and other cross\-functional teams. * Strong understanding of ecommerce ecosystems and processes that include end\-to\-end data flows and processing from order management, fulfillment, payments, customer service and other backend systems. * Experienced in working across multiple teams and adapting various architectures to meet business needs. **Why you'll love working here:*** **Our employees matter.** As a people\-focused business, we work hard to provide meaningful rewards and development opportunities for our employees, recognizing performance, and creating a supportive working environment for them, wherever they are based. * **Vibrant culture.** We are committed to a diverse and rich culture, welcoming people from all walks of life. Our long\-standing commitment to culture and inclusion empowers us to bring our authentic selves and unique differences to work every day. * **Socially responsible.** We want to minimize our products' impact on the environment and help create positive journeys worldwide. We do this by creating the best products using the most sustainable and innovative materials, methods, and models. **What we value:**At Samsonite, we do more than create the bags that move with our consumer, we inspire and celebrate the moments that move them. We believe we have a responsibility to the world in how we operate, the products we sell, the communities where we live and work, and how we treat the people we employ. We're as diverse as travel itself, and like travel, your journey with Samsonite presents the opportunity to be a part of something bigger and explore your passions. This is why we offer various paths for professionals and celebrate the knowledge and skills they bring to our team. We are committed to a respectful workplace that allows our team members to bring their best selves to the workplace daily. Samsonite is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to promoting and maintaining a work environment in which all applicants, associates, customers, and other individuals are treated with dignity and respect free from unlawful harassment, discrimination, or retaliation.

Join a global network that powers how Sanofi delivers — seamlessly, purposefully, and at scale. In Manufacturing \& Supply, you’ll help reimagine how life\-changing treatments reach people everywhere, faster. **About Sanofi:** We’re an R\&D\-driven, AI\-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve lives. **Main Responsibilities** * Review and approval of SAT FAT Commissioning and Qualification and Design documentation protocols test scripts reports assessments. * Impact assessments Change Control Functional Component and Design Review Design Qualification DRDQ. * Protocol and Test Script authoring. * Continuous improvement authoring updates to site Commissioning and Qualification platform procedures * Engineering Change Management process * Contractor management This role offers a dynamic blend of technical leadership quality governance and cross functional collaboration. **As a key member of our engineering team, you will** * Serve as the primary Commissioning and Qualification Engineering interface with project management and project controls functions supporting contractor budget and schedule performance measurements and reporting Provide strong Commissioning and Qualification focus and oversight for packaging and inspection systems. * Provide Commissioning and Qualification support for projects focusing equipment and utilities to support Drug substance processing Final Filling process and Inspection and Packaging * Review and approve protocols test scripts data packs and reports to ensure consistent high\-quality engineering documentation across all assigned projects. * Audit engineering quality in accordance with site and project level Commissioning and Qualification plans development qualification Global Engineering Guidelines and Quality Operational Qualification Guidelines. Update and approve site Commissioning and Qualification platform methods and procedures ensuring alignment with project lessons learned GEG updates and global quality document revisions. * Support technical engineering staff in the use and documentation of the engineering change management process. * Execute audit initiatives and remediation activities including action items resulting from internal and external audits change controls and deviation remediation as directed by the Plant Process and Commissioning and Qualification Lead and or Site Project Engineering Lead * Manage contract associates as required to support Commissioning and Qualification activities. **Scope and Impact** Your work will directly influence the quality and compliance of engineering documentation across both CAPEX and OPEX projects by applying Global Engineering Guidelines and local engineering methods you will ensure that every project meets the highest standards of engineering and regulatory excellence Specific activities include * Executing System and Functional Component Criticality Assessments * Conducting Design Review and Qualification activities * Authoring Protocols Test Scripts and Reports as assigned * Authoring technical assessments in support of change controls deviations and CAPA **About You** **Basic qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Life other related fields. * **Additional skills:** * Packaging and Inspection process systems * Process Equipment Filling systems isolators purification systems * Chromatography systems autoclaves washers and Controlled Temperature Units * GMP Utilities WFI Clean Steam Clean Compressed Air * Experience in the vaccine or pharmaceutical industry * Demonstrated expertise in the quality review of good documentation practices * GDP Knowledge of quality and regulatory requirements applicable to pharmaceutical and biotech manufacturing * Experience with contemporary commissioning and qualification jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager
jobs.description: We're Scan.com. We're building America's national imaging network: the infrastructure that connects patients, providers, and payers to faster, better\-value diagnostic imaging. Thousands of patients move through our platform every day, and each is a real person waiting for an answer to a healthcare concern. We exist to get them that answer faster. We manage the medical imaging pathway end\-to\-end. Providers order through a single point of entry, and from there, we run the entire medical diagnostic pathway. Managing the full pathway, rather than brokering pieces of it, is what lets us deliver imaging faster, at higher quality, and at a lower cost than the fragmented status quo. We're looking for a **Senior Engineering Manager** at an exciting time. We've raised over $200m in funding to date, reached profitability, and are growing 100% year on year. Millions of people wait too long for a diagnosis. Come help us fix that. **WHAT YOU WILL BE GETTING INVOLVED IN** ---------------------------------------- We are a small, high\-output team building across a complex technical surface: consumer marketplace, provider\-facing scheduling tools, interoperability infrastructure, revenue cycle tooling, and AI\-augmented workflows. We don't scale headcount to scale output. We scale leverage through AI\-native development practices, tight feedback loops, and engineers who own outcomes rather than tickets. As **Senior Engineering Manager**, you will lead a cross\-functional engineering team and remain a hands\-on contributor. We expect roughly 30% of your time to be spent writing code, reviewing architecture, or directly shaping technical decisions. This is not a role for someone who wants to move fully into management. It's a role for someone who finds that combination energising. You will report to our CTO and partner closely with Product, Operations, and Data to ship the systems that run our business. You are expected to be genuinely AI\-native: not just comfortable with AI tooling, but actively shaping how your team uses it. That means deploying agents, building evaluation frameworks, and coaching engineers to work at a level of throughput that wasn't possible two years ago. As a scale\-up business, you can expect your role to develop over time. Here are some of the types of things you could be getting involved in: * Lead and develop a team of engineers across multiple product domains, owning velocity, process, performance, technical growth, and team culture * Remain a consistent technical contributor by writing production code, leading design reviews, and pairing with engineers on complex problems. * Define and enforce engineering standards across code quality, system design, testing discipline, deployment practices, and incident response * Drive the team's AI\-native operating model by identifying where AI agents can replace or accelerate engineering workflows, building evaluation frameworks to measure output quality, and coaching engineers to leverage AI tooling as a primary development instrument rather than an occasional aid * Partner with Product to refine roadmaps, push back on scope where necessary, and ensure the team is working on the highest\-leverage problems at any given time * Own the architecture of your team's systems by making build vs. buy decisions, managing technical debt deliberately, and ensuring the stack can support the growth trajectory of the business * Contribute to Scan.com's broader engineering culture through interview loops, cross\-team design reviews, engineering all\-hands, and the institutional knowledge that makes a small team punch above its weight **WHAT YOU MIGHT BRING TO THE TABLE** ------------------------------------- You don't need to tick all the boxes to apply for this role. Whether it's your first role or your fifth, we believe everyone can add value, learn, and grow. However, these might be some of the ways you are currently adding value: * Proven experience managing and growing engineering teams in a startup environment. You have operated with limited resources, changing priorities, and a high bar for individual output, and you have thrived in that context. * Genuine AI\-native fluency: you have deployed AI agents in production engineering workflows, you understand evaluation frameworks and can design them for non\-trivial tasks, and you have coached teams to use AI as a primary tool rather than a novelty. Candidates who cannot speak concretely to this will not be competitive * Active technical contributor with strong engineering fundamentals. You write production\-quality code in at least one modern backend or full\-stack language, can lead a system design discussion at a senior level, and have not been out of the code for more than a year * Experience in a scaling healthcare technology company is a strong plus. Familiarity with the regulatory environment, interoperability constraints, and the operational complexity of healthcare delivery meaningfully shortens the ramp * Strong cross\-functional instincts: you have partnered effectively with Product and Operations, understand how to negotiate scope without burning relationships, and can represent technical constraints to a non\-technical audience without losing fidelity * A track record of growing engineers. ICs on your previous teams have been promoted, expanded their scope, and credited you with material development in their careers * High ownership orientation: you do not wait to be asked, you do not manage up problems without a proposed path forward, and you treat the business outcomes of your team's work as personally yours **A VIEW ON OUR CULTURE** ------------------------- We're building something that matters. Every scan we speed up is a real person waiting on an answer, and that urgency runs through everything we do. We move fast, we own outcomes, and take pride in our output. If you like ambiguity, working with ambitious people, and want your work to visibly move the needle, you'll feel at home here. To be successful at Scan.com you must embody our values. **HOW WE WILL INTERVIEW YOU** ----------------------------- We keep our interview process short and sweet, and we're a nimble team that can progress at pace. Here are the stages you can expect, but we might switch up the order of each step depending on team availability: * Introductory call/interview with our Senior Talent Partner. The call is via telephone and lasts around 30 minutes. * Should it feel like there is an initial fit for all, we will invite you to a video call with the hiring manager for around 45 minutes. This is a more structured interview that will deep\-dive into the role and technical needs. * 'Scan Standard' interview, where our panel screens for values alignment and the success factors that matter at Scan.com. You will also be assessed on your AI fluency at the stage and depth relevant to your role (see AI Requirements above). * Meet the founders and/or other team members. Again, length varies depending on how many interviewers, and whether in person or via video call. * Offer! **WHAT WE OFFER** ----------------- We go beyond the basics with our benefits package. We believe great work starts with supporting our people. Here's what you can expect from us: * Salary range of $180,000 \- $240,000 * Flexible remote or hybrid work options * Dedicated personal development budget * Medical, vision, and dental coverage * 28\+ days of paid time off across PTO and wellbeing days, so you can show up at your best * Paid parental leave * 401k retirement plan * All the equipment you need to do your best work * Inclusive, people\-first policies designed by our team, for our team **DIVERSITY AT** **SCAN.COM** ----------------------------- Scan.com is committed to eliminating discrimination and encouraging diversity within our team. We strive to provide equality and fairness for all job applicants and employees and never discriminate on the basis of gender, marital status, age, race, ethnicity, religion, or physical differences. We are opposed to all forms of unlawful treatment and discrimination. Our ambition is for our team to be representative of society's diversity, and for every employee to feel respected and able to bring their best selves to work. If you need an accommodation to apply or interview, contact us at people@scan.com. We look forward to receiving your application! Compensation Range: $180K \- $240K

jobs.description: **Champion Aerospace LLC** Job Description **Job Title:** Security Engineer **Department:** IT **Reports To:** I T \& IS Manager **Shift/Schedule:** Office Hours **Summary** The Security Engineer is a high\-visibility position responsible for supporting the company's day\-to\-day IT operations while maintaining and improving the organization's cybersecurity program. This role provides hands\-on technical support to employees, helps administer and secure IT systems, and works closely with internal teams and technology vendors to resolve issues and improve the reliability and security of company systems. This position supports a broad range of technologies, including endpoint systems, Microsoft 365, identity and access management, networking, security tools, business applications, and other infrastructure. The Security Engineer will also participate in projects that improve IT services, security controls, business processes, and compliance. **Duties and Responsibilities** * Support day\-to\-day IT and security operations, including alert triage, log review, endpoint monitoring, and assisting with security investigations and incident response. * Provide hands\-on IT support and troubleshooting for Windows workstations, laptops, applications, peripherals, and common network/connectivity issues. Help diagnose and resolve PC problems and escalate more complex issues when appropriate. * Help administer identity and access management systems, including Entra ID, SSO, MFA, directory services, and user onboarding, transfers, and offboarding. Conduct periodic access reviews and help clean up stale accounts and entitlements. * Maintain and improve endpoint security across the company, including EDR health, patch management, configuration standards, disk encryption, and endpoint security controls. * Assist with network and infrastructure security tasks, including firewall rule reviews, VPN administration, network segmentation, monitoring, and identifying configuration issues. * Support the vulnerability management program by assisting with vulnerability scanning, prioritizing findings, coordinating remediation with system owners, and tracking remediation progress. * Provide basic vendor management and coordination, including opening and tracking support cases, communicating with vendors on technical issues, reviewing service or security documentation, and helping ensure vendor commitments and follow\-up items are completed. * Support third\-party and vendor risk management by reviewing security documentation, identifying potential concerns, and tracking remediation or risk acceptance activities. * Contribute to the company's compliance and security programs by helping collect evidence, maintain policies and procedures, complete customer security questionnaires, and prepare for audits and assessments, including CMMC, Cyber Insurance, and other applicable requirements. * Build and deliver security awareness content, including phishing simulations, onboarding training, and internal security guidance. * Serve as a knowledgeable point of contact for employees with IT and security questions, including suspicious emails, lost or replaced devices, access issues, software problems, and security\-related requests. * Document processes, troubleshooting procedures, and runbooks. * Identify opportunities to improve IT and security processes through automation, better documentation, and more efficient use of existing tools. * Participate in an on\-call rotation as needed for critical IT or security issues. **Minimum Job Requirements** * Associate degree in an IT field and/or 3\-5 years of experience in a cybersecurity role **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required** * Strong understanding of Windows operating systems, Microsoft 365, networking, and common enterprise IT technologies. * Working knowledge of cybersecurity concepts, including identity and access management, endpoint protection, vulnerability management, email security, and network security. * Working knowledge of Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID. * Familiarity with endpoint management and security platforms such as Microsoft Intune, EDR, vulnerability scanners, and SIEM/logging systems. * Basic understanding of networking concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, firewalls, switching, and wireless networks. * Ability to troubleshoot PC hardware, operating systems, applications, peripherals, and connectivity problems. * Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into practical technical solutions. * Comfortable working independently while also collaborating with other IT staff, vendors, and business departments. * Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects, support requests, and competing priorities. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical and security concepts to employees with varying levels of technical knowledge. * Ability to maintain accurate technical documentation and follow established processes. * Familiarity with scripting or automation using PowerShell, or similar tools is preferred. * Familiarity with IT security and compliance frameworks such as CMMC, NIST, or similar requirements is preferred. * Relevant certifications such as CompTIA Security\+, Network\+, Microsoft certifications, CISA, CISM, CISSP, or similar are preferred. **Additional Requirements** * Work will be performed on\-site. * Nights, weekends, and holidays are required at times. * Successful candidates may be subject to a background check prior to starting work. **Working Conditions and Physical Effort** * Physical effort is required. * Work is normally performed in a typical interior/office work environment. * Moderate physical activity. Requires handling of average\-weight objects up to 50 pounds. The employee is expected to adhere to all company policies. **NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all\-inclusive. Employee may perform other duties assigned to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.**

As a Process Engineer, you will identify opportunities to improve manufacturing processes, helping to increase efficiency, quality, and safety across operations. You will also use data and continuous improvement principles to help drive better performance and reliable results. **A typical day as a Process Engineer might include:** * Providing engineering support in multiple areas of manufacturing. * Specifying, developing, justifying, implementing, and sustaining assembly equipment and materials. * Improving quality, yield, efficiency, and capacity of processes in accordance with strategic objectives. * Applying statistical problem solving to identify root causes. * Evaluating new equipment and processes and process improvement activities. * Interpreting results and providing recommendations to management. * Keeping abreast of new developments in equipment, industry standards, best practices, and developments in assembly processes. * Modeling, teaching, and applying SEL Values, Principles of Operations, and World Class Manufacturing Principles. **This job might be for you if:** * You have a B.S. in Engineering or equivalent combination of education and experience. * You have two years' experience in process development in a related world class manufacturing company. * You can lead a cross functional team. * You can influence others and reach consensus. * You have project management experience. * You have knowledge of statistics as applied to process capability measurements. * You have effective writing, documentation, and speaking skills. * You can work cooperatively in a team environment. * You have background check results satisfactory to SEL. * You have negative drug test result(s). **It is a plus if you have:** * Thorough understanding of the materials used in the industry. **Physical Requirements** None **About Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories** SEL designs, manufactures, and supports products and systems that protect, monitor, control, and automate electric power systems. jobs.description: Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd, Slideshare, Everand, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise. **Culture at Scribd, Inc.** --------------------------- We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer. We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in\-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in\-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location. So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long\-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude. This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization. **The team.** Data \& Analytics at Scribd brings together Analytics Engineering, Data Science, and Product Analytics to turn fragmented data and inconsistent definitions into trusted foundations, and to build AI\-assisted tools that bring reliable intelligence into how teams make decisions. **The role.** This role supports Content Supply \& Understanding, the team that owns Scribd’s library of more than 400 million documents, which reaches over 250 million monthly active users. The team’s remit covers who contributes the content, how well we understand it, and how it reaches users. You will report to the Senior Manager, Data Analytics, and work embedded alongside Product, Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Science, and Analytics Engineering partners. The role is open at the Senior and Lead levels, and we will level based on the experience you bring. At the Senior level you own analytical workstreams within a defined area. At the Lead level you also set the measurement strategy for the area, take on the most open\-ended problems, and raise the bar for the analysts around you. **Mandate.** Make it possible to say with confidence what is in the corpus, where it falls short of what users look for, and whether enrichment is making content easier to find and use, with numbers that stay comparable as content sources, models, and pipelines change. **Core philosophy.** A metric definition is a shared artifact. We care about documentation, versioning, and data quality as much as the readout on top, because a number that quietly breaks upstream is worse than no number at all. **About you** ------------- * You are at your best when the question is not yet well formed. You look at an incomplete picture, work out what matters, and produce an answer a product team can act on, with the limits of the evidence stated plainly. * You are equally comfortable as the strategist and the analyst. You can size an opportunity, model its return, write the SQL behind the metric, and defend the number in a room full of product and executive leaders. * You are skeptical by default. When a metric moves sharply, your instinct is to find the field or pipeline that changed before you write the narrative. * You are pragmatic. You ask what the right next version is, and you use AI where it creates measurable value. * You communicate early and plainly, and you write things down. Methodology and metric documentation are part of the deliverable. **You will** ------------ * Build measurement for content understanding. Define how we measure classification and metadata coverage, accuracy, and the effect of enrichment on discovery and engagement. * Own analytics for content supply and generate insights on where the corpus falls short: size the gap between user demand and the corpus, estimate the value of closing it, and help prioritize where to invest, using the same market sizing, segmentation, and ROI methods applied in go\-to\-market analysis. * Partner with Product Managers on strategy and roadmap. pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, or data migration efforts from legacy systems to cloud platforms. * Familiarity with cloud data platforms such as Databricks and AWS, including exposure to Delta tables data accuracy, consistency, and edge cases. * Experience working within Agile/Scrum project methodologies. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work across cross\-functional, matrixed teams. **Preferred Skills** * Experience testing or validating AI/ML model outputs or AI agent\-based use cases. * Familiarity with medallion architecture, including Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers, and modern data lakehouse design. * Experience with test automation tools and frameworks for data or API testing. * Experience operating within FISMA High, FedRAMP, or
