jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Customer & Vendor Management
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Senior Software Engineer **Company:** Snapsheet **Job Location:** USA,Remote **Job Type:** Full\-time, direct hire **About Snapsheet**: Snapsheet is claims technology the way it should be: purposeful, precise, and designed to deliver outcomes. Where others bolt things on, we engineer them into our core systems and processes across cloud\-based claims management, virtual vehicle appraisals, and elite loss and recovery services. Trusted by over 170\+ P\&C Carriers, MGAs, MGUs, TPAs, and logistics companies, our open architecture is built to fit how our companies work, not the other way around. **Role Overview:** We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join Snapsheet’s Customer Vendor Management (CVM) team who is passionate about technology, eager to learn, and ready to create impactful solutions. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a key contributor to the evolution of our industry\-leading claims engine. CVM owns how claims connect with customers, vendors, and external partners across the full claim lifecycle. In this role, you will build the customer self\-service experiences that start a claim, such as online claim reporting and photo capture. You’ll also build the vendor integrations and workflows that connect carriers with repair shops, appraisers, salvage partners, and other third parties. You’ll help shape estimating, appraisal, and total loss functionality and make sure our partner ecosystem runs reliably at scale. **What we are looking for:** * BS in Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related STEM field * 5\+ years of full\-stack web development experience, with particular strength in back\-end development + Designing and building APIs + Designing schemas and performant queries for relational databases + Understanding of scalability challenges and performance of server\-side code * Prior professional experience using React and/or Typescript a plus * Prior experience using Ruby on Rails a plus * Experience with AI tools and AI\-assisted software development (AI SDLC) is a plus * Eagerness to learn from and work with a collaborative team * Commitment to quality and passion for technology and creating cutting\-edge solutions * Ability to manage tasks and to contribute towards multiple initiatives during a sprint **Our tech stack:*** Frameworks: Ruby on Rails and React * Methodology: Agile * Infrastructure: MySQL, S3, Redis, Elasticsearch, RabbitMQ, Lambda, Docker, CloudFront **We’re Built to Grow With You – And That Starts With How We Support You** At Snapsheet, we know that growth doesn’t happen in a vacuum—it’s fueled by the right support at the right time. That’s why we’ve built a benefits experience designed to grow with you, wherever life takes you. * Choose from 2 robust medical plans through Blue Cross Blue Shield—plus, we contribute to your HSA when you enroll in our high\-deductible health plan. * Offer two dental plans and one vision plan to keep you and your family healthy. * Peace of mind with company\-paid Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability, and Life Insurance. * Additional protection through voluntary benefits like Accident Insurance, Hospital Indemnity, Critical Illness, and Legal Assistance. * 401(k) with a 4% company match—because your future is worth investing in. * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with 6 sessions per life incident to support your mental well\-being. **Perks That Make Growing Here Even Better:** * Flexible PTO and 7\.5 company\-observed holidays to recharge on your terms. * In\-person connection points throughout the year including our annual Summit and Roadshows. * Snapsheet SWAG and surprise mailers to keep the spirit alive. * Endless opportunity to shape your path—career growth, learning, and real impact are all within reach. * Health and wellness campaigns that evolve with you year over year. **Compensation that Grows with You** For this position, the base salary range is $135,000 \- $165,000\. While this range serves as a guideline, your actual compensation will reflect your unique experience, skill set, and location. At Snapsheet, we believe growth should be rewarded—our compensation and benefits are built to evolve with you as your career does. *We are not currently accepting applications for candidates who reside in New York or California.* * *Please note that we are unable to sponsor applicants for work visas for this position at this time.* *Don’t meet every single requirement? jobs.title: AI Software Engineer
jobs.description: At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI\-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. **Data Transformation** is the foundational product portfolio that makes enterprise Agentic AI possible. Our mission is to transform the full enterprise data estate. We build the product that guides customers through every layer of a modern AI architecture: from Platform Foundation \& Migration, through Data Ingestion \& Engineering, to Semantic, Context, Ontology, \& Governance layers. By unlocking each layer, we enable customers to deploy Agentic AI with full, governed access to their complete Snowflake data estate. The Data Transformation workflows are some of the most complex enterprise challenges and the most impactful for our customers and for Snowflake. **FRONTIER ENGINEERING** Sitting within Snowflake’s **Frontier Engineering organization**—a specialized team of Engineers, Product Managers, Solutions Architects, and AI Experts—you will own Snowflake’s Data Transformation product portfolio. Your scope spans intelligent migration products that understand and rewrite legacy application logic, multi\-source ingestion pipelines, legacy data warehouse modernization, ETL/ELT transformation, and data platform rationalization. In this role, you will set product vision, lead a team of PMs, and deliver the tooling that turns fragmented legacy infrastructure into an AI\-first enterprise platform. **AS A DIRECTOR OF PRODUCT MANAGEMENT, YOU WILL:** * Define Vision \& Strategy: Own the strategic roadmap across the full transformation stack—from platform migration to semantic and context layers—ensuring every initiative moves enterprises closer to an AI\-ready Snowflake platform. * Lead \& Scale a High\-Performing PM Team: Build, mentor, and manage a team of product managers, fostering a culture of high velocity, accountability, and technical rigor. * Partner with Engineering Leadership: Deeply engage with technical leaders to shape execution strategies, balancing engineering effort and long\-term architectural scalability across complex pipeline and query transformation workloads. * Drive Execution with an MVP Mindset: Champion speed and clarity, setting precise roadmap milestones, prioritizing ruthlessly, and ensuring seamless cross\-functional alignment. * Own GTM \& Customer Adoption: Partner with Marketing, field teams, and executive customers to position transformation capabilities, accelerate migrations, and drive platform adoption. * Drive Thought Leadership: Serve as an external voice for Snowflake, helping shape the industry narrative around legacy modernization, automated pipeline refactoring, and AI\-first data architecture. **OUR IDEAL DIRECTOR OF PRODUCT MANAGEMENT WILL HAVE:** * 12\+ Years in Data Infrastructure: Proven track record delivering enterprise\-scale data platforms, migration tooling, query engines, or pipeline infrastructure. * Proven PM Leadership: Strong experience building, managing, and mentoring high\-performing product management teams. * Deep Technical Foundation: Hands\-on familiarity with modern data ecosystems—including SQL execution, ETL/ELT patterns, declarative pipelines, and workflow orchestration. * Applied GenAI Exposure: Practical understanding of AI\-assisted capabilities, such as automated code translation, developer co\-pilots, semantic validation, and LLM\-driven refactoring. * Strategic \& Analytical Execution: Ability to navigate technical ambiguity, make sound decisions using data and instincts, and reduce time\-to\-value for enterprise customers. * Executive Communication: Exceptional ability to translate complex architectural capabilities into clear, compelling narratives for customers, field leadership, and executives. Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. How do you want to make your impact? For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role: * The estimated base salary range for this role is $304,000 \- $437,000\. * Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Snowflake’s bonus and equity plan. The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; flexible spending \& health savings account; at least 12 paid holidays; paid time off; parental leave; employee assistance program; and other company benefits. jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description: At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI\-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. **Software Engineer — Ingestion Execution Platform** ==================================================== **Build the always\-on engine behind Snowflake ingestion** ---------------------------------------------------------- Snowflake’s ingestion products land customer data into the AI Data Cloud at petabytes scale, on a path to much larger scale. Those products run on a shared, always\-on **ingestion execution platform**: a multi\-tenant control plane that owns pipeline lifecycle, durable work queues, single\-owner execution, step orchestration across control plane and compute, multi\-tenant scheduling, source monitoring, and cluster topology. You will build the substrate other ingestion teams ship on. Reliability, fairness, and efficiency at this layer multiply across ingestion products. As a **Software Engineer**, you will own substantial platform work end to end: take a hard distributed\-systems problem from design through production, make neighboring teams more successful, and raise the bar on correctness, isolation, and operability. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Design and ship core platform capabilities. Work on areas such as multi\-tenant isolation, fair scheduling, ownership and placement, durable queues, source monitoring, or compute allocation. You own the work from design through production. * Strengthen isolation and fairness. Build and evolve the primitives that let many products and pipelines share one platform safely: quotas, backpressure, resource accounting, and intelligent placement. * Raise reliability and observability. Improve availability and latency for pipeline health, ingest APIs, and compute allocation. Instrument the system so behavior is visible and actionable. * Build a clean platform surface. Give product teams a consistent way to express pipelines and processing steps, so they can ship on shared primitives rather than special\-casing the stack. * Scale the control plane. Design for more concurrent pipelines, higher ingest volume, and efficient use of compute and metadata as customer usage grows. * Operate what you ship. This platform sits on the critical path for production ingest. You will participate in production support, improve observability, and automate operational work. Mentorship of junior engineers is part of the job. You will also work closely with engineers on larger platform bets. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- * 3–6\+ years building and operating large\-scale distributed systems or cloud infrastructure in production. You have shipped something hard that other teams depend on, not only application features. * Track record of end\-to\-end ownership: you took an ambiguous, cross\-cutting problem, wrote the design, landed the code, and lived with it in production. Comfortable operating above your level, influencing adjacent teams and helping sequence larger bets without waiting to be told what to do. * Strong proficiency in Java (this codebase is Java\-first). C\+\+ or systems\-level experience is a plus. You write concurrent, failure\-aware code and you care about the invariants. * Experience in at least one of: multi\-tenant control planes, durable queues and at\-least\-once processing, distributed locking / leases / membership, cluster scheduling, or streaming/ingest execution engines. * Instinct for correctness under failure. You think carefully about crashes, retries, redelivery, and exclusive ownership. * Clear written and verbal communication. You can write a clear design for engineers on neighboring product teams, and you can hold a technical argument without ego. * BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. **Bonus Points** ---------------- * Experience building internal platforms used by multiple product teams (orchestration, job/runtime frameworks, multi\-tenant schedulers). * Background in multi\-tenant isolation and fairness: resource accounting, request throttling, quota systems, or load\-aware placement. * Hands\-on with transactional or consensus\-backed metadata stores (for example etcd, ZooKeeper, or Spanner\-style systems). * Familiarity with open table formats (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake), Kafka\-style streaming, or warehouse scheduling. * Performance work at scale: tail latency, memory and thread accounting, I/O batching, or cost\-per\-unit efficiency. * You have used AI as a serious engineering collaborator (design review, debugging, test generation) and can show how it made you faster without lowering the bar. Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. How do you want to make your impact? For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role: * The estimated base salary range for this role is $160,000 \- $230,000\. * Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Snowflake’s bonus and equity plan. This is an excellent opportunity for a software professional who enjoys solving problems, building AI\-driven solutions, and transforming manual processes into efficient, automated workflows. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with Databricks. * Experience using Claude or similar AI platforms and large language model (LLM) technologies. * Familiarity with AI\-assisted workflow automation, data processing, and analytics. * Experience developing internal applications, productivity tools, or solutions that improve operational efficiency. * Experience documenting software solutions and conducting user training or knowledge\-sharing sessions. jobs.title: Principal Data Scientist - Identity and Matching Models
jobs.description: ##### **About Spokeo** Spokeo is a people intelligence platform that helps over 18 million monthly visitors reconnect with friends, reunite with families, and build trust in new relationships. Thousands of companies also trust Spokeo's 60 billion public records to improve customer research, help verify information, and prevent fraud. Founded in 2006, Spokeo has built a dedicated, remote\-first team with an average tenure of 6\.9 years. Comparably has recognized it as a Best Company for Compensation, Employee Happiness, Perks and Benefits, Support for Women, Work\-Life Balance, and CEO Leadership. ##### **About This Opportunity** Every Spokeo search result depends on one decision: do these records describe the same person, and how sure are we? You will build the models that make that call, on messy data from many vendors and public sources, where there is no answer key to check against. You will own a modeling problem from the first question to the production release, and you will see your work change what customers see. The Data Science team is small, so you work directly with the Director of Data Science and the product owners. If you like designing the test as much as building the model, and you want to mentor teammates as the team grows, this is the place to do it. ##### **What You'll Do:** Rough share of your time, subject to change. * 35%: Build and improve the models that match records and score how confident we are in each result. You will choose the approach, train it, test it honestly on held\-out data, and ship it. * 20%: Design the labels and the measurement. Decide what to hand\-check, build the evaluation sets, and estimate how often we are right when a full answer key does not exist. This includes using AI models to help label at scale, and checking them against human judgment. * 15%: Take models to production on AWS, with ML engineering and DevOps. That covers the retrain schedule, the model registry, and a record of where every model and its data came from. * 10%: Review each data build before it ships. Find what changed, catch regressions, and explain it in plain language to product and sales partners. * 10%: Work with the Product Owner to turn findings into stories with clear targets, and defend the priority of the next research spike. * 10%: Document your methods, review teammates' code, and take part in the DS/ML working group. Tools. What you will work with: Python, SQL, Spark, AWS SageMaker, Databricks, and MLflow. Challenges. Noisy and incomplete records, no large hand\-labeled set to lean on, and opt\-out and retention rules that every model must respect. People. The Director of Data Science, product owners, ML engineers, DevOps, and the DS/ML working group. ##### **Who You Are:** What you have done matters more than the tools you have touched. Equivalent experience counts. * Required: 6\+ years of applied data science, though what you have shipped matters more than the count. * Required: A Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field is expected, and a master’s is preferred, or equivalent professional experience. * Taken a model from idea to production in a cloud setting (AWS SageMaker, Databricks, MLflow, or similar), monitored it, and measured how it performed after launch. * Worked with very large datasets (100 million rows or more) using Spark or a similar tool, with Python and SQL. * Judged whether a model is good when no clean answer key exists, for example by sampling and hand\-checking results, and said how confident you are in the number. * Told a real improvement from noise, and explained the result, its limits, and the tradeoffs in plain language to engineers and product owners alike. * Kept a model healthy as its data changed: knowing when labels and models have gone out of date and need refreshing, and writing the process down so a teammate can pick it up. * Handled personal data responsibly, following opt\-out, retention, and lineage rules without being reminded. * Experience matching or de\-duplicating records, using AI to help label data, graph methods, or turning a raw model score into a confidence a product team can act on, is a plus. ##### **Working at Spokeo** Our mission is to advance transparency, and to achieve that goal, we rally around six core values: listening with empathy, understanding the why, clarifying with data, innovating to learn, collaborating to achieve, and insisting on quality. As a remote\-first company, we can hire team members in the following US states: AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, KY, MD, MI, MO, NJ, NV, NC, PA, SC, SD, TX, VA, WA, or WY. In addition to a highly competitive base salary, our generous benefits include: * annual bonus program * stock options * 401K matching * 100% medical/dental/vision coverage * unlimited PTO * mental health resources * paid home office equipment * fitness reimbursements * support paying for courses * and more We extend written offers to candidates who successfully complete their selection process. Offers will depend on several factors, including, but not limited to, marketplace competition, job leveling, experience, and skills. Privacy Notice for Candidates: https://www.spokeo.com/recruiting\-policy Spokeo is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status. Spokeo fosters a business culture where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best products, and be relevant in a rapidly changing world. Recruiters or staffing agencies: Spokeo is not obligated to compensate any external recruiter or search firm who presents a candidate or their resume or profile to a Spokeo employee without 1\) a current, fully executed agreement on file, and 2\) being assigned to the open position (as a search) via our applicant tracking solution. ##### **Use of Artificial Intelligence in Our Hiring Process** Spokeo may use artificial intelligence\-enabled tools to support portions of the recruiting process. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Stanford's Graduate School of Business (GSB) has built a global reputation based on its immersive and innovative management programs. We provide students a transformative leadership experience, pushing the boundaries of knowledge with faculty research, and offering a portfolio of entrepreneurial and non\-degree programs that deliver global impact. We invite you to be part of our mission of developing innovative, principled, and insightful leaders who change lives, change organizations, and change the world. Success at the GSB is defined by The GSB Way \- a commitment to shared purpose, community, and excellence in all that we do. We seek individuals who elevate themselves and those around them through the practice of academic candor, generous collaboration, and bringing curiosity and rigor to solving meaningful problems. At the GSB, impact means taking ownership and contributing to a purpose\-driven, collaborative, and high\-performing community in service to the institution’s mission. The Digital Solutions department of the Stanford Graduate School of Business seeks a Senior Software Engineer who will work on several web applications and cloud platforms. In this role, along with supporting operational activities, you will also have the opportunity to contribute towards all phases of a delivery project, including systems analysis, architecture and technical design, development, build \& release, and maintenance. You will be expected to provide innovative technology solutions to grow and stabilize the technology platforms along with improving the processes. You are a self\-motivated, rapid learner, a seasoned thought partner, and an exceptional communicator with the ability to translate between business and technical partners. **Primary responsibilities include:** * Design and develop complex applications, web solutions, and integrations that address business needs. * Quickly assess new ideas for feasibility, value, data availability, security, cost, and operational needs. Build prototypes, validate assumptions with users, and recommend whether and how to proceed. * Develop AI\-enabled applications and workflows using appropriate models, APIs, retrieval techniques, and tools. Use AI development tools effectively while remaining accountable for code quality and correctness. * Convert successful prototypes into secure, scalable production applications with automated testing, deployment pipelines, monitoring, and rollback capabilities. * Incorporate security and privacy throughout development, including access controls, sensitive data protection, and safeguards against AI\-specific risks. * Own the application life cycle, including deployment, production support, documentation, maintenance, dependency and model upgrades, migration, and retirement. * Oversee testing, debugging, and change control. Evaluate application and AI performance, reliability, output quality, latency, and cost, and address failures and regressions. * Lead projects, troubleshoot complex problems, mentor engineers, establish standards, and contribute to long\-term technical planning. Evaluate emerging technologies through hands\-on experimentation and guide appropriate adoption. * Collaborate with business users, analysts, QA, and distributed remote technical teams across time zones to improve processes and deliver value. Exemplify GSB principles of open, honest, and timely communication, personal ownership, and innovation. * Perform other duties as assigned. **To be successful in this position, you will bring:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline and eight years of increasing responsibility in software development, or a combination of education and relevant experience. * At least two years of sustained, hands\-on experience building, evaluating, and improving AI\-enabled applications or substantive AI workflows. Occasional use of chatbots, AI plugins, or code assistants alone does not meet this requirement. * Demonstrable AI experience gained through professional work, applied research, open\-source contributions, or sustained independent projects. Ability to explain your implementations, experiments, technical decisions, failures, and improvements. Examples may be anonymized; public repositories are not required. * Proven ability to independently assess ambiguous ideas, rapidly build working prototypes, and deliver and support production applications, including AI\-enabled solutions. * Practical experience with model APIs or SDKs, prompt and context design, and relevant patterns such as retrieval\-augmented generation, structured outputs, or tool calling. Ability to evaluate results, diagnose failures, and balance quality, latency, cost, and privacy. * Experience using AI coding assistants or agentic development tools for substantive development, debugging, testing, or refactoring, with the ability to understand, validate, and maintain the resulting code. * Strong coding skills in at least one language such as Java, Python, PHP, or C\#, and experience with frontend and backend web development, including JavaScript frameworks such as React or NextJS. * Demonstrated understanding of software architecture, testing, deployment, and life cycle management, including secure coding, scalability, accessibility, complex workflows, and system integration. * Skills in one or more areas such as API development, service\-oriented architecture, cloud computing, MVC, or mobile application development. * Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and continuous learning, with experience working in distributed agile/scrum teams and explaining technical tradeoffs to technical and nontechnical audiences.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Acoustics
jobs.description: Join Starkey as a software engineer and help turn advances in hearing science, acoustics, and signal processing into innovative features that improve people’s lives. Collaborate with talented, cross\-functional teams, grow your expertise in a modern C\#/.NET environment, and make every detail count as we help the world hear and live better. Starkey is a world leader in the manufacturing and distribution of advanced hearing technologies. We are in the business of connecting people and changing lives. Our teams come to work each day focused on ensuring people everywhere have the products and services they need to hear better and live better. Founded in 1967 by Bill Austin, Starkey is known for our cutting\-edge hearing health innovations, industry\-leading research and development, and not being afraid to push the edge of what’s possible. We are headquartered in Eden Prairie, Minnesota, have over 5,000 employees in 29 facilities across the globe, and do business in more than 100 markets worldwide. Watch this video to see more of what sets Starkey apart: https://youtu.be/9cUYwTlCepg?si\=wkovx8\_R\_iINfrc6 (https://youtu.be/9cUYwTlCepg?si\=wkovx8\_R\_iINfrc6\) Starkey is looking for a software engineer to work at the intersection of software engineering, hearing science, acoustics, and signal processing. In this unique position, you will join our software engineering team and collaborate heavily with other various teams to bring innovative new hearing aid features to market. This is an opportunity to join a team that does meaningful work surrounded by other bright and talented engineers. The ideal candidate for this position is someone who takes pride in learning how complex systems work, has an interest in translating the physical world to the digital one, and pays attention to minute details that others do not notice. In the world of hearing aids, every millimeter, decibel, and bit matters: come join a team that brings that spirit with them to work every day as we help the world to hear better and live better! *You Will Be* * Working in a modern C\#/.NET codebase that is leveraged by all of Starkey’s customer\-facing and internal software applications to program hearing aids * Working with R\&D cross\-functional teams to build and maintain the subsystem of our fitting software that is focused on modelling the acoustics of our hearing aids as well as the impact of new signal processing algorithms on acoustic performance * Collaborating with clinical and customer\-facing teams to debug and root cause issues that audiologists face in the field * Learning to balance tradeoffs and technical constraints that impact acoustic performance, usability, and maintainability for patients and clinicians * Analyzing and presenting data to decision\-making stakeholders * Receiving mentorship from seasoned software engineers and engineers in other disciplines as you learn the hearing aid domain from every angle *Our Culture Provides* * An experienced and knowledgeable team with a culture of professional growth and knowledge sharing * Fun\-loving work environment * An excellent work/life balance * Hybrid work environment * Excellent starting salary, competitive benefits package, and company paid continuing education *You Will Need* * Experience and interest in both software development and acoustics with a bachelor’s degree in at least one of these areas: computer science, electrical engineering, hearing science, audiology (or adjacent domain) * Understanding of object\-oriented software design * A learner’s mindset with a willingness to ask questions and soak up knowledge * Ability to thrive in a team environment * Passion for science, data\-driven decision making, and experimentation *Salary and Other Compensation:* *The target pay rate for this position is between $94,000 \- $131,000 annually. Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include: geography/market, skills, education, experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.* *This position is eligible for a bonus based upon performance results. There is no guarantee of payout.* *The following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements, include medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan with company match, company\-paid life and short\-term disability insurance, long\-term disability insurance, employee assistance plan, hearing aid benefits, Paid Time Off, paid holidays, paid floating holidays, paid volunteer service day, paid paternity and maternity leave and tuition reimbursement.* \#LI\-MP1 Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you! **Compensation:** $105,000\-$125,000 commensurate with experience **What You’ll Do:** * Serve as the primary coordination point between business stakeholders and the software development team for assigned initiatives, enhancements, defects, and support\-related development work. * Manage and govern the intake of technical requests across jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **How You'll Make An Impact** At Strive Health, patients come first. This is a senior, hands\-on individual contributor role. You will take on the most complex and ambiguous technical problems, designing and building scalable, reliable, and secure software while balancing the need to maintain and scale existing systems with the need to deliver new capabilities for patients, clinicians, and partners. Your impact will extend well beyond the systems you build yourself. You will help teams make sound architectural decisions, establish reusable patterns and standards, address systemic technical risk, and mentor engineers across multiple teams, raising the bar on design, implementation quality, and cross\-functional collaboration. This role reports to a Senior Engineering Manager or Director of Engineering. **The Day to Day** * Lead the technical strategy, architecture, and roadmap for one or more critical domains within Strive's platform, grounded in our business objectives and long\-term product vision. * Design and deliver end\-to\-end solutions for complex, cross\-team initiatives, from problem framing and architecture through implementation, rollout, and production operation. * Stay hands\-on in the code, writing high\-quality, well\-tested, observable software, especially where complexity, risk, or ambiguity calls for senior engineering leadership. * Make pragmatic architectural tradeoffs that balance scalability, reliability, security, compliance, delivery speed, cost, and long\-term maintainability, while keeping the platform simple for other engineers to build on. * Design and evolve the APIs, services, data models, integrations, and distributed systems that support Strive's products and healthcare operations. * Partner with Product, Clinical, Data, Security, and Operations leaders to make sure we solve the right problems in the right order, with clear outcomes and measures of success. * Identify systemic technical risks, architectural limitations, performance bottlenecks, and technical debt, and lead the work to address them. * Establish reusable architectural patterns, reference implementations, and engineering standards that help teams build consistently and effectively. * Drive platform\-wide improvements in developer experience, reliability, observability, security posture, and performance that measurably improve how engineering delivers value. * Provide technical leadership across teams by facilitating design and architecture reviews, guiding major engineering decisions, and unblocking teams through hands\-on help. * Participate in production support and incident response, helping teams find root causes and turn operational lessons into better architecture, tooling, and practices. * Collaborate with Security and Compliance to ensure systems protect sensitive healthcare information and meet regulatory and organizational requirements. * Mentor and coach engineers and tech leads through design discussions, code reviews, pairing, and day\-to\-day work, helping them strengthen their technical judgment and grow as owners of their domains. * Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI\-assisted engineering tools, and identify opportunities to improve developer productivity, software quality, and engineering effectiveness. * Co xperience building them into application and system design. * Strong experience designing and scaling distributed systems, event\-driven architectures, and data pipelines on AWS or a similar cloud platform. * Familiarity with healthcare interoperability, clinical data, electronic health records, or standards such as FHIR and HL7\. * Experience with relational and non\-relational data stores and systems processing significant volumes of operational or clinical data. * Experience influencing engineering strategy beyond a single team, such as setting technical direction or establishing architecture, testing, observability, and operational standards across teams. * Experience leading modernization efforts involving legacy systems, architecture evolution, or significant technical debt. * Experience with AI\-assisted software development tools, and with evaluating new technologies through prototypes, reference implementations, and incremental adoption. * Exposure to kidney care, value\-based care, or other complex clinical workflows. **About You** * You are a builder who enjoys designing systems, writing code, solving hard problems, and seeing your work run successfully in production. * You are energized by ambiguous, high\-impact problems and can turn loosely defined challenges into clear technical approaches, even where process and systems don't yet exist. * You pair broad knowledge of software engineering with deep expertise in one or more areas, and you use that breadth to weigh the organizational impact of technical choices. * You have strong technical judgment and know that the best solution isn't always the most complex one, or when a long\-term platform investment is worth it versus a simpler approach. * You balance short\-term needs with long\-term architectural investments and keep a clear view of tradeoffs and sequencing over time. * You are an excellent systems thinker and communicator who explains decisions and the reasoning behind them, and proactively shares risks, tradeoffs, and progress. * You raise engineering standards through influence, collaboration, and example rather than authority, and you enjoy helping others grow their skills and autonomy. * You challenge assumptions constructively while staying open to different perspectives and new information. * You take ownership of outcomes, including the reliability and maintainability of software long after it ships. * You approach privacy, security, and risk thoughtfully because the systems you build support patients and clinicians, and you handle sensitive information with integrity and discretion. * You are collaborative, low\-ego, and motivated by the success of the broader team rather than ownership boundaries. * You are outcome\-driven and curious, using data, experimentation, and feedback loops, as well as thoughtful adoption of AI and other new capabilities, to keep improving the platform and how engineering works. **Annual Salary Range: $130,000 \- $163,000\. This position is also eligible for a target annual bonus of 15%** Final compensation will be determined based on location, experience, and qualifications. **SQL**. * Experience developing and consuming **REST APIs** and building software integrations. * Familiarity with Bash, PowerShell, or other scripting languages. * Experience working with cloud Excellent customer communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Strong project management, organization, and problem\-solving abilities. * Comfortable working in a fast\-paced startup environment with evolving priorities and ambiguous technical challenges. * Willingness to travel approximately **25% to 40%** jobs.title: Sr. Sensor Hardware Engineer, Sensor Fusion
jobs.description: **What to Expect** The best rides feel effortless and rejuvenating. The cabin is prepared for you before you notice: the freshness of the air, the atmosphere, the temperature, and the humidity. The vehicle seems to know when you need warming up, when you are heating up, when you are feeling unwell, and when you are ready to rest. None of it happens because someone pressed a button. It happens because the car quietly senses how its passengers are doing and responds. Think of automatic climate control, or air recirculation that reacts to what is in the air outside. We are building the next generation of that technology, to go with Tesla's industry\-leading FSD vehicles. Passengers never tell a vehicle how they feel, and no single sensor tells the whole story. Body heat, comfort, and drowsiness show up across many signals, and the vehicle understands them best when a well\-chosen set of sensors works together. As a sensor fusion hardware engineer on the Sensing Hardware Team, you will design that set. You'll decide which sensors the vehicle needs, where they go, and how their signals come together. Then you'll build prototypes, study the data, and refine the suite until it is as simple, robust, and affordable as it can be. You'll work closely with the algorithm team, and you're welcome to shape the algorithms yourself. As FSD frees people from the wheel, the ride itself becomes the product. You'll own a focused part of it, from first prototype to high\-volume production, on one of the most visible products in the world. **What You'll Do*** Own your subsystem end to end, from requirements through production, and be accountable for how it performs in the field * Architect the sensor suite for passenger comfort and state: choose sensing principles, quantity, and placement, and decide people and in vehicles, and turn the results into clear hardware decisions * Work with suppliers and manufacturing to take the design from prototype to production **What You'll Bring*** Degree in domain, such as thermal, climate, air or gas, optical, MEMS, biometric, wearable, medical, consumer, industrial, appliance, or robotics, and the curiosity to learn a new one * Experience combining multiple sensors and showing that the combination beats any one of them * Strong PCB and analog design, with working knowledge of CAD and mechanical integration * Strong data analysis (Python, MATLAB, or similar), with comfort using statistical or machine\-learning methods * Familiarity with common cabin and environmental conditions (temperature, humidity, CO2, VOCs) and how people affect them, We create in\-flight entertainment systems that engross 50 million fliers every year and we develop the avionics that control the world’s largest commercial aircrafts. Our simulators train the next generation of pilots for fighter jets, transporters and search and rescue helicopters. And, together, each and every member of our aerospace team makes a difference. When you rely on airlines to connect you in flight, you rely on Thales. In an increasingly fast paced world, we make the unpredictable, predictable by connecting and entertain passengers to make your life better. Combining a diversity of talents, we master the decisive moments that matter to passengers and airlines. Whatever it takes.**AI Engineer \- Graduate** Orlando, FL (Hybrid) **Position Summary** Thales is looking for a **AI Engineer Graduate** to join our engineering team and support the development of applied AI solutions that enhance the inflight passenger experience for millions of travelers worldwide, as well as support internal business and engineering initiatives. You will bring a foundational understanding of AI technologies, cloud platforms, software development practices, and Agile methodologies, along with a strong desire to expand your expertise in AI engineering and intelligent automation solutions. In this position you will contribute to the design, development, testing, deployment, and support of AI\-enabled applications across cloud and edge environments while gaining experience across the software development lifecycle and modern AI technologies. You will research, implement, test, document, deploy, and maintain new and existing solutions. To succeed, you must demonstrate strong problem\-solving skills, accountability, collaboration, and adaptability in a fast\-paced engineering environment. You will have opportunities to build your technical expertise, contribute to innovative solutions, and take on increasingly complex assignments as your experience grows. **Key Areas of Responsibility** * Contribute to the design, development, testing, deployment, and support of AI\-enabled applications and services; develop and maintain AI solutions, including Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications, intelligent automation capabilities, agent\-based workflows, and orchestration solutions, under the guidance of senior engineering team members. * Collaborate with engineering, product, platform, and business teams to understand requirements and assist in delivering AI solutions that address operational and customer needs; participate in code reviews, design discussions, sprint planning, and Agile development activities. * Support implementation of AI security, governance, privacy, and responsible AI practices by following established standards, processes, and technical controls. * Develop reusable components, tools, and automation capabilities that improve development efficiency, quality, and consistency across AI initiatives; stay current with emerging AI technologies and contribute ideas for continuous improvement and innovation within the engineering team. * Assist with monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance optimization to support reliable and scalable AI solutions; perform unit, integration, and automated testing to support secure, high\-quality software releases. * Create and maintain technical documentation for AI applications, workflows, deployment processes, and operational support procedures. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field – awarded within the 2 years preceding your application; 0\-2 years’ experience in software engineering, cloud development, machine learning, AI engineering, or a related technical discipline. * Working knowledge of applied AI concepts and solution patterns, including Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), agent\-based workflows, orchestration frameworks, intelligent automation, and prompt engineering; foundational understanding of modern AI systems, including model evaluation, tool integration, guardrails, observability, and responsible AI principles. * Proficiency in Python and experience developing modern applications using APIs and web technologies; experience working with cloud platforms, preferably AWS, including familiarity with serverless architectures and AI/ML services. * Foundational knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and automated deployment concepts. * Ability to analyze technical problems, evaluate options, and implement effective solutions; jobs.title: Data Engineer 2
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- The Farmer's Dog was born from a mission to change the landscape of pet health, providing dogs and their humans with honest, smart, and simple care. We're starting by radically improving the $90 billion pet food industry, replacing bags of highly\-processed pellets with a personalized subscription service that sends complete and balanced, freshly\-made dog food directly to customers' doors. Our ultimate goal is to create innovative, delightful and personalized experiences across all aspects of pet care, and we believe our direct\-to\-consumer business model, holistic approach to growth, and dynamic culture uniquely position us to shepherd this backwards industry into the future. To date, The Farmer's Dog has delivered over 1 billion meals nationwide and raised over $150M in funding to help us build a company as healthy as the dogs who are eating those meals. Join us as we continue to develop ways of bringing peace of mind to customers, health to their companions, and much\-needed change to the way people feed and care for their pets. \#LongLiveDogs **What We Stand For and Where You'll Come In** ---------------------------------------------- The Farmer's Dog is seeking a Data Engineer 2 to join our growing group! You will maximize your technical expertise and data analysis skills to develop, implement, and maintain data analytics solutions within the organization. This role will collaborate with cross\-functional groups \- including data scientists, data engineers, and business partners to gather requirements, design data models, build data pipelines, and deliver practical insights. You will be critical to ensure data integrity, optimize data workflows, and enabling partners to make effective decision\-making rooted in data. If you have a genuine love for data, technology, problem\-solving and want to improve how The Farmer's Dog makes strategic decisions at the company level, then this is the role for you! **One Team:** We don't think of ourselves as "Acquisition Marketers", "Engineers", "Data Analysts", or "Product Managers". Beyond denoting skill sets and areas of expertise, we don't think departments matter. We'd rather align ourselves to the goals we're working to achieve and make sure we have necessary subject matter expertise to drive meaningful impact. We strive to orient ourselves around customer problems TOGETHER – getting the right people, with the right context, in the right rooms/Zooms to solve problems holistically. **We are skeptical about everything and precious about nothing:** Ideas can and should come from anywhere, and we aren't tied to our own. We proactively source input. We talk to our customers and leads regularly and are quick to change course if we know there's a better or more impactful way to solve problems. **We consider the customer journey in all of our decisions:** We know that no interaction exists in a silo and therefore understand how important every single one is. We ensure our strategy sets prospective and new customers up for success and drives long\-term retention. We answer questions and address problems early and proactively. We understand the value of different channels, initiatives, and messages and know how to articulate impact and advocate for prioritization holistically. **We Execute For Impact:** We don't subscribe to "best practices" or "industry KPIs". We're uninterested in how we compare to "benchmarks"; instead we orient ourselves around being the best we can possibly be. Similarly, we don't subscribe to rigid or classical expectations of roles – i.e. acquisition is hyper\-focused on improving customer retention and experience. **We Are Focused and Work Without Assumption**: We are not beholden to ideas. We have goals and believe everything beyond that is a series of hypotheses to validate. To that end, we seek to work in sequence and not in parallel. We constantly ask ourselves, "what's the most important hypothesis I should be working on right now? How do I confirm or reject that hypothesis as fast as possible?". We rarely have timelines/deadlines and are constantly taking in new information and adjusting our priorities accordingly. We don't expect to be perfect the first time. **How You'll Make An Impact** ----------------------------- * Build and maintain data pipelines for structured and unstructured data supporting reporting, analytics and AI/ML use cases. * Write production\-level code that processes and validates millions of events per day. * Develop AI tooling and automation to enhance data engineering capabilities and workflows. * Ingest data from APIs, databases, file systems, and streaming platforms into our data infrastructure, and build and maintain pipelines for structured and unstructured data that support reporting, analytics, and AI/ML use cases. * Establish and maintain robust data governance frameworks across our data warehouse to ensure data integrity, reliability, and security across the organization * Impl nd data requirements and deliver solutions and you have experience communicating technical concepts effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * You're **detail\-oriented with strong problem\-solving skills** and can manage multiple priorities effectively * You are eager to learn new technologies, expand your skill set in a fast\-paced environment, and take initiative to optimize systems. * You love dogs. **Office Guidelines** --------------------- We are an in\-office culture, made of in\-office people who thrive on the collaboration and magnetism of working in a shared space. We are seeking individuals who excel in this type of environment, where being present fosters deeper connections and engagement. We ask all team members to be in office 4 \- 5 days a week to build a collaborative and invested environment to foster our unique in\-person culture we are proud to have. This office policy is subject to change at company discretion. **Our Belonging Philosophy:** ----------------------------- At TFD, we believe Belonging is a shared commitment to creating a workplace where every person feels respected, valued, and empowered to be themselves. When people feel a true sense of belonging, they do their best work, take smart risks, and bring forward diverse perspectives — leading to stronger decisions and deeper relationships. We anchor this belief in a simple phrase: "Everyone's welcome at the dog park." No matter your background, identity, or role, there's space for you here. There's no one way to show up at the dog park— just shared space, mutual respect, and the freedom to be yourself. Being included is just the beginning, it's about contributing your voice, growing through challenges, and building trust through shared goals. This philosophy guides how we lead, how we hire, how we communicate, and how we grow. We continuously evaluate to ensure we are creating a consistent experience that cultivates belonging for all employees, from hiring and performance reviews to talent development. We also believe Belonging happens in everyday moments of connection; lunch with a new teammate, a shared laugh, or a quick story about your weekend. Our structure includes biannual employee surveys, manager training, TFD camps, and support from Humans to ensure we're listening and learning from our Team. Together, these efforts reflect what Belonging means at TFD: a culture where everyone can thrive. **A Few of Our Best Benefits** ------------------------------ * Dog\-friendly office in SoHo * Market\-competitive compensation and equity packages * Comprehensive Healthcare, Dental, and Vision * Company supported mental health benefits * 12 week paid parental leave * Competitive 401k plan with company match * Flexible PTO * Discounted fresh food for your pup * Your pet interrupting video calls (and in\-person meetings) is now a feature, not a bug **Equal Employment Opportunity Statement** ------------------------------------------ The Farmer's Dog, Inc. is an equal employment opportunity employer and does not discriminate in hiring on the basis of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic or status. For more information, please visit Know Your Rights. **Reasonable Accommodations** ----------------------------- TFD complies with applicable federal, state, and local disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. If a reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact humansops@thefarmersdog.com. **We're Here to Help** ---------------------- We're happy to answer any questions you may have about the position or our hiring process \- please reach out at careers@thefarmersdog.com.

jobs.title: Sr Cloud Data and AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Details** --------------- Location: Charlotte, NC Category: Data \& Analytics Employment Type: Full time, Hybrid or Remote Job Ref: R2627133\-166 Sr Data Engineer \- GE07BE We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future. The Employer Group Actuarial Service area is seeking a Senior Cloud Data Engineer who combines deep expertise in cloud data engineering with a passion for Artificial Intelligence (AI), automation, and modern data platforms. The ideal candidate will help design and implement scalable data solutions while leveraging emerging AI technologies, intelligent automation, and cloud\-native capabilities to accelerate business insights, operational efficiency, and innovation across Employer Benefits actuarial functions. This position is in a small group that works directly with our customers and prides itself in delivery capabilities. This role offers the opportunity to have a significant bottom\-line impact through the delivery of quality and actionable information to our business customers. The ideal candidate is a highly motivated, results\-oriented individual with strong technical skills and project\-level leadership experience. We are looking for a well\-rounded individual that is comfortable working in a process light environment and willing to cross the traditional role boundaries of developer, BA, Architect and project lead. To be successful in this role you must be comfortable working directly with customers in an iterative fashion to achieve the desired result. As such, strong verbal communication and the ability to create your own technical specifications and designs based on customer needs is critical for success in this role. This role can have a Hybrid or Remote work schedule. Candidates who live near one of our locations will have the expectation of working in an office 3 days a week (Tuesday through Thursday). Candidates who do not live near an office should maintain their current work arrangement with the expectation of coming into the office as business needs arise **Responsibilities**: * Regularly engage in continuing education and serve as a technical expert in Informatica IDMC, Snowflake, AI and Generative AI platforms, cloud\-native data services, CICD tooling, environment management, Oracle, metadata\-driven architectures, and enterprise data quality processes. * Evaluate, prototype, and operationalize emerging AI technologies, including Generative AI, Agentic AI workflows, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), and Model Context Protocol (MCP)\-based integrations. * Design and develop high quality, scalable data solutions to enable pricing and reserving activities for Employer Benefit Actuarial team. * Ability to synthesize, reconcile, and explain data differences between GB actuarial output against other standard published data. * Gain deep understanding on various Actuarial applications, data elements and business process. * Work closely with Actuarial customers during the close of current financial months to provide solutions to time sensitive issues while ensuring strategic solutions are planned for next release cycle. * Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers while fostering collaboration across onshore and offshore teams to deliver innovative, scalable, and sustainable data solutions. Leverage strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to discover, integrate, and optimize data from diverse sources, enabling informed decision\-making and supporting mission\-critical business processes. * Ability to discover, analyze and integrate data from various sources to support decision making and enable critical business processes * Consult with cross\-functional team partners to understand business needs and develop reliable and effective solutions that are easily maintainable. * Ability to work directly with the customers to understand their needs and provide solutions. * Willingness to develop deep functional knowledge in the pricing and rating process. * Develop and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL processes to support Insurance processing, actuarial analysis, and reporting. * Use Enterprise GitHub for version control, documentation, code collaboration, and technical project management. * Research, evaluate, and champion modern data technologies, frameworks, and best practices to drive operational excellence and accelerate data\-driven innovation. Build deep functional knowledge of pricing, rating, and actuarial processes while working within agile delivery frameworks and partnering across organizations to enhance enterprise data assets and capabilities. **Qualifications**: * Bachelor’s degree with at least 7 years of applicable work experience. * Experience in following is required: Snowflake, IDMC, Informatica, Oracle * Hands\-on experience using AI\-assisted engineering tools, Snowflake Cortex and Agentic AI capabilities, Generative AI platforms, Model Context Protocol (MCP), cloud\-based AI services, and intelligent automation frameworks. * Experience building AI\-powered self\-service analytics, intelligent data catalogs, automated reconciliation frameworks, or knowledge management solutions. * Demonstrated passion for continuous learning in Artificial Intelligence, cloud architecture, automation, and emerging technologies. * Experience with CICD, GitHub, Autosys, and SQL * 7\+ years ETL / Data analysis / Warehouse Technologies experience * Strong data warehouse knowledge preferably in the insurance domain, Demonstrated expertise in Data analysis, Data Quality and reconciliation processes. * Group Benefits business knowledge is a plus. * Knowledge of AWS and cloud\-based data solutions is a plus * Strong experience in Python , R and other modern languages, including experience building APIs, automation frameworks, AI\-driven applications, and cloud\-native data services. * Experience in on\-premises to cloud migration of data pipelines, modernizing them to leverage full cloud potential. * Experienced in Agile and Kanban Methodologies **Candidate must be authorized to work in the US without company sponsorship. The company will not support the STEM OPT I\-983 Training Plan endorsement for this position.** **Compensation** The listed annualized base pay range is primarily based on analysis of similar positions in the external market. Actual base pay could vary and may be above or below the listed range based on factors including but not limited to performance, proficiency and demonstration of competencies required for the role. The base pay is just one component of The Hartford’s total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include short\-term or annual bonuses, long\-term incentives, and on\-the\-spot recognition. The annualized base pay range for this role is: $117,200 \- $175,800 Equal Opportunity Employer/Sex/Race/Color/Veterans/Disability/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity or Expression/Religion/Age

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: **How to Apply** ---------------- A cover letter and resume are important submissions for the hiring team to get a sense of your experience. In the cover letter, in two pages or less, please let us know how this role aligns with your career aspirations and skill set. Submit both a cover letter and resume as one file (because of system limitations). **Who We Are** -------------- **About the Center for Academic Innovation** Through curricular innovation, tools for student success, and educational research and analytics, the University of Michigan Center for Academic Innovation is building the future of education. Our vision is a future in which education connects and empowers learners everywhere to reach their full potential throughout their lives. To realize our vision, we make it our mission to collaborate across campus and around the world to create equitable, lifelong educational opportunities for learners everywhere. **About the Technology Infrastructure and Support Team** The TIS team builds and maintains the technology behind CAI's learning, media, and IT work. Our work spans Michigan Online infrastructure, cloud storage, cybersecurity, disaster recovery, studio production, XR, AV systems, media asset management, and internal support. TIS is also home to the AI Enablement Team, which partners with teams across the Center to test promising ideas and turn the ones that work into tools and workflows people can rely on. Working closely with Creative Studios, Operations, and product engineering teams, we keep CAI's systems dependable and secure so learners, faculty, and staff can focus on their work. For more information, please visit our website: Academic Innovation. **Responsibilities\*** ---------------------- * Prototype and test AI\-enabled workflows for CAI projects selected through intake, building lightweight applications, connectors, retrieval pipelines, and automations that integrate with existing CAI systems * Support pilots with domain experts, collect user feedback, diagnose failures, and iterate * Build evaluation datasets, test cases, and repeatable harnesses for quality, reliability, safety, and cost * Implement logging, access controls, guardrails, and operational telemetry in partnership with TIS staff * Establish defined operating work for CAI's local AI server, including model deployment, updates, monitoring, and runbook upkeep * Share practical guidance through demonstrations, office hours, and workshops for staff and student fellows **What You'll Do** ------------------ The Center for Academic Innovation at the University of Michigan is seeking an Applied AI Engineer for a one\-year post\-graduate fellowship focused on practical AI prototyping, evaluation, platform operations, and knowledge transfer. Reporting to the Director of Technology Infrastructure and Support, you will work closely with the AI Enablement Lead and TIS colleagues to build and test AI\-enabled workflows, integrations, evaluation tools, and technical documentation. The successful candidate is a careful builder who can learn quickly, explain tradeoffs clearly, and turn experiments into maintainable, well\-documented assets. You will report to the Director of Technology, Infrastructure and Support. **What makes this fellowship distinctive** You will help operate CAI's dedicated multi\-GPU local AI server and the open\-source software stack that supports it, gaining experience deploying, evaluating, and monitoring models. Projects across the Center will give you a varied portfolio of applications and reusable tools. You will also share your work through demonstrations, office hours, and workshops. The fellowship combines hands\-on delivery, platform operations, and knowledge transfer, with documented project outcomes and a handoff to the next cohort to help build a fellowship alumni community over time. **Required Qualifications\*** ----------------------------- * A bachelor's degree in computer science, information, human\-computer interaction, data science, engineering, learning sciences, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and applied experience, completed by the start date * Hands\-on programming experience in Python, JavaScript, or a comparable language, including experience working with APIs * Experience building applications with large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, structured outputs, agents, or related AI techniques * Experience using Git and working with cloud, container, or modern application\-development environments * Experience designing tests or evaluations and interpreting both quantitative results and user feedback * Working knowledge of software security, privacy, access control, and responsible AI practices * Experience with retrieval\-augmented generation and agent frameworks, experience with evaluation or observability tooling * Ability to learn and appropriately use new technologies to improve processes, communication, and outcomes, including AI\-enabled tools where relevant to the role, consistent with university policy and job responsibilities **Modes of Work** ----------------- Positions that are eligible for hybrid or mobile/remote work mode are at the discretion of the hiring department. Work agreements are reviewed annually at a minimum and are subject to change at any time, and for any reason, throughout the course of employment. Learn more about the work modes. **Additional Information** -------------------------- This is a one\-year term\-limited fellowship with the possibility of annual renewal depending on funding and performance. Candidates must have legal authorization to work in the United States. The mode of work for this position is **Hybrid** with a minimum of 4 days in the office per week, Monday through Thursday, with an option of remote work on Fridays. On occasion, you may be required and must be available to work onsite on Fridays if necessitated by our center's policy and domain leadership or by your job requirements. The salary for this position will be based upon the selected candidate's education and experience. We support the creative, responsible, and ethical use of AI tools to enhance our work, in alignment with institutional policies and best practices. Excellent benefits are available, for details, see http://benefits.umich.edu/. **Salary Information** The general salary range for this position is $85,000 \- $92,000\. Candidates can expect to be paid a competitive and equitable salary. Factors used to determine salary include education level, experience, knowledge and skills for the position and salaries that are currently established within the unit. All candidates are encouraged to discuss salary questions to honor alignment and transparency throughout the recruiting process. **Organizational Statement on Harassment** We believe all individuals deserve to be treated with respect and dignity and have the right to work in a professional atmosphere that promotes mutual respect and a safe space for collaboration. Any concerns shared with any staff members and student employees in the Center for Academic Innovation will be reported to the Equity, Civil Rights, \& Title IX Office to be reviewed and addressed, and the Center for Academic Innovation encourages reporting of any forms of harassment including sexual and gender\-based harassment. **Background Screening** ------------------------ The University of Michigan conducts background checks on all job candidates upon acceptance of a contingent offer and may use a third party administrator to conduct background checks. Background checks will be performed in compliance with the Fair Credit Reporting Act. **Application Deadline** ------------------------ Job openings are posted for a minimum of seven calendar days. The review and selection process may begin as early as the eighth day after posting. This opening may be removed from posting boards and filled any time after the minimum posting period has ended. **Decision Making Process** --------------------------- Applications will be reviewed as received throughout the posting period and continue until the position is filled. **U\-M EEO Statement** ---------------------- The University of Michigan is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. ### **Job Opening ID** 284255 ### **Working Title** Applied AI Engineer ### **Job Title** AI Appl Developer Assoc ### **Work Location** Ann Arbor Campus Ann Arbor, MI ### **Modes of Work** Hybrid ### **Full/Part Time** Full\-Time ### **Regular/Temporary** Regular ### **FLSA Status** Exempt ### **Organizational Group** Vp Acad Innovation ### **Department** Center for Academic Innovation ### **Posting Begin/End Date** 10/13/2026 \- 11/03/2026 ### **Salary** $85,000\.00 \- $92,000\.00 ### **Career Interest** Information Technology

jobs.title: Civil Design Engineer
jobs.description: **Collaborative Design. Technical Excellence. Community Impact.** Are you an aspiring or junior engineer looking to build a versatile foundation in civil design? Thompson \& Litton, an established multi\-disciplined firm serving both public and private sector clientele, has an immediate opening for a **Civil Design Engineer**. Whether you are a recent graduate eager to learn or a professional looking to further develop your design skills, we want a self\-motivated individual to grow within our dynamic team. While we are open to any engineering branch focus, candidates with exposure to or an interest in **water and wastewater design** are highly encouraged to apply. The Role: From Concept to Completion As part of our civil engineering group, you will gain hands\-on exposure to diverse engineering projects, working closely with senior staff to take designs from concept to reality. You will: * **Infrastructure \& Site Design:** Assist in the design and layout of municipal infrastructure, utility networks, or site developments based on project and client needs. * **Engineer Utility \& Water Systems:** Support the design of critical public works infrastructure, including water distribution networks, sanitary sewer systems, water/wastewater treatment components, and pump stations. * **Manage Stormwater \& Drainage:** Assist with grading design, hydraulic calculations, and stormwater management systems (conveyance, storage, and quality controls). * **Conduct Research \& Due Diligence:** Perform site visits and review local, state, and federal regulations, municipal zoning, and development ordinances to ensure project compliance. * **Support Project Delivery:** Perform supporting technical calculations, prepare specifications, develop construction cost estimates, and assist with engineering proposals. What You Bring * **Education:** Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering or a closely related field. * **Licensure:** Engineer\-in\-Training (EIT) designation, or on track to obtain it shortly after hire, is preferred. * **Technical Skills:** Experience with AutoCAD Civil 3D is a strong plus. Any academic coursework, internships, or prior work experience in water and wastewater systems is highly advantageous. * **Communication:** Strong verbal and written communication skills, with a collaborative mindset and an eagerness to learn.
