jobs.title: Sr AI Architect/Engineer
jobs.description: An extraordinarily talented group of individuals work together every day to drive TNS' success, from both professional and personal perspectives. Come join the excellence! **Overview** ------------ Researches, designs, plans, develops and/or evaluates new, advanced network technologies by translating customer requirements or strategic business objectives into final product design. Work typically includes in\-depth assessment of the customer’s networked application needs, providing network modeling and simulation testing, consulting to further clarify needs, and engineering high\-speed technology network transports to deliver application functionality.**Responsibilities** -------------------- **Why this role exists** ======================== TNS is moving from AI governance and foundations into execution. The platform building blocks are in place or underway — Microsoft 365, Copilot, Entra ID, SharePoint, and Anthropic's Claude models via AWS Bedrock. What we don't yet have is a dedicated person who can both **build and operate the secure, production\-grade AI platform that lets AI work safely against our data** *and* **embed with our lines of business to turn that capability into measurable value.** This role does both. You'll be the technical engine and the on\-the\-ground partner who makes AI a productive, trusted tool across the enterprise — and who multiplies that impact by enabling others to build, not just building yourself. **What you'll do** ================== Your time will span two connected halves. **Build and operate the AI platform** ------------------------------------- **Model platform and private hosting.** Own our Claude deployment on AWS Bedrock end to end — model access and versioning, region and data\-residency decisions, provisioned throughput vs. on\-demand, and the private, VPC\-isolated hosting posture that keeps our data inside our boundary and out of third\-party training. Evaluate and manage additional models where they fit, and maintain a routing layer so applications aren't hard\-wired to a single model or provider. **Harness and orchestration management.** Build and maintain the application harness that sits between our users and the models: prompt and context management, tool and function calling, agent orchestration, retrieval pipelines, guardrails and content filtering, caching, and fallback behavior. Own the evaluation harness too — regression suites, quality benchmarks, and the release process that lets us upgrade models without breaking what's in production. **Data connectivity.** Design and build secure, governed connections between AI systems and TNS data — Microsoft 365 and Graph, SharePoint, databases, data warehouses, APIs, and line\-of\-business systems. Own the retrieval architecture, indexing and freshness strategy, and the permission\-trimming that ensures every user sees only what they're entitled to see, with no leakage across boundaries. **Security and access control.** Architect least\-privilege access across identity, network, and data layers — IAM and Entra ID, private networking, encryption and key management, secrets handling, and tenant isolation. Defend against AI\-specific threats: prompt injection, data exfiltration through model outputs, insecure tool use, and over\-permissioned agents. Partner with security and governance so every deployment is auditable and compliant by design, with a full audit trail of prompts, outputs, and data access. **Monitoring and observability.** Instrument the platform for production operations — latency, error rates, throughput and quota headroom, output quality and drift, guardrail trips, and anomalous usage. Build the dashboards and alerting that let us find problems before users do, and the usage telemetry that tells us which solutions are actually delivering value. **Cost management.** Own AI spend as a first\-class engineering concern: token\-level cost attribution by application and line of business, budgets and alerting, model right\-sizing (using the cheapest model that meets the quality bar), prompt caching and context optimization, batch processing where latency allows, and provisioned\-throughput decisions. Produce the chargeback and unit\-economics reporting leadership needs to fund the portfolio with confidence. **Reusable foundations.** Turn all of the above into patterns, templates, and guardrails so each new use case is faster, cheaper, and safer to build than the last. **Ship value with the business (forward\-deployed engineering)** ---------------------------------------------------------------- * Embed directly with teams across our lines of business (Communications, Waypoint, Payments, Corporate/Shared) to identify high\-value AI and automation opportunities. * Prototype quickly, validate with real users, and take the strongest ideas to production. * Drive adoption — measure whether solutions are actually used and delivering value, and iterate until they are. * Enable others: seed and support a networ urable value — reduced cost to serve, shorter cycle times, and volume absorbed without added headcount. * Establish a use\-case intake and prioritization process so demand is triaged by value rather than by who asks loudest. * Deliver AI cost transparency and attribution by application and line of business. * Enable at least one capable AI champion in each line of business. **What you bring (required)** ============================= * Strong software / solutions engineering background with hands\-on experience building and deploying production AI/LLM applications — RAG, agents, tool use, orchestration, and evaluation. * Direct experience with a managed model platform in production; **AWS Bedrock strongly preferred**, along with the surrounding AWS estate (IAM, VPC, KMS, CloudWatch, PrivateLink). * Demonstrated ability to build and operate data connectivity to enterprise systems with permission\-aware retrieval. * Working command of enterprise security and data governance: identity and access, data protection, encryption and key management, and AI\-specific threat models. * Production operations instincts — you instrument what you build, and you've owned the monitoring and on\-call reality of a live system. * Cost discipline: you treat inference spend as an engineering constraint and can show where the money goes. * Genuine business fluency and communication skills — you're comfortable sitting with finance, operations, or sales, understanding their problems, and translating them into solutions. * A demonstrated bias toward shipping and adoption, not just building demos. **Nice to have** ================ * Depth in the Microsoft / Azure ecosystem alongside AWS (Azure AI, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Entra ID, SharePoint / Graph) — our environment spans both. * Experience in a regulated or security\-sensitive industry — payments, telecom, or financial data. * Self\-hosted or fine\-tuned model experience, and a clear view of when it beats a managed API. * Infrastructure\-as\-code and CI/CD for AI systems (Terraform, pipelines, automated evals in the release path). * Change\-management or internal\-consulting experience. * Prior forward\-deployed or customer\-facing engineering experience. **Qualifications** ------------------ **Who you are** =============== The rare blend of builder and partner. You carry the technical depth of a staff engineer and the people instincts of an internal consultant. You're energized by variety — a private\-networking and key\-management problem in the morning, a finance\-team workflow in the afternoon. You measure yourself by value delivered and adopted, not lines of code. You teach and multiply rather than hoard knowledge. And you operate with ownership: when a deployment is struggling or a cost\-line spikes, you own the fix. **How your success is measured** ================================ In short: reduced cost to serve on named processes, use cases shipped and *sustained* in production, adoption across lines of business, champions enabled, platform reliability and cost\-per\-unit\-of\-value, and a clean security and governance record. For this role, we anticipate paying $150,000 \- $250,000 annually. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate’s knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. TNS offers a competitive benefit package including medical and dental coverage, life insurance, paid holidays and vacations, and a 401K plan with company match. If you are passionate about technology, love personal growth and opportunity, come see what TNS is all about! TNS is an equal opportunity employer. TNS evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **SENIOR MACHINE LEARNING ENGINEER IV** At Trilliant Health, we help hospitals and healthcare systems make smarter, data\-driven decisions in an increasingly complex healthcare environment. We build our models with libraries including scikit\-learn, XGBoost, and PyTorch, and our newer LLM\-based systems with LangChain. Our services and internal web applications use FastAPI and NiceGUI, several of them backed by SQLite, and we deploy everything to Azure. decisions across teams * Demonstrated willingness to speak up, challenge assumptions, and advocate for sound technical or modeling decisions. * Experience working collaboratively across engineering and cross\-functional teams **Machine Learning \& Data Science** * Strong understanding of predictive modeling and machine learning techniques * Experience selecting, developing, evaluating, and improving ML models * Understanding of statistics, experimentation, and model evaluation * Experience working with large, complex datasets * Experience developing ML workflows from experimentation through production **Software Engineering** * Strong, hands\-on Python development experience, including writing production\-quality, maintainable, and well\-tested code * Experience developing and maintaining distributed data pipelines * Experience with SQL and relational databases * Experience with CI/CD, Python packaging, and software deployment * Proficiency with Git and modern you. **Why Join Trilliant Health?** You’ll have the opportunity to work at the intersection of healthcare, data, software engineering, and machine learning, building technology that helps healthcare organizations make better decisions. jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI Content Systems
jobs.description: Job Description Software Engineer \- AI Content Systems TrueLearn \| Fully Remote About TrueLearn At TrueLearn, we help medical professionals provide the best possible care for their patients. Our learning science–driven platform supports clinicians at every stage of their careers, from board preparation through continuing education. The work we do touches the people who touch patients — which means every line of code, every model, and every experiment we ship has the potential to ripple outward into better care, better outcomes, and better lives. We are looking for a software engineer to help build the AI\-integrated content system at the center of our next\-generation platform. All TrueLearn content is authored, organized, and validated by learning scientists and practicing clinicians. The system we’re building puts AI to work alongside them, generating, reviewing, and improving content under expert supervision. You’ll own meaningful pieces of that system and its integration into the learning platform. The Role Early, foundational work on a consolidating platform. We're replacing a landscape that grew up in pieces with a single next\-generation system. The decisions made now are the ones everything else will be built on top of. We are building a deeply intelligent, human\-supervised, adaptive learning platform that responds to each learner’s unique needs in real time, empowering them to master their domain. Achieving this visionary goal requires a foundation built on technical excellence and thoughtful engineering, beginning with these essential building blocks: * AI\-forward, full\-stack development. We are building a sophisticated, adaptive engine using TypeScript and Next.js. You’ll be crafting the robust full\-stack architecture that supports high\-velocity AI integration, translating complex learning science into reliable, scalable software. * Editorial workflows as the foundation of intelligence. Our content models aren’t just storage—they are the training ground for our AI. You will design intuitive, structured workflows that allow subject matter experts to collaborate seamlessly with AI, ensuring our system remains both human\-supervised and machine\-ready. * A culture of rapid experimentation. We believe the best path to an adaptive learning future is paved with brave experimentation. You will be encouraged to test new approaches, use AI agents to accelerate velocity, and view failures as essential data points in our journey to build something truly transformative. You’ll own features from design through production and make technical calls within your area. You’ll work alongside senior engineers who will push on your thinking as much as you push on theirs, and on a team where asking questions is a sign of engagement, not a gap. How we work. We build with AI coding agents as partners. Our repo has maintained agent context, a doc\-gardening skill that keeps it current, MCP tooling, and instrumentation to measure whether any of it is actually helping. We expect you to use agents to the fullest in your own work and to bring what you learn back to the team. When you find a bottleneck in how we work, we'd rather you tell us and help fix it than work around it quietly. What You'll Do * Build AI powered features within our established content management framework using TypeScript, React, and Next.js * Design how LLM output is structured, validated, and traced back to its source, so AI\-generated content is something experts can trust and audit * Implement multi\-step editorial workflows that streamline collaboration among a wide and diverse group of experts and alongside AI agents; versions, assignments, revisions, audit trails, etc * Design and implement role\-based permissions across collections, so the right experts can do the right things without a support ticket * Implement and extend WYSIWYG editing capabilities to support manual and automated edits, lineage, and history * Write and review db migrations, and reason about how schema changes land in a system people are actively using * Build and maintain integrations with TrueLearn products, platforms, and AI services. * Work directly with cross\-functional team members. See first\-hand the impact of your work * Investigate ambiguous problems and communicate what you find. The most impactful work starts with curiosity * Notice what's slowing the team down and do something about it. Flaky test, undocumented setup step, a review cycle that keeps stalling. The fix is welcome even when nobody asks * Write tests, review PRs, and prepare design proposals. Ask the naive question that turns out to be the right one What We're Looking For * 4\+ years of professional experience building and shipping web applications, with production experience in TypeScript and React. You've worked on software real users depended on, and you can walk us through what you built and why. (Own the Outcome.) * Engineering discipline that doesn't loosen when the work speeds up. AI to g agents on real work, not just demos. You understand that output quality depends on what the agent knows, so you think about prompting, model context, and how the harness is set up, and you can tell when an agent is confidently wrong. (Lead with Evidence.) * A steep growth curve and the drive behind it. We care more about trajectory than credentials. Tell us about something you taught yourself because the work demanded it, a problem you stayed with longer than was comfortable, or a skill you have now that you didn't a year ago. We're hiring for who you'll be in two years as much as who you are today. (Always Learning.) * A real interest in the users and the mission. Our editors, medical experts, and learners depend on this system every day. The best engineers here get curious about how they work, care about the experience, and notice friction others have accepted as normal. You don't need a healthcare background, but you should care that this work matters. (Help Others Succeed.) * Strong written and verbal communication. On a remote team, writing is the primary currency for building trust. You take ownership of clarity — in PR descriptions, proposals, and updates — and you can facilitate a cross\-functional conversation where everyone leaves aligned, regardless of technical background. * Experience shipping AI features to production. You’ve built product features on top of LLMs that real users depend on, not just prototypes. jobs.description: **Position overview Position title:** Assistant Professor Salary range: The current salary range for this position is $111,400–$163,200 (9\-month academic year salary), however, off\-scale salary and other components of pay, which would yield compensation that is higher than this range, are offered to meet competitive conditions. Anticipated start: 07/01/2027 Review timeline: Not yet provided Application Window **Open date:** October 12, 2026 **Next review date:** Tuesday, Dec 1, 2026 at 11:59pm (Pacific Time) Apply by this date to ensure full consideration by the committee. **Final date:** Tuesday, Dec 1, 2026 at 11:59pm (Pacific Time) Applications will continue to be accepted until this date. Position description **Position Description:** The University of California, Berkeley invites applications for an approved faculty position at the non\-tenured (tenure\-track) Assistant Professor level in the area of AI for Materials. This appointment will start as a 100% Materials Science and Engineering (MSE) appointment, with the appointee joining the Bakar Institute for Digital Materials for the Planet (BIDMaP) in the College of Computing, Data Science, and Society (CDSS) as a member, with access to its collaborative resources and postdoctoral program. It is the intention to move to the position to a 50/50 split appointment between MSE and a future interdisciplinary data science unit if/when established in CDSS, with MSE as the home department. **About the Units:** The MSE department is part of the College of Engineering (COE) and maintains close ties with Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory (LBNL). It advances the understanding and design of materials through an interdisciplinary blend of chemistry, physics, and engineering, pairing rigorous fundamentals with modern, application\-driven approaches. Our key strength is our collaborative, cross\-disciplinary research community, with abundant opportunities for students and collaborators across campus and beyond. BIDMaP is an institute in CDSS, a new college at Berkeley, with the goal of advancing the state\-of\-the\-art in the core of computing, data science, and statistics, while making sustained progress on issues of human and societal significance. BIDMaP advances the synthesis, design, and translation of innovative materials aimed at mitigating critical global challenges. jobs.title: IT Technician 5 - User Services
jobs.description: The University of Nevada, Reno (UNR) appreciates your interest in employment at our growing institution. We want your application process to go smoothly and quickly. Final applications must be submitted prior to the close of the recruitment. If you need assistance or have questions regarding the application process, please contact our recruitment helpline at (775\) 784\-1495 or jobs@unr.edu . **Job Description** The University of Nevada, Reno is recruiting for an IT Technician 5 position within the Office of Information Technology (OIT) – User Services. \*\*This position does not provide layoff rights and is contingent upon funding.\*\* The technician will work as a member of the Endpoint Services unit and will be responsible for supporting and managing endpoint devices across the University’s central campus and offsite locations. This includes the deployment, configuration, maintenance, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management of OIT\-managed computing devices and peripherals, including computers, laptops, printers, and other related technologies. Responsibilities may include troubleshooting hardware, software, and operating system issues; installing and configuring software; managing endpoint connectivity and peripheral devices; and supporting applications such as Microsoft Office, Adobe Creative Cloud, ESRI, Autodesk, and other enterprise technologies. This position is called upon to transport equipment to various physical locations, work on a bench in the shop area, and perform on\-site repairs when possible. Duties also include evaluating and recommending replacement parts and hardware upgrades for institutionally owned equipment; performing equipment relocations, replacements, and modifications; deploying new endpoint devices using established imaging, configuration, and management processes; coordinating deployments with department personnel; performing data transfers in accordance with University, OIT, and departmental data security requirements; and advising departments on University\-approved surplus procedures to ensure the secure disposition of institutional data and equipment. The position also supports device lifecycle management activities and shared computing environments, including instructional labs, classrooms, and other institutional technology spaces. **Essential Qualifications** * Graduation from high school or equivalent education and two (2\) years of IT work experience in the installation, maintenance, and repair of network workstation hardware and software; **OR** * One (1\) year of relevant experience as an IT Technician 4 in Nevada State service; **OR** A n equivalent combination of education and experience as described above. * A valid Class “C” driver’s license or higher operator’s license is required at the time of appointment and as a condition of continuing employment. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Microsoft Intune (Endpoint Manager), Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (formerly SCCM), JAMF, Active Directory, Group Policy Management (GPMC), DeepFreeze, and LabStats. * Experience deploying, managing, and troubleshooting Windows endpoint devices in an enterprise environment, including PowerShell scripting and automation to support deployment, configuration, reporting, and operational efficiency. * Experience with operating system deployment, software packaging, endpoint security practices, and device lifecycle management. Experience supporting large\-scale endpoint environments, including shared computing labs, classrooms, and other institutional technology spaces. * **Schedule** The typical work schedule is Monday through Friday from 8:00 am to 5:00 pm; this is subject to change based on organizational needs. **Compensation Grade** Grade 34 (Entry: Step 01 $30\.16/hr. \- Step 05 $35\.81\) In classified service, salary is in Grade and Step. Salary placement above a Step 01 at initial appointment is determined based on the recruitment, the candidate’s qualifications, internal equity and budgets. A request to accelerate salary must be approved by Human Resources and abide by the Nevada Administrative Code. To view the classified compensation schedules, please visit: Classified Compensation . Select Salary schedule, PP01\. I’m completely secure and confident that my retirement will always be there for me.” – Robin F. Rich retirement plan \- Retirement Calculator * **Perks of Working at future powered by knowledge. Founded in 1874 as Nevada’s original land\-grant university, the University serves more than 23,000 undergraduate and graduate students from all 50 states and 63 countries. Classified by the Carnegie® Classification of Institutions of Higher Education as an R1 (“Very High Research”) university, it is also recognized in the Carnegie® Community Engagement classification. The University is also ranked by U.S. News \& World Report among the “Best National Universities” and “Best National Public Universities.” It also ranks in the top tier of the WSJ/Times Higher Education World University Rankings and the New York Times’ “Top Colleges for Economic Diversity.” Since 2009, nearly $1 billion has been has invested in advanced labs, facilities, and residence halls on the main campus. The University is home to Nevada’s first medical school – the University of Nevada, Reno School of Medicine and the Wayne L. Prim Campus at Lake Tahoe, where education, research, and creative work thrive in a stunning mountain setting. The University delivers on its original land\-grant mission with outreach across the state through the University of Nevada, Reno Extension, Nevada Agricultural Experiment Station, Nevada Bureau of Mines and Geology, Nevada Small Business Development Center, the Nevada Seismological Laboratory, and Wolf Pack Athletics. The main campus is in Reno, Nevada, a burgeoning global technology hub with a vibrant midtown and downtown. Found where the high desert of the Great Basin meets the High Sierra and Lake Tahoe, the beautiful, 290\-acre main campus is also a Nevada State Arboretum. The University’s physical infrastructure is expanding with ongoing construction of the newly named John Tullock Business Building, set to open in fall 2025\. Collaborating with world\-renowned organizations, the University fosters innovation through initiatives such as the Digital Wolf Pack partnership with Apple, which ensures equitable access to technology for students, providing new incoming freshman or transfer students with an iPad Air and accessories. Google’s TechWise initiate is an 18\-month program that fully supports undergraduate students in becoming entry\-level software engineers by graduation. In 2023, the U.S. Department of Commerce’s Economic Development Administration (EDA) announced that Nevada – led by the University of Nevada, Reno – was named one of the inaugural 31 Regional Technology and Innovation Hubs (TechHubs). Nevada was selected from a competitive pool of 489 applicants from across the United States and its territories. Nevada’s Tech Hub will strengthen America’s lithium batteries, critical elements and other electric vehicle materials industry sectors within the state. Through its commitment to high\-impact education, world\-improving research and creative activity, and outreach that’s transforming Nevada’s communities and businesses, the University continues its 150\-year tradition of benefitting our state, nation and world. The University recognizes that diversity promotes excellence in education and research. The inclusive and engaged community on campus recognizes the added value that students, faculty, and staff from different backgrounds bring to the educational experience. Today, the University delivers on its original land\-grant mission of access to education and knowledge by investing in the academics, facilities, support, engagement and vibrant campus life that promote our diverse students’ cognitive growth and academic achievement – all while remaining one of the best values in American higher education. For more information, please visit the University’s website . **University of Nevada, Reno** ------------------------------

jobs.description: **About Upstart** At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence. As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress. We’re proudly digital\-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80\+ cities in the US and Canada. The team builds and evolves the common systems used to translate underwriting insights into accurate risk and profitability decisions for every loan we originate, while enabling a seamless borrower experience across products. As a **Senior Software Engineer on Core Pricing**, you will design and build scalable, reliable systems that power pricing decisions across Upstart’s products. In close partnership with engineering, data science, product, and business teams, you will own meaningful technical projects, improve the architecture and reliability of our pricing services, and help translate complex modeling and business requirements into durable software capabilities. **How you’ll make an impact** * Design, build, and evolve high\-performance, real\-time pricing systems that iteration. * Partner with data scientists, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate modeling and business requirements into reliable software solutions. * Identify and implement architectural improvements that increase the flexibility, maintainability, observability, and resilience of pricing services. * Contribute to technical standards for system design, testing, monitoring, and operational excellence within the Core Pricing team. * Support other engineers through design reviews, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing while contributing to sound technical decisions across the team. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, or its equivalent, plus **4 years of software engineering experience**. * Experience writing production software in Python and working with Java, Kotlin, or another strongly typed programming language. * Experience designing, building, and operating scalable production. * Experience building production systems with requirements related to scalability, latency, reliability, or correctness. **Preferred Qualifications** * Knowledge of fintech, financial systems, financial mathematics, statistics, machine learning platforms, or decisioning systems. * Experience working on business\-critical systems that affect revenue, profitability, risk, or core product outcomes. * Experience with distributed systems, cloud\-native architecture, platform engineering, continuous integration and deployment, or infrastructure as code. * Experience partnering with data science and product teams to productionize models, decisioning logic, or experimentation capabilities. * Ability to work effectively across engineering and non\-engineering teams on technically complex initiatives. **Position location** This role is available in the following locations: Remote **Time zone requirements** The team operates on the East/West coast time zones. jobs.title: Senior Information Systems Technology Management
jobs.description: Overview: Byte Systems, a subsidiary of VTG, is seeking Senior Information Systems Technology Asset Management. The Senior Information Systems Technology Asset Management is responsible for the planning, coordination, governance, documentation, procurement, financial management, and lifecycle management of enterprise IT Infrastructure assets across a large, complex on\-premises environment. This position serves as the central coordination point between Infrastructure Engineering Teams, Finance Officer, Enterprise Procurement Team, Leadership, and external vendors to ensure technology assets are properly planned, acquired, tracked, maintained, supported, and retired throughout their lifecycle. The enterprise environment consists of thousands of technology assets spanning multiple infrastructure domains, including network, storage, data platforms, operating systems platforms (e.g., Linux \& Windows), databases (e.g., Oracle), web services, software licenses, and vendor maintenance agreements contracts from multiple IT vendors. This is a senior enterprise\-level IT Asset Management position that integrates technical infrastructure knowledge with IT asset lifecycle governance, procurement coordination, financial procurement planning, vendor management, and project management to support a mission\-critical infrastructure environment. The role requires an understanding of enterprise infrastructure technologies to effectively collaborate with infrastructure engineering teams while applying sound business, financial, and operational practices to support executive leadership, procurement, finance, and long\-term technology planning. The successful candidate will possess exceptional organizational skills, meticulous attention to detail, strong analytical and project management capabilities, excellent communication and relationship management skills, and the ability to coordinate multiple concurrent initiatives while ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and compliance of enterprise IT asset records, financial plans, procurement activities, lifecycle documentation, and technology refresh strategies. This position plats a critical role in enabling informed business decisions, optimizing technology investments, minimizing operational risk, and ensuring the long\-term sustainability of the organization’s IT infrastructure. jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer
jobs.description: Valence has built the only AI native coaching platform for enterprise, offering personalized, expert, and human\-like guidance and support to any leader or employee. We’re not just talking about the future of work — we’re building it now, with the most innovative Fortune 500 companies across healthcare, financial services, manufacturing, and technology. Learn more about our work with Microsoft: Valence Brings AI Coaching More Deeply Into the Flow of Work with Microsoft 365 Our focus is on the problems that actually decide whether AI changes how organizations operate — the ones with no playbook, no obvious answers, and no guarantee of success. If you want to be part of the small group that defines how AI transforms the future at a global scale, this is your chance. And this isn’t for everyone. We’re not looking for people who want predictability or incremental progress. We only want those who are restless at the edge of what’s possible, who get bored when things feel “done,” and who are driven to redefine what AI can mean for leaders, companies, and the world. Because at Valence, the work worth doing is the kind that redefines work itself. **The Role** ------------ As a Senior/Staff Product Engineer, you will be instrumental in architecting, building, and scaling both backend systems and user\-facing experiences that power our LLM\-driven coaching platform. You will ship features end\-to\-end \- from designing resilient APIs and integrating models to delivering polished interfaces in the browser \- while collaborating closely with cross\-functional partners in product, design, and infrastructure. This is a *ground\-floor opportunity* to shape a category\-defining product used by enterprise customers worldwide. You’ll contribute to: * Full stack architecture, development, and optimization of features spanning backend, AI/model integration, and frontend interfaces. * Designing for scale, performance, and security in enterprise environments. * Debugging across the stack \- from model behavior and backend services to UI logic and client performance. * Collaborating with product, design, and operations to deliver delightful, resilient user experiences. * Helping evolve the engineering culture, tooling, hiring, and technical roadmap as the team grows. **About Valence** ----------------- We're the only company pioneering leadership coaching for large enterprises in an AI\-first way. Our mission is to transform how the world's biggest companies approach learning and development, helping teams work better together through AI\-powered personalization that adapts to individual goals and organizational culture using the latest advances in machine learning and natural language processing. We've been featured in Harvard Business Review, TIME, World Economic Forum, Financial Times, Forbes and an Inc. 5000 fastest\-growing private companies in America. Our clients represent the most diverse and sophisticated enterprise AI implementations globally, including Coca\-Cola, Delta, Nestlé, General Mills, Schneider Electric, Deutsche Telekom, AstraZeneca, Prudential, CVS and Bristol Myers Squibb. Working at Valence means you'll work directly with Fortune 500 technology leaders, building expertise through the most complex enterprise deployments while gaining insight into diverse organizational approaches to AI transformation. These aren't just any enterprise clients \- they're the companies defining what AI\-first business transformation looks like across every major industry. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Build and extend critical backend services:** architect APIs, integrate LLMs and related services, and optimize server\-side systems for performance and reliability. * **Develop polished frontend experiences:** craft intuitive UI flows, ensure accessibility and responsiveness, and manage data flow between frontend and backend. * **Own end\-to\-end delivery:** from scoping requirements, writing tests, deploying code, to monitoring and observability in production. * **Collaborate deeply:** work across product, design, data, and infrastructure to solve real user problems and accelerate delivery. * **Drive best practices:** help shape engineering standards, CI/CD automation, observability, and performance benchmarking. * **Mentor and grow:** support team members through code reviews, technical discussions, and institution of scalable practices. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * **Strong full stack experience:** you have shipped production\-grade systems involving both backend and frontend components, and you’re comfortable owning APIs and user experiences end\-to\-end. * **Technical breadth/ Engineering skills:** deep proficiency with Python (Django preferred) or similar languages for backend; strong JavaScript skills and familiarity with modern frameworks (e.g., React, Vue). * **Frontend craftsmanship/ UX obsessed:** experience building responsive, high\-performance UI with attention to usability an , performance, security, and maintainability in large, distributed environments. * **Builder at Heart:** you’ve architected and shipped production\-grade, user\-facing systems. You balance polish with speed, knowing when to prioritize craftsmanship and when to push scrappy experiments to learn fast. * **Versatility and pragmatism:** you balance sound architectural decisions with a willingness to prototype and iterate quickly when needed. * **Customer\-Centered \& Product\-Focused:** you care as much about usability, accessibility, and adoption as you do about code quality. You think beyond “does it work” to “does it work for the user, at scale, and in enterprise environments.” * **Startup fluent:** you thrive in ambiguity, value momentum over perfection, and enjoy wearing multiple hats. **What You'll Get** ------------------- **Ownership \& Rapid Growth** * Outsized missions from day one, with direct responsibility for company\-defining projects * Work alongside the executive team with transparency into strategy and decision\-making * Influence on direction through real\-time customer feedback and market insights **AI\-First Operator** * Work directly with cutting\-edge AI models and next\-generation platforms * Build expertise in enterprise AI implementation across Fortune 500 companies and multiple industries * Establish yourself as a recognized leader among peers in shaping how AI transforms work at a global scale **Compensation** * Competitive salary including base \+ bonuses * Comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental, vision) from day one * Generous PTO, company\-wide R\&R shutdowns, and paid parental leave * Retirement plan support for US and global employees **Equity** * Meaningful ownership in a venture\-backed company at a growth inflection point * Financial upside that comes from scaling fast * Top\-up grants as we scale and you deliver exceptional performance — your compensation grows alongside your impact **Top\-Performing Culture** * A culture built for top talent: intensity to win, growth without limits, and a team that solves hard problems and celebrates big wins together **Learn more about us and meet our team** **here** **Location and Work Environment** --------------------------------- This role can be either remote or hybrid from our offices in New York or Toronto. Candidates must be comfortable working with colleagues in different time zones (UK), and have valid travel documents without work authorization restrictions in the US. **Diversity and Inclusion** --------------------------- We are dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and supported. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and offer accommodations upon request throughout the hiring process. If you have any questions, please reach out to Allison Langille, Head of People, at jobs@valence.co. **Employment Verification \& Commitment** ----------------------------------------- We use third\-party services to verify employment history, education, and other information relevant to your candidacy. Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of these verification checks. This is a full\-time role that requires a high level of focus, availability, and commitment. Employees may not hold concurrent full\-time employment with another organization while employed at Valence. Any outside consulting, advisory, freelance, or other professional work must be disclosed and approved in advance and must not interfere with job responsibilities, availability, performance, or create a conflict of interest \- including risks related to confidentiality, intellectual property, or competition. *Valence takes candidate fraud seriously. We verify identity, LinkedIn profiles, employment history, and references; any misrepresentation during the hiring process is grounds for withdrawing an offer or ending employment. All offers are contingent on successful completion of these checks.* \#LI\-Hybrid

jobs.title: IT Infrastructure Engineer, NA
jobs.description: **About Vantage** ================= Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well\-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands. **Technology \& Systems Department** ------------------------------------ The Technology \& Systems department drives technological innovation for the company and advances the technology strategy to support global growth. This includes IT, Software Development, OT / Automation Systems, and business process improvement. At Vantage, we are very hands\-on. In most cases, we specify, purchase, configure, and maintain all networking and server hardware. We also work closely with partner VARs to learn about the latest technology changes, so we can make informed purchase decisions. The Technology \& Systems department participates in designing each of our new data center building’s networking infrastructure, including but not limited to diverse pathways connecting to carriers, meet\-me room hosting (rack, cabs, ladders, cross\-connect panels…), wireless AP coverage, etc. We rely on extreme collaboration with Sales, Construction, Operations, and Corporate Functions to drive simplification and establish global standards with continuous improvement and speed to value. We are working to build a reliable, scalable, sustainable, and secure technology roadmap/landscape that enables us to serve our customers and employees better and be the partner of choice. Our focus is on speed to value with financial and execution discipline. **Position Overview** --------------------- **This role will be based onsite in Port Washington, WI.** The IT Infrastructure Engineer is a hands\-on infrastructure professional responsible for supporting the deployment, implementation, operational readiness, and ongoing support of IT infrastructure at Vantage Data Centers' Lighthouse campus in Port Washington, Wisconsin. Working closely with Construction, Operations, Engineering, Security, and Technology \& Systems teams, this role helps ensure IT infrastructure, networking, telecommunications, security systems, and building management systems are procured, delivered, installed, tested, documented, and ready to support commissioning and turnover activities. This position serves as a key on\-site representative for Vantage, coordinating vendors, managing inventory, supporting RFIs, tracking project deliverables, conducting quality assurance reviews, assisting with technical deployments, and maintaining alignment between multiple stakeholders. The ideal candidate combines foundational infrastructure knowledge with strong organizational, communication, customer service, and project coordination skills. The role operates within established standards, deployment processes, and service management frameworks to support the successful delivery and long\-term operation of one of Vantage's largest North American campuses. **Essential Job Functions** --------------------------- * Serve as the primary on\-site IT Infrastructure representative supporting deployment, implementation, and operational readiness activities across the Lighthouse campus. * Coordinate with Construction, Operations, Engineering, Security, vendors, contractors, and customers to ensure infrastructure deliverables remain aligned with project schedules and readiness milestones. * Support RFIs, site surveys, infrastructure assessments, deployment planning, and technical reporting activities throughout project lifecycles. * Manage IT infrastructure inventory, asset tracking, receiving, staging, deployment status, and lifecycle documentation in accordance with Vantage standards. * Support procurement activities by coordinating equipment ordering, receiving, inventory reconciliation, deployment scheduling, and vendor engagement. * Assist with the installation, configuration, testing, validation, and turnover of network, server, telecommunications, wireless, and related IT infrastructure. * Perform quality assurance and quality control reviews to ensure deployments align with documented standards, requirements, and operational readiness criteria. * Work under limited supervision, both independently and within a team environment. * Manage multiple one\-time and/or ongoing projects. * Respond to safety and emergency situations and maintain a safe and secure work environment. * Frequent contact with employees at all levels of the organization; frequent external contact with vendors. **Duties** ---------- * Coordinate infrastructure deployment activities from procurement through installation, testing, commissioning support, and operational handoff. * Maintain inventory records, deployment tracking, asset databases, and equipment documentation. * Support ven  as CCNA or VCP certification, are preferred. * Successful completion of a background check is required. **Experience** -------------- * Minimum of 2 \- 4 years of experience supporting IT infrastructure, networking, data center operations, systems administration, technology deployments, helpdesk operations, or related technical functions. * Technical knowledge covering Windows Server and Desktop, Active Directory, VMWare vSphere/ESX, Office 365, Firewalls, Security, Storage, Backup Technologies, and Networking. * Experience working within critically important facilities and/or critical infrastructure is preferred. * Experience supporting infrastructure deployment projects, implementation activities, site installations, hardware deployments, or operational readiness programs. * Experience coordinating vendors, contractors, service providers, or multiple stakeholder groups within technical projects. * Experience with ticketing systems, service management processes, inventory management, asset tracking, procurement coordination, or deployment management. * Ability to communicate well in both oral and written reports and presentation skills. * Candidates must possess reliable transportation for reporting to work for shifts or emergencies. * Travel is expected to be less than 20%, occasionally for training purposes. **Physical Demands and Special Requirements** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle, or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop or kneel; talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. **Additional Details** * Salary Range: $90,000\- $105,000 \+ Bonus (this range is based on Colorado market data and may vary in other locations) * This position is eligible for company benefits including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and AD\&D, short and long\-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program that includes company match, and many other additional voluntary benefits. * Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including your qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience and may fall outside of the range shown. \#LI\-Onsite \#LI\-JH1 We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations. Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community. Don't meet all the requirements? Please still apply if you think you are the right person for the position. We are always keen to speak to people who connect with our mission and values. Vantage is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Vantage does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm agencies. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of Vantage. We’ll be accepting applications for at least one week from the date this role is posted. If you're interested, we encourage you to apply soon—we’re excited to find the right person and will keep the role open until we do!

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II
jobs.description: We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer II to provide technical leadership within a collaborative XactRestore product team. Our teams bring together product management, UX, and engineering—including QA—to understand customer problems, discover effective solutions, and deliver measurable results. You’ll lead substantial engineering work, guide technical decisions, and strengthen development practices while sharing accountability for product outcomes with your teammates. You’ll also collaborate with engineering leaders across the Restore division to improve our technical direction and how we build software. You’ll help build reliable capabilities that support customers’ operational needs, including the complexity of enterprise organizations adopting XactRestore across their teams. **Contribute to product discovery and delivery.** Work with product management, UX, and fellow engineers to understand customer problems, explore solutions, and assess technical feasibility. Help the team achieve its intended outcomes through implementation, release, and ongoing improvement. **Lead through technical design and hands\-on development.** Write, review, and troubleshoot production code while guiding sound design decisions. Apply established architectural patterns and development principles, make tradeoffs explicit, and address maintainability, reliability, security, and operational needs. **Drive technical execution with sound judgment.** Break complex work into manageable increments, coordinate dependencies, and identify and address technical risks. Work independently within agreed priorities, helping the product team sequence engineering work and seeking guidance when appropriate. **Strengthen engineering practices and quality.** Work with developers and QA engineers to apply meaningful testing, code review, and release validation. Improve CI/CD and automation practices, using lessons from delivery and production operations to refine how the team works. **Guide responsible use of AI in development.** Apply and improve practices for AI\-assisted and agentic workflows. Ensure appropriate verification and clear boundaries for autonomous work, human guidance, and actions that must stop because they exceed authorized permissions or risk limits. **Use evidence to guide improvement.** Work with the product team and engineering leaders to select meaningful measures, establish baselines, and track improvements or regressions in software quality, reliability, delivery, and customer outcomes. Use findings to guide decisions and assess whether changes achieve their intended benefits. **Contribute to technical leadership across Restore.** Collaborate with engineering leaders on technical direction, shared standards, incident learnings, and build\-versus\-buy decisions. Help evaluate technical debt proposals, determine which improvements to pursue, and prioritize their implementation. Lead agreed engineering initiatives and coordinate adoption across affected teams. **Support production reliability.** Participate in the team’s on\-call rotation and contribute to incident investigation, mitigation, and resolution. Turn operational lessons into improvements to the software and development process. **Develop other engineers.** Provide thoughtful reviews, mentoring, and technical guidance that improve the team’s judgment, independence, and effectiveness. * A four\-year bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field with 7\+ years of related experience. * A record of leading complex, hands\-on engineering work within collaborative product teams, from discovery through delivery and operation. * Strong technical judgment and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to evaluate design options, explain tradeoffs, and manage technical risks. * Experience improving engineering practices and helping other engineers apply them effectively. * Practical judgment in using AI\-assisted development tools, verifying their work, and recognizing when human intervention is required. * Experience using data to assess technical decisions and improvements, or demonstrated analytical judgment with a commitment to developing these practices further. * Clear communication, effective collaboration, and the ability to work independently within agreed priorities. * Accountability for your contributions and the team’s outcomes, with a willingness to surface risks, learn from failures, and improve the approach. **Technical expectations and experience** Strong experience building and operating production applications across the stack is required. Experience with some or all of the following technologies is preferred: **Web:** Angular. **Backend and APIs:** .NET and GraphQL. **Mobile:** React Native and Expo. **Cloud:** AWS. **Databases:** MongoDB and PostgreSQL. We welcome candidates with strong experience in comparable technologies who meet the role’s broader qualifications and are committed to learning our stack. You’ll be expected to develop working proficiency in the technologies needed to contribute across our web, backend, and mobile applications. \#LI\-LM03 \#LI\-Hybrid For over 50 years, Verisk has been the leading data analytics and technology partner to the global insurance industry by delivering value to our clients through expertise and scale. We empower communities and businesses to make better decisions on risk, faster. At Verisk, you'll have the chance to use your voice and build a rewarding career that's as unique as you are, with work flexibility and the support, coaching, and training you need to succeed. For the eighth consecutive year, Verisk is proudly recognized as a Great Place to Work® for outstanding workplace culture in the US, the fourth consecutive year in the UK, Spain, and India, and the second consecutive year in Poland. In addition, we’ve been recognized by The Wall Street Journal as one of the Best\-Managed Companies and by Forbes as a World’s Best Employer, testaments to the value we place on workplace culture. We’re 7,000 people strong. We relentlessly and ethically pursue innovation. And we are looking for people like you to help us translate big data into big ideas. Join us and create an exceptional experience for yourself and a better tomorrow for future generations. **Verisk Businesses** Underwriting Solutions — provides underwriting and rating solutions for auto and property, general liability, and excess and surplus to assess and price risk with speed and precision Claims Solutions — supports end\-to\-end claims handling with analytic and automation tools that streamline workflow, improve claims management, and support better customer experiences Property and Restoration Solutions — offers property estimation software and tools for professionals in estimating all phases of building and repair to make day\-to\-day workflows the most efficient Specialty Business Solutions — provides an integrated suite of software for full end\-to\-end management of insurance and reinsurance business, helping companies manage their businesses through efficiency, flexibility, and data governance Catastrophe and Risk Solutions — provides risk modeling solutions to help individuals, businesses, and society become more resilient to catastrophic events. Marketing Solutions — delivers data and insights to improve the reach, timing,relevance, and compliance of every consumer engagement Life Insurance Solutions – offers end\-to\-end, data insight\-driven core capabilities for carriers, distribution, and direct customers across the entire policy lifecycle of life and annuities for both individual and group. jobs.title: Agentic AI Engineer
jobs.description: ### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. We are seeking an **Agentic AI Engineer** to architect and implement autonomous, multi\-agent workflows that go beyond static text generation. You will be responsible for building reliable agentic systems that interface with enterprise databases, execute real\-world APIs, manage long\-term state, and operate safely within strict performance and governance guardrails. You will be responsible for the following but not limited to: * **Agent Architecture \& Orchestration:** Design stateful, multi\-step agentic workflows using reasoning frameworks (e.g., ReAct, Plan\-and\-Solve, Reflection). * **Tool \& API Integration:** Build reliable execution layers connecting LLMs to external systems via REST APIs, database connectors, and protocol standards like **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**. * **Context \& Memory Management:** Implement short\-term and long\-term memory architectures, state persistency, context window optimization, and hybrid RAG retrieval layers. * **Evaluation \& Guardrails:** Establish offline test sets ("golden sets") and real\-time observability pipelines (using LLM\-as\-a\-judge, trace analysis, and latency/cost monitoring) to prevent hallucinations, infinite loops, and unwanted drift. * **Production Deployment:** Containerize and deploy multi\-agent microservices using scalable async patterns, distributed queues, and fallback mechanisms. **What we’re looking for...** You thrive on creating smart, customer\-centric solutions that simplify user interactions and deliver immediate answers. Your expertise allows you to build secure, scalable AI frameworks using established software engineering practices, ensuring smooth integration with downstream enterprise tools. As a trusted engineer, teams rely on you to navigate challenging obstacles in NLP, AI integration, and search relevance. By combining deep technical proficiency in AI with an analytical, collaborative mindset, you will directly enhance our user journey. **You’ll need to have:** * Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. * Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training. * Experience building **Multi\-Agent Systems** with complex delegation models (human\-in\-the\-loop escalation paths). * Hands\-on experience developing enterprise\-grade agentic workflows, multi\-agent topologies, and task orchestration pipelines using platforms such as **LangGraph**, **Google ADK / CES**, **Sierra**, **Decagon**, or similar * Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) architectures, and generative AI guardrails. **Even better if you have one or more of the following:** * Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field. * Experience in programming in modern languages (Python, Java, NodeJS) for building custom fulfillment webhooks, microservices, and backend APIs. * Experience implementing Vertex AI Search / Enterprise Search, grounding models, custom data store connectors, and tuning search relevance and rankings. * Experience integrating Google AI solutions with non\-Google enterprise architectures via REST/SOAP APIs, pub/sub messaging, and webhook integrations. * Knowledge of contact center integrations (telephony adapters, CRM platforms like Salesforce/Genesys, and live agent hand\-off protocols). If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. ### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. ### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part\-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours. The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full\-time schedule is: $101,000\.00 \- $194,000\.00\.

jobs.title: Mechanical Systems Specialist
jobs.description: **Via Separations** is a Boston\-area startup dedicated to enabling process efficiency and intensification for the industrial sector. In 2024, Via delivered its first commercial facility and changed the narrative around market\-driven energy technologies that drive value for industrial customers. At the intersection of engineering, society, and impact, our team is passionate about making a difference and building the technology and organization to do it. We are a fast\-paced, interdisciplinary team backed by leading venture capital firms, and we are looking to add talented, mission\-driven people to our cohort. We are **passionate** about transformative impact, **optimistic** about scientific progress, and **unafraid** of hard problems. We believe that our people are our unfair advantage, and drive our mission forward. We embrace the diversity of our team for creative solutions and believe the best ideas come from the intersection of disciplines and perspectives. We want you to join us! **Role Description** Via Separations is seeking a Mechanical Systems Specialist to join our Internal Systems group. As the Mechanical Systems Specialist, you will lead the assembly, fabrication, and build\-out of internal test equipment, including test skids and pilot support systems consisting of pumps, controls, piping, valves, instruments, and wiring. You will be responsible for maintaining and troubleshooting existing test skids and assets. This is a hands\-on technical leadership position requiring the ability to read and work from engineering drawings, source and order material, and operate hand and shop tools safely while working around hazardous liquids and gases. This role is based on\-site in Watertown, MA, with primary work in our lab space, and may involve occasional travel to support field\-deployed pilot units. **Responsibilities Include:** **Build \& Assembly** * Assemble and fabricate internal test equipment and skids, including pumps, piping, valves, instrumentation, controls, and electrical/wiring components. * Read and interpret engineering drawings, P\&IDs, and specifications to plan and execute builds accurately. * Order and track material required for builds, coordinating with engineering and procurement to ensure correct specifications and timely delivery. * Use hand tools and shop equipment — including cut\-off saws and pipe threading machines — to fabricate and install piping and structural components. * Lead build sequencing and task assignment for assigned projects, ensuring work meets quality and safety standards. * Support shipping and receiving activities as needed, including building crates and packaging large items and equipment for outgoing freight. * Coordinate with external trades, including electricians, plumbers, and HVAC contractors, to support the installation, maintenance, repair, and upgrade of laboratory equipment and lab facility systems in support of lab test equipment. **Maintenance \& Troubleshooting** * Maintain, inspect, and repair existing test skids and internal systems to keep them in safe, reliable operating condition. * Troubleshoot mechanical, piping, instrumentation, and electrical issues on test equipment, identifying root causes and implementing corrective actions. * Coordinate with process and systems engineers on equipment modifications, upgrades, and recurring issues. **Safety \& Leadership** * Work safely and confidently around hazardous liquids and gases, following all relevant safety protocols and PPE requirements. * Serve as a technical lead for build and maintenance activities, mentoring other colleagues and helping enforce shop safety and quality standards. * Identify and escalate safety concerns, near\-misses, or process deviations promptly. **Required Qualifications:** * 10\+ years of hands\-on experience assembling, fabricating, and maintaining mechanical and piping systems, including pumps, valves, piping, instrumentation, and basic electrical wiring. * Ability to read and work directly from engineering drawings, P\&IDs, and specifications. * Experience using hand tools and shop equipment, including cut\-off saws and pipe threading machines. * Comfortable and safety\-conscious working around hazardous liquids and gases. * Experience ordering or specifying material for fabrication or maintenance work. * Strong troubleshooting skills across mechanical, piping, and basic electrical/controls systems. * Knowledge of reverse osmosis (RO) and high\-pressure system components, operation, and safe handling. * Ability to lead tasks and provide direction to others on a build or maintenance job. * Able to work independently with minimal oversight, prioritizing and managing tasks with sound judgment. * The position requires the use of PPE (eye protection, respirator, etc.) and strict adherence to safety procedures when working with hazardous liquids and gases, pressurized systems, and powered shop equipment. * Candidates must be able to lift up to 50 pounds, undergo background and drug screening, and spend extended periods standing and performing hands\-on mechanical assembly and fabrication tasks. * U.S. work authorization is required for this role. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Prior experience in a lab, industrial test/fabrication, or field equipment deployment environment. * Familiarity with piping codes and material standards (e.g., ASME B31\.3\) and basic instrumentation/controls wiring. * Experience with chemical process equipment or corrosive service materials (e.g., stainless steel, specialty alloys.) **We Offer:** * Competitive compensation package, including equity options * Medical, Dental \& Vision Insurance * Disability \& Life Insurance * 401(k) * 12 weeks paid Family Leave * Flexible PTO * Paid time off for Company holidays * Onsite gym In addition to the base salary range listed above, Via's compensation package includes an annual performance bonus and equity options. Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they believe they can perform every job description task. We are most interested in finding the best candidate for the job, and that candidate may come from a less traditional background. Via may consider an equivalent combination of knowledge, skills, education, and experience to meet minimum qualifications. If you are interested in applying, we encourage you to think broadly about your background and skill set for the role! At Via, we value and prioritize diversity of thought, access, and experiences, and are an equal opportunity employer by choice. We consider all qualified applicants equally for employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, protected veteran status, religion, physical or mental disability, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, or any other basis protected by law, ordinance, or regulation. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
