jobs.title: Data Scientist, Seller Merchant
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ San Francisco, CA; New York, NY; Seattle, WA **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Department** -------------- EngineeringData \& Marketplace Integrity **Compensation** ---------------- * $194K – $215K • Offers Equity The salary or hourly rate range may be inclusive of several levels that would be applicable to the position. Final salary or hourly rate will be based on a number of factors including, level, relevant prior experience, skills, and expertise. This range is only inclusive of base salary or hourly rate, not benefits or equity. **Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!** --------------------------------------------- Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops. As a remote co\-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact. We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the \#1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce. **Role** -------- The Seller Merchant team helps sellers bring inventory onto Whatnot, organize it effectively, and make it easier to sell. That includes products, listings, variants, catalog, taxonomy, inventory creation, seller workflows, and integrations such as Shopify. Our sellers range from someone going live for the first time on their phone to sophisticated merchants managing large inventories across multiple systems. They also operate across very different categories, countries, and selling formats. The right product experience for one seller may be completely wrong for another. As a Data Scientist on Seller Merchant, you'll use data to help us understand those differences and build better products for sellers. Your work will ultimately help sellers become more productive, grow their businesses, and bring more high\-quality supply to the marketplace. You'll: * **Identify and prioritize the highest\-impact opportunities to improve seller success.** Use product analysis, opportunity sizing, and strategic thinking to understand where changes to seller workflows can have the largest impact on activation, inventory creation, selling efficiency, and GMV. * **Design and evaluate experiments across the seller experience.** Partner with Product, Engineering, and Design to turn ambiguous questions into testable hypotheses, define success metrics and guardrails, design rigorous experiments, and translate results into product decisions. * **Develop the analytical frameworks that shape product strategy.** Go beyond answering incoming questions by proactively identifying opportunities, defining new ways to measure seller success, and helping the team decide what to build next. * **Understand how different sellers need different products.** Analyze differences across seller size, maturity, category, country, inventory type, and selling format, and help determine when a single experience works versus when we should build for distinct seller segments. * **Help us make good decisions even when the data isn't perfect.** Supply\-side problems often involve smaller samples, heterogeneous populations, or decisions where data provides important evidence without giving a black\-and\-white answer. You'll apply analytics, causal inference, and other statistical approaches where appropriate, while partnering closely with product leaders to combine evidence with sound judgment. You'll be deeply embedded with the product team, but you'll also have meaningful independence to develop your own hypotheses, challenge existing thinking, and use data to influence where the team invests. **We offer flexibility to work from home or from one of our global office hubs, and we value in\-person time for planning, problem\-solving, and connection. Team members in this role must live within commuting distance of our New York, San Francisco hub.** **You** ------- People who do well at Whatnot tend to be comfortable figuring things out as they go, biased toward action, and genuinely curious about what they're building. They care more about outcomes than credit and stay close to the product and the people using it. As our next Data Scientist, you should have 5\+ years of experience in product data science, analytics, or a closely related field, plus: * A Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Mathematics,  existing approach and built something better rather than copying what was done before. * You've owned outcomes end\-to\-end, not just tasks within a narrow scope. * You've stepped outside your job description to solve a problem because it needed to get done. * You use Whatnot as a buyer or seller and can speak to the product with real context. * You've worked on a marketplace, platform, or product where meaningfully different user groups required different product experiences or analytical approaches. * You've made consequential product recommendations in situations where the data was incomplete, ambiguous, or statistically challenging. **What You'll Get at Whatnot** ------------------------------ * **Compressed career growth.** Short feedback loops, real ownership, and problems no one has solved before mean you learn faster. People regularly say one year here equals three elsewhere, and high performers take on more responsibility quickly. * **Category\-defining work.** Live commerce at this scale has never been done in the West. Your work shapes how an entirely new industry develops. * **Exceptional colleagues.** We're deliberate about talent density. Your coworkers will challenge your thinking, raise your standards, and make you better. * **Real ownership.** You'll be expected to form opinions, influence decisions, and own outcomes \- not just execute a queue of analytical requests. * **Tangible seller impact.** Sellers are the supply side of our marketplace and are building real businesses on Whatnot. Helping them onboard, operate more efficiently, and grow is fundamental to the company's growth. * **Intellectually difficult problems.** Seller data is often heterogeneous, sparse, and deeply tied to real\-world business behavior. The interesting questions rarely reduce to a single metric or obvious experiment. * **AI\-forward tools and workflows.** We invest in modern AI tools and expect them to be part of daily work. The important skill is increasingly not just writing code, but knowing what questions to ask, moving quickly, and recognizing when the output is, or isn't, trustworthy. * **Rewarding collaboration.** The work is challenging, but the people are great and wins get celebrated. **Benefits** ------------ * Generous Holiday and Time off Policy * Health Insurance options including Medical, Dental, Vision * Work From Home Support + Home office setup allowance + Monthly allowance for cell phone and internet * Care benefits + Monthly allowance for wellness + Annual allowance towards Childcare + Lifetime benefit for family planning, such as adoption or fertility expenses * Retirement; 401k offering for Traditional and Roth accounts in the US (employer match up to 4% of base salary) and Pension plans internationally * Monthly allowance to dogfood the app + All Whatnauts are expected to develop a deep understanding of our product. We're passionate about building the best user experience, and all employees are expected to use Whatnot as both a buyer and a seller as part of their job (our dogfooding budget makes this fun and easy!). * Parental Leave + 16 weeks of paid parental leave \+ one month gradual return to work \*company leave allowances run concurrently with country leave requirements which take precedence. **Please note: Whatnot will only contact you through official @whatnot.com email addresses. If you see an email impersonating a Whatnot recruiter, please disregard and report it as spam.** **EOE** ------- Whatnot is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, parental status, disability status, or any other status protected by local law. We believe that our work is better and our company culture is improved when we encourage, support, and respect the different skills and experiences represented within our workforce. Compensation Range: $194K \- $215K

jobs.title: Staff Product Designer
jobs.description: **We are WisdomAI.** *We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity.* WisdomAI builds AI\-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn’t just surface insights — it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context. We’re trusted by companies like Cisco, Patreon, and Rubrik — and we’re just getting started.The problems here are hard, and the expectations are high. Our team is energized by both. If you’re compelled by ambitious problems, high standards, and meaningful ownership, you’ll thrive here. **Design at WisdomAI** WisdomAI is building an AI thinking partner for business — a context\-aware platform that answers questions from your data, builds apps, and powers agents that help run your business. Grounded in the context of your business, it delivers accurate, consistent answers that help people understand what's happening, why it matters, and what to do next. We're building a small, deliberately senior design team: fewer designers, more ownership each. As a Staff Product Designer, you'll set direction for the product experience as a whole, not a single feature: how our core surfaces fit together, how the design system scales with them, and what the craft standard of the company should be. You'll still do the hands\-on work yourself, and you'll make the designers around you better while you do it. You'll work directly with our VP of Design as a hands\-on partner, and as the team grows, there's room for this role to grow with it. Some UX patterns for AI are settling; many aren't. You'll lead on some of AI's most interesting design problems: how answers earn trust, how intelligent analytical agents create value and report back, how a generated app should feel, and how complex analysis becomes clear and actionable through New York Times–caliber data visualization. Part of this job is applying what works, part is inventing what doesn't exist yet, and part is deciding which of those a problem needs. The goal is a thinking partner that helps people make smarter decisions and take smarter actions. It's simple by default, with power one click away. Our product's entire promise is trust — people make real decisions from what we show them. A chart that's technically correct but visually misleading is a failure. An answer that's right but illegible is a failure. Craft isn't decoration at WisdomAI. It's the product working. We work AI\-forward. Exploration often starts in an LLM — clarifying intent, mapping edge cases, pressure\-testing a direction before a single frame exists. We move fluidly between tools like Figma, Paper, Claude, or Cursor. We're not precious about process or toolchain; we optimize for velocity and quality. At the staff level, you'll help define how the team works this way, not only practice it. **What you'll do** * Set the product experience vision across multiple areas, and turn it into a direction the team, PMs, and engineers can build toward. * Take on the most ambiguous, highest\-stakes problems: frame them with customers and leadership, explore the solution space, and carry the work through launch and iteration. * Shape the roadmap alongside product and engineering leadership, using customer insight and design exploration to influence what we build, not only how. * Design the moments where complexity becomes clarity: trustworthy AI answers that range from a single number to deep analysis, data visualizations that make the story clear enough to act on, artifacts from dashboards to apps and presentations, and intelligent analytical agents that work on users' behalf. * Own the coherence of the product. Define the interaction patterns and principles that keep chat, apps, agents, and visualizations feeling like one system. * Lead the evolution of our design system and its foundations, partnering with engineering on how it's built and adopted. * Prototype early and often using AI tools, and set the bar for how the team uses them, sharing prompts, patterns, and process. * Mentor designers through crits, pairing, and direct feedback, and raise the craft standard in what we ship. * Help shape how design works across R\&D: our rituals, our quality bar, and how design partners with product and engineering. * Help grow the team: shape who we hire and the culture they join. * Talk to customers directly. Treat research as a velocity tool, not a gate. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 8\+ years designing exceptional products, ideally in B2B, data, AI, or other complex domains, including time leading work across multiple product areas. * Exceptional visual craft and taste. You notice the 1px things, and you know which ones matter. * Mastery of typography, color, spacing, and hierarchy, with attention to the details that make interfaces feel effortless and hold up in daily use. * A portfolio that shows product vision as well as execution: work where you defined the direction, made complex systems feel simple, and shipped it. * Systems thinking. You design patterns and frameworks that other designers build on, and you can show where your decisions shaped a whole product, not one screen. * A track record of influence without authority. You've changed a roadmap, aligned leadership on a direction, or set a standard a team adopted. * Experience mentoring designers and raising the quality of a team's work. * A strong appetite for designing with AI. Hands\-on experience with LLMs and AI prototyping tools is strongly preferred, along with curiosity about whatever ships next. If you're not there yet but you're hungry to work this way, we want to hear from you. **Nice to haves** ----------------- * You code, or consider yourself one part design engineer — conversant in components, states, and how interfaces get built. * You have deep experience with data visualization, and opinions about it. * You've built or led a design system and know what it takes for shared components to scale. * You've led design on fast\-moving product teams where iteration and momentum win. * You've been an early design hire or helped build a design team from the ground up. * You've managed designers, or you're ready to. \- **Our CRAFT** CRAFT isn’t a list of aspirational values. It’s how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves. **C — Customer trust.** Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust — never the other way around. **R — Relentless on outcomes.** We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn’t the measure — results are. If something isn’t working, we change the approach now. **A — Authenticity.** We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together. **F — First principles, grounded in reality.** We don’t accept “that’s how it’s done.” We strip problems to what’s actually true and build up from there — then validate quickly and let real\-world results decide. **T — Transparency.** We share the why, not just the what. When something can’t be shared, we say so. We’re one team — information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we’re wrong. \- **Equal opportunity employer** WisdomAI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Back End)
jobs.description: Within Wonder, the Robotics team (Spyce) is a core pillar of our innovation strategy. We build the automation solutions that help make Wonder’s 'no\-compromise' promise possible at scale. Our mission is to use robotics to enable incredible variety and culinary authenticity. By reimagining the kitchen environment, we improve the daily experience of our team members and ensure every customer receives a perfect meal, every time. **About The Opportunity** The Infinite Kitchen is the heart of Wonder’s automation future. We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our backend team to build and maintain the "brains" of our automated restaurants. In this role, you will focus on the mission\-critical applications that orchestrate the lifecycle of a customer order and systems that manage a fleet of connected robotic systems across the country. You will work primarily with Elixir and the Phoenix framework to build real\-time distributed systems that bridge the gap between our cloud infrastructure and on\-premise robotics. You will collaborate closely with frontend, robotics, and QA engineers to ship features that directly impact how we feed thousands of customers. **The Impact You Will Make** * Orchestrate the Kitchen: Develop the Elixir applications that manage order processing, store pacing algorithms, and real\-time event handling. * Produce High Quality Software: We are proud of the phenomenal uptime we have on our Infinite Kitchens. The ideal candidate for this role will champion reliability on the Infinite Kitchen product line. * Bridge Cloud and Hardware: Build and maintain robust APIs and WebSocket protocols to communicate between cloud event streams and on\-site Python\-based robotics applications. * Data Integrity \& Performance: Manage and optimize Postgres databases to ensure every order is tracked accurately and processed with minimal latency. * Feature Innovation: Design and implement complex business logic, including order prioritization, B2B features, and store\-level resource management. * Operational Excellence: Participate in the on\-call rotation, a standard responsibility for all Infinite Kitchen engineering roles. **What You Bring to the Table** * 2\+ years of professional software development experience. * Proficiency in Elixir and the Phoenix framework (or significant experience in other functional languages with a desire to master Elixir). * Experience with PostgreSQL and database design. * Strong understanding of real\-time communication (WebSockets, Phoenix Channels) and event\-driven architecture. * Familiarity with building and consuming RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs. * A pragmatic approach to problem\-solving and a passion for building reliable, real\-world systems. ***As a matter of company policy, Wonder does not sponsor applicants for employment visa status for this role.*** This role is based in our Boston office in Charlestown, MA. Our hybrid model requires 3 days a week in the office. That said, many team members choose to come in more often to take advantage of in\-person collaboration and connection. You're welcome—and encouraged—to be in the office up to 5 days a week if it works for you. \#LI\-Hybrid Massachusetts: $139,500 \- $151,000 per year. Wonder uses geographic\-specific salary structures, which means the salary offered may vary depending on where the job is located. The final salary offer will take into account various factors, such as the candidate's skills, education, training, credentials, and experience. **Benefits** The benefits applicable to this role include a competitive compensation package with equity and a 401(k). We also offer a choice of medical, dental, and vision plans, company paid short and long term disability coverage, paid time off including flexible time off for exempt employees, paid vacation for non\-exempt employees, and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable law in addition to paid parental leave, discounted meals and exclusive perks across the Wonder family of brands. Eligibility, effective dates, and available plan options vary by employment classification and location. To learn more about benefits for this role, visit our Careers page here. **A Final Note** At Wonder, we build the best teams by hiring with an objective lens — evaluating people for their potential while championing diversity, equity, and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, marital status, disability, or any other protected class. As part of our commitment to fair and compliant hiring practices, Wonder participates in the federal government's E\-Verify program to confirm employment eligibility. If you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know. **We look forward to hearing from you! We'll contact you via email or text to schedule interviews and share information about your candidacy**.

We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. **About the Team** Agent Factory is where Workday’s next chapter gets built. We’re forming small, senior, cross\-functional AI teams that bring together product leaders, AI engineers, and full\-stack builders to create intelligent agents used by millions of people every day. This is production\-grade AI—deeply embedded into Workday’s platform—not research experiments or maintenance work. Teams own problems end to end, collaborate tightly across disciplines, and use the right tools to solve real customer challenges at global scale. You’ll work at the intersection of AI, platform architecture, and human workflows, with the autonomy to shape how agents reason, act, and scale responsibly. High trust, high expectations, and real impact. Engineering, but brighter. **About the Role** **As an AI Engineer in Agent Factory, you will develop and integrate the intelligent feature layers behind Workday’s next generation of AI agents. While our ML Engineers focus on building, training, and optimizing foundational algorithms, your mission is intelligence orchestration and product delivery—connecting the brain to the product.** ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Working within a collaborative, cross\-functional pod, you’ll implement how pre\-trained foundational models (LLMs, vision APIs, etc.) power functional, user\-facing enterprise software. You will be hands\-on with building Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, managing orchestration frameworks, and continuous prompt engineering. This role sits at the intersection of AI application building and software engineering: you will work closely with senior engineers, product managers, and designers to turn cutting\-edge agentic workflows into highly responsive, reliable, and user\-centric features embedded directly into the Workday stack. **About You** **About You** **Basic Qualifications** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a solid track record of developing, testing, and deploying production code. * 1\+ years of professional experience (or a strong, demonstrable portfolio of applied project work) working with Large Language Models (LLMs), foundational models, or modern AI APIs. * Demonstrated experience working with AI orchestration concepts (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar tooling) and a strong foundation in prompt engineering to build functional LLM\-powered features. * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience with API integration, backend application development, and managing data pipelines. * 2\+ years of experience working with core development languages (such as Python) and handling modern software engineering workflows (CI/CD, testing frameworks, and version control). **Other Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree (Master’s preferred) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or an equivalent technical field. * Product \& Application Focus: A strong interest in user experience and a passion for applying AI capabilities to solve practical, real\-world customer problems. * Hands\-on Orchestration: Familiarity with AI orchestration concepts, vector databases, semantic search, and prompt optimization techniques. * Data Fluency: Experienced in handling data exploration, transformation, and integrating varied data sources to contextually ground AI outputs. * Agile Collaboration: Proven ability to thrive in a team environment, collaborating closely with software developers, product managers, and UX designers. Curiosity \& Growth Mindset: Eagerness to stay up to date with the rapid advancements in generative AI, autonomous agents, and LLM application design. * **Workday Pay Transparency Statement** The annualized base salary ranges for the primary location and any additional locations are listed below. jobs.description: **XPRIZE Overview** XPRIZE is an established global leader in designing and executing large\-scale competitions to solve humanity’s greatest challenges. As a 501(c)3, our unique model democratizes innovation by incentivizing crowd\-sourced, scientifically viable solutions to create a more equitable and abundant future for all. jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description: St. George, UT Full\-time Posted 2026\-10\-13 Zonos is the AI operating system for cross\-border trade, powering everything from checkout to customs clearance for more than 50,000 ecommerce merchants and 70\+ postal operators across 200\+ countries. We help businesses grow globally by removing the complexity of international commerce—calculating, collecting, and guaranteeing duties, taxes, and fees at checkout so shoppers see the true total cost upfront, eliminating surprise charges at delivery and the burden of managing country\-specific tax requirements. Beyond ecommerce, Zonos supports carriers, postal operators, marketplaces, and customs agencies with AI\-driven tools that infer and validate key customs data, including HS codes, country of origin, and customs value, alongside licensed customs brokerage services that ensure goods move compliantly and efficiently across borders. ### **Overview** Behind almost every part of that is a data problem. Inferring an HS code from a messy product title, estimating customs value, deciding when an answer is confident enough to guarantee, spotting the shipments that need a human, and pricing risk across 200\+ countries all have real financial and regulatory consequences. We're hiring a data scientist who solves problems and ships the solution. Sometimes that's a fine\-tuned LLM. Sometimes it's a Bayesian model, a well\-designed experiment, an optimization, a simulation, or a 30\-line rule that beats everything else. We want someone with the whole toolbelt and the judgment to pick the right tool. Cleverness for its own sake doesn't interest us. You'll report directly to our Chief Data Scientist and work side by side with engineering, taking problems from "fuzzy and important" to something running in production that customers rely on. ### **How we work** Zonos doesn't have product managers. At the senior level, you talk to customers and internal teams directly, understand the problem, decide what's worth solving and how, and ship it. Part of the job is judgment: pushing back, proposing a simpler approach, or saying the data doesn't support the decision. Disagreements get resolved quickly and in writing, with clear owners. ### **Life in St. George UT** This role is on\-site at our headquarters in St. George, Utah, where our team enjoys Southern Utah's 300 days of sunshine each year. Snow Canyon State Park is minutes away, Zion National Park is about an hour's drive, and Las Vegas is about two. Relocation assistance is available for candidates moving here. ### **What you'll do** * Own data problems at the heart of the product, such as classification, valuation, risk, and compliance. Choose the approach, whether that's statistical modeling, classical ML, deep learning and LLMs, optimization, or a simple rule. * Work with messy, multilingual product and shipment data. Figure out what it actually says before modeling anything. * Quantify uncertainty and make it useful. Decide when we're confident enough to act, when to route work to a human, and what each error costs. * Design the evaluations, experiments, and analyses that tell us whether something actually worked, and hold the line when it didn't. * Write production\-quality Python and SQL, then ship, monitor, and iterate on what you build. * Join the on\-call rotation and debug in production, including the subtle failures that only show up on real traffic. * Bring rigor to product and business decisions beyond your own projects. ### **You might be a great fit if you...** * **Reach for the right tool, not the newest one.** You can explain why you chose a GLM over a transformer, or a heuristic over both, and tell us how it played out. * **Own the full loop.** You've framed a problem, built the solution, shipped it, and stayed with it after launch. * **Can point to impact.** You've shipped work that moved a real metric, and you can tell us which one and how you measured it. * **Write code engineers are happy to merge.** You explore in notebooks, and you ship clean, tested code. * **Lead with product judgment.** You ask "should we solve this?" before "how do we solve this?" * Want to live and work in sunny St. George, Utah, with a real work\-life balance. * You also bring: + 5\+ years of hands\-on data science work with a Bachelor's degree, or 3\+ years with a Master's or PhD, including things you built that ran in production. + Real depth in statistics: inference, experimental design, and uncertainty. You understand what the numbers mean, not just how to produce them. + Practical experience with ML and LLMs/NLP, including fine\-tuning, embeddings, evaluation, and text classification at scale. + Strong Python and SQL. * Nice to have: optimization or operations research, causal inference, forecasting, Bayesian methods, serving models on GPUs, and experience with trade, customs, logistics, ecommerce, or payments data. ### **What we offer** * **Compensation:** $200,000–$275,000 annual base salary, depending on experience and demonstrated impact. If your compensation expectations fall outside this range, we'd still love to hear from you. We're focused on finding the right person and are willing to be flexible for exceptional talent. * Relocation assistance is available for candidates relocating to St. George, Utah. * Medical, Dental, Vision, \& Life \- we pay 100% of the employee premium! * Paid parental leave and other life event leave * 401k retirement plan with generous company match * 4 weeks of vacation, plus sick and other paid time off. Take some time to relax! * Employee Assistance Program * 1 month paid time off at 5 year anniversary * Office stocked with snacks and drinks * Weekly company lunch **Ready to Join the Team?** --------------------------- Become a Zonut and help us create trust in global trade. We're building something meaningful—a company that puts people first and makes cross\-border commerce accessible to everyone. If you're passionate about solving complex challenges with cutting\-edge technology, we'd love to meet you.

jobs.description: **About Zoox** Zoox is an autonomous ride\-hailing company building the world's first purpose\-built robotaxi — fully electric, bidirectional, with no steering wheel or driver's seat. Backed by Amazon and founded to make transportation safer, cleaner, and more accessible, Zoox designs its vehicles entirely around the rider. We're currently operating in Las Vegas and San Francisco, with Austin and Miami on the horizon, and testing underway across seven U.S. markets. **About Our Part\-Time Student Worker Program** Zoox's part\-time student worker program puts you at the center of one of the most ambitious challenges in transportation. supporting the end\-to\-end validation pipeline for AI tools: maintaining test datasets, running benchmarks, and measuring agent accuracy across routing decisions, classification labels, and structured output fields. ### **Responsibilities** * Run and maintain the benchmark pipeline, analyzing results to identify routing errors and regressions across agent variants * Build and expand ground truth datasets used to evaluate agent outputs against known\-correct answers * Identify and address gaps in benchmark validation and support building a more comprehensive evaluation infrastructure to improve validation prior to release * Develop new evaluation dimensions such as label accuracy and structured output correctness beyond the existing team classification benchmarks * Investigate failure modes in agent outputs and work with engineers to surface actionable improvements * Write scripts and tooling to automate data collection, result parsing, and metric reporting * Document findings, track benchmark trends over time, and present results to the team ### **Program Requirements** * Currently enrolled in a B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering or a related field * Available to commit to a minimum three\-month assignment * Able to commit to a minimum of 20 hours per week * Able to work on\-site at one of our office locations * Must adhere with Zoox confidentiality requirements, including refraining from using or sharing proprietary company information outside of Zoox, such as in academic research, theses, publications, or presentations ### **Qualifications** * Familiar with Cursor or Claude * Familiar with Python * Familiar with evaluation concepts: precision, recall, F1 score, and confusion matrices * Comfortable working with structured data (CSV, JSON) * Experience modifying or writing reproducible analysis scripts ### **Bonus Qualifications** * Prior exposure to LLM\-based systems, prompt engineering, or AI agent evaluation * Experience with Jira or Slack (e.g. ticketing systems, messaging apps) **Closing** We want to be transparent: this is not an internship. The hourly rate is as posted, and benefits eligibility is determined by the vendor. **About Zoox** Zoox is developing the first ground\-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. with working knowledge of cloud infrastructure * Low ego, high empathy: you listen to different perspectives, question your assumptions, and use evidence to find the best solutions * High agency: you take initiative, manage priorities, navigate ambiguity, collaborate effectively, and proactively communicate progress, risks, and blockers * Sound judgment about managing sensitive data, access controls, API credentials, and third\-party integrations * Ability to analyze usage, cost, and outcome data and translate findings into practical recommendations to improve AI usage and efficiency * Strong communication skills: clear writing and polished public speaker and presenter The anticipated salary range for this role is between $189,000 \- $221,000, actual starting pay may vary based on a Explain what you learned and recommend which ideas to pursue. Lead the work to turn promising prototypes into reliable production systems that the team can maintain. * **Find and Solve Systemic Problems:** Identify gaps and recurring bottlenecks across our platforms. Trace root causes, weigh alternatives, and make changes that improve performance, reliability, or the team's ability to deliver. Balance longer\-term improvements with current commitments. * **Build Shared Tools:** Develop reusable modules, internal tools, and reference implementations that solve problems across teams. Bring people into decisions early, explain complex work clearly, and document enough context for others to contribute asynchronously. Raise risks promptly and keep agreed follow\-ups moving. * **Coach Engineers and Technical Leads:** Help lead engineers work through architectural decisions and guide their teams. Share your expertise through pairing, design reviews, and practical training. Encourage questions and help engineers develop their own technical judgment. * **Set Engineering Standards:** Use code and design reviews to improve maintainability, testing, and operational reliability across teams. Work with the relevant partners to translate accessibility, security, and privacy requirements into implementation and testing practices. * **Lead AI Use Across the Team:** Build and improve AI workflows for investigation, prototyping, and production work. Define what agents need to know, what they can access, and how their work will be checked. Teach engineers how to direct the agents and review their output. Refine these practices as the team uses them. * **Shape Technical Priorities:** Bring architectural risks and opportunities to engineering and business leaders. Explain the costs, dependencies, and expected benefits of proposed work so leaders can make informed decisions. Help teams plan the work alongside existing commitments. **Qualifications** * **Architecture and Problem Solving:** Experience designing and evolving systems used by multiple teams. Strong understanding of service boundaries, distributed systems, data flow, caching, and failure handling. Ability to investigate unfamiliar systems and make sound decisions with incomplete information. * **JavaScript and TypeScript:** Deep language knowledge and strong experience with React and Next.js, including rendering, state management, asynchronous behavior, and performance trade\-offs. * **Node.js and Backend Systems:** Hands\-on experience building secure APIs, integrating services, and managing asynchronous processing. Ability to diagnose problems across frontend applications and backend systems. * **HTML and CSS:** Strong knowledge of semantic markup, DOM and Web APIs, modular CSS, and responsive layouts. Experience diagnosing browser behavior, rendering issues, and performance bottlenecks. * **CMS and Content Platforms:** Experience with headless CMS architecture, content modeling, and CMS or DAM integrations. Familiarity with platforms such as Contentful, Contentstack, or WordPress, and the trade\-offs in how content is stored and delivered. * **Cloud Infrastructure and Tooling:** Expertise with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and observability. Ability to evaluate deployment approaches and build tooling that improves development and production support. * **Accessibility and Quality:** Strong understanding of accessible UI patterns, including keyboard navigation, focus management, and assistive technology testing. Experience defining testing strategies and diagnosing performance and reliability problems in production. * **AI Engineering and Automation:** Extensive hands\-on experience with coding agents, LLM APIs, and automated engineering workflows. Understand how context, tools, and model limitations affect results. Judge when to give agents autonomy, when to intervene, and how to verify their work through tests and code review. Choose models and manage context to balance quality, speed, and cost. * **Technical Communication:** Ability to represent engineering in discussions with senior leaders, up to and including the C\-suite. Explain recommendations in terms of business impact, cost, and timelines. Adjust the level of detail to the audience, answer questions directly, and be clear about trade\-offs and uncertainty. Write useful documentation and give and receive constructive feedback. **Additional Information** **Please note this is a hybrid role with onsite expectations of 3x/week (Tues \- Thurs) from our office locations in either of the following: San Mateo, CA, Bellevue, WA, or Boston, MA.** The annual base salary range for this position is **$ 192,000\- $237,000\.** This role is also eligible for a target bonus. Compensation is based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to location, experience, job\-related skills, and level. Freshworks offers multiple options for dental, medical, vision, disability, and life insurance. Equity \+ ESPP, flexible PTO, flexible spending, commuter benefits, and wellness benefits are also offered. Freshworks also offers adoption and parental leave benefits. At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**
